        assert!(m("colou?r", "color"));
        assert!(m("colou?r", "colour"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn negated_class_and_escape() {
        assert!(m("[^0-9]+", "abc"));
        // 非锚定搜索：abc123 含非数字前缀 abc，属命中。
        assert!(m("[^0-9]+", "abc123"));
        assert!(m("a\\*b", "a*b literal"));
        assert!(!m("a\\*b", "axb"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn char_class_ranges_and_literal_brackets() {
        assert!(m("[a-cx-z]", "y"));
        assert!(!m("[a-cx-z]", "d"));
        assert!(m("[]a]+", "]]]"));
        assert!(m("[-x]+", "---"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_patterns_rejected_with_subset_hint() {
        let e = parse("a||b").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.contains("empty"), "{e}");
        let e2 = parse("a|").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e2.contains("empty"), "{e2}");
        let e3 = parse("[abc").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e3.contains("unterminated"), "{e3}");
        let e4 = parse("a**").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e4.contains("no operand"), "{e4}");
        let e5 = parse("").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e5.contains("must not be empty"), "{e5}");
        let e6 = parse("[z-a]").unwrap_err();
        assert!(e6.contains("inverted range"), "{e6}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_match_semantics_and_literal_parenthesis() {
        // 标准搜索语义：可空模式匹配空行；不可空模式不匹配空行。
        assert!(m("x?", ""));
        assert!(!m("x", ""));
        assert!(m("x?y", "y"));
        // `(` 不在元字符集，按字面处理（无分组支持）。
        assert!(m("a(b", "a(b"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn star_plus_and_adjacent_classes() {
        assert!(m("a*b", "aaaaaaab"));
        assert!(m("a*b", "b"));
        assert!(m("x+", "xxx"));
        assert!(m("[a-z]+[0-9]+", "abc123"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn alternation_and_empty_start() {
        assert!(m("abc|def", "xxdefxx"));
        assert!(!m("abc|def", "xxabexx"));
        assert!(m("ab?c", "ac"));
        assert!(m("ab?c", "abc"));
    }
}

//! 可选语义增强打分器（`cargo feature="semantic"`，零第三方 crate）。
//!
//! - 权重文件为自描述 JSON：`{"schema":"scx-sem-1","dim":N,"weights":[...],
//!   "sha256":"hex"}`；`sha256` 为 weights 的二进制规范编码（每 f64 大端 8
//!   字节拼接）的 SHA-256 十六进制，校验失败即拒绝加载。
//! - 打分：`sigmoid(w·x)`，全部 `std::f64` 实现；固定权重 + 固定特征 =
//!   固定输出（无随机源）。
//! - feature 关闭时本模块不参与编译，默认路径与 v0.4.1 逐字节一致；
//!   feature 开启时默认**不启用**（需 `--semantic <weights.json>` 显式加载）。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use crate::hash::{hex, sha256};
use crate::json::{parse, Json};
use std::fs;

/// 权重集（自描述 JSON 校验后加载）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Weights {
    pub dim: usize,
    w: Vec<f64>,
}

fn read(path: &str) -> Result<Json, String> {
    let txt = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {path}: {e}"))?;
    parse(&txt).map_err(|e| format!("{path}: {e}"))
}

fn dim(path: &str, v: &Json) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let schema = v
        .get("schema")
        .and_then(Json::str)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}: missing schema"))?;
    if schema != "scx-sem-1" {
        return Err(format!(
            "{path}: unsupported schema \"{schema}\" (want \"scx-sem-1\")"
        ));
    }
    v.get("dim")
        .and_then(Json::num)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}: missing dim"))
        .map(|d| d.max(0.0) as usize)
}

fn weights(path: &str, v: &Json, dim: usize) -> Result<Vec<f64>, String> {
    let ws = match v.get("weights") {
        Some(Json::Arr(items)) => items
            .iter()
            .map(|it| {
                let n = it
                    .num()
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}: non-numeric weight"))?;
                if !n.is_finite() {
                    // JSON 数字 `1e999` 溢出为 f64::INFINITY，NaN/inf 会污染打分破坏确定性。
                    return Err(format!("{path}: non-finite weight {n}"));
                }
                Ok(n)
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<f64>, String>>()?,
        _ => return Err(format!("{path}: missing weights array")),
    };
    if ws.len() != dim {
        return Err(format!("{path}: dim={dim} but weights.len={}", ws.len()));
    }
    Ok(ws)
}

fn verify(path: &str, v: &Json, ws: &[f64]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let want = v
        .get("sha256")
        .and_then(Json::str)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}: missing sha256"))?;
    let got = hex(&sha256(&encode(ws)));
    if got != want.to_ascii_lowercase() {
        return Err(format!(
            "{path}: sha256 mismatch (file {want}, computed {got})"
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

impl Weights {
    /// 加载并校验权重文件；schema/dim/weights/sha256 任一不符即拒绝。
    pub fn load(path: &str) -> Result<Weights, String> {
        let v = read(path)?;
        let dim = dim(path, &v)?;
        let ws = weights(path, &v, dim)?;
        verify(path, &v, &ws)?;
        Ok(Weights { dim, w: ws })
    }

    /// 打分：`sigmoid(w·x)`，确定性（固定权重 + 固定特征 = 固定输出）。
    pub fn score(&self, x: &[f64]) -> f64 {
        let mut dot = 0.0;
        for (i, xi) in x.iter().enumerate() {
            if i < self.w.len() {
                dot += self.w[i] * xi;
            }
        }
        1.0 / (1.0 + (-dot).exp())
    }
}

/// weights 的二进制规范编码：每 f64 大端 8 字节拼接（IEEE-754 位模式稳定）。
fn encode(ws: &[f64]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(ws.len() * 8);
    for w in ws {
        out.extend_from_slice(&w.to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

/// 行 → dim 维确定性特征向量（前 6 维有语义，其余补 0）。
/// 特征模板与 compress 打分表正交，只作可选加分项。
pub fn feats(line: &str, query_terms: &[String], dim: usize) -> Vec<f64> {
    let lower = line.to_lowercase();
    let hit = hits(query_terms, &lower);
    let overlap = overlap(hit, query_terms.len());
    let chars = line.chars().count();
    let caps = line.chars().filter(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase()).count();
    let digits = line.chars().filter(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).count();
    let cap_ratio = ratio(caps as f64, chars as f64);
    let dig_ratio = ratio(digits as f64, chars as f64);
    let structure = shape(line);
    let mut out = vec![
        overlap,
        hit.min(1) as f64,
        (1.0 + chars as f64).ln(),
        cap_ratio,
        dig_ratio,
        structure,
    ];
    out.resize(dim, 0.0);
    out
}

fn hits(query_terms: &[String], lower: &str) -> usize {
    query_terms
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| !t.is_empty() && lower.contains(t.as_str()))
        .count()
}

fn overlap(hit: usize, terms: usize) -> f64 {
    if terms == 0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        hit as f64 / terms as f64
    }
}

fn ratio(num: f64, den: f64) -> f64 {
    if den == 0.0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        num / den
    }
}

fn shape(line: &str) -> f64 {
    let t = line.trim_start();
    if t.starts_with("```")
        || t.starts_with("~~~")
        || t.starts_with("import ")
        || t.starts_with("use ")
        || t.starts_with("#include")
        || t.starts_with("at ")
        || t.to_lowercase().starts_with("caused by:")
    {
        1.0
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 英文屈折词干扩展（recall 侧加性补召回）。
//
// 与 `terms::expand`（手写领域同义对）同机制：只追加词根形式、不替换原词，
// 原词仍居 Plan 词表前缀，因此打分时追加项自动按 synonym_weight 半权
// （见 recall::Plan::original）。纯 std、确定性；错误词根最坏不命中任何 doc。
// 仅在 feature=semantic 编译、且 meta [params] stem_enable=1 时生效。

/// 对每个 token 追加其规则词根并去重保序（加性，原词全部保留）。
pub fn stem_expand(terms: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = terms.to_vec();
    for t in terms {
        if let Some(s) = stem(t) {
            if !out.iter().any(|x| x == &s) {
                out.push(s);
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// 单个 token 的规则词根；非纯小写字母或太短（<4 字节）返回 None。
fn stem(w: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if w.len() < 4 || !w.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_lowercase()) {
        return None;
    }
    strip_affix(w).filter(|s| s.len() >= 3)
}

/// 最长后缀优先：ies→y；咝音后 es 脱落；其余尾 s 脱落。
fn strip_affix(w: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if let Some(r) = w.strip_suffix("ies") {
        return Some(format!("{r}y"));
    }
    if w.ends_with("es") && sibilant(&w[..w.len() - 2]) {
        return Some(w[..w.len() - 2].to_string());
    }
    let r = w.strip_suffix('s')?;
    (!w.ends_with("ss") && r.len() >= 3).then(|| r.to_string())
}

/// 去 es 后词根须以咝音结尾（ch/sh/s/x/z），避免 issues→issu、dishes→dish。
fn sibilant(stem: &str) -> bool {
    stem.ends_with("ch")
        || stem.ends_with("sh")
        || stem.ends_with('s')
        || stem.ends_with('x')
        || stem.ends_with('z')
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sha256_known_vectors() {
        assert_eq!(
            hex(&sha256(b"")),
            "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            hex(&sha256(b"abc")),
            "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn weights_load_validates_sha() {
        let ws = vec![0.1, -0.2, 0.3];
        let want = hex(&sha256(&encode(&ws)));
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("scx-sem-{}.json", std::process::id()));
        fs::write(
            &path,
            format!(
                "{{\"schema\":\"scx-sem-1\",\"dim\":3,\"weights\":[0.1,-0.2,0.3],\"sha256\":\"{want}\"}}"
            ),
        )
        .unwrap();
        let w = Weights::load(path.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(w.dim, 3);
        // 篡改权重 → sha 不匹配 → 拒绝。
        fs::write(
            &path,
            format!(
                "{{\"schema\":\"scx-sem-1\",\"dim\":3,\"weights\":[0.9,-0.2,0.3],\"sha256\":\"{want}\"}}"
            ),
        )
        .unwrap();
        let err = Weights::load(path.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.contains("sha256 mismatch"), "err: {err}");
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&path);
    }

    #[test]
    fn weights_load_rejects_bad_schema_dim() {
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("scx-sem-bad-{}.json", std::process::id()));
        fs::write(
            &path,
            r#"{"schema":"scx-sem-9","dim":2,"weights":[0.1,0.2],"sha256":"deadbeef"}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(Weights::load(path.to_str().unwrap())
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("schema"));
        fs::write(
            &path,
            r#"{"schema":"scx-sem-1","dim":3,"weights":[0.1,0.2],"sha256":"deadbeef"}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(Weights::load(path.to_str().unwrap())
            .unwrap_err()
            .contains("dim"));
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&path);
    }

    #[test]
    fn weights_reject_non_finite_value() {
        // 1e999 溢出为 f64::INFINITY，会污染打分破坏确定性，必须在加载时拒绝。
        // json::parse 已在解析层拒绝（"number out of range"），或 weights 校验层
        // 拒绝（"non-finite"）——两条路径均满足确定性门禁。
        let err = match crate::json::parse(r#"{"weights":[1e999, 0.5]}"#) {
            Ok(v) => weights("test", &v, 2).unwrap_err(),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        assert!(
            err.contains("non-finite") || err.contains("range"),
            "err: {err}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn score_is_deterministic() {
        let w = Weights {
            dim: 2,
            w: vec![1.0, 1.0],
        };
        let x = vec![1.0, 2.0];
        assert_eq!(w.score(&x), w.score(&x));
        // sigmoid(3) 介于 0..1 且 > sigmoid(1)。
        assert!(w.score(&x) > w.score(&[0.5, 0.5]));
        assert!(w.score(&x) < 1.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn feats_shape_and_bounds() {
        let f = feats("conn 9f2a broken db crash", &["conn".to_string()], 6);
        assert_eq!(f.len(), 6);
        assert!(f[0] > 0.0, "overlap 非零");
        assert!(f[0] <= 1.0);
        assert!(f[2] > 0.0, "长度特征非零");
        let f8 = feats("x", &["y".to_string()], 8);
        assert_eq!(f8.len(), 8);
        assert_eq!(f8[6], 0.0);
        assert_eq!(f8[7], 0.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn stem_plurals_and_ies() {
        // 规则复数 / ies→y：高精度技术词形桥接。
        for (word, want) in [
            ("errors", "error"),
            ("timeouts", "timeout"),
            ("connections", "connection"),
            ("failures", "failure"),
            ("restarts", "restart"),
            ("retries", "retry"),
            ("dependencies", "dependency"),
            ("crashes", "crash"),
            ("boxes", "box"),
            ("passes", "pass"),
            ("issues", "issue"),
            ("datasets", "dataset"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(stem(word).as_deref(), Some(want), "{word}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn stem_skips_short_nonalpha_ambiguous() {
        // 短词 / 数字符 / CJK / 含标点 token 不触发，避免垃圾词根。
        for w in [
            "err",
            "oom",
            "gc",
            "as",
            "8080",
            "conn_id",
            "数据库连接",
            "us",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(stem(w), None, "{w} must not stem");
        }
        // issues 经咝音判定后回退尾 s 规则，得到 issue 而非 issu。
        assert_eq!(stem("issues").as_deref(), Some("issue"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn stem_expand_is_additive_dedup_preserves_order() {
        let got = stem_expand(&["errors".into(), "spike".into(), "error".into()]);
        // 原词全保留且居前缀；追加词根去重（error 已在原词中）。
        assert_eq!(&got[..3], &["errors", "spike", "error"]);
        assert_eq!(got.iter().filter(|t| t.as_str() == "error").count(), 1);
        // 无词形可追的 token 原样透传。
        assert_eq!(stem_expand(&["zzz".into()]), vec!["zzz".to_string()]);
    }
}

//! scx setup：一键注册到 Claude / Codex / Cursor 的 MCP 配置。
//!
//! 行为契约：
//! - 注册名统一小写 `scx`，命令为当前二进制绝对路径 + 子命令 `mcp`（stdio）。
//! - Claude / Codex 优先调用官方 CLI（`claude mcp add` / `codex mcp add`），
//!   CLI 不可用或失败时兜底直接写配置文件。
//! - 幂等：已存在 `scx` 条目则更新 command/args，绝不重复追加。
//! - 写前备份原配置到 `<path>.scx.bak`（每次覆盖最新一份，可回滚）。
//! - 写后自检：spawn 自身 `mcp` 做 tools/list 握手并打印验证结果。
//! - 零第三方 crate、零网络：全部 std 实现；配置文件路径以 `$HOME` 为准。
//!
//! 配置写入目标：
//! - Claude：`claude mcp add` 优先；兜底 `~/.claude.json` 顶层 `mcpServers`。
//! - Codex：`codex mcp add` 优先；兜底 `~/.codex/config.toml` `[mcp_servers.scx]`。
//! - Cursor：`~/.cursor/mcp.json`（`mcpServers` 顶层）；若当前目录存在
//!   `.cursor/mcp.json` 则优先写项目配置。

use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

use crate::json::{parse, Json};

/// 主入口：`scx setup [--claude|--codex|--cursor] [--project-cursor] [--help]`。
/// 返回进程退出码（0 = 全部成功）。
pub fn run(args: &[String]) -> i32 {
    if args.iter().any(|a| a == "--help" || a == "-h") {
        print_usage();
        return 0;
    }
    let only_claude = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--claude");
    let only_codex = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--codex");
    let only_cursor = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--cursor");
    let proj_cursor = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--project-cursor");
    let exe = match exe_path() {
        Ok(e) => e,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx setup: {e}");
            return 1;
        }
    };
    let mut bad = 0;
    if !only_codex && !only_cursor {
        bad += reg_and_check("Claude", claude_reg(&exe), &exe);
    }
    if !only_claude && !only_cursor {
        bad += reg_and_check("Codex", codex_reg(&exe), &exe);
    }
    if !only_claude && !only_codex {
        bad += reg_and_check("Cursor", cursor_reg(&exe, proj_cursor), &exe);
    }
    if bad > 0 {
        eprintln!("scx setup: {bad} agent(s) failed (see above; backups kept at *.scx.bak)");
        1
    } else {
        let _ = crate::ops::out_line("scx setup: all agents registered (server name: scx)");
        0
    }
}

fn print_usage() {
    let _ = crate::ops::out_line(
        "usage: scx setup [--claude] [--codex] [--cursor] [--project-cursor] [--help]\n\
         \n\
         Register the scx MCP stdio server into agent configs (idempotent).\n\
         --claude / --codex / --cursor  limit registration to that agent.\n\
         --project-cursor                write Cursor config to ./.cursor/mcp.json\n\
                                        (default: ~/.cursor/mcp.json).\n\
         Config files are backed up to <path>.scx.bak before writing;\n\
         a tools/list handshake runs after each successful registration.",
    );
}

/// 注册 + 写后 tools/list 握手自检，汇总为退出码贡献。
fn reg_and_check(name: &str, r: Result<String, String>, exe: &Path) -> i32 {
    let line = match r {
        Ok(line) => line,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx setup: [{name}] FAILED: {e}");
            return 1;
        }
    };
    let _ = crate::ops::out_line(&format!("scx setup: [{name}] {line}"));
    match handshake(exe) {
        Ok(h) => {
            let _ = crate::ops::out_line(&format!("scx setup: [{name}] {h}"));
            0
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx setup: [{name}] handshake FAILED: {e}");
            1
        }
    }
}

fn exe_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    env::current_exe().map_err(|e| format!("cannot locate own binary: {e}"))
}

fn home_dir() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    match env::var("HOME") {
        Ok(h) if !h.is_empty() => Ok(PathBuf::from(h)),
        _ => Err("HOME is not set".to_string()),
    }
}

// ---------- Claude ----------

fn claude_reg(exe: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    if Command::new("claude").arg("--version").output().is_ok() {
        let out = Command::new("claude")
            .args(["mcp", "add", "scx", "--"])
            .arg(exe)
            .arg("mcp")
            .output();
        if let Ok(o) = out {
            if o.status.success() {
                return Ok("registered via claude mcp add".to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    let path = home_dir()?.join(".claude.json");
    let entry = entry_json(exe);
    json_reg(&path, "mcpServers", "scx", &entry)?;
    Ok(format!("wrote {}", path.display()))
}

// ---------- Codex ----------

fn codex_reg(exe: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    if Command::new("codex").arg("--version").output().is_ok() {
        let out = Command::new("codex")
            .args(["mcp", "add", "scx", "--"])
            .arg(exe)
            .arg("mcp")
            .output();
        if let Ok(o) = out {
            if o.status.success() {
                return Ok("registered via codex mcp add".to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    let dir = home_dir()?.join(".codex");
    let path = dir.join("config.toml");
    if !dir.exists() {
        fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir {}: {e}", dir.display()))?;
    }
    toml_reg(&path, exe)?;
    Ok(format!("wrote {}", path.display()))
}

// ---------- Cursor ----------

fn cursor_reg(exe: &Path, project: bool) -> Result<String, String> {
    let path = if project {
        env::current_dir()
            .map_err(|e| format!("cannot read cwd: {e}"))?
            .join(".cursor/mcp.json")
    } else {
        home_dir()?.join(".cursor/mcp.json")
    };
    let entry = entry_json(exe);
    json_reg(&path, "mcpServers", "scx", &entry)?;
    Ok(format!("wrote {}", path.display()))
}

// ---------- 配置文件写入 ----------

/// 统一 MCP stdio 条目（type/command/args）。
fn entry_json(exe: &Path) -> Json {
    Json::Obj(vec![
        ("type".to_string(), Json::Str("stdio".to_string())),
        (
            "command".to_string(),
            Json::Str(exe.to_string_lossy().into_owned()),
        ),
        (
            "args".to_string(),
            Json::Arr(vec![Json::Str("mcp".to_string())]),
        ),
    ])
}

/// JSON 配置：读 → 树改写（key 存在则更新，否则插入）→ 备份 → 原子写。
fn json_reg(path: &Path, section: &str, key: &str, entry: &Json) -> Result<(), String> {
    let existing = match fs::read_to_string(path) {
        Ok(t) => Some(t),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
        Err(e) => return Err(format!("read {}: {e}", path.display())),
    };
    let mut root = match &existing {
        Some(t) => parse(t).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?,
        None => Json::Obj(vec![]),
    };
    set_entry(&mut root, section, key, entry);
    let out = write_json(&root);
    if existing.as_deref() == Some(out.trim_end()) {
        return Ok(()); // 内容未变：幂等跳过，不写不备份。
    }
    backup(path)?;
    write_atomic(path, &out)?;
    Ok(())
}

/// TOML 配置（Codex config.toml）：文本级追加/更新 `[mcp_servers.scx]` 段。
fn toml_reg(path: &Path, exe: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let existing = match fs::read_to_string(path) {
        Ok(t) => Some(t),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
        Err(e) => return Err(format!("read {}: {e}", path.display())),
    };
    let command = format!(
        "command = \"{}\"",
        exe.to_string_lossy()
            .replace('\\', "\\\\")
            .replace('"', "\\\"")
    );
    let section = "[mcp_servers.scx]";
    let mut text = existing.unwrap_or_default();
    // 只认真实的段头行：`# [mcp_servers.scx]` 之类的注释行曾被 contains 误判为
    // 已注册，导致 update_toml_command 找不到段而最终静默不注册。
    let has_section = text.lines().any(|l| header(l.trim()));
    if has_section {
        // 已注册：原位更新 command 行（args 恒为 ["mcp"]，无需重写）。
        let updated = update_toml_command(&text, &command);
        if updated != text {
            backup(path)?;
            write_atomic(path, &updated)?;
        }
    } else {
        if !text.is_empty() && !text.ends_with('\n') {
            text.push('\n');
        }
        text.push_str(section);
        text.push('\n');
        text.push_str(&command);
        text.push('\n');
        text.push_str("args = [\"mcp\"]\n");
        backup(path)?;
        write_atomic(path, &text)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 段头判定：`[mcp_servers.scx]` 允许行尾注释（`# note`），但不匹配更长的段名。
/// 只用精确匹配会把「段头带注释」当成未注册，进而追加重复段使配置损坏。
fn header(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.strip_prefix("[mcp_servers.scx]").is_some_and(|rest| {
        let rest = rest.trim_start();
        rest.is_empty() || rest.starts_with('#')
    })
}

/// 段内更新 command 行（保持文件其余内容逐字节不变）。
fn update_toml_command(text: &str, command: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut in_scx = false;
    for line in text.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if header(t) {
            in_scx = true;
            out.push_str(line);
            out.push('\n');
            continue;
        }
        if in_scx && t.starts_with('[') && t.ends_with(']') {
            in_scx = false;
        }
        // command 键：允许任意空白后跟 `=`（`command =` / `command=` / `command  =`），
        // 注释行（`#` 开头）因 trim 后带 `#` 前缀不会误判。
        if in_scx && t.starts_with("command") {
            let rest = &t["command".len()..];
            if rest.trim_start().starts_with('=') {
                out.push_str(command);
                out.push('\n');
                continue;
            }
        }
        out.push_str(line);
        out.push('\n');
    }
    out
}

/// 树改写：section 对象内设置 key（已存在更新，否则追加）。
fn set_entry(root: &mut Json, section: &str, key: &str, entry: &Json) {
    let kv = obj_mut(root);
    let idx = kv.iter().position(|(k, _)| k == section);
    let mut sec = match idx {
        Some(i) => take_obj(&mut kv[i].1),
        None => Vec::new(),
    };
    upsert(&mut sec, key, entry);
    match idx {
        Some(i) => kv[i].1 = Json::Obj(sec),
        None => kv.push((section.to_string(), Json::Obj(sec))),
    }
}

/// 顶层对象视图（非对象就地重建为空对象）。
fn obj_mut(root: &mut Json) -> &mut Vec<(String, Json)> {
    if !matches!(root, Json::Obj(_)) {
        *root = Json::Obj(vec![]);
    }
    let Json::Obj(kv) = root else { unreachable!() };
    kv
}

/// 取走对象内容；非对象就地替换为空对象。
fn take_obj(v: &mut Json) -> Vec<(String, Json)> {
    match v {
        Json::Obj(s) => std::mem::take(s),
        _ => {
            *v = Json::Obj(vec![]);
            Vec::new()
        }
    }
}

/// 键存在则更新，否则追加。
fn upsert(sec: &mut Vec<(String, Json)>, key: &str, entry: &Json) {
    match sec.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| k == key) {
        Some((_, v)) => *v = entry.clone(),
        None => sec.push((key.to_string(), entry.clone())),
    }
}

// ---------- 序列化 ----------

/// 紧凑两空格缩进 JSON 序列化（键序保持解析序）。
fn write_json(v: &Json) -> String {
    let mut s = String::new();
    write_node(v, &mut s, 0);
    s.push('\n');
    s
}

fn write_node(v: &Json, out: &mut String, indent: usize) {
    match v {
        Json::Null => out.push_str("null"),
        Json::Bool(b) => out.push_str(bool_lit(*b)),
        Json::Num(n) => write_num(*n, out),
        Json::Str(s) => out.push_str(&crate::json::string(s)),
        Json::Arr(items) => write_arr(items, out, indent),
        Json::Obj(kv) => write_obj(kv, out, indent),
    }
}

fn bool_lit(b: bool) -> &'static str {
    if b {
        "true"
    } else {
        "false"
    }
}

fn write_num(n: f64, out: &mut String) {
    if n.fract() == 0.0 && n.abs() < 9.0e15 {
        out.push_str(&format!("{}", n as i64));
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!("{n}"));
    }
}

fn write_arr(items: &[Json], out: &mut String, indent: usize) {
    if items.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("[]");
        return;
    }
    out.push_str("[\n");
    for (i, it) in items.iter().enumerate() {
        pad(out, indent + 1);
        write_node(it, out, indent + 1);
        if i + 1 < items.len() {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push('\n');
    }
    pad(out, indent);
    out.push(']');
}

fn write_obj(kv: &[(String, Json)], out: &mut String, indent: usize) {
    if kv.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("{}");
        return;
    }
    out.push_str("{\n");
    for (i, (k, val)) in kv.iter().enumerate() {
        pad(out, indent + 1);
        out.push_str(&crate::json::string(k));
        out.push_str(": ");
        write_node(val, out, indent + 1);
        if i + 1 < kv.len() {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push('\n');
    }
    pad(out, indent);
    out.push('}');
}

fn pad(out: &mut String, indent: usize) {
    for _ in 0..indent {
        out.push_str("  ");
    }
}

// ---------- 文件安全 ----------

/// 备份：原文件复制为 `<path>.scx.bak`（覆盖最新一份）。
fn backup(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let bak = backup_path(path);
    match fs::copy(path, &bak) {
        Ok(_) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(format!("backup {}: {e}", bak.display())),
    }
}

fn backup_path(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut name = path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_os_string();
    name.push(".scx.bak");
    path.with_file_name(name)
}

/// 原子写：临时文件 + rename（避免半写文件被 agent 读到）。
fn write_atomic(path: &Path, text: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    // 目标是符号链接（dotfiles 管理的配置）时写到真实文件：rename 不跟随软链，
    // 直接写会把用户的软链替换成普通文件。
    let resolved = fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf());
    let path = resolved.as_path();
    let parent = match path.parent() {
        Some(p) if p.as_os_str().is_empty() => Path::new("."),
        Some(p) => p,
        None => return Err(format!("no parent for {}", path.display())),
    };
    if !parent.exists() {
        fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir {}: {e}", parent.display()))?;
    }
    let tmp = parent.join(format!(".scx-setup-{}", std::process::id()));
    fs::write(&tmp, text).map_err(|e| format!("write {}: {e}", tmp.display()))?;
    // 保留原文件权限：fs::write 按 umask 创建 0644，会把原 0600 的配置放宽。
    // 原文件不存在（首次注册）时跳过，沿用默认 umask。
    if let Ok(meta) = fs::metadata(path) {
        let _ = fs::set_permissions(&tmp, meta.permissions());
    }
    fs::rename(&tmp, path).map_err(|e| format!("rename {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    Ok(())
}

// ---------- 写后自检 ----------

/// stdio 握手：spawn 自身 `mcp`，initialize → tools/list，验证 compress_context。
pub fn handshake(exe: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut child = Command::new(exe)
        .arg("mcp")
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .spawn()
        .map_err(|e| format!("spawn {exe:?} mcp: {e}"))?;
    let mut stdin = child
        .stdin
        .take()
        .ok_or_else(|| "cannot take child stdin".to_string())?;
    let stdout = child
        .stdout
        .take()
        .ok_or_else(|| "cannot take child stdout".to_string())?;
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdout);
    let mut line = String::new();
    let _ = stdin.write_all(
        b"{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"initialize\",\"params\":{\"protocolVersion\":\"2025-03-26\",\"capabilities\":{},\"clientInfo\":{\"name\":\"scx-setup\",\"version\":\"0\"}}}\n",
    );
    let _ = stdin.flush();
    reader
        .read_line(&mut line)
        .map_err(|e| format!("initialize read: {e}"))?;
    let _ = stdin.write_all(b"{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":2,\"method\":\"tools/list\"}\n");
    let _ = stdin.flush();
    let mut list = String::new();
    reader
        .read_line(&mut list)
        .map_err(|e| format!("tools/list read: {e}"))?;
    // 关闭子进程 stdin（EOF）使其自然退出，避免 wait 死锁。
    drop(stdin);
    let _ = child.wait();
    if list.contains("compress_context") {
        Ok("tools/list handshake OK (compress_context present)".to_string())
    } else {
        Err(format!(
            "tools/list handshake failed: unexpected reply {list:?}"
        ))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn header_accepts_trailing_comment_but_not_longer_names() {
        assert!(header("[mcp_servers.scx]"));
        assert!(header("[mcp_servers.scx] # keep this note"));
        assert!(header("[mcp_servers.scx]#note"));
        assert!(!header("[mcp_servers.scx2]"), "更长的段名不得误判");
        assert!(!header("# [mcp_servers.scx]"), "注释行不是段头");
    }

    #[test]
    fn commented_section_header_is_updated_in_place() {
        // 段头带行尾注释时也必须原位更新，不得追加第二个同名段（TOML 重复表会损坏配置）。
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("scx-setup-hdr-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let cfg = dir.join("config.toml");
        std::fs::write(
            &cfg,
            "[mcp_servers.scx] # keep this note\ncommand = \"/old/bin\"\nargs = [\"mcp\"]\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
        toml_reg(&cfg, Path::new("/new/bin")).unwrap();
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&cfg).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            text.matches("[mcp_servers.scx]").count(),
            1,
            "不得追加重复段: {text}"
        );
        assert!(
            text.contains("command = \"/new/bin\""),
            "应原位更新: {text}"
        );
        assert!(text.contains("# keep this note"), "段头注释保留: {text}");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }

    #[test]
    fn update_toml_command_matches_any_whitespace_and_skips_comments() {
        // `command =` / `command=` / `command  =` 都应原位替换；注释里的
        // `[mcp_servers.scx]` 或 `command =` 不误判。
        let text = "[mcp_servers.scx]\ncommand = \"/old/bin\"\nargs = [\"mcp\"]\n# [mcp_servers.scx]\n# command = should-not-change\n";
        let out = update_toml_command(text, "command = \"/new/bin\"");
        assert!(
            out.contains("command = \"/new/bin\""),
            "command = 应替换: {out}"
        );
        assert!(!out.contains("\"/old/bin\""), "旧 command 应被替换: {out}");
        assert!(
            out.contains("# command = should-not-change"),
            "注释不得改动: {out}"
        );
        assert!(out.contains("args = [\"mcp\"]"), "args 保留: {out}");

        // 多空格 `command   =` 也应匹配。
        let multi = "[mcp_servers.scx]\ncommand   = \"/old\"\n";
        let out2 = update_toml_command(multi, "command = \"/new\"");
        assert!(
            out2.contains("command = \"/new\""),
            "多空格 command 应替换: {out2}"
        );
    }

    #[cfg(unix)]
    #[test]
    fn write_atomic_preserves_file_permissions() {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "scx-setup-perm-{}-{}",
            std::process::id(),
            std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        ));
        fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let path = dir.join("config.json");
        fs::write(&path, "old").unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
        write_atomic(&path, "new").unwrap();
        let mode = fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o777;
        assert_eq!(mode, 0o600, "原子写后应保留原 0600 权限，而非放宽到 0644");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }
}

//! 可插拔相似度后端（默认关闭，`--embed-cmd` 启用）。
//!
//! 设计原则：相似度是**传入纯核心的数据**，不在 `compress` 内做 I/O。
//! 本模块只提供一个批量函数 `compute`：`ops` 层在进入 `compress` 前调用它，
//! 得到 `query` 与每行的相似度 `Vec<f64>`，经 `Config::sims` 传入纯核心。
//! 默认 `None` 返回全 0，`compress` 行为与 v0.6.7 逐字节一致。
//!
//! 子进程协议（批量、文本行）：
//! - stdin：首行 `Q\t<query>`，随后每行 `L\t<text>`，写完关闭 stdin（EOF）。
//! - stdout：与 `L` 行数相同的浮点相似度，每行一个（顺序对应）。
//! - 约定：子进程**先读完 stdin 再写 stdout**（批式），避免管道死锁。
//!   确定性只保证在确定性 provider 下成立（固定模型 + 固定 seed）。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Write};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

/// 计算 `query` 与每个候选文本的相似度。
///
/// `cmd: None` → 返回全 0（默认路径，无副作用、无 I/O）。
/// `cmd: Some(program)` → 以 `sh -c <program>` 启动 provider，按上述协议批式计算。
pub fn compute(cmd: Option<&str>, query: &str, texts: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, String> {
    let Some(program) = cmd else {
        return Ok(vec![0.0; texts.len()]);
    };
    let program = program.trim();
    if program.is_empty() {
        return Err("--embed-cmd requires a non-empty command".to_string());
    }

    let mut child = Command::new("sh")
        .arg("-c")
        .arg(program)
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
        .spawn()
        .map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd spawn: {e}"))?;

    {
        let mut stdin = child
            .stdin
            .take()
            .ok_or_else(|| "--embed-cmd: provider stdin unavailable".to_string())?;
        let safe_query = sanitize(query);
        writeln!(stdin, "Q\t{safe_query}").map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd write: {e}"))?;
        for t in texts {
            let safe = sanitize(t);
            writeln!(stdin, "L\t{safe}").map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd write: {e}"))?;
        }
    } // stdin 在此关闭，子进程读到 EOF。

    let stdout = child
        .stdout
        .take()
        .ok_or_else(|| "--embed-cmd: provider stdout unavailable".to_string())?;
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdout);
    let mut sims = Vec::with_capacity(texts.len());
    for _ in 0..texts.len() {
        let mut line = String::new();
        let n = reader
            .read_line(&mut line)
            .map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd read: {e}"))?;
        if n == 0 {
            return Err(
                "--embed-cmd: provider closed stdout before emitting all scores".to_string(),
            );
        }
        let v: f64 = line
            .trim()
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd: bad score {:?}: {e}", line.trim()))?;
        if !v.is_finite() {
            return Err(format!("--embed-cmd: non-finite score {v}"));
        }
        sims.push(v);
    }

    let status = child.wait().map_err(|e| format!("--embed-cmd wait: {e}"))?;
    if !status.success() {
        return Err(format!("--embed-cmd: provider exited with {status}"));
    }
    Ok(sims)
}

/// 去除换行/回车，避免破坏 `Q\t`/`L\t` 单行协议（text 为已切行切片，通常无需处理）。
fn sanitize(s: &str) -> String {
    if s.contains('\n') || s.contains('\r') {
        s.replace(['\n', '\r'], " ")
    } else {
        s.to_string()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn no_backend_returns_zeros() {
        assert_eq!(compute(None, "q", &["a", "b"]).unwrap(), vec![0.0, 0.0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_command_is_rejected() {
        assert!(compute(Some("   "), "q", &["a"]).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn subprocess_scores_are_parsed_in_order() {
        // 用 printf 模拟 provider：读入后输出固定两个分数（批式，先读后写）。
        let cmd = "printf '0.25\\n0.75\\n'";
        let got = compute(Some(cmd), "query", &["line a", "line b"]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 2);
        assert!((got[0] - 0.25).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((got[1] - 0.75).abs() < 1e-9);
    }

    #[test]
    fn short_output_is_rejected() {
        let cmd = "printf '0.5\\n'"; // 只输出 1 个，但请求 2 个
        assert!(compute(Some(cmd), "q", &["a", "b"]).is_err());
    }
}

//! 词面层：停用词表、CJK 判定、查询切词与 token 估算（纯函数、零分配复用缓冲）。
//!
//! 与引擎解耦：压缩与记忆库都直接复用 `terms`、`memory` 与 `estimate`，
//! 保证"同一查询词面 → 同一词表"的确定性。

use std::collections::HashSet;

pub(crate) const MAX_QUERY_TERMS: usize = 256;
/// 单 token 上限（字节）。记忆索引的 doc 词表长度字段为 u8；超长 token
/// 不能静默截断，否则索引会错位。线性与索引路径共用本切词器，在入口统一
/// 丢弃超长 token，保持两条路径同口径。
pub(crate) const MAX_TERM_BYTES: usize = u8::MAX as usize;
pub(crate) const STOP: &[&str] = &[
    "the", "and", "for", "with", "that", "this", "from", "your", "are", "was", "were", "not",
    "you", "use", "using", "的", "了", "是", "在", "和", "与", "或", "把", "被", "我", "你", "请",
    "帮", "一下", "一个", "这个", "那个", "怎么", "如何", "什么",
];

/// 语义敏感词：裁剪时**永不摘除**（score ≥ 2，同命中词）。
/// 否定/比较/转折/程度词一旦被摘会反转或削弱推理语义
/// （"not divisible"→"divisible"），数值语义词（each/per/total）是
/// 数学推理链的语义骨架。与 `STOP` 有交集（如 `not`）时 KEEP 优先。
pub(crate) const KEEP: &[&str] = &[
    // 否定
    "not", "no", "never", "without", "except", "不", "没", "无", "非", // 比较/转折
    "than", "more", "less", "least", "most", "but", "however", "although", "yet", "still", "only",
    "just", "exactly", "但", "而", "虽", "却", "更", "最",
    // 数值语义（推理链骨架）
    "each", "per", "every", "total", "每", "共", "总",
];

pub(crate) fn ideograph(c: char) -> bool {
    let u = c as u32;
    (0x3400..=0x4DBF).contains(&u)
        || (0x4E00..=0x9FFF).contains(&u)
        || (0x3040..=0x30FF).contains(&u)
        || (0xAC00..=0xD7AF).contains(&u)
        || (0x20000..=0x2FA1F).contains(&u)
}
pub(crate) fn full(c: char) -> bool {
    let u = c as u32;
    ideograph(c) || (0x3000..=0x303F).contains(&u) || (0xFF00..=0xFFEF).contains(&u)
}

/// 压缩与记忆库共享的词法扫描；两种口径只在 CJK 子词展开策略上不同。
fn scan(query: &str, memory: bool) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut terms: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let lower = query.to_lowercase();
    ascii(&lower, &mut terms, &mut seen);
    if terms.len() < MAX_QUERY_TERMS {
        cjk(query, &mut terms, &mut seen, memory);
    }
    terms
}

/// ASCII/标点词法扫描：按分隔符切词，停用词与超长 token 不入词表。
fn ascii(lower: &str, terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>) {
    let mut cur = String::new();
    for c in lower.chars() {
        if token(c) {
            cur.push(c);
            continue;
        }
        if valid(&cur) {
            push(terms, seen, cur.clone());
            if terms.len() >= MAX_QUERY_TERMS {
                return;
            }
        }
        cur.clear();
    }
    if valid(&cur) {
        push(terms, seen, cur);
    }
}

/// CJK 词法扫描：连续 CJK 字符成段，段长 >=2 进入词表。
fn cjk(query: &str, terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>, memory: bool) {
    let mut run = String::new();
    for c in query.chars() {
        if ideograph(c) {
            run.push(c);
            continue;
        }
        if run.chars().count() >= 2 {
            segment(terms, seen, &run, memory);
            if terms.len() >= MAX_QUERY_TERMS {
                return;
            }
        }
        run.clear();
    }
    if run.chars().count() >= 2 {
        segment(terms, seen, &run, memory);
    }
}

fn token(c: char) -> bool {
    c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || "_./\\:@-".contains(c)
}

fn valid(cur: &str) -> bool {
    cur.len() >= 2 && cur.len() <= MAX_TERM_BYTES && !STOP.contains(&cur)
}

fn push(terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>, term: String) {
    if terms.len() >= MAX_QUERY_TERMS {
        return;
    }
    if seen.insert(term.clone()) {
        terms.push(term);
    }
}

/// CJK 没有空格分词：≤6 字整段成词；长段按 6 字块切分，尾部单字用最后两字
/// 补齐。记忆库在块内追加重叠 bigram/trigram 以桥接释义变体。
fn segment(terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>, run: &str, memory: bool) {
    if STOP.contains(&run) {
        return;
    }
    let chars: Vec<char> = run.chars().collect();
    if chars.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    if !memory && chars.len() <= 6 {
        push(terms, seen, run.to_string());
        return;
    }
    let mut start = 0;
    while start < chars.len() {
        let end = (start + 6).min(chars.len());
        if end - start >= 2 {
            part(terms, seen, &chars[start..end], memory);
        }
        start += 6;
    }
    if chars.len() % 6 == 1 {
        let tail = &chars[chars.len() - 2..];
        part(terms, seen, tail, memory);
    }
}

fn part(terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>, segment: &[char], memory: bool) {
    if memory {
        grams(terms, seen, segment);
    } else {
        push(terms, seen, segment.iter().collect());
    }
}

/// 压缩引擎词表（CJK 整段/6 字块，不展开滑动 n-gram）。
pub(crate) fn terms(query: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    scan(query, false)
}

/// 记忆库召回用词表——在 `terms` 基础上对 **CJK 段/块
/// （≤6 字）** 追加重叠 bigram/trigram（相邻 2/3 字），保留整段用于精确匹配。
///
/// 动机：整段/6 字块对中文释义层几乎不重叠（"数据库连接池耗尽" vs "连接池满了"
/// 词面无交集）。重叠 n-gram 让"症状不同、根因相同"的中文变体桥接（共享 trigram
/// "连接池"）。>6 字长段切成 6 字块后，**每块仍走 n-gram**（块 ≤6 字，膨胀可控，
/// 长证据 doc 词表约 170 tokens/百字中文段）。尾部 1 字按现有补齐。
///
/// 记忆库 query 与 doc（index/edge/eval-B/feedback/annotate）统一走本函数，
/// A/B 对拍保持同词表口径。compress 引擎维持 `terms` 不动（压缩语义不变）。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
pub(crate) fn memory(query: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    scan(query, true)
}

/// case 的 query 词表与 query∪text 去重词表（索引/线性/实体桥共用同一口径）。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
pub(crate) fn document(query: &str, text: &str) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
    let query_terms = memory(query);
    let mut terms = query_terms.clone();
    terms.extend(memory(text));
    terms.sort_unstable();
    terms.dedup();
    (query_terms, terms)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 运维领域确定性同义词表。
//
// 两个使用方：
// - `annotate`：按 seed 做字面改写，生成 paraphrase 标注（PARAPHRASE_PAIRS）；
// - `recall`：把 query 词扩展为同义 token 补召回（expand_recall_terms）。
// 只做精确 token 匹配，不做子串替换；表顺序固定，输出确定。

/// 双向词对（中英混排）；新增词对必须同时覆盖两个方向，避免检索不对称。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
pub(crate) const PARAPHRASE_PAIRS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("db", "database"),
    ("database", "db"),
    ("timeout", "超时"),
    ("超时", "timeout"),
    ("conn_id", "连接id"),
    ("连接id", "conn_id"),
    ("conn", "connection"),
    ("connection", "conn"),
    ("connection", "连接"),
    ("连接", "connection"),
    ("pool", "连接池"),
    ("连接池", "pool"),
    ("池", "pool"),
    ("error", "错误"),
    ("错误", "error"),
    ("errno", "错误码"),

/// 召回专用的高精度子集：只收无字面交集的领域释义对。
///
/// 不使用 `db/database`、`error/错误`、`timeout/超时` 这类高频宽词：
/// 它们会把 `db write` 扩成 `database`，让 database connection pool case
/// 反超真正的 db write 目标（104 条截断诊断中已实测 literal MRR 退化）。
///
/// 宽泛→具体的对可以单向（`memory→gc`、`disk→filesystem`）：反向扩展会把
/// 具体查询稀释成整类，实测让 `gc` 查询的 OOM case 反超目标。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
const RECALL_PAIRS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("replication", "replica"),
    ("replica", "replication"),
    ("delay", "lag"),
    ("lag", "delay"),
    ("memory", "heap"),
    ("heap", "memory"),
    ("memory", "oom"),
    ("oom", "memory"),
    ("certificate", "cert"),
    ("cert", "certificate"),
    ("config", "configuration"),
    ("configuration", "config"),
    ("deploy", "deployment"),
    ("deployment", "deploy"),
    ("failure", "failed"),
    ("failed", "failure"),
    ("disk", "storage"),
    ("storage", "disk"),
    ("permission", "denied"),
    ("denied", "permission"),
    ("auth", "authentication"),
    ("authentication", "auth"),
    ("conn", "connection"),
    ("connection", "conn"),
    ("fmt", "format"),
    ("format", "fmt"),
    ("msg", "message"),
    ("message", "msg"),
    ("内存", "memory"),
    ("memory", "内存"),
    ("memory", "gc"),
    ("disk", "filesystem"),
    ("存储", "storage"),
    ("storage", "存储"),
    ("队列", "queue"),
    ("queue", "队列"),
    ("连接", "connection"),
    ("connection", "连接"),
    ("连接池", "pool"),
    ("pool", "连接池"),
    ("崩溃", "crash"),
    ("crash", "崩溃"),
    ("配置", "config"),
    ("config", "配置"),
    ("部署", "deploy"),
    ("deploy", "部署"),
    ("权限", "permission"),
    ("permission", "权限"),
    ("线程", "thread"),
    ("thread", "线程"),
];

/// 对每个精确命中的 token 追加召回用同义 token，并去重保序。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
pub(crate) fn expand(terms: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = terms.to_vec();
    for t in terms {
        for (from, to) in RECALL_PAIRS {
            if t == from && !out.iter().any(|x| x == to) {
                out.push((*to).to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// 一个 ≤6 字 CJK 块：整段（精确）+ 重叠 bigram + 重叠 trigram（模糊桥接）。
fn grams(terms: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>, chars: &[char]) {
    push(terms, seen, chars.iter().collect());
    for w in chars.windows(2) {
        push(terms, seen, w.iter().collect());
    }
    if chars.len() >= 3 {
        for w in chars.windows(3) {
            push(terms, seen, w.iter().collect());
        }
    }
}

/// 计量口径系数：对齐 `token-meter` 的字符三分类启发式。
/// ASCII 4 字符/token；CJK 族（表意/假名/谚文/全角）0.6 token/字；
/// other（emoji/西里尔/阿拉伯/泰文等非 ASCII 非 CJK）2.5 字符/token。
/// 纯 ASCII 与纯 CJK 输入与旧口径逐位一致，仅修正 other 脚本此前按 0.25
/// token/字符低估 4–12 倍的问题。
const ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN: f64 = 4.0;
const CJK_TOKENS_PER_CHAR: f64 = 0.6;
const OTHER_CHARS_PER_TOKEN: f64 = 2.5;

/// `--max-tokens`/预算的保守上界系数：生效上限 = 用户上限 ÷ `BUDGET_SAFETY_FACTOR`，
/// 即 `estimate × 系数` 作为上界，宁高估勿低估，避免启发式在 CJK/emoji/other 脚本上
/// 低估导致超预算。⚠ 当前为临时保守值 2.0：cl100k 对 CJK ≈1 token/字而启发式按 0.6，
/// 低估 ~1.67×，故取 2.0 覆盖 CJK（emoji ~2.5–7.5× 仍可能超）；未经留出分位数校准，
/// tiktoken 可用时重跑 `tools/calibrate.py` 冻结真实 P95 比率后再收紧。
pub(crate) const BUDGET_SAFETY_FACTOR: f64 = 2.0;

pub(crate) fn estimate(s: &str) -> f64 {
    if s.is_ascii() {
        return s.len() as f64 / ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN + 1.0;
    }
    let (mut ascii, mut cjk, mut other) = (0usize, 0usize, 0usize);
    for c in s.chars() {
        if c.is_ascii() {
            ascii += 1;
        } else if full(c) {
            cjk += 1;
        } else {
            other += 1;
        }
    }
    ascii as f64 / ASCII_CHARS_PER_TOKEN
        + cjk as f64 * CJK_TOKENS_PER_CHAR
        + other as f64 / OTHER_CHARS_PER_TOKEN
        + 1.0
}

/// 整数化 token 计数（`estimate` 向上取整；空串为 0，供计量/预算用整数口径）。
pub(crate) fn count(s: &str) -> usize {
    if s.is_empty() {
        0
    } else {
        estimate(s).ceil() as usize
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// 中文释义层桥接——query 与 doc 的 CJK 段即使整段不重叠，
    /// 重叠 trigram/bigram 也必须提供公共词（共享根因桥）。10 组真实感中/中英混排
    /// 变体：每组 (query, doc) 词表交集必须非空；其中至少 4 对存在 ≥3 字强桥
    /// （trigram 级词面锚，如"连接池""检测到"）。
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn mem_terms_bridge_zh_paraphrases() {
        let pairs: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
            ("数据库连接池耗尽", "连接池满了"),
            ("数据库连接池耗尽", "数据库连接池空闲不足"),
            ("磁盘空间不足", "磁盘空间不够用"),
            ("tls握手超时", "SSL握手超时"),
            ("死锁检测到", "检测到死锁等待链"),
            ("连接pool最小空闲不足", "连接池空闲连接太少"),
            ("端口被占用", "8080端口已被使用"),
            ("内存溢出堆栈", "out of memory 堆栈溢出"),
            ("队列积压太多", "队列backlog溢出"),
            ("磁盘io读取超时", "磁盘读写卡死"),
        ];
        let mut strong = 0usize;
        for (q, d) in pairs {
            let qt = memory(q);
            let dt = memory(d);
            let common: Vec<&String> = qt.iter().filter(|t| dt.contains(t)).collect();
            assert!(!common.is_empty(), "{} vs {}: no shared term", q, d);
            if common.iter().any(|t| t.chars().count() >= 3) {
                strong += 1;
            }
        }
        assert!(strong >= 4, "strong bridges: {strong}/10");
    }

    /// `terms`（compress 侧）语义不变：6 字块切 + 尾部补齐，无滑动 n-gram。
    #[test]
    fn terms_keeps_compress_semantics() {
        let t = terms("数据库连接池耗尽");
        assert!(t.contains(&"数据库连接池".to_string()), "{t:?}");
        assert!(t.contains(&"耗尽".to_string()), "{t:?}");
        // 无滑动 n-gram（"据库连"等 3 字滑动产物必须不存在）。
        assert!(!t.iter().any(|x| x == "据库连" || x == "连接池耗"), "{t:?}");
        let t2 = terms("数据库连接池耗尽磁盘空间不足");
        assert!(t2.iter().any(|x| x == "数据库连接池"), "{t2:?}");
        assert!(t2.iter().any(|x| x == "耗尽磁盘空间"), "{t2:?}");
        assert!(t2.iter().any(|x| x == "不足"), "{t2:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn term_cap_keeps_first_occurrence_order() {
        let q: Vec<String> = (0..300).map(|i| format!("w{i}")).collect();
        let terms = terms(&q.join(" "));
        assert_eq!(terms.len(), MAX_QUERY_TERMS);
        assert_eq!(terms.first().map(String::as_str), Some("w0"));
        assert_eq!(
            terms.last().map(String::as_str),
            Some("w255"),
            "cap must keep the first 256 unique terms"
        );
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn doc_terms_are_sorted_unique_with_query_order_preserved() {
        let (query_terms, terms) = document("Beta alpha beta", "alpha gamma alpha");
        assert_eq!(query_terms, ["beta", "alpha"]);
        assert_eq!(terms, ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"]);
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn expands_only_exact_known_tokens() {
        let got = expand(&["replication".into(), "delay".into(), "x".into()]);
        assert!(got.contains(&"replica".to_string()));
        assert!(got.contains(&"lag".to_string()));
        assert!(!got.contains(&"y".to_string()));
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn does_not_expand_broad_db_alias_in_recall() {
        assert_eq!(expand(&["db".into()]), vec!["db".to_string()]);
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn expands_high_precision_abbrev_pairs() {
        // P3.2 保守补充：标准技术缩写 ↔ 全称（双向、去重）。
        let got = expand(&["fmt".into()]);
        assert!(got.contains(&"format".to_string()));
        let got2 = expand(&["message".into()]);
        assert!(got2.contains(&"msg".to_string()));
        let got3 = expand(&["format".into(), "fmt".into()]);
        assert_eq!(
            got3.iter().filter(|t| *t == "fmt").count(),
            1,
            "双向扩展必须去重"
        );
        // 字面前缀交集对（param/parameter）不加入词表。
        assert_eq!(expand(&["param".into()]), vec!["param".to_string()]);
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn expansion_is_bidirectional_and_deduplicated() {
        let got = expand(&["memory".into(), "heap".into()]);
        assert_eq!(got.iter().filter(|t| *t == "memory").count(), 1);
        assert_eq!(got.iter().filter(|t| *t == "heap").count(), 1);
        assert!(got.contains(&"oom".to_string()));
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn expands_cjk_domain_terms_to_english() {
        let got = expand(&["内存".into(), "存储".into()]);
        assert!(got.contains(&"memory".to_string()));
        assert!(got.contains(&"storage".to_string()));
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn broad_terms_expand_one_way_only() {
        let broad = expand(&["memory".into(), "disk".into()]);
        assert!(broad.contains(&"gc".to_string()));
        assert!(broad.contains(&"filesystem".to_string()));
        let specific = expand(&["gc".into(), "filesystem".into()]);
        assert!(!specific.contains(&"memory".to_string()));
        assert!(!specific.contains(&"disk".to_string()));
    }
}

//! 零依赖行式配置解析（TOML 子集）：`[section]` + `key = value` 行。
//!
//! 记忆库 `meta.toml` 与内核策略文件（P3 `--policy-file`）共用同一解析器；
//! 只做解析与类型转换，不持有状态、不含 I/O。语义与 meta.rs 既有行式解析
//! 逐字节一致（trim、跳过空行/注释、节追踪、`=` 拆分）。

/// 一条解析结果：所属节（"" 为根节）、键、值（均已 trim）。
pub struct Entry<'a> {
    pub section: &'a str,
    pub key: &'a str,
    pub value: &'a str,
}

/// 逐行解析：空行与 `#` 注释跳过；`[name]` 切换节；无 `=` 的行忽略。
pub fn parse<'a>(lines: impl Iterator<Item = &'a str>) -> Vec<Entry<'a>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut section = "";
    for raw in lines {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
            continue;
        }
        if line.starts_with('[') && line.ends_with(']') {
            section = &line[1..line.len() - 1];
            continue;
        }
        let Some(eq) = line.find('=') else {
            continue;
        };
        let key = line[..eq].trim();
        let value = line[eq + 1..].trim();
        out.push(Entry {
            section,
            key,
            value,
        });
    }
    out
}

/// 带行号的解析结果（P3 `--policy-file` 报错定位用）。
pub struct Line<'a> {
    /// 与 `parse` 相同的解析结果。
    pub entry: Entry<'a>,
    /// 原文 1-based 行号。
    pub line: usize,
}

/// 逐行解析并保留行号（语义与 `parse` 完全一致）。
pub fn numbered<'a>(lines: impl Iterator<Item = (usize, &'a str)>) -> Vec<Line<'a>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut section = "";
    for (line_no, raw) in lines {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
            continue;
        }
        if line.starts_with('[') && line.ends_with(']') {
            section = &line[1..line.len() - 1];
            continue;
        }
        let Some(eq) = line.find('=') else {
            continue;
        };
        let key = line[..eq].trim();
        let value = line[eq + 1..].trim();
        out.push(Line {
            entry: Entry {
                section,
                key,
                value,
            },
            line: line_no,
        });
    }
    out
}

/// f64 读取：必须可解析且有限（NaN/inf 拒绝）。
pub fn float(v: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    v.parse::<f64>().ok().filter(|f| f.is_finite())
}

/// usize 读取（df 快照等）。
pub fn size(v: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    v.parse().ok()
}

/// u64 读取（gen 代际等）。
pub fn integer(v: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    v.parse().ok()
}

/// 去掉首尾空白与一对双引号（TOML 字符串值的朴素处理）。
pub fn strip(v: &str) -> &str {
    v.trim().trim_matches('"')
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// 确定性模糊：策略文件与 meta.toml 都是外部可写文本，任意行都不得 panic，
    /// 且返回的切片必须仍属于输入（不越界、不破坏 UTF-8）。
    #[test]
    fn parse_never_panics_on_arbitrary_lines() {
        let pool: Vec<char> = "[]=# \t\n\"abc012中🚀".chars().collect();
        let mut state = 0xcafe_babeu32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..1500 {
            let n = next() as usize % 5;
            let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..n {
                let m = next() as usize % 16;
                let mut s = String::new();
                for _ in 0..m {
                    s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
                }
                lines.push(s);
            }
            for e in parse(lines.iter().map(String::as_str)) {
                let _ = (e.section, e.key, e.value);
            }
            for l in numbered(lines.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, s)| (i + 1, s.as_str()))) {
                let _ = (l.line, l.entry.section, l.entry.key, l.entry.value);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_sections_and_values() {
        let src =
            "# comment\nschema = 2\n\n[params]\nbm25_k1 = 1.2\nbad = nan\n[word_w]\nfoo = 0.5\n";
        let entries = parse(src.lines());
        assert_eq!(entries.len(), 4);
        assert_eq!(entries[0].section, "");
        assert_eq!(entries[0].key, "schema");
        assert_eq!(entries[0].value, "2");
        assert_eq!(entries[1].section, "params");
        assert_eq!(entries[1].key, "bm25_k1");
        assert_eq!(float(entries[1].value), Some(1.2));
        assert!(float(entries[2].value).is_none(), "nan 必须拒绝");
        assert_eq!(entries[3].section, "word_w");
    }

    #[test]
    fn unquotes_and_typed_reads() {
        assert_eq!(strip("  \"abc\"  "), "abc");
        assert_eq!(size("42"), Some(42));
        assert_eq!(integer("7"), Some(7));
        assert_eq!(size("x"), None);
        assert_eq!(integer("-1"), None);
    }
}

//! 行内 token 级裁剪（`--trim 1`，LLMLingua-2 思路的零依赖启发式）。
//!
//! 与行级 `fill_floor` 互补：行级决定「哪些行保留」，token 级决定「保留行
//! 内部哪些 token 值得留下」。目标场景是 LLM 上下文压缩——GSM8K 8-shot
//! 这类密集推理文本行级几乎不可压（证据邻域膨胀），但行内大量 token 是
//! 停用词/纯标点/低信息量填充，可按重要性预算摘除而不破坏数字与语义锚。
//!
//! 打分规则（配置声明在 `policy`，此处只消费常量，零硬编码）：
//! - 数字/数值 token（含数字字符）最高重要：数学题的关键是数字。
//! - 结构锚 token（`<|`、`|>`、`<`、`>`、`[`、`]`、`{`、`}` 等）保留：
//!   摘除会破坏 chat/JSON/XML 骨架。
//! - 命中 query 词根的 token 高重要：与检索意图直接相关。
//! - 行首/行尾 token 强制保留：保持行边界可读与拼接完整。
//! - 停用词与纯标点低重要：优先摘除。
//!
//! 预算：每行可保留 token 数 = `max(1, 行内 token 数 × trim_ratio)`，
//! 先摘除低分 token，分数相同时按原顺序（确定性）。默认 `trim=0` 时
//! 本模块完全跳过，输出与现状逐字节一致。

/// 行内 token 视图：拆分规则对齐 `terms::ascii` 的 token 字符集
/// （ASCII 字母/数字/`_./:\@-`），但**不做**停用词剔除与长度下限——
/// 裁剪必须能看到停用词才能摘除它。
pub(crate) struct Tokens {
    /// token 起始字节偏移（升序）。
    pub(crate) start: Vec<usize>,
    /// token 结束字节偏移（不含）。
    pub(crate) end: Vec<usize>,
    /// 是否为数字 token（含至少一个 ASCII 数字）。
    pub(crate) numeric: Vec<bool>,
    /// 是否结构锚（单字符括号/尖括号/管道）。
    pub(crate) anchor: Vec<bool>,
    /// 是否命中 query 词根（小写词在 query 的切词表中出现过）。
    pub(crate) hit: Vec<bool>,
    /// 是否停用词（`terms::STOP` 命中）。
    pub(crate) stop: Vec<bool>,
    /// 是否语义敏感词（`terms::KEEP` 命中）：否定/比较/转折/数值语义，
    /// 永不摘除（与命中同级 score 2）。
    pub(crate) keep: Vec<bool>,
    /// 是否低信息量单字符（单 ASCII 字符/全角标点）：得分 0，优先摘除。
    pub(crate) punct: Vec<bool>,
}

/// 切分一行文本的 token 视图。`query_terms` 为 `terms::terms` 的词表（小写）。
///
/// ASCII 连续段成 token（与 `terms::ascii` 同字符集）；**CJK/全角单字各成
/// 一个 token**（`terms::full` 判定），使中文裁剪能保留命中字、摘除虚词，
/// 而不再把整段中文当非 token 丢弃（此前 `--trim` 对中文行只留 ASCII）。
pub(crate) fn tokens(line: &str, query_terms: &[String], op_keep: bool) -> Tokens {
    let lower = line.to_lowercase();
    let mut t = Tokens {
        start: Vec::new(),
        end: Vec::new(),
        numeric: Vec::new(),
        anchor: Vec::new(),
        hit: Vec::new(),
        stop: Vec::new(),
        keep: Vec::new(),
        punct: Vec::new(),
    };
    let bytes = line.as_bytes();
    let n = bytes.len();
    let mut cur = 0usize;
    while cur < n {
        if bytes[cur].is_ascii() {
            cur = scan_ascii(line, &lower, query_terms, cur, op_keep, &mut t);
        } else {
            cur = scan_cjk(line, query_terms, cur, op_keep, &mut t);
        }
    }
    t
}

/// ASCII 分支：跳过非 token 字符；连续 token 字符段成一个 token。
/// 返回下一个扫描位置。
fn scan_ascii(
    line: &str,
    lower: &str,
    query_terms: &[String],
    cur: usize,
    op_keep: bool,
    t: &mut Tokens,
) -> usize {
    let bytes = line.as_bytes();
    let n = bytes.len();
    if !token_char(bytes[cur], op_keep) {
        return cur + 1;
    }
    let s = cur;
    let mut c = cur;
    while c < n && bytes[c].is_ascii() && token_char(bytes[c], op_keep) {
        c += 1;
    }
    if c <= s {
        return c + 1;
    }
    let tok = &line[s..c];
    let tok_lower = &lower[s..c];
    t.start.push(s);
    t.end.push(c);
    t.numeric.push(tok.bytes().any(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()));
    t.anchor.push(is_anchor(tok, op_keep));
    t.hit
        .push(query_terms.iter().any(|q| q.as_str() == tok_lower));
    t.stop.push(crate::terms::STOP.contains(&tok_lower));
    t.keep.push(crate::terms::KEEP.contains(&tok_lower));
    // 单 ASCII 字符（字母/标点）非数字非锚：低信息量（保持旧口径）。
    t.punct
        .push(tok.len() == 1 && !tok.bytes().any(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()));
    c
}

/// 非 ASCII 分支：解码单个 UTF-8 char。CJK/全角字符（表意/假名/谚文/全角
/// 标点数字）作为单字 token；其余（emoji 等）整体跳过，不切坏字节。
/// 返回下一个扫描位置。
fn scan_cjk(
    line: &str,
    query_terms: &[String],
    cur: usize,
    op_keep: bool,
    t: &mut Tokens,
) -> usize {
    match line[cur..].chars().next() {
        Some(ch) if crate::terms::full(ch) => {
            let w = ch.len_utf8();
            let s = cur;
            let c = cur + w;
            let tok = &line[s..c];
            t.start.push(s);
            t.end.push(c);
            t.numeric.push(ch.is_numeric());
            t.anchor.push(is_anchor(tok, op_keep));
            // CJK 无大小写：单字命中任一 query term 的包含关系（"内存"
            // 在词表 → "内"/"存" 均命中）。
            t.hit.push(query_terms.iter().any(|q| q.contains(ch)));
            t.stop.push(crate::terms::STOP.contains(&tok));
            // CJK 无大小写：单字命中任一 KEEP 词（"不/没/无/每/共/总"等）。
            t.keep.push(crate::terms::KEEP.contains(&tok));
            // 全角标点（非表意/非数字）：低信息量，可摘除。
            t.punct
                .push(!crate::terms::ideograph(ch) && !ch.is_numeric());
            c
        }
        Some(ch) => cur + ch.len_utf8(),
        None => cur + 1,
    }
}

fn token_char(b: u8, op_keep: bool) -> bool {
    b.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
        || b"_./:\\@-<>|[]{}".contains(&b)
        || b == b'%'
        || b == b'$'
        || (op_keep && (b == b'+' || b == b'=' || b == b'*'))
}

/// 结构锚：单字节括号/尖括号/管道/大括号（JSON/XML/chat 骨架）、
/// 以及 chat 模板标记词 `im_start`/`im_end`（`<|im_start|>` 拆出的内部词）。
/// `<|im_start|>` 会被拆成 `<` `|` `im_start` `|` `>`，各成分均强制保留。
/// `op_keep` 打开时算术符号（`+` `=` `*` `-`）也强制保留——代码/算式
/// 语义核心，删了 `n ** 3` 变 `n 3`。默认关：GSM8K 数学场景无益（P6d
/// 实测），代码场景由 `--trim-op-keep 1` 打开（P6f）。
fn is_anchor(tok: &str, op_keep: bool) -> bool {
    matches!(
        tok,
        "<" | ">" | "[" | "]" | "{" | "}" | "|" | "im_start" | "im_end"
    ) || (op_keep && matches!(tok, "+" | "=" | "*" | "-"))
}

/// 裁剪一行：返回裁剪后的文本。`trim_ratio` ∈ (0,1]：**低分 token** 的保留比例。
///
/// 语义（对齐 LLMLingua-2 的 token 重要性裁剪，零依赖启发式）：
/// - 高重要 token 永不摘除：数字（答案关键）、命中 query 词根、结构锚。
/// - 低分 token（停用词/普通词/单字符标点）按 `trim_ratio` 保留——
///   先保分数高的，分数相同按原顺序。
/// - 行首/行尾 token 强制保留（保持行边界可读与拼接完整）。
/// - 组装按原文相邻性拼接：两 token 在原文中相邻（无分隔字符）则直接
///   相连，否则单空格分隔——CJK 逐字 token 因此保持成词（"内存" 不会
///   变成 "内 存"），ASCII token 间仍保留单空格。
pub(crate) fn trim_line(
    line: &str,
    query_terms: &[String],
    trim_ratio: f64,
    op_keep: bool,
) -> String {
    let t = tokens(line, query_terms, op_keep);
    let total = t.start.len();
    if total <= 1 {
        return line.trim().to_string();
    }
    // 高重要（数字/命中/锚）与行首尾：强制保留。
    let mut keep = vec![false; total];
    for (i, k) in keep.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        if score(&t, i) >= 2 || t.anchor[i] || i == 0 || i == total - 1 {
            *k = true;
        }
    }
    // 低分 token 候选（未强制保留）：保留分数较高的前 keep_low 个。
    // 同分按原顺序（稳定）。
    let low: Vec<usize> = (0..total).filter(|&i| !keep[i]).collect();
    if low.is_empty() {
        return line.trim().to_string();
    }
    let keep_low = ((low.len() as f64) * trim_ratio).ceil() as usize;
    let mut order: Vec<usize> = low.clone();
    order.sort_unstable_by(|&a, &b| {
        let sa = score(&t, a);
        let sb = score(&t, b);
        sb.partial_cmp(&sa)
            .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then(a.cmp(&b))
    });
    for &i in order.iter().take(keep_low) {
        keep[i] = true;
    }
    assemble(line, &t, &keep)
}

/// 组装：按原文相邻性拼接保留 token（原文相邻 → 直接相连，否则单空格）。
fn assemble(line: &str, t: &Tokens, keep: &[bool]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut prev_end: Option<usize> = None;
    for (i, &k) in keep.iter().enumerate() {
        if k {
            if let Some(pe) = prev_end {
                if pe != t.start[i] {
                    out.push(' ');
                }
            }
            out.push_str(&line[t.start[i]..t.end[i]]);
            prev_end = Some(t.end[i]);
        }
    }
    out
}

fn score(t: &Tokens, i: usize) -> i32 {
    if t.anchor[i] {
        4
    } else if t.numeric[i] {
        3
    } else if t.hit[i] || t.keep[i] {
        2
    } else if t.stop[i] || t.punct[i] {
        0
    } else {
        1
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn keeps_numerics_and_structure() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec!["janet".into(), "ducks".into()];
        let line = "Q: Janet's ducks lay 16 eggs per day.";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.5, false);
        assert!(out.contains("16"), "数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(
            out.to_lowercase().contains("janet"),
            "命中词必须保留: {out}"
        );
        assert!(out.len() < line.len(), "应有裁剪: {} -> {}", line, out);
    }

    #[test]
    fn trims_stopwords() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.5, false);
        assert!(!out.contains(" the "), "停用词应被摘除: {out}");
        assert!(
            out.starts_with("the ") || out.starts_with("quick"),
            "行首保留: {out}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn preserves_first_last() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "aaaa bbbb cccc dddd eeee ffff";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, false);
        assert!(out.starts_with("aaaa"), "行首 token 必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.ends_with("ffff"), "行尾 token 必须保留: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_or_single_token_passthrough() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        assert_eq!(trim_line("", &terms, 0.5, false), "");
        assert_eq!(trim_line("alpha", &terms, 0.5, false), "alpha");
    }

    #[test]
    fn budget_full_preserves_line() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "alpha beta gamma";
        assert_eq!(trim_line(line, &terms, 1.0, false), line);
    }

    #[test]
    fn chat_anchor_survives_aggressive_trim() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "<|im_start|> user hello world <|im_end|>";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.3, false);
        assert!(out.contains("<|im_start|>"), "chat 锚必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("<|im_end|>"), "chat 锚必须保留: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_keeps_hits_and_numbers_without_space() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec!["内存".into()];
        let line = "节点0 内存占用 512MB 缓存命中 耗时 0.3秒";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.5, false);
        assert!(out.contains("内存"), "命中 CJK 词必须保留成词: {out}");
        assert!(!out.contains("内 存"), "CJK 字间不得插空格: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('0'), "数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('5'), "数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(
            out.len() < line.len(),
            "中文行应有裁剪: {} -> {}",
            line,
            out
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_drops_stopword_chars() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "这个问题非常重要";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.3, false);
        // 行首尾强制保留；中间的虚词/普通字按预算摘除，长度必须下降。
        assert!(
            out.chars().count() < line.chars().count(),
            "虚词应被摘除: {out}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn keeps_semantic_sensitive_words() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        // not 在 STOP 里（0 分最易摘），但 KEEP 强制保留——语义反转不可接受。
        let line = "8 is not divisible by 5, but 10 is";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, false);
        assert!(out.to_lowercase().contains("not"), "否定词必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.to_lowercase().contains("but"), "转折词必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("8"), "数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("10"), "数字必须保留: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_negation_kept() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "这个数不能被 5 整除，但可以被 10 整除";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, false);
        assert!(out.contains('不'), "中文否定字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('但'), "中文转折字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('5'), "数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('1'), "数字必须保留: {out}");
    }
    #[test]
    fn percent_and_dollar_stay_with_numbers() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        // "30% of the trees die"：% 必须随数字保留，否则 30% 变成 30 棵（语义反转）。
        // "$2 per ticket"：$ 随数字保留，价格语义不丢。
        let line = "30% of the trees die, each costs $2";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, false);
        assert!(out.contains("30%"), "百分比必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("$2"), "货币符号必须随数字保留: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn keeps_code_operators() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        // 代码场景：运算符删了会破坏语义（n ** 3 变 n 3）。
        let line = "print(n ** 3)  x -= 30  t = s * 2";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, true);
        assert!(out.contains("**"), "幂运算符必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("="), "赋值号必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("*"), "乘号必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains("-"), "减号必须保留: {out}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_numeric_fullwidth_is_kept() {
        let terms: Vec<String> = vec![];
        let line = "总共 １２３ 个苹果";
        let out = trim_line(line, &terms, 0.2, false);
        assert!(out.contains('１'), "全角数字必须保留: {out}");
        assert!(out.contains('２'), "全角数字必须保留: {out}");
    }
}

//! `scx wrap`：包装一个命令，把其 stdout+stderr 合并后按需压缩输出。
//!
//! 用法：`scx wrap [--query Q] [--ratio R] [--context N] [--force P] [--preserve T] [--evidence N|substr] -- CMD...`
//!
//! 行为：执行 CMD，合并 stdout+stderr；小输出由 `compress` 内核自动 passthrough，
//! 大输出按 `--query`/`--force`/`--preserve` 压缩（无信号时 fail-open 保留原文）；
//! 正文写 stdout、效果卡写 stderr，退出码沿用 CMD。

use std::process::Command;

/// 主入口：解析 `--` 分隔的压缩选项与命令，执行后压缩输出。返回进程退出码。
/// 退出码沿用被包装命令；信号终止按 shell 惯例映射为 128+信号值。
fn exit_code(status: std::process::ExitStatus) -> i32 {
    if let Some(code) = status.code() {
        return code;
    }
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
        if let Some(sig) = status.signal() {
            return 128 + sig;
        }
    }
    1
}

pub fn run(args: &[String]) -> i32 {
    let Some(sep) = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--") else {
        eprintln!("scx wrap: usage: scx wrap [--query Q] [--ratio R] [--context N] [--force P] [--preserve T] [--evidence N|substr] -- CMD...");
        return 2;
    };
    let (opts, cmd) = (&args[..sep], &args[sep + 1..]);
    if cmd.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("scx wrap: missing command after --");
        return 2;
    }
    let (config, query) = match parse_opts(opts) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx wrap: {e}");
            return 2;
        }
    };

    // 执行命令，合并 stdout+stderr（命令的 stderr 也是排障证据，一并参与筛选）。
    // stdin 必须继承：`echo x | scx wrap -- cat` 的输入要交给被包装命令
    // （`Command::output()` 会把 stdin 置空，故手动 spawn + wait_with_output）。
    let child = match Command::new(&cmd[0])
        .args(&cmd[1..])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::inherit())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
    {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx wrap: cannot run {}: {e}", cmd[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    };
    let output = match child.wait_with_output() {
        Ok(o) => o,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx wrap: cannot read {} output: {e}", cmd[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    };
    let mut text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned();
    text.push_str(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));

    // 压缩（小输入 passthrough、无信号 fail-open 均由内核保证）。
    let outcome = crate::compress(&text, &query, &config);
    if let Err(e) = crate::ops::out_text(&outcome.text) {
        eprintln!("scx wrap: write stdout failed: {e}");
    }
    if !outcome.text.is_empty() && !outcome.text.ends_with('\n') {
        let _ = crate::ops::out_text("\n");
    }
    eprintln!("{}", crate::ops::recall_report(&outcome, &query));

    // 退出码沿用被包装命令；信号终止按 shell 惯例映射为 128+信号值。
    exit_code(output.status)
}

/// 解析 `--` 前的压缩选项（有限的声明式集合，与 args 表解耦）。
fn parse_opts(opts: &[String]) -> Result<(crate::Config, String), String> {
    let mut config = crate::Config::default();
    let mut query = String::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < opts.len() {
        let name = opts[i].as_str();
        let next = |i: &mut usize| -> Result<&str, String> {
            *i += 1;
            opts.get(*i)
                .map(|s| s.as_str())
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("{name} requires a value"))
        };
        match name {
            "--query" => query = next(&mut i)?.to_string(),
            "--ratio" => {
                let r: f64 = next(&mut i)?
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| "--ratio expects a number".to_string())?;
                config.ratio = r;
            }
            "--context" => {
                let c: i64 = next(&mut i)?
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| "--context expects an integer".to_string())?;
                config.context = c;
            }
            "--force" => config.forces.push(next(&mut i)?.to_string()),
            "--preserve" => {
                let ty = next(&mut i)?;
                crate::args::preserve_into(&mut config, ty)?;
            }
            "--evidence" => config.evidence.push(evidence(next(&mut i)?)),
            other => return Err(format!("unknown option {other}")),
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    Ok((config, query))
}

/// 显式证据解析：正整数 = 原始行号（1-based），其他 = 输出必须出现的子串。
/// 与 `args.rs` 的 `--evidence` 同口径（wrap 与 args 表解耦，故独立实现）。
fn evidence(v: &str) -> crate::Evidence {
    let trimmed = v.trim();
    match trimmed.parse::<usize>() {
        Ok(n) if n >= 1 => crate::Evidence::Line(n),
        _ => crate::Evidence::Substr(trimmed.to_string()),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parse_opts_reads_query_ratio_force_preserve() {
        let opts: Vec<String> = [
            "--query",
            "db timeout",
            "--ratio",
            "0.5",
            "--force",
            "SPECIAL",
            "--preserve",
            "url",
        ]
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .collect();
        let (config, query) = parse_opts(&opts).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(query, "db timeout");
        assert!((config.ratio - 0.5).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert_eq!(
            config.forces,
            vec!["SPECIAL".to_string(), "re://".to_string()]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_opts_rejects_unknown_and_missing_value() {
        assert!(parse_opts(&["--bogus".to_string()]).is_err());
        assert!(parse_opts(&["--query".to_string()]).is_err());
        assert!(parse_opts(&["--preserve".to_string(), "bogus".to_string()]).is_err());
    }
}

【L1】以下 CUDA 规约代码中，块 0 的 g[0] 是多少（d[0..15] = 0..15）？
```cuda
__global__ void k(int* g, int* d) {
    __shared__ int s[16];
    s[threadIdx.x] = d[threadIdx.x];
    __syncthreads();
    for (int stride = 8; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
        if (threadIdx.x < stride) s[threadIdx.x] += s[threadIdx.x + stride];
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (threadIdx.x == 0) g[0] = s[0];
}
k<<<1, 16>>>();
```
【L2】上述规约代码中，如果 s 数组改为 stride 访问 s[threadIdx.x * 2]（线程访问间隔 2），会引入什么问题？
【L3】要规约 100 万个 int（超出单块共享内存），最合理的分层架构是什么？
