    /// 朴素参考实现：线性查找重复，独立于生产实现的 HashMap/复用路径。
    #[allow(dead_code)] // clippy 对 test 参考实现误报
    fn naive_dedup(
        lines: &[&str],
        mask: &[u64],
        words: usize,
        err: &[bool],
        force: &[bool],
        _code_keep: bool,
    ) -> (Vec<bool>, usize) {
        let mut keys: Vec<(String, usize)> = Vec::with_capacity(lines.len());
        let mut dup = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let mut n = 0usize;
        let mut key = String::new();
        for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
            key.clear();
            normalize(line, &mut key);
            if short(&key) {
                continue;
            }
            match keys.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| *k == key) {
                Some((_, count)) => {
                    *count += 1;
                    let h = hit(mask, words, i);
                    if foldable(count, h, err[i], force[i], _code_keep, false) {
                        dup[i] = true;
                        n += 1;
                    }
                }
                None => keys.push((std::mem::take(&mut key), 1)),
            }
        }
        (dup, n)
    }

    #[test]
    fn zh_keep_preserves_question_lines_and_skips_trim() {
        // zh-keep=1：中文问句行整行保留并跳过行内 trim（题干不被摘碎）。
        let text = [
            "CUDA 编程模型里，kernel<<<4,32>>> 启动后第 2 号块 blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？",
            "请用答案格式作答：答案是 X #### X。",
            "背景知识行：共享内存是块内线程共享的高速存储区域。",
        ]
        .join("\n");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg);
        let q_line = "blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？";
        assert!(
            out.text.contains(q_line),
            "zh-keep 问句行必须整行保留: {}",
            out.text
        );
        assert!(
            out.text.contains("答案是 X #### X"),
            "格式要求行必须整行保留: {}",
            out.text
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn zh_keep_off_keeps_previous_behavior() {
        // 默认 zh_keep=0：问句行被行内 trim 摘碎（对照）；zh_keep=1 整行保留。
        // 多行输入避开小输入透传（单行 <SMALL_TOK 会 fail-open 原样返回）。
        let ctx = (0..45)
            .map(|_| "背景：CUDA 编程模型 kernel GPU 线程，共享内存是块内线程共享的高速存储，原子操作保证并发安全。")
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let q = "问题：kernel<<<4,32>>> 启动后第 2 号块 blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？请用答案是 69 #### 69 格式作答。";
        let text = format!("{ctx}\n{q}");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: false,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg);
        assert!(
            !out.text.contains("全局线性线程 ID 是多少"),
            "zh-keep=0 时问句行应被 trim 摘碎（对照行为）: {}",
            out.text
        );
        let cfg2 = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out2 = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg2);
        assert!(
            out2.text.contains("全局线性线程 ID 是多少"),
            "zh-keep=1 时问句行必须整行保留: {}",
            out2.text
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn drop_runs_budget_runs() {

        let dup = vec![false; 6];

        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr[0].start, dr[0].end), (2, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);
        assert_eq!((dr[1].start, dr[1].end), (5, 5));

    }

    fn drop_runs_overflow_reason() {
        let keep = vec![false, false, true];
        let dr = runs(&keep, &[false; 3], true);
        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::MaxTokens);
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason.as_str(), "max-tokens");

        assert_eq!(crate::Reason::Dedup.as_str(), "dedup");
    }

    #[test]
    fn drop_runs_dedup_splits_from_budget() {
        // dup 行记 Dedup，与相邻 budget 行拆分为不同区间。
        let keep = vec![true, false, false];
        let dup = vec![false, true, false];
        let dr = runs(&keep, &dup, false);
        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr[0].start, dr[0].end), (2, 2));
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::Dedup);
        assert_eq!((dr[1].start, dr[1].end), (3, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr[1].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);
        // 同一原因延续不拆分：两个相邻 dup 合并为一个 Dedup 区间。
        let keep2 = vec![true, false, false, false];
        let dup2 = vec![false, true, true, false];
        let dr2 = runs(&keep2, &dup2, false);
        assert_eq!(dr2.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr2[0].start, dr2[0].end), (2, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr2[0].reason, crate::Reason::Dedup);
        assert_eq!((dr2[1].start, dr2[1].end), (4, 4));
        assert_eq!(dr2[1].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);
    }

    #[test]
    fn dedup_matches_naive_reference_on_generated_corpora() {
        // 确定性 LCG 生成含连续重复、数字/十六进制、空白与短行的语料，
        // 生产实现（含「与上一行相同则复用归一化」快速路径）必须与朴素参考一致。
        let alphabet = b" abcef0129\t#=:xX-";
        let mut state = 0x1234_5678u32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..300 {
            let len = (next() as usize >> 8) % 24;
            let mut raw: Vec<String> = Vec::with_capacity(len);
            let mut prev = String::new();
            for _ in 0..len {
                let roll = next() as usize;
                // 30% 概率重复上一行，触达快速路径。
                if roll % 10 < 3 && !prev.is_empty() {
                    raw.push(prev.clone());
                    continue;
                }
                let n = (next() as usize >> 8) % 20;
                let mut s = String::new();
                for _ in 0..n {
                    s.push(alphabet[(next() as usize >> 16) % alphabet.len()] as char);
                }
                prev = s.clone();
                raw.push(s);
            }
            let lines: Vec<&str> = raw.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
            // 掩码随机置位（模拟查询命中），错误/force 同理。
            let mut mask = vec![0u64; lines.len() * 2];
            for slot in mask.iter_mut() {
                if next() % 7 == 0 {
                    *slot = 1;
                }
            }
            let err: Vec<bool> = (0..lines.len()).map(|_| next() % 11 == 0).collect();
            let force: Vec<bool> = (0..lines.len()).map(|_| next() % 13 == 0).collect();
            let got = dedup(&lines, &mask, 2, &err, &force, false);
            let want = naive_dedup(&lines, &mask, 2, &err, &force, false);
            assert_eq!(got, want, "dedup mismatch on {:?}", raw);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn token_table_matches_estimate_and_falls_back() {
        let lines = ["abc", "数据库连接超时", "x y z 42"];
        let (tok, total) = tally(&lines, 3, 0.0, true);
        let want: f64 = lines.iter().map(|l| crate::terms::estimate(l)).sum();
        assert_eq!(total, want);
        for (i, l) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(est(&tok, &lines, i), crate::terms::estimate(l));
        }
        // do_tok=false：空表 + small_tok，调用方回退现算。
        let (empty, small) = tally(&lines, 3, 7.5, false);
        assert!(empty.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(small, 7.5);
        assert_eq!(est(&empty, &lines, 1), crate::terms::estimate(lines[1]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn dedup_skips_short_and_padded_lines() {
        // 归一化键 < 6 字符（含首尾空白填充）的行从不参与折叠；长行仍按
        // 第 3 次起折叠。快速路径（trim 后 < 6 字节直接跳过）不得改变判定。
        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![
            "abc",
            "   abc   ",
            "a\tb",
            "错误",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
        ];
        let mask = vec![0u64; lines.len()];
        let err = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let force = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let (dup, n) = dedup(&lines, &mask, 0, &err, &force, false);
        assert!(!dup[0] && !dup[1] && !dup[2] && !dup[3], "短/填充行不折叠");
        assert!(dup[6] && dup[7], "长行第 3、4 次出现应折叠");
        assert_eq!(n, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn code_keep_folds_hit_templates_but_never_code() {
        // code_keep=1：重复格式模板（命中 query）折叠；围栏内代码行永不折叠。
        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
        ];
        // mask 置满 → 所有行都命中 query（hit 豁免），验证 code_keep 覆盖命中。
        let words = 2usize;
        let mask = vec![u64::MAX; lines.len() * words];
        let err = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let force = vec![false; lines.len()];
        // 关：命中行不折叠（现状行为）。
        let (dup0, n0) = dedup(&lines, &mask, words, &err, &force, false);
        assert_eq!(n0, 0, "命中豁免：默认不折叠任何行");
        assert!(dup0.iter().all(|&d| !d));
        // 开：Q 模板第 3 次起折叠，围栏行与代码行永不折叠。
        let (dup1, n1) = dedup(&lines, &mask, words, &err, &force, true);
        assert_eq!(n1, 1, "第 3 个 Q 模板行折叠");
        assert!(dup1[8], "第 3 个 Q 模板行折叠");
        assert!(!dup1[4], "第 2 个 Q 模板行保留（前两次不折叠）");
        assert!(
            !dup1[1] && !dup1[2] && !dup1[6] && !dup1[10],
            "围栏行与代码行永不折叠"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn nan_sims_do_not_poison_scores() {
        // 外部嵌入命令输出 NaN 时不得进入排序分（比较器会失去全序）。
        let text = (0..200)
            .map(|i| format!("line {i}: conn pool timeout db error 9f2a"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            sims: Some(vec![f64::NAN; 200]),
            ..crate::Config::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "conn timeout", &cfg);
        assert!(out.kept >= 1, "NaN 相似度不应破坏压缩结果");
        assert!(out.text.is_char_boundary(0));
    }

    }

        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![

    }

    #[test]
    fn code_fence_keeps_and_marks_raw_only_inside() {
        let lines = [
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "print(a // b)",
            "```",
            "A: 答案是 8",
        ];
        let mut keep = vec![false, false, false, false, false, false];
        let mut kept = 0usize;
        let mut reason = vec![0u8; 6];
        let mut raw = vec![false; 6];
        mark_code_fence(&lines, &mut keep, &mut kept, &mut reason, &mut raw);
        // 围栏行 + 围栏内代码行全部保留且 raw；说明行不受影响。
        assert_eq!(keep, vec![false, true, true, true, true, false]);
        assert_eq!(raw, vec![false, true, true, true, true, false]);
        assert_eq!(kept, 4);
        // 已保留行不重复计数（kept 只统计新保留）。
        mark_code_fence(&lines, &mut keep, &mut kept, &mut reason, &mut raw);
        assert_eq!(kept, 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn scoped_gates_far_errors() {
        // 全量守卫（None）保留所有错误行；区域门控（Some）只保留证据邻域内的错误行。
        let keep = vec![false; 5];
        let dup = vec![false; 5];
        let guard_lines = vec![true, true, true, true, true];
        let marker = vec![false; 5];
        let in_region = vec![false, false, true, false, false];
        let mut reason = vec![0u8; 5];

        let mut k_full = keep.clone();
        let mut kc = 0;
        guard(
            &mut k_full,
            &mut kc,
            &dup,
            &guard_lines,
            &marker,
            None,
            &mut reason,
        );
        assert_eq!(kc, 5, "全量守卫保留所有错误行");

        let mut k_region = keep.clone();
        let mut kc2 = 0;
        guard(
            &mut k_region,
            &mut kc2,
            &dup,
            &guard_lines,
            &marker,
            Some(&in_region),
            &mut reason,
        );
        assert_eq!(kc2, 1, "区域门控只保留证据邻域内的错误行");
        assert!(k_region[2], "in-region 错误行保留");
    }
}

//! 压缩管线·规划阶段（compress/plan）：切行统计、折叠判定、权重打分、
//! 种子与结构区域识别。纯函数、无 I/O；全部 `pub(crate)` 供管线阶段互调。

use super::*;
use crate::analysis::{
    closes, diff, fence, flags, frame, heading, import, lineref, marker, meta, stack,
};
use crate::analysis::{lowercase, normalize};
use crate::policy::Weights;
use crate::Config;

pub(crate) struct Mask {
    pub(crate) mask: Vec<u64>,
    pub(crate) words: usize,
    pub(crate) errs: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) marked: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) guards: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) pinned: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) total_tok: f64,
    /// 每行 token 估算（空 = 未计算，调用方回退现算）。
    pub(crate) tok: Vec<f64>,
}

pub(crate) fn tally(lines: &[&str], total: usize, small_tok: f64, do_tok: bool) -> (Vec<f64>, f64) {
    if !do_tok {
        return (Vec::new(), small_tok);
    }
    let mut tok = vec![0.0; total];
    let mut sum = 0.0;
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        tok[i] = crate::terms::estimate(line);
        sum += tok[i];
    }
    (tok, sum)
}

pub(crate) fn masks(
    lines: &[&str],
    terms: &[String],
    forces: &[Force],
    small_tok: f64,
    do_tok: bool,
    precise: bool,
) -> Mask {
    let total = lines.len();
    let words = terms.len().div_ceil(64).max(1);
    let mut mask = vec![0u64; total * words];
    let mut errs = vec![false; total];
    let mut marked = vec![false; total];
    let mut guards = vec![false; total];
    let mut pinned = vec![false; total];
    // 每行 token 估算表：供填充与记账复用（此前同一批行会被 estimate 2–3 次）。
    // do_tok=false（小输入/针尖档）时为空表，调用方回退现算。
    let (tok, total_tok) = tally(lines, total, small_tok, do_tok);
    let mut low = String::new();
    for i in 0..total {
        low.clear();
        lowercase(lines[i], &mut low);
        let ll = low.as_str();
        let (err, guard) = flags(ll);
        errs[i] = err;
        guards[i] = if precise { error_line(ll) } else { guard };
        marked[i] = marker(ll);
        pinned[i] = forces.iter().any(|p| match p {
            Force::Sub(s) => ll.contains(s.as_str()),
            Force::Re(n) => n.matches(ll),
        });
        let base = i * words;
        for (k, t) in terms.iter().enumerate() {
            if ll.contains(t.as_str()) {
                mask[base + k / 64] |= 1u64 << (k % 64);
            }
        }
    }
    Mask {
        mask,
        words,
        errs,
        marked,
        guards,
        pinned,
        total_tok,
        tok,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn dedup(
    lines: &[&str],
    mask: &[u64],
    words: usize,
    err: &[bool],
    force: &[bool],
    code_keep: bool,
) -> (Vec<bool>, usize) {
    let total = lines.len();
    let mut seen: hash::Hash<String, usize> =
        hash::Hash::with_capacity_and_hasher(total, Default::default());
    let mut dup = vec![false; total];
    let mut folds = 0usize;
    let mut key = String::new();
    // 与上一行原文相同（日志里连续重复很常见）时，key 里的归一化结果仍然有效，
    // 省掉一次 normalize。字符串相等先比长度再比字节，差异行通常是廉价判断。
    let mut prev: Option<&str> = None;
    // 围栏感知（code_keep 时）：围栏区间内代码行禁折叠。
    let fence = if code_keep {
        fence_mask(lines)
    } else {
        vec![false; total]
    };
    for i in 0..total {
        if prev != Some(lines[i]) {
            key.clear();
            normalize(lines[i], &mut key);
            prev = Some(lines[i]);
        }
        if short(&key) {
            continue;
        }
        match seen.get_mut(key.as_str()) {
            Some(n) => {
                *n += 1;
                let is_dup = foldable(
                    n,
                    hit(mask, words, i),
                    err[i],
                    force[i],
                    code_keep,
                    fence[i],
                );
                dup[i] = is_dup;
                folds += usize::from(is_dup);
            }
            None => {
                seen.insert(key.clone(), 1);
            }
        }
    }
    (dup, folds)
}

/// 围栏掩码（code_keep 时）：``` 区间内的代码行标记，禁折叠。
fn fence_mask(lines: &[&str]) -> Vec<bool> {
    let mut fence = vec![false; lines.len()];
    let mut in_fence = false;
    for i in 0..lines.len() {
        if lines[i].trim_start().starts_with("```") {
            in_fence = !in_fence;
            fence[i] = true;
        } else if in_fence {
            fence[i] = true;
        }
    }
    fence
}

pub(crate) fn short(key: &str) -> bool {
    let key_len = if key.is_ascii() {
        key.len()
    } else {
        key.chars().count()
    };
    key_len < 6
}

pub(crate) fn hit(mask: &[u64], words: usize, i: usize) -> bool {
    (0..words).any(|w| mask[i * words + w] != 0)
}

pub(crate) fn foldable(
    n: &usize,
    hit: bool,
    err: bool,
    force: bool,
    code_keep: bool,
    fence: bool,
) -> bool {
    *n > 2 && (!hit || code_keep) && !err && !force && !fence
}

pub(crate) struct Stat {
    pub(crate) df: Vec<usize>,
    pub(crate) weights: Vec<f64>,
    pub(crate) rare_thr: usize,
}

pub(crate) fn weights(
    mask: &[u64],
    words: usize,
    dup: &[bool],
    n_terms: usize,
    folds: usize,
) -> Stat {
    let total = dup.len();
    let live: usize = total - folds;
    let n_live = live.max(1) as f64;
    let mut df = vec![0usize; n_terms];
    for (i, &is_dup) in dup.iter().enumerate() {
        if is_dup {
            continue;
        }
        let base = i * words;
        for w in 0..words {
            let mut bits = mask[base + w];
            while bits != 0 {
                let k = w * 64 + bits.trailing_zeros() as usize;
                bits &= bits - 1;
                if k < n_terms {
                    df[k] += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let weights: Vec<f64> = df
        .iter()
        .map(|&d| (1.0 + n_live / (1.0 + d as f64)).ln())
        .collect();
    let rare_thr = (live / 5).max(1);
    Stat {
        df,
        weights,
        rare_thr,
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Seed {
    pub(crate) seed: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) hits: Vec<usize>,
    pub(crate) sumw: Vec<f64>,
    pub(crate) hit_lines: usize,
    pub(crate) force_any: bool,
}

pub(crate) fn marks(
    mask: &[u64],
    words: usize,
    dup: &[bool],
    df: &[usize],
    weights: &[f64],
    rare_thr: usize,
    force: &[bool],
) -> Seed {
    let total = dup.len();
    let mut hits = vec![0usize; total];
    let mut sumw = vec![0.0f64; total];
    let mut seed = vec![false; total];
    let mut hit_lines = 0usize;
    let mut force_any = false;
    for i in 0..total {
        if dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        let base = i * words;
        let (h, sw, lone) = count(mask, base, words, df.len(), weights);
        let fm = force[i];
        force_any |= fm;
        hits[i] = h;
        sumw[i] = sw;
        seed[i] = rare(h, lone, df, rare_thr, fm);
        if h > 0 {
            hit_lines += 1;
        }
    }
    Seed {
        seed,
        hits,
        sumw,
        hit_lines,
        force_any,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn count(
    mask: &[u64],
    base: usize,
    words: usize,
    df_len: usize,
    weights: &[f64],
) -> (usize, f64, usize) {
    let mut h = 0usize;
    let mut sw = 0.0f64;
    let mut lone = usize::MAX;
    for w in 0..words {
        let mut bits = mask[base + w];
        while bits != 0 {
            let k = w * 64 + bits.trailing_zeros() as usize;
            bits &= bits - 1;
            if k >= df_len {
                continue;
            }
            h += 1;
            sw += weights[k];
            lone = if h == 1 { k } else { usize::MAX };
        }
    }
    (h, sw, lone)
}

pub(crate) struct Region {
    pub(crate) in_region: Vec<bool>,
    /// 仅结构区域（`--structure 1` 时 merge 并入的行）；默认关时全 false。
    pub(crate) struct_region: Vec<bool>,
    pub(crate) count: usize,
    pub(crate) gate: bool,
}

pub(crate) fn expand(
    seed: &[bool],
    window: usize,
    total: usize,
    structs: Option<&Shape>,
) -> Region {
    let mut in_region = vec![false; total];
    let mut struct_region = vec![false; total];
    let seed_idx: Vec<usize> = (0..total).filter(|&i| seed[i]).collect();
    // 结构并入是“叠加”而非“替代”：基础种子邻域（±window + gap 合并）先行，
    // 含种子的结构区域整段并入其上；count 以合并后的 mask 重算。
    let count = if let Some(map) = structs {
        windows(&seed_idx, window, total, &mut in_region);
        merge(seed, window, total, map, &mut in_region, &mut struct_region);
        regions(&in_region)
    } else {
        windows(&seed_idx, window, total, &mut in_region)
    };
    Region {
        in_region,
        struct_region,
        count,
        gate: (0..total).any(|i| seed[i]),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn windows(seed_idx: &[usize], w: usize, total: usize, in_region: &mut [bool]) -> usize {
    let maxgap = (w * crate::policy::GAP_RATIO).max(2);
    if seed_idx.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut count = 0usize;
    let mut a = seed_idx[0].saturating_sub(w);
    let mut b = (seed_idx[0] + w).min(total - 1);
    for &s in &seed_idx[1..] {
        if s <= b + maxgap {
            b = (s + w).min(total - 1);
        } else {
            for slot in in_region.iter_mut().take(b + 1).skip(a) {
                *slot = true;
            }
            count += 1;
            a = s.saturating_sub(w);
            b = (s + w).min(total - 1);
        }
    }
    for slot in in_region.iter_mut().take(b + 1).skip(a) {
        *slot = true;
    }
    count + 1
}

pub(crate) fn merge(
    seed: &[bool],
    window: usize,
    total: usize,
    map: &Shape,
    in_region: &mut [bool],
    struct_region: &mut [bool],
) {
    for r in &map.regions {
        if !(r.start..=r.end).any(|i| seed[i]) {
            continue;
        }
        if r.end - r.start < crate::policy::REGION_DEFAULT.max_span {
            for (slot, sslot) in in_region
                .iter_mut()
                .zip(struct_region.iter_mut())
                .take(r.end + 1)
                .skip(r.start)
            {
                *slot = true;
                *sslot = true;
            }
        } else {
            let half = crate::policy::REGION_DEFAULT.max_span / 2;
            let idx: Vec<usize> = (r.start..=r.end).filter(|&i| seed[i]).collect();
            windows(&idx, half.max(window), total, in_region);
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn regions(in_region: &[bool]) -> usize {
    let mut count = 0usize;
    let mut prev = false;
    for &b in in_region {
        if b && !prev {
            count += 1;
        }
        prev = b;
    }
    count
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Kind {
    Import,
    Stack,
}

pub(crate) struct Span {
    pub(crate) start: usize,
    pub(crate) end: usize,
}

pub(crate) struct Shape {
    pub(crate) regions: Vec<Span>,
}

pub(crate) fn structures(lines: &[&str]) -> Shape {
    let mut regions: Vec<Span> = Vec::new();
    let mut block: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut cur: Option<(usize, Kind)> = None;
    let mut brace = Brace::new();
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some(start) = block {
            if closes(line) {
                regions.push(Span { start, end: i });
                block = None;
                cur = None;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if fence(line) {
            // 进入 fence 前先收尾此前的连续结构段（如 import 块），否则该段
            // 起点会随 cur 一起被丢弃，`--structure 1` 保护不到它。
            close(&mut regions, cur, i.saturating_sub(1));
            block = Some(i);
            cur = None;
            brace.reset();
            continue;
        }
        brace.scan(i, line, &mut regions);
        let kind = kind(line);
        if !continues(cur, kind) {
            close(&mut regions, cur, i.saturating_sub(1));
            cur = kind.map(|k2| (i, k2));
        }
    }
    close(&mut regions, cur, lines.len().saturating_sub(1));
    Shape { regions }
}

pub(crate) struct Brace {
    pub(crate) start: Option<usize>,
    pub(crate) depth: usize,
}

impl Brace {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Brace {
            start: None,
            depth: 0,
        }
    }

    /// 进入 fence 时丢弃未闭合的块（fence 内行不参与大括号判定）。
    pub(crate) fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.start = None;
        self.depth = 0;
    }

    /// 扫描一行的大括号，块闭合时追加 Span。
    pub(crate) fn scan(&mut self, i: usize, line: &str, regions: &mut Vec<Span>) {
        let (opens, closes) = braces(line);
        if self.start.is_none() {
            if opens > 0 {
                self.start = Some(i);
                self.depth = opens.saturating_sub(closes);
                if self.depth == 0 {
                    regions.push(Span { start: i, end: i });
                    self.start = None;
                }
            }
        } else {
            self.depth = self.depth.saturating_add(opens).saturating_sub(closes);
            if self.depth == 0 {
                regions.push(Span {
                    start: self.start.unwrap(),
                    end: i,
                });
                self.start = None;
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn braces(line: &str) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut opens = 0usize;
    let mut closes = 0usize;
    for &b in line.as_bytes() {
        match b {
            b'{' => opens += 1,
            b'}' => closes += 1,
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    (opens, closes)
}

pub(crate) fn continues(cur: Option<(usize, Kind)>, kind: Option<Kind>) -> bool {
    match (cur, kind) {
        (Some((_, k)), Some(k2)) => k == k2,
        _ => false,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn kind(line: &str) -> Option<Kind> {
    if import(line) {
        Some(Kind::Import)
    } else if stack(line) {
        Some(Kind::Stack)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

pub(crate) fn close(regions: &mut Vec<Span>, cur: Option<(usize, Kind)>, end: usize) {
    if let Some((start, _)) = cur {
        if end >= start {
            regions.push(Span { start, end });
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn score(
    lines: &[&str],
    hits: &[usize],
    sumw: &[f64],
    err: &[bool],
    force: &[bool],
    i: usize,
    tbl: &Weights,
) -> f64 {
    let total = lines.len();
    let line = lines[i];
    let mut sc = sumw[i] * tbl.sumw_mul;
    sc += state(hits[i], err[i], force[i], i, total, tbl);
    sc += region(line, hits[i], tbl);
    sc
}

pub(crate) fn state(
    hits: usize,
    err: bool,
    force: bool,
    i: usize,
    total: usize,
    tbl: &Weights,
) -> f64 {
    let mut sc = 0.0;
    if hits >= 2 {
        sc += tbl.pair_bonus;
    }
    if err {
        sc += tbl.error_bonus;
    }
    if force {
        sc += tbl.force_bonus;
    }
    if edge(i, total, tbl) {
        sc += tbl.edge_bonus;
    }
    sc
}

pub(crate) fn region(line: &str, hits: usize, tbl: &Weights) -> f64 {
    let mut sc = 0.0;
    if heading(line) {
        sc += tbl.heading_bonus;
    }
    if meta(line) {
        sc += tbl.diffmeta_bonus;
    }
    if patch(line, hits) {
        sc += tbl.diffline_hit_bonus;
    }
    if trace(line) {
        sc += tbl.frame_bonus;
    }
    sc
}

pub(crate) fn patch(line: &str, hits: usize) -> bool {
    diff(line) && hits > 0
}

pub(crate) fn trace(line: &str) -> bool {
    frame(line) || lineref(line)
}

pub(crate) fn edge(i: usize, total: usize, tbl: &Weights) -> bool {
    i < tbl.edge_head || i >= total.saturating_sub(tbl.edge_tail)
}

pub(crate) fn scores(
    lines: &[&str],
    dup: &[bool],
    hits: &[usize],
    sumw: &[f64],
    err: &[bool],
    force: &[bool],
    tbl: &Weights,
) -> Vec<f64> {
    let total = lines.len();
    let mut scores = vec![0.0f64; total];
    for i in 0..total {
        if dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        scores[i] = score(lines, hits, sumw, err, force, i, tbl);
    }
    scores
}

pub(crate) fn boost(scores: &[f64], dup: &[bool], window: usize, tbl: &Weights) -> Vec<f64> {
    let total = scores.len();
    let mut boost = vec![0.0f64; total];
    for (i, b) in boost.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        let mut m = 0.0f64;
        for d in -(window as i64)..=window as i64 {
            let j = i as i64 + d;
            if j >= 0 && (j as usize) < total && !dup[j as usize] {
                m = m.max(scores[j as usize]);
            }
        }
        *b = (m / tbl.boost_div).min(tbl.boost_cap);
    }
    boost
}

pub(crate) fn apply_sims(cfg: &Config, scores: &mut [f64], dup: &[bool], total: usize) {
    let Some(sims) = &cfg.sims else {
        return;
    };
    if cfg.sim_weight == 0.0 {
        return;
    }
    for i in 0..total {
        if !dup[i] && i < sims.len() {
            // 外部嵌入命令可能输出 NaN/inf（`f64::from_str` 接受 "NaN"）；
            // 一旦进入 scores，排序比较器将不再满足全序，std 会 panic 或乱序。
            if sims[i].is_finite() {
                scores[i] += sims[i] * cfg.sim_weight;
            }
        }
    }
}

//! 压缩管线·渲染阶段（compress/render）：保留/裁剪区间落地、原因注释、
//! 输出截断与效果说明。纯函数、无 I/O；全部 `pub(crate)`。

use super::*;
use crate::{Config, Mode, Risk};

pub(crate) fn render(
    lines: &[&str],
    keep: &[bool],
    cfg: &Config,
    raw: &[bool],
    query_terms: &[String],
) -> (String, Vec<usize>) {
    let mut out_text = String::with_capacity(lines.len() / 2);
    let mut numbers = Vec::with_capacity(keep.len());
    let mut in_gap = false;
    for (i, &k) in keep.iter().enumerate() {
        if k {
            if in_gap && cfg.elide {
                out_text.push_str("...\n");
            }
            in_gap = false;
            emit_line(
                &mut out_text,
                &mut numbers,
                i,
                lines[i],
                cfg,
                raw,
                query_terms,
            );
        } else {
            in_gap = true;
        }
    }
    if in_gap && cfg.elide {
        out_text.push_str("...\n");
    }
    (out_text, numbers)
}

/// 单行落地：行号前缀、行内 trim（raw 行跳过）、追加换行并记录序号。
fn emit_line(
    out: &mut String,
    numbers: &mut Vec<usize>,
    i: usize,
    line: &str,
    cfg: &Config,
    raw: &[bool],
    query_terms: &[String],
) {
    if cfg.lineno {
        prefix(out, i + 1);
    }
    let text = if cfg.trim && !raw[i] {
        crate::trim::trim_line(line, query_terms, cfg.trim_ratio, cfg.trim_op_keep)
    } else {
        line.to_string()
    };
    out.push_str(&text);
    out.push('\n');
    numbers.push(i + 1);
}

pub(crate) fn spans(
    cfg: &Config,
    seed: &[bool],
    window: usize,
    total: usize,
    lines: &[&str],
) -> Region {
    if cfg.structure {
        let map = structures(lines);
        expand(seed, window, total, Some(&map))
    } else {
        expand(seed, window, total, None)
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "semantic")]
pub(crate) fn semantic(
    cfg: &Config,
    lines: &[&str],
    uniq_terms: &[String],
    total: usize,
    dup: &[bool],
    scores: &mut [f64],
) {
    if let Some(w) = &cfg.semantic {
        for i in 0..total {
            if dup[i] {
                continue;
            }
            scores[i] += w.score(&crate::semantic::feats(lines[i], uniq_terms, w.dim));
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(not(feature = "semantic"))]
pub(crate) fn semantic(
    _cfg: &Config,
    _lines: &[&str],
    _uniq_terms: &[String],
    _total: usize,
    _dup: &[bool],
    _scores: &mut [f64],
) {
}

pub(crate) fn optional(
    sel: &Select,
    cfg: &Fill,
    context: i64,
    overflow: Option<Mode>,
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) -> f64 {
    if context == 0 || overflow.is_some() {
        return 0.0;
    }
    fill(sel, cfg, keep, kept, reason)
}

pub(crate) fn active(risk: Risk, cfg: &Config) -> bool {
    risk == Risk::High && cfg.gate
}

pub(crate) fn runs(keep: &[bool], dup: &[bool], overflow: bool) -> Vec<crate::Dropped> {
    let mut out: Vec<crate::Dropped> = Vec::with_capacity(keep.len() / 2);
    let mut start: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut cur = crate::Reason::Budget;
    for (i, &k) in keep.iter().enumerate() {
        if k {
            if let Some(s) = start.take() {
                run(&mut out, s, i, cur);
            }
            continue;
        }
        let reason = drop_reason(dup[i], overflow);
        advance(&mut out, &mut start, &mut cur, i, reason);
    }
    if let Some(s) = start {
        run(&mut out, s, keep.len(), cur);
    }
    out
}

pub(crate) fn drop_reason(dup: bool, overflow: bool) -> crate::Reason {
    if dup {
        crate::Reason::Dedup
    } else if overflow {
        crate::Reason::MaxTokens
    } else {
        crate::Reason::Budget
    }
}

pub(crate) fn advance(
    out: &mut Vec<crate::Dropped>,
    start: &mut Option<usize>,
    cur: &mut crate::Reason,
    i: usize,
    reason: crate::Reason,
) {
    match *start {
        None => {
            *start = Some(i);
            *cur = reason;
        }
        Some(s) if reason != *cur => {
            run(out, s, i, *cur);
            *start = Some(i);
            *cur = reason;
        }
        Some(_) => {}
    }
}

pub(crate) fn run(out: &mut Vec<crate::Dropped>, start: usize, end: usize, reason: crate::Reason) {
    out.push(crate::Dropped {
        start: start + 1,
        end,
        reason,
    });
}

pub(crate) fn explain(reason: &[u8], dup: &[bool]) -> Vec<crate::Explain> {
    reason
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, &r)| match r {
            R_SEED => crate::Explain::Seed,
            R_CONTEXT => crate::Explain::Context,
            R_FILL => crate::Explain::Fill,
            R_GUARD => crate::Explain::Guard,
            R_ANCHOR => crate::Explain::Anchor,
            R_NUM_LINE => crate::Explain::NumLine,
            R_SYM_LINE => crate::Explain::SymLine,
            R_ZH_LINE => crate::Explain::ZhLine,
            _ => {
                if dup[i] {
                    crate::Explain::Dedup
                } else {
                    crate::Explain::Dropped
                }
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) fn cut(out_text: &str, chars_a: usize) -> (usize, f64) {
    let chars_b = if out_text.ends_with('\n') {
        chars(out_text).saturating_sub(1)
    } else {
        chars(out_text)
    };
    let cut = if chars_a > 0 {
        100.0 * (1.0 - chars_b as f64 / chars_a as f64)
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    (chars_b, cut)
}

//! 压缩管线·选择与守卫阶段（compress/score）：证据/上下文/锚点/围栏/符号行
//! 标记、填充与预算、风险审计与守卫。纯函数、无 I/O；全部 `pub(crate)`。

use crate::policy::Limits;
use crate::{Config, Risk};

pub(crate) const R_SEED: u8 = 1;
pub(crate) const R_CONTEXT: u8 = 2;
pub(crate) const R_FILL: u8 = 3;
pub(crate) const R_GUARD: u8 = 4;
pub(crate) const R_ANCHOR: u8 = 5;
pub(crate) const R_NUM_LINE: u8 = 6;
pub(crate) const R_SYM_LINE: u8 = 7;
pub(crate) const R_ZH_LINE: u8 = 8;

/// 标记阶段共享可变上下文：keep 位图 / 计数 / 原因，与只读 scores/fill_floor。
pub(crate) struct Ctx<'a> {
    pub(crate) scores: &'a [f64],
    pub(crate) fill_floor: f64,
    pub(crate) keep: &'a mut [bool],
    pub(crate) kept: &'a mut usize,
    pub(crate) reason: &'a mut [u8],
}

pub(crate) fn floor(
    seed: &[bool],
    context: i64,
    total: usize,
    scores: &[f64],
    fill_floor: f64,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) -> (Vec<bool>, usize) {
    let mut keep = vec![false; total];
    let mut kept = 0usize;
    mark_seeds(seed, &mut keep, &mut kept, reason);
    mark_context(
        seed,
        context,
        total,
        &mut Ctx {
            scores,
            fill_floor,
            keep: &mut keep,
            kept: &mut kept,
            reason,
        },
    );
    (keep, kept)
}

pub(crate) fn mark_seeds(seed: &[bool], keep: &mut [bool], kept: &mut usize, reason: &mut [u8]) {
    for (i, &is_seed) in seed.iter().enumerate() {
        if is_seed {
            keep[i] = true;
            *kept += 1;
            reason[i] = R_SEED;
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mark_context(seed: &[bool], context: i64, total: usize, ctx: &mut Ctx) {
    for (i, &is_seed) in seed.iter().enumerate() {
        if !is_seed {
            continue;
        }
        // 种子行左右 context 邻域（不含种子自身）：左区间 [i-context, i)，右区间 (i, i+context]。
        let lo = (i as i64 - context).max(0) as usize;
        for j in lo..i {
            keep_neighbor(j, ctx);
        }
        let hi = (i as i64 + context).min(total as i64 - 1) as usize;
        for j in (i + 1)..=hi {
            keep_neighbor(j, ctx);
        }
    }
}

/// 单邻域行落地：未被保留且分数不低于地板时标记 R_CONTEXT。
fn keep_neighbor(j: usize, ctx: &mut Ctx) {
    if !ctx.keep[j] {
        if ctx.fill_floor > 0.0 && ctx.scores[j] < ctx.fill_floor {
            return;
        }
        ctx.keep[j] = true;
        *ctx.kept += 1;
        ctx.reason[j] = R_CONTEXT;
    }
}

pub(crate) fn anchors(lines: &[&str], kinds: &[crate::AnchorKind]) -> Vec<bool> {
    let json = kinds.contains(&crate::AnchorKind::Json);
    let xml = kinds.contains(&crate::AnchorKind::Xml) || kinds.contains(&crate::AnchorKind::Idoc);
    let yaml = kinds.contains(&crate::AnchorKind::Yaml);
    let md = kinds.contains(&crate::AnchorKind::Markdown);
    let mut a = vec![false; lines.len()];
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if t.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        a[i] = (json && json_anchor(t))
            || (xml && tag_anchor(t))
            || (yaml && yaml_anchor(t))
            || (md && md_anchor(t));
    }
    a
}

pub(crate) fn json_anchor(t: &str) -> bool {
    let s = t.trim_end_matches(',');
    matches!(s, "{" | "}" | "[" | "]")
        || s.ends_with('{')
        || s.ends_with('[')
        || s.starts_with('}')
        || s.starts_with(']')
}

pub(crate) fn tag_anchor(t: &str) -> bool {
    if !t.starts_with('<') || !t.ends_with('>') {
        return false;
    }
    !t[1..t.len() - 1].contains('>')
}

pub(crate) fn yaml_anchor(t: &str) -> bool {
    if t.starts_with('#') || t.starts_with("---") || t.starts_with("...") {
        return false;
    }
    t.ends_with(':') || t.starts_with("- ")
}

pub(crate) fn md_anchor(t: &str) -> bool {
    if !t.starts_with('#') {
        return false;
    }
    let hashes = t.bytes().take_while(|&b| b == b'#').count();
    (1..=6).contains(&hashes) && (t.as_bytes().get(hashes) == Some(&b' ') || t.len() == hashes)
}

pub(crate) fn mark_anchors(
    anchors: &[bool],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) {
    for (i, &a) in anchors.iter().enumerate() {
        if a && !keep[i] {
            keep[i] = true;
            *kept += 1;
            reason[i] = R_ANCHOR;
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mark_structure_anchors(
    cfg: &Config,
    lines: &[&str],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) {
    if cfg.structure_anchors.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let anchor_mask = anchors(lines, &cfg.structure_anchors);
    mark_anchors(&anchor_mask, keep, kept, reason);
}

pub(crate) fn mark_code_fence(
    lines: &[&str],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
    raw: &mut [bool],
) {
    let mut in_fence = false;
    for i in 0..lines.len() {
        let t = lines[i].trim();
        if t.starts_with("```") {
            in_fence = !in_fence;
            if !keep[i] {
                keep[i] = true;
                *kept += 1;
                reason[i] = R_ANCHOR;
            }
            raw[i] = true;
            continue;
        }
        if in_fence {
            if !keep[i] {
                keep[i] = true;
                *kept += 1;
                reason[i] = R_ANCHOR;
            }
            raw[i] = true;
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mark_num_lines(
    lines: &[&str],
    dup: &[bool],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) {
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        if keep[i] || dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        if line.bytes().any(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {
            keep[i] = true;
            reason[i] = R_NUM_LINE;
            *kept += 1;
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn sym_line(t: &str) -> bool {
    let heads = [
        "fn ",
        "pub fn",
        "impl ",
        "int ",
        "void ",
        "long ",
        "size_t ",
        "char ",
        "double ",
        "float ",
        "bool ",
        "template ",
        "class ",
        "struct ",
        "static ",
        "const ",
        "unsigned ",
        "typedef ",
        "using ",
        "Signature: ",
    ];
    if heads.iter().any(|h| t.starts_with(h)) && (t.contains('(') || t.ends_with(';')) {
        return true;
    }
    t.contains(" -> ") && t.contains('(')
}

pub(crate) fn mark_sym_lines(
    lines: &[&str],
    dup: &[bool],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
    raw: &mut [bool],
) {
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        if dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        // 签名行常含 query 命中词（如函数名）已被 keep——此时仍需设置 raw，
        // 否则已保留的签名行仍会被行内 trim 摘掉 `&`/`->`/`:`。
        if sym_line(line.trim()) {
            if !keep[i] {
                keep[i] = true;
                *kept += 1;
            }
            reason[i] = R_SYM_LINE;
            raw[i] = true;
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn eligible(sel: &Select, cfg: &Fill, keep: &[bool], i: usize) -> bool {
    !sel.dup[i]
        && !keep[i]
        && (sel.scores[i] > 0.0 || sel.struct_region[i])
        && (!cfg.region_gate || sel.in_region[i] || i < cfg.edge_head)
        && sel.scores[i] >= cfg.floor
}

pub(crate) struct Select<'a> {
    pub(crate) lines: &'a [&'a str],
    pub(crate) scores: &'a [f64],
    pub(crate) boost: &'a [f64],
    pub(crate) dup: &'a [bool],
    pub(crate) in_region: &'a [bool],
    pub(crate) struct_region: &'a [bool],
    /// 每行 token 估算（masks 预计算；空时回退现算）。
    pub(crate) tok: &'a [f64],
}

pub(crate) struct Fill {
    pub(crate) region_gate: bool,
    pub(crate) total_tok: f64,
    pub(crate) ratio: f64,
    pub(crate) edge_head: usize,
    pub(crate) remaining: f64,
    /// 填充入选分数门槛（`--fill-floor`；0 = 现状）。
    pub(crate) floor: f64,
}

pub(crate) fn fill(
    sel: &Select,
    cfg: &Fill,
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) -> f64 {
    let total = sel.lines.len();
    let budget = (cfg.total_tok * cfg.ratio).max(crate::policy::BUDGET_MIN);
    let cap = budget.min(cfg.remaining);
    let mut order: Vec<(usize, f64)> = (0..total)
        .filter(|&i| eligible(sel, cfg, keep, i))
        .map(|i| (i, sel.scores[i] + sel.boost[i]))
        .collect();
    order.sort_unstable_by(|&(a, sa), &(b, sb)| {
        if sb != sa {
            sb.partial_cmp(&sa).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        } else {
            a.cmp(&b)
        }
    });
    let mut used = 0.0f64;
    for &(i, _) in &order {
        let t = est(sel.tok, sel.lines, i);
        if used + t > cap {
            continue;
        }
        if !keep[i] {
            keep[i] = true;
            *kept += 1;
            reason[i] = R_FILL;
        }
        used += t;
    }
    used
}

pub(crate) fn est(tok: &[f64], lines: &[&str], i: usize) -> f64 {
    tok.get(i)
        .copied()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| crate::terms::estimate(lines[i]))
}

pub(crate) fn tokens(lines: &[&str], keep: &[bool], tok: &[f64]) -> f64 {
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    for (i, &k) in keep.iter().enumerate() {
        if k {
            sum += est(tok, lines, i);
        }
    }
    sum
}

pub(crate) fn audit(keep: &[bool], err: &[bool], hits: &[usize], tbl: &Limits) -> Risk {
    let (err_dropped, hit_dropped) = dropped(keep, err, hits);
    let kept = keep.iter().filter(|&&k| k).count();
    let risk_raw = (err_dropped + hit_dropped * tbl.hit_drop_w) as f64 / kept.max(1) as f64;
    level(risk_raw, tbl)
}

pub(crate) fn dropped(keep: &[bool], err: &[bool], hits: &[usize]) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut err_dropped = 0usize;
    let mut hit_dropped = 0usize;
    for i in 0..keep.len() {
        if keep[i] {
            continue;
        }
        if err[i] {
            err_dropped += 1;
        }
        if hits[i] > 0 {
            hit_dropped += 1;
        }
    }
    (err_dropped, hit_dropped)
}

pub(crate) fn level(raw: f64, tbl: &Limits) -> Risk {
    if raw >= tbl.high {
        Risk::High
    } else if raw >= tbl.med {
        Risk::Medium
    } else {
        Risk::Low
    }
}

pub(crate) fn guard(
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    dup: &[bool],
    guard: &[bool],
    marker: &[bool],
    region: Option<&[bool]>,
    reason: &mut [u8],
) -> u8 {
    let mut guarded = 0u8;
    for i in 0..keep.len() {
        if keep[i] || dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        // 区域门控：只保护证据邻域内的错误/标记行（根因聚集在证据附近），
        // 丢弃远处无关错误行；None 时为现状全量保护。
        if region.is_some_and(|r| !r[i]) {
            continue;
        }
        if guard[i] || marker[i] {
            keep[i] = true;
            *kept += 1;
            reason[i] = R_GUARD;
            guarded = 1;
        }
    }
    guarded
}

pub(crate) fn ev_retention(
    evidence: &[crate::Evidence],
    numbers: &[usize],
    text: &str,
    kept: usize,
    total: usize,
) -> f64 {
    if total == 0 {
        return 1.0;
    }
    if evidence.is_empty() {
        return kept as f64 / total as f64;
    }
    let mut hit = 0usize;
    for e in evidence {
        let ok = match e {
            crate::Evidence::Line(n) => {
                // kept == total 表示未删任何行（passthrough/fail-open/no-kept），
                // 此时行号 1..=total 全部存活；否则按保留行号集合判定。
                if kept == total {
                    *n >= 1 && *n <= total
                } else {
                    numbers.contains(n)
                }
            }
            crate::Evidence::Substr(s) => text.contains(s.as_str()),
        };
        if ok {
            hit += 1;
        }
    }
    hit as f64 / evidence.len() as f64
}

/// 中文问句行识别（--zh-keep）：含疑问词/问号的中文行。
/// 疑问词表覆盖中文问答题干（多少/什么/如何/为什么/是否/哪个/哪里/哪些/
/// 请用/请回答/输出什么/等于多少/值是多少 等）；无 CJK 的行直接拒绝，
/// 英文/代码行不受影响。
pub(crate) fn zh_line(t: &str) -> bool {
    const Q: &[&str] = &[
        "多少",
        "什么",
        "如何",
        "为什么",
        "是否",
        "哪个",
        "哪里",
        "哪些",
        "哪种",
        "请用",
        "请回答",
        "请给出",
        "请输出",
        "输出什么",
        "等于多少",
        "值是多少",
        "是多少",
        "哪一",
        "几次",
        "几个",
        "的区别",
    ];
    if !t.chars().any(|c| ('\u{4e00}'..='\u{9fff}').contains(&c)) {
        return false;
    }
    Q.iter().any(|w| t.contains(w)) || t.trim_end().ends_with('？') || t.trim_end().ends_with('?')
}

/// 中文问句行整行保留并标记 raw（跳过行内 trim）——问句行是题目的
/// 语义核心，trim 逐字摘碎后模型无法理解（P8-E 实测保持率 0.2 根因）。
pub(crate) fn mark_zh_lines(
    lines: &[&str],
    dup: &[bool],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
    raw: &mut [bool],
) {
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        if dup[i] {
            continue;
        }
        if zh_line(line.trim()) {
            if !keep[i] {
                keep[i] = true;
                *kept += 1;
            }
            reason[i] = R_ZH_LINE;
            raw[i] = true;
        }
    }
}

//! 内核评测协议：evidence containment（证据保留率）判定。
//!
//! 纯函数：给定压缩输出与语料证据行，判定证据行原文是否逐字节存活于输出。
//! 语料编排与统计由 `tools/scx.py contain`（Python）承担；本模块是判定/计分
//! 的唯一事实源，两者不得复刻彼此的语义。
//! 口径与 `docs/containment.md` 一致；结果属作者侧自测，非第三方独立评测。

use crate::compress;
use crate::{Config, Mode, Outcome};

/// 语料切片（只读判定输入）：`evidence` 为证据行原文（与冻结语料逐字一致）。
pub struct Slice<'a> {
    pub id: &'a str,
    pub query: &'a str,
    pub full_text: &'a str,
    pub evidence: &'a [&'a str],
}

/// 单切片判定报告。
pub struct Report {
    pub id: String,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub kept: usize,
    pub total: usize,
    pub input: usize,
    pub output: usize,
    pub cut: f64,
    /// 证据保留计数（等值判定：输出行集包含证据行原文）。
    pub evidence_kept: usize,
    pub evidence_total: usize,
    /// 未保留的证据行原文（空 = 全保留）。
    pub miss: Vec<String>,
}

/// 汇总统计：证据保留率、平均字符压减、逐切片未保留证据明细。
pub struct Summary {
    pub slices: usize,
    pub evidence_kept: usize,
    pub evidence_total: usize,
    pub mean_cut_pct: f64,
    pub miss: Vec<(String, String)>,
}

/// 运行单切片：`cfg` 由调用方提供（工具侧默认 ratio=0.35 / context=1）。
pub fn run(case: &Slice, cfg: &Config) -> Report {
    let o: Outcome = compress::compress(case.full_text, case.query, cfg);
    let out_lines: Vec<&str> = o.text.split('\n').collect();
    let mut kept = 0usize;
    let mut miss: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for ev in case.evidence {
        if out_lines.contains(ev) {
            kept += 1;
        } else {
            miss.push(ev.to_string());
        }
    }
    Report {
        id: case.id.to_string(),
        mode: o.mode,
        kept: o.kept,
        total: o.total,
        input: o.input,
        output: o.output,
        cut: o.cut,
        evidence_kept: kept,
        evidence_total: case.evidence.len(),
        miss,
    }
}

/// 汇总一组报告（空输入返回零统计）。
pub fn summarize(reports: &[Report]) -> Summary {
    let mut ev_kept = 0usize;
    let mut ev_total = 0usize;
    let mut cut_sum = 0.0f64;
    let mut miss: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();
    for r in reports {
        ev_kept += r.evidence_kept;
        ev_total += r.evidence_total;
        cut_sum += r.cut;
        for m in &r.miss {
            miss.push((r.id.clone(), m.clone()));
        }
    }
    let mean_cut = if reports.is_empty() {
        0.0
    } else {
        cut_sum / reports.len() as f64
    };
    Summary {
        slices: reports.len(),
        evidence_kept: ev_kept,
        evidence_total: ev_total,
        mean_cut_pct: mean_cut,
        miss,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn cfg() -> Config {
        Config {
            ratio: 0.35,
            context: 1,
            ..Config::default()
        }
    }

    /// 与语料同构的最小切片（synthetic，非真实事故）；填充段重复至 >40 行
    /// 以确保走 sieve 路径（与冻结语料 build-01 结构一致）。
    fn build_case() -> Slice<'static> {
        let filler: String = (0..5)
            .map(|_| {
                concat!(
                    "   Compiling scx-core v0.4.1 (/workspace/project/crates/core)\n",
                    "   Compiling scx-util v0.4.1 (/workspace/project/crates/util)\n",
                    "warning: unreachable pattern\n",
                    "  --> crates/util/src/lib.rs:80:9\n",
                    "   |\n",
                    "81 |         _ => unreachable!(\"arm removed in refactor\"),\n",
                    "   |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^\n",
                    "   = note: `#[warn(unreachable_patterns)]` on by default\n",
                    "   Compiling scx-cli v0.4.1 (/workspace/project/crates/cli)\n",
                    "    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debugin] target(s) in 3m 12s\n",
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let mut full = String::new();
        full.push_str(&filler);
        full.push_str("error[E0382]: borrow of moved value: `order`\n");
        full.push_str("  --> crates/service/src/order.rs:142:9\n");
        full.push_str("142 |     let total = order.compute_total();\n");
        full.push_str("    |                 ^^^^^ value borrowed here after move\n");
        full.push_str(&filler);
        Slice {
            id: "build-01",
            query: "build error E0382 borrow moved value",
            full_text: Box::leak(full.into_boxed_str()),
            evidence: &[
                "error[E0382]: borrow of moved value: `order`",
                "  --> crates/service/src/order.rs:142:9",
                "142 |     let total = order.compute_total();",
                "    |                 ^^^^^ value borrowed here after move",
            ],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn containment_full_on_evidence_case() {
        let r = run(&build_case(), &cfg());
        assert_eq!(
            r.evidence_kept, r.evidence_total,
            "证据必须全保留: {:?}",
            r.miss
        );
        assert!(r.miss.is_empty());
        assert!(r.cut > 0.0, "压缩必须产生真实压减");
        assert_eq!(r.mode, Mode::Sieve);
    }

    #[test]
    fn summarize_aggregates_counts() {
        let r = run(&build_case(), &cfg());
        let s = summarize(&[r]);
        assert_eq!(s.evidence_kept, 4);
        assert_eq!(s.evidence_total, 4);
        assert_eq!(s.slices, 1);
        assert!(s.miss.is_empty());
    }
}

//! SHA-256 与十六进制编码（纯 std、零第三方 crate，常驻编译）。
//!
//! 从 `semantic`（可选 feature）抽出为公共模块，供权重校验与治理层
//! （`meter` 快照指纹）共用同一实现，避免两套并行哈希。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

/// SHA-256 轮常量（FIPS 180-4）。
const SHA256_K: [u32; 64] = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
];

/// SHA-256（FIPS 180-4，纯 std 实现）。
pub fn sha256(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut h: [u32; 8] = [
        0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab,
        0x5be0cd19,
    ];
    let msg = pad(data);
    let mut w = [0u32; 64];
    for chunk in msg.chunks_exact(64) {
        block(chunk, &mut w, &mut h);
    }
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    for (i, v) in h.iter().enumerate() {
        out[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

/// 消息填充：追加 `0x80`、补零至 56 mod 64，尾接 64 位大端位长。
fn pad(data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut msg = data.to_vec();
    let bit_len = (data.len() as u64).wrapping_mul(8);
    msg.push(0x80);
    while msg.len() % 64 != 56 {
        msg.push(0);
    }
    msg.extend_from_slice(&bit_len.to_be_bytes());
    msg
}

/// 单块压缩：消息调度 + 64 轮压缩。
fn block(chunk: &[u8], w: &mut [u32; 64], h: &mut [u32; 8]) {
    for (i, b) in chunk.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
        w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes([b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3]]);
    }
    for i in 16..64 {
        let s0 = w[i - 15].rotate_right(7) ^ w[i - 15].rotate_right(18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
        let s1 = w[i - 2].rotate_right(17) ^ w[i - 2].rotate_right(19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
        w[i] = w[i - 16]
            .wrapping_add(s0)
            .wrapping_add(w[i - 7])
            .wrapping_add(s1);
    }
    let (mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d) = (h[0], h[1], h[2], h[3]);
    let (mut e, mut f, mut g, mut hh) = (h[4], h[5], h[6], h[7]);
    for i in 0..64 {
        let s1 = e.rotate_right(6) ^ e.rotate_right(11) ^ e.rotate_right(25);
        let ch = (e & f) ^ (!e & g);
        let t1 = hh
            .wrapping_add(s1)
            .wrapping_add(ch)
            .wrapping_add(SHA256_K[i])
            .wrapping_add(w[i]);
        let s0 = a.rotate_right(2) ^ a.rotate_right(13) ^ a.rotate_right(22);
        let maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
        let t2 = s0.wrapping_add(maj);
        hh = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = d.wrapping_add(t1);
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = t1.wrapping_add(t2);
    }
    h[0] = h[0].wrapping_add(a);
    h[1] = h[1].wrapping_add(b);
    h[2] = h[2].wrapping_add(c);
    h[3] = h[3].wrapping_add(d);
    h[4] = h[4].wrapping_add(e);
    h[5] = h[5].wrapping_add(f);
    h[6] = h[6].wrapping_add(g);
    h[7] = h[7].wrapping_add(hh);
}

/// FNV-1a 64 位（字节口径）：稳定的零依赖散列，供去重分桶与记忆库身份键共用。
pub fn fnv1a(bytes: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    fnv1a_parts(&[bytes])
}

/// 分片 FNV-1a：等价于对拼接后的字节流取哈希，避免拼接临时缓冲。
pub fn fnv1a_parts(parts: &[&[u8]]) -> u64 {
    let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
    for part in parts {
        for &b in *part {
            h ^= b as u64;
            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01b3);
        }
    }
    h
}

/// 字节 → 小写十六进制。
pub fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut s = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
    for b in bytes {
        s.push_str(&format!("{b:02x}"));
    }
    s
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sha256_known_vectors() {
        assert_eq!(
            hex(&sha256(b"")),
            "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            hex(&sha256(b"abc")),
            "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"
        );
    }
}

//! PostToolUse 自动拦截（P0）：压缩 Bash 大输出，减少进上下文的 token。
//!
//! 宿主 hook 协议（Claude Code）：stdin 收 PostToolUse JSON，stdout 写
//! `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"updatedToolOutput":{...}}}` 替换 tool_response
//! （须匹配工具输出结构 `{stdout,stderr,interrupted,isImage}`，否则被忽略）。
//! 小输入 / 无命中 / 非 Bash 一律透传（`{"continue":true}`），零副作用。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use crate::json::{parse, Json};
use crate::{compress, Config, Mode};

/// 核心变换：PostToolUse JSON → hook 输出 JSON；`None` = 透传。
fn transform(input: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let v = parse(input).ok()?;
    if v.get("tool_name").and_then(Json::str).unwrap_or("") != "Bash" {
        return None;
    }
    let resp = v.get("tool_response")?;
    let stdout = resp.get("stdout").and_then(Json::str).unwrap_or("");
    let cmd = v
        .get("tool_input")
        .and_then(|t| t.get("command"))
        .and_then(Json::str)
        .unwrap_or("");
    let query = if cmd.trim().is_empty() {
        "error timeout failed"
    } else {
        cmd
    };
    let o = compress(stdout, query, &Config::default());
    // 只有真正筛选（sieve/overflow）才替换；小输入/无命中透传保留原文。
    if !matches!(
        o.mode,
        Mode::Sieve | Mode::OverflowEvidence | Mode::OverflowFill
    ) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(render_hook(resp, &o.text))
}

/// 组装 `updatedToolOutput`，保留 stderr/interrupted/isImage 结构。
fn render_hook(resp: &Json, stdout: &str) -> String {
    let stderr = resp.get("stderr").and_then(Json::str).unwrap_or("");
    let interrupted = matches!(resp.get("interrupted"), Some(Json::Bool(true)));
    let is_image = matches!(resp.get("isImage"), Some(Json::Bool(true)));
    format!(
        "{{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{{\"updatedToolOutput\":{{\"stdout\":{},\"stderr\":{},\"interrupted\":{},\"isImage\":{}}}}}}}",
        crate::json::string(stdout),
        crate::json::string(stderr),
        interrupted,
        is_image
    )
}

fn passthrough() -> i32 {
    let _ = crate::ops::out_line("{\"continue\":true}");
    0
}

/// `scx hook` 入口：读 stdin，变换，写 stdout。
pub fn run() -> i32 {
    let mut input = String::new();
    if std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut input).is_err() {
        return passthrough();
    }
    match transform(&input) {
        Some(out) => {
            let _ = crate::ops::out_line(&out);
            0
        }
        None => passthrough(),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn bash_json(stdout: &str) -> String {
        let s = stdout
            .replace('\\', "\\\\")
            .replace('"', "\\\"")
            .replace('\n', "\\n");
        format!(
            "{{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{{\"command\":\"db timeout\"}},\
\"tool_response\":{{\"stdout\":\"{s}\",\"stderr\":\"\"}}}}"
        )
    }

    #[test]
    fn small_output_passthrough() {
        assert_eq!(transform(&bash_json("hello\nworld\n")), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn large_output_compressed_and_replaces() {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = (0..200)
            .map(|i| format!("filler alpha beta line {i}"))
            .collect();
        lines[100] = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a".to_string();
        let j = bash_json(&lines.join("\n"));
        let out = transform(&j).expect("large output must be compressed");
        assert!(out.contains("hookSpecificOutput"));
        assert!(out.contains("updatedToolOutput"));
        assert!(
            !out.contains("filler alpha beta line 50"),
            "中间噪声应被裁剪"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn non_bash_passthrough() {
        let j = "{\"tool_name\":\"Read\",\"tool_response\":{\"stdout\":\"x\"}}";
        assert_eq!(transform(j), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn string_round_trips_control_chars() {
        assert_eq!(crate::json::string("a\"b\nc"), "\"a\\\"b\\nc\"");
        assert_eq!(crate::json::string("tab\tend"), "\"tab\\tend\"");
    }
}

//! CLI 输入读取：stdin / 多文件聚合，带 64 MiB 上限与 UTF-8 容错解码。

use std::io::{self, Read};

/// 64 MiB：交互式上下文压缩的内存上限；更大的日志应先分段，避免一次读入和筛选向量挤爆内存。
pub(crate) const MAX_INPUT_BYTES: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

pub(crate) fn decode(bytes: Vec<u8>) -> String {
    match String::from_utf8(bytes) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => String::from_utf8_lossy(e.as_bytes()).into_owned(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn read<R: Read>(reader: R, limit: u64) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    reader.take(limit.saturating_add(1)).read_to_end(&mut buf)?;
    Ok(buf)
}

pub(crate) fn large(len: usize, limit: u64) -> bool {
    len as u64 > limit
}

pub(crate) fn error(limit: u64) -> String {
    format!(
        "input exceeds the {} MiB limit; split the input first",
        limit / (1024 * 1024)
    )
}

pub(crate) fn sources(files: &[String], limit: u64) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut total_bytes = 0usize;
    for f in files {
        // 文件边界只在必要时插入换行；限制仍按真实输入字节计数，不把生成的分隔符
        // 算进配额。单缓冲同时避免“每个文件一份 Vec + join 再复制”的峰值内存。
        if !bytes.is_empty() && !bytes.ends_with(b"\n") {
            bytes.push(b'\n');
        }
        let file =
            std::fs::File::open(f).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read input: {}: {}", f, e))?;
        let remaining = limit.saturating_sub(total_bytes as u64);
        let before = bytes.len();
        file.take(remaining.saturating_add(1))
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
            .map_err(|e| format!("cannot read input: {}: {}", f, e))?;
        total_bytes = total_bytes.saturating_add(bytes.len() - before);
        if large(total_bytes, limit) {
            return Err(error(limit));
        }
    }
    Ok(decode(bytes))
}

pub(crate) fn stdin(limit: u64) -> Result<String, String> {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let buf = read(stdin.lock(), limit).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read input: {}", e))?;
    if large(buf.len(), limit) {
        return Err(error(limit));
    }
    Ok(decode(buf))
}

pub fn input(files: &[String]) -> Result<String, String> {
    if files.is_empty() {
        stdin(MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
    } else {
        sources(files, MAX_INPUT_BYTES)
    }
}

/// 读取 `--fix-file` 文本，并在分配前限制到与记忆库相同的上限。
pub fn fix(path: &str, limit: u64) -> Result<String, String> {
    let file =
        std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read --fix-file {path}: {e}"))?;
    let buf = read(file, limit).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read --fix-file {path}: {e}"))?;
    if large(buf.len(), limit) {
        return Err(format!("--fix-file {path} exceeds the {limit}-byte limit"));
    }
    Ok(decode(buf))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn capped_reader_detects_one_byte_over_limit() {
        let exact = read(std::io::Cursor::new(b"12345678"), 8).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(exact, b"12345678");
        assert!(!large(exact.len(), 8));

        let over = read(std::io::Cursor::new(b"123456789"), 8).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(over, b"123456789");
        assert!(large(over.len(), 8));
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_limit_is_aggregate_across_inputs() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir();
        let pid = std::process::id();
        let a = dir.join(format!("scx-cap-a-{}.txt", pid));
        let b = dir.join(format!("scx-cap-b-{}.txt", pid));
        std::fs::write(&a, b"1234").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&b, b"5678").unwrap();
        let files = vec![
            a.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            b.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        ];

        assert_eq!(sources(&files[..1], 4).unwrap(), "1234");
        assert!(sources(&files, 7).is_err());
        assert_eq!(sources(&files, 8).unwrap(), "1234\n5678");

        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(a);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(b);
    }

    #[test]
    fn file_boundary_does_not_add_blank_lines() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir();
        let pid = std::process::id();
        let a = dir.join(format!("scx-boundary-a-{pid}.txt"));
        let b = dir.join(format!("scx-boundary-b-{pid}.txt"));
        std::fs::write(&a, b"first\n").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&b, b"second\n").unwrap();
        let files = vec![
            a.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            b.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        ];
        assert_eq!(sources(&files, 13).unwrap(), "first\nsecond\n");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(a);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(b);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fix_file_is_capped_before_decode() {
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "scx-fix-cap-{}-{}.txt",
            std::process::id(),
            std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        ));
        std::fs::write(&path, b"12345").unwrap();
        let path = path.to_string_lossy();
        assert_eq!(fix(&path, 5).unwrap(), "12345");
        assert!(fix(&path, 4).is_err());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(path.as_ref());
    }
}

//! 极简 JSON 解析（零第三方 crate，供 MCP 与 semantic 权重文件复用）。
//! 值保留键序；递归下降解析，规模远小于深度限制风险。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
// 公共工具模块：mcp/semantic 各 feature 下消费点不同，允许部分方法在某构建未用。
#![allow(dead_code)]

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum Json {
    Null,
    Bool(bool),
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Arr(Vec<Json>),
    Obj(Vec<(String, Json)>),
}

impl Json {
    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&Json> {
        match self {
            Json::Obj(kv) => kv.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == key).map(|(_, v)| v),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn str(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            Json::Str(s) => Some(s),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn num(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        match self {
            Json::Num(n) => Some(*n),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

/// JSON 字符串转义（唯一实现，供各序列化点复用，避免重复）。
pub fn string(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + 2);
    out.push('"');
    for c in s.chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}

/// 最大嵌套深度：递归下降解析器在更深处直接报错，防恶意深嵌套触发栈溢出。
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 128;

struct Parser<'a> {
    src: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
    depth: usize,
}

impl<'a> Parser<'a> {
    fn new(src: &'a str) -> Self {
        Parser {
            src: src.as_bytes(),
            pos: 0,
            depth: 0,
        }
    }

    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> {
        self.src.get(self.pos).copied()
    }

    fn space(&mut self) {
        while let Some(b) = self.peek() {
            if b.is_ascii_whitespace() {
                self.pos += 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    fn eat(&mut self, b: u8) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.space();
        if self.peek() == Some(b) {
            self.pos += 1;
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(format!("expected byte {b:?} at pos {}", self.pos))
        }
    }

    fn value(&mut self) -> Result<Json, String> {
        self.space();
        if matches!(self.peek(), Some(b'{') | Some(b'[')) {
            self.depth += 1;
            if self.depth > MAX_DEPTH {
                self.depth -= 1;
                return Err(format!("nesting exceeds {MAX_DEPTH} at pos {}", self.pos));
            }
            let v = match self.peek() {
                Some(b'{') => self.obj(),
                Some(b'[') => self.arr(),
                _ => unreachable!("guarded by matches!"),
            };
            self.depth -= 1;
            return v;
        }
        match self.peek() {
            Some(b'"') => Ok(Json::Str(self.string()?)),
            Some(b't') => self.lit("true", Json::Bool(true)),
            Some(b'f') => self.lit("false", Json::Bool(false)),
            Some(b'n') => self.lit("null", Json::Null),
            Some(b'-') | Some(b'0'..=b'9') => self.num(),
            Some(b) => Err(format!("unexpected byte {b:?} at pos {}", self.pos)),
            None => Err("unexpected end of input".to_string()),
        }
    }

    fn lit(&mut self, word: &str, v: Json) -> Result<Json, String> {
        if self.src[self.pos..].starts_with(word.as_bytes()) {
            self.pos += word.len();
            Ok(v)
        } else {
            Err(format!("expected literal {word} at pos {}", self.pos))
        }
    }

    fn num(&mut self) -> Result<Json, String> {
        let start = self.pos;
        if self.peek() == Some(b'-') {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        while matches!(
            self.peek(),
            Some(b'0'..=b'9') | Some(b'.') | Some(b'e') | Some(b'E') | Some(b'+') | Some(b'-')
        ) {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        let raw = std::str::from_utf8(&self.src[start..self.pos]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let n: f64 = raw.parse().map_err(|e| format!("bad number {raw}: {e}"))?;
        // JSON 无 Infinity/NaN：`1e999` 会解析成 inf，放行会导致回显 `"id":inf`
        // 这类非法 JSON（MCP 客户端整流解析失败）。
        if !n.is_finite() {
            return Err(format!("number out of range: {raw}"));
        }
        Ok(Json::Num(n))
    }

    fn string(&mut self) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.eat(b'"')?;
        // 收集原始 UTF-8 字节，收尾统一解码：多字节序列（中文等）不再被按字节拆成 Latin-1 乱码。
        let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        loop {
            match self.peek() {
                Some(b'"') => {
                    self.pos += 1;
                    return String::from_utf8(out).map_err(|e| format!("bad string: {e}"));
                }
                Some(b'\\') => {
                    self.pos += 1;
                    let esc = self
                        .peek()
                        .ok_or_else(|| "unterminated escape".to_string())?;
                    match esc {
                        b'n' => out.push(b'\n'),
                        b't' => out.push(b'\t'),
                        b'r' => out.push(b'\r'),
                        b'"' => out.push(b'"'),
                        b'\\' => out.push(b'\\'),
                        b'/' => out.push(b'/'),
                        b'u' => {
                            let cp = self.u_escape()?;
                            let mut buf = [0u8; 4];
                            out.extend_from_slice(cp.encode_utf8(&mut buf).as_bytes());
                        }
                        _ => return Err(format!("bad escape \\{esc:?}")),
                    }
                    self.pos += 1;
                }
                Some(b) => {
                    out.push(b);
                    self.pos += 1;
                }
                None => return Err("unterminated string".to_string()),
            }
        }
    }

    /// 解析 `\uXXXX`（进入时 pos 指向 'u'；返回后 pos 指向该转义序列最后一个 hex 字节，
    /// 由调用方统一 +1 前进），支持 UTF-16 代理对。
    fn u_escape(&mut self) -> Result<char, String> {
        fn hex4(src: &[u8], pos: usize) -> Result<u32, String> {
            // pos 指向 'u'，4 个 hex 紧跟其后
            let raw = src
                .get(pos + 1..pos + 5)
                .ok_or_else(|| "short \\u escape".to_string())?;
            u32::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(raw).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?, 16)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
        }
        let hi = hex4(self.src, self.pos)?;
        if (0xD800..=0xDBFF).contains(&hi) {
            // 高代理必须紧跟 \uXXXX 低代理
            if self.src.get(self.pos + 5) == Some(&b'\\')
                && self.src.get(self.pos + 6) == Some(&b'u')
            {
                let lo = hex4(self.src, self.pos + 6)?;
                if !(0xDC00..=0xDFFF).contains(&lo) {
                    return Err("bad \\u low surrogate".to_string());
                }
                self.pos += 10;
                let cp = 0x1_0000 + ((hi - 0xD800) << 10) + (lo - 0xDC00);
                return char::from_u32(cp).ok_or_else(|| "bad \\u code point".to_string());
            }
            return Err("\\u high surrogate without pair".to_string());
        }
        self.pos += 4;
        char::from_u32(hi).ok_or_else(|| "bad \\u code point".to_string())
    }

    fn arr(&mut self) -> Result<Json, String> {
        self.eat(b'[')?;
        let mut items = Vec::new();
        loop {
            self.space();
            if self.peek() == Some(b']') {
                self.pos += 1;
                return Ok(Json::Arr(items));
            }
            items.push(self.value()?);
            self.space();
            if self.peek() == Some(b',') {
                self.pos += 1;
            } else if self.peek() == Some(b']') {
                self.pos += 1;
                return Ok(Json::Arr(items));
            } else {
                return Err(format!("bad array at pos {}", self.pos));
            }
        }
    }

    fn obj(&mut self) -> Result<Json, String> {
        self.eat(b'{')?;
        let mut kv = Vec::new();
        loop {
            self.space();
            if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {
                self.pos += 1;
                return Ok(Json::Obj(kv));
            }
            let key = self.string()?;
            self.eat(b':')?;
            let val = self.value()?;
            kv.push((key, val));
            self.space();
            if self.peek() == Some(b',') {
                self.pos += 1;
            } else if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {
                self.pos += 1;
                return Ok(Json::Obj(kv));
            } else {
                return Err(format!("bad object at pos {}", self.pos));
            }
        }
    }
}

/// 解析 JSON 文本（递归下降；MCP 消息规模远小于深度限制风险）。
pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Json, String> {
    let mut p = Parser::new(s);
    let v = p.value()?;
    p.space();
    if p.peek().is_some() {
        Err(format!("trailing data at pos {}", p.pos))
    } else {
        Ok(v)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn str_utf8_multibyte() {
        // 多字节 UTF-8 不得被按字节拆成 Latin-1 乱码（回归：MCP 中文 query/text）。
        let v = parse(r#"{"query":"数据库连接失败"}"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v.get("query").unwrap().str(), Some("数据库连接失败"));
        let v = parse(r#"{"text":"错误行: 端口5432 被占用"}"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            v.get("text").unwrap().str(),
            Some("错误行: 端口5432 被占用")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn str_ascii_escapes() {
        let v = parse(r#"{"a":"x\ny\t\"\\\/z"}"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v.get("a").unwrap().str(), Some("x\ny\t\"\\/z"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn str_u_escapes_utf16_surrogate_pair() {
        // \uD83D\uDE80 = U+1F680 🚀（代理对），\u4E2D = 中
        let v = parse(r#"{"q":"\u4E2D\u6587\uD83D\uDE80"}"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v.get("q").unwrap().str(), Some("中文🚀"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn str_u_escape_high_surrogate_without_pair_errors() {
        assert!(parse(r#"{"q":"\uD83D"}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"q":"\uDE80"}"#).is_err());
    }

    /// 确定性模糊：MCP 请求是外部不可信输入，任意文本都不得 panic；
    /// 成功解析的值做访问器调用也不得 panic。
    #[test]
    fn parse_never_panics_on_arbitrary_input() {
        let pool: Vec<char> = "{}[]\",:0123456789.eE+-\\/ \n\t\u{0}中文🚀truefalsenull"
            .chars()
            .collect();
        let mut state = 0xfeed_faceu32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..2000 {
            let n = next() as usize % 48;
            let mut s = String::new();
            for _ in 0..n {
                s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
            }
            if let Ok(v) = parse(&s) {
                // 访问器对任意已解析值都必须安全。
                let _ = v.get("id").and_then(Json::str);
                let _ = v.get("params").and_then(|p| p.get("name"));
                let _ = v.str();
                let _ = v.num();
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn non_finite_numbers_are_rejected() {
        // `1e999` 会解析成 inf；放行会让 MCP 回显 `"id":inf` 这种非法 JSON。
        assert!(parse(r#"{"id":1e999}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"id":-1e999}"#).is_err());
        // 1.5e308 仍在 f64 范围内（有限），必须照常接受。
        assert!(parse(r#"{"id":1.5e308}"#).is_ok());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"id":1e10}"#).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn deep_nesting_is_rejected_not_stack_overflow() {
        let ok = format!("{}1{}", "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH), "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH));
        assert!(parse(&ok).is_ok(), "深度内应正常解析");
        let over = format!(
            "{}1{}",
            "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1),
            "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1)
        );
        let err = parse(&over).unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.contains("nesting"), "超深应报错而非栈溢出: {err}");
    }
}

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
#![warn(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
// 测试代码是数据驱动的断言清单，按行拆分反而降低可读性；认知复杂度门禁只约束生产代码。
#![cfg_attr(test, allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity))]

//! scx 引擎：本地查询感知证据筛选压缩（纯函数、无 I/O、零依赖、确定性）。
//!
//! 语义（v0.4.1）：种子不变量（证据行与 ±context（默认 1，可设 0）最小邻域无条件保留，`ratio` 只删可选）；证据仅
//! 来自 IDF 加权查询命中与 `forces`；种子区域门控（可选预算只填种子邻域区域：±window
//! 扩展，间隔 <= window*3 合并；种子为零回退全图）；邻域权重只排序；context=0 完全跳过可选填充（针尖模式）；无信号 fail-open；
//! `gate` 在风险 HIGH 时保护失败级错误行(warn/警告 级除外)与事故标记行(root cause / fix hint / mitigation / recommendation / action / assertionerror)。只删不改、保留行逐字原文；省略以单行 "..." 标记；`lineno` 可为保留行附加原文行号前缀。
//!
//! 模块划分：`terms` 负责词面与估算，`analysis` 负责归一化与结构分类，
//! `compress` 是算法主体。三者均为纯函数层；本文件只保留公共类型、模块声明和
//! 跨模块行为测试。
//!
//! 压缩模式与风险等级以 `Mode` / `Risk` 枚举表达（`Display` 输出保持 v0.4.1
//! 字符串格式：`passthrough:small` / `failopen:zero-signal` / `LOW` / `HIGH` 等）。

use std::fmt;

mod compress;
pub mod contain;

/// 三层优先级 CLI > pipeline.json > policy 常量；未知键/越界 fail-loud。
pub mod pipeline;
mod policy;
mod terms;
/// TOML 子集解析（`--policy-file` 与记忆库 `meta.toml` 共用；零第三方 crate）。
pub mod toml;
mod trim;

/// CLI 与集成层模块（库内可用）：`args` 声明式参数解析、`input` 输入读取、
/// `ops` 操作编排（Op 枚举 + run + 纯渲染）。`ops::render` 供 MCP 等
/// 集成层复用，不依赖 CLI 渲染。
pub mod args;
pub mod input;
pub mod ops;

/// `compress` 完全隔离；`--no-default-features` 时整模块 cfg 排除。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
pub mod memory;

pub mod wrap;

pub mod bucket;

pub mod hook;

pub mod meter;

pub mod sim;
