fn explain_report(r: &Outcome) -> String {
    r.explain
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, e)| format!("{}:{}", i + 1, e.as_str()))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
}

/// 脱敏命中审计（stderr，一行；`kind=count` 空格分隔）。
fn redact_report(hits: &[crate::redact::Hit]) -> String {
    let parts: Vec<String> = hits
        .iter()
        .map(|h| format!("{}={}", h.kind, h.count))
        .collect();
    format!("scx: redact: {}", parts.join(" "))
}

/// 附加 stderr 诊断（json/explain/redact），从 `filter` 抽出以压认知复杂度。
fn diagnostics(job: &Compress, outcome: &Outcome, redact_hits: &[crate::redact::Hit]) {
    if job.json {
        eprintln!("scxjson: {}", render(outcome));
    }
    if job.explain {
        eprintln!("scx: explain: {}", explain_report(outcome));
    }
    if !redact_hits.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("{}", redact_report(redact_hits));
    }
}

/// 压缩前脱敏入口：空 kinds 时原样返回（无命中）。
fn redact_input(
    text: String,
    kinds: &[crate::redact::RedactKind],
) -> (String, Vec<crate::redact::Hit>) {
    if kinds.is_empty() {
        (text, Vec::new())
    } else {
        crate::redact::redact(&text, kinds)
    }
}

/// token 缩减率（%）：输入估算为 0 时视为 0（passthrough/fail-open 恒为 0）。
fn token_cut(tin: f64, tout: f64) -> f64 {
    if tin <= 0.0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        (tin - tout) * 100.0 / tin
    }
}

/// 千分位格式化（u64，如 3318 -> "3,318"）。
fn sep(n: u64) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + s.len() / 3);
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (s.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(c);
    }
    out
}

/// 长文本截断（按字符数，超长加省略号）。
fn clip(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    if s.chars().count() <= max {
        s.to_string()
    } else {
        let head: String = s.chars().take(max).collect();
        format!("{head}…")
    }
}

/// 字段名补宽到 8 列（CJK 按 2 列），保证效果报告各行左对齐。
fn pad_field(field: &str) -> String {
    let w = field
        .chars()
        .map(|c| if crate::terms::full(c) { 2 } else { 1 })
        .sum::<usize>();
    format!("{field}{}", " ".repeat(8usize.saturating_sub(w)))
}

/// 效果报告行：`{icon} {field:8}  {value}`。
fn row(icon: &str, field: &str, value: &str) -> String {
    format!("{icon} {}  {value}\n", pad_field(field))
}

/// 风险等级中文（效果报告用）。
/// 风险行文案：`guarded` 是 0/1 标志位（是否触发风险守卫），不是被守卫行数，
/// 因此不得写成「N 条额外守护」。
fn guard_note(risk: crate::Risk, guarded: u8) -> String {
    let risk = risk_zh(risk);
    if guarded > 0 {
        format!("{risk} · 已启用额外守护")
    } else {
        risk.to_string()
    }
}

fn risk_zh(r: crate::Risk) -> &'static str {
    match r {
        crate::Risk::Low => "低",
        crate::Risk::Medium => "中",
        crate::Risk::High => "高",
    }
}

/// 模式中文标签与一句话说明（效果报告用）。
fn title(m: Mode) -> (&'static str, &'static str) {
    match m {
        Mode::Sieve => ("sieve 智能筛选", "按问题逐行召回证据"),
        Mode::PassSmall => ("小输入透传", "无需压缩"),
        Mode::PassLongline => ("超长行透传", "单行过长，原样保留"),
        Mode::PassTooManyLines => ("行数超限透传", "行数过多，原样保留避免内存放大"),
        Mode::PassNoKept => ("预算过紧回退", "未选出有效行，原文保留"),
        Mode::FailOpenZeroSignal => ("无命中保护", "零丢失"),
        Mode::OverflowEvidence => ("证据优先保底", "超过 token 上限，证据全保留"),
        Mode::OverflowFill => ("上限裁剪", "超上限，保留证据并裁剪可选内容"),
    }
}

/// 压缩召回效果报告（v0.6.4）：stderr 人工可读块，stdout 契约零变化。
/// 三模式各有结论卡；数字口径与 `render()` JSON 完全一致（`terms::estimate`）。
pub fn recall_report(r: &Outcome, query: &str) -> String {
    let mut s = String::from("✦ SCX 压缩召回 ✦\n\n");
    s.push_str(&row("📌", "查询", &clip(query, 40)));
    let (label, desc) = title(r.mode);
    s.push_str(&row("⚙️", "模式", &format!("{label} · {desc}")));
    match r.mode {
        Mode::Sieve | Mode::OverflowEvidence | Mode::OverflowFill => {
            let tin = r.tokens_in;
            let tout = crate::terms::estimate(&r.text);
            s.push_str(&row(
                "📥",
                "原始",
                &format!(
                    "{} 行 · {} 字符 · 约 {} token",
                    sep(r.total as u64),
                    sep(r.input as u64),
                    sep(tin as u64)
                ),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row(
                "📤",
                "压缩后",
                &format!(
                    "{} 行 · {} 字符 · 约 {} token",
                    sep(r.kept as u64),
                    sep(r.output as u64),
                    sep(tout as u64)
                ),
            ));
            let d_rows = r.total.saturating_sub(r.kept);
            let d_chars = r.input.saturating_sub(r.output);
            s.push_str(&row(
                "💾",
                "省下",
                &format!(
                    "{} 行 · {} 字符 · 约 {} token（-{:.1}%）",
                    sep(d_rows as u64),
                    sep(d_chars as u64),
                    sep((tin - tout) as u64),
                    token_cut(tin, tout)
                ),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row(
                "🎯",
                "证据召回",
                &format!("{} 条关键证据全部保留 · 0 丢失", r.evidence),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row("🔁", "去重", &format!("{} 行重复内容已折叠", r.dup)));
            s.push_str(&row(
                "✂️",
                "裁剪",
                &format!("{} 段无关内容已移除", r.dropped.len()),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row("🛡️", "风险", &guard_note(r.risk, r.guarded)));
        }
        Mode::PassSmall | Mode::PassLongline | Mode::PassTooManyLines | Mode::PassNoKept => {
            s.push_str(&row(
                "📥",
                "原始",
                &format!("{} 行 · {} 字符", sep(r.total as u64), sep(r.input as u64)),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row("📤", "压缩后", "原样保留，一字未动"));
            let save = match r.mode {
                Mode::PassSmall => "0 —— 内容本就很少",
                Mode::PassLongline => "0 —— 无损失保留原文",
                Mode::PassTooManyLines => "0 —— 无损失保留原文",
                _ => "0 —— 无损失保留原文",
            };
            let why = match r.mode {
                Mode::PassSmall => format!(
                    "内容很少（<{} 行且不足 {} token），压缩反而可能丢信息，自动跳过",
                    crate::policy::SMALL_LINES,
                    crate::policy::SMALL_TOK as u64
                ),
                Mode::PassLongline => "单行过长无法安全压缩，原样返回，不冒险删减".to_string(),
                Mode::PassTooManyLines => format!(
                    "行数超过 {}，筛选会按行数放大内存，原样返回避免内存耗尽",
                    crate::policy::MAX_LINES
                ),
                _ => "预算过紧未选出有效行，宁可原样返回也不静默删减".to_string(),
            };
            s.push_str(&row("💾", "省下", save));
            s.push_str(&row("💡", "说明", &why));
        }
        Mode::FailOpenZeroSignal => {
            s.push_str(&row(
                "📥",
                "原始",
                &format!("{} 行 · {} 字符", sep(r.total as u64), sep(r.input as u64)),
            ));
            s.push_str(&row("📤", "压缩后", "原样保留，一字未动"));
            s.push_str(&row("💾", "省下", "0 —— 无相关内容可压缩"));
            s.push_str(&row(
                "💡",
                "说明",
                "没找到与问题相关的证据行，压缩会误删信息，完整返回",
            ));
        }
    }
    s
}

/// 输出召回段 `mem: ...`（旁路，绝不影响正文/统计/退出码）。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// case 只显示指纹段（`YYYY-MM-DD_<hash16>` 的 hash16），保证输出不随日期漂移。
fn lines(
    out: &mut dyn Write,
    hits: &[Hit],
    root: &str,
    detail: bool,
    tolerate_unreadable: bool,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    for h in hits {
        let short = h.id.rsplit('_').next().unwrap_or(&h.id);
        // 索引路径的 id 未过白名单，可能含控制字符；转义后回显防终端注入。
        writeln!(
            out,
            "mem: sim={:.2} score={:.2} case={}",
            h.sim,
            h.score,
            escape(short)
        )?;
        let c = match crate::memory::load(root, &h.id) {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) if tolerate_unreadable => {
                eprintln!("scx: warning: recall case {short} unreadable: {e}");
                continue;
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        };
        if detail {
            writeln!(out, "  summary: {}", escape(&summary(&c)))?;
            for (i, &lno) in c.evidence_lno.iter().enumerate() {
                writeln!(
                    out,
                    "  evidence: {} {}",
                    lno,
                    escape(c.evidence.get(i).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""))
                )?;
            }
        }
        if !c.fix.is_empty() {
            writeln!(
                out,
                "  fix: {} (candidate, sim={:.2})",
                escape(&c.fix),
                h.sim
            )?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 召回详情摘要：字段 + 首个错误/非空行，最多 300 字符。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn summary(c: &Case) -> String {
    let mut parts: Vec<&str> = c
        .fields
        .error_code
        .iter()
        .chain(&c.fields.file_loc)
        .map(String::as_str)
        .collect();
    // 单趟找“首个错误行”，找不到再用“首个非空行”；避免对整篇正文扫两遍。
    if let Some(line) = first(&c.text) {
        parts.push(line);
    }
    let s = parts.join(" | ");
    // 只数到截断点：超长日志行不应为“是否加省略号”再扫一遍剩余字符。
    truncate(&s)
}

/// 单趟找“首个错误行”，找不到再用“首个非空行”。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn first(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    let mut first_nonempty = None;
    for line in text.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|t| !t.is_empty()) {
        if first_nonempty.is_none() {
            first_nonempty = Some(line);
        }
        if error(line) {
            return Some(line);
        }
    }
    first_nonempty
}

/// 最多 300 字符，截断处补省略号。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn truncate(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len().min(900));
    for (i, ch) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        if i == 300 {
            out.push('…');
            break;
        }
        out.push(ch);
    }
    out
}

/// 错误/警告行词面判定（summary 的谓词，V(G)=6）。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn error(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.contains("error")
        || t.contains("ERROR")
        || t.contains("错误")
        || t.contains("ERR")
        || t.contains("warn")
        || t.contains("WARN")
        || t.contains("警告")
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// 召回回放输出转义控制字符（ANSI ESC / C0），防恶意日志注入终端。
fn escape(s: &str) -> String {
    crate::memory::escape(s)
}

fn write(result: io::Result<()>) -> Reply {
    match result {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(Failure::message(format!("cannot write output: {e}"))),
    }
}

/// 逐行写 stdout；BrokenPipe 视为正常结束（下游关闭，如 `| head`），与 [`write`]
/// 同口径，其余 IO 错误上报。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn lines_out(lines: Vec<String>) -> Reply {
    let mut out = io::stdout().lock();
    for line in lines {
        match writeln!(out, "{line}") {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => return Err(Failure::message(format!("cannot write output: {e}"))),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 写 stdout 原文；BrokenPipe 视为正常结束（下游关闭，如 `| head`）。
pub(crate) fn out_text(text: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut out = io::stdout().lock();
    match out.write_all(text.as_bytes()) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

/// 写一行 stdout（含换行）；BrokenPipe 语义同 [`out_text`]。
pub(crate) fn out_line(text: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut out = io::stdout().lock();
    match writeln!(out, "{text}") {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

/// 单行 stdout 输出（BrokenPipe 语义同 [`lines_out`]）。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn say(text: String) -> Reply {
    lines_out(vec![text])
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn emit(result: io::Result<Vec<String>>, action: &str) -> Reply {
    let lines = result.map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("{action} failed: {e}")))?;
    lines_out(lines)
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn eval(result: io::Result<(Vec<String>, bool)>) -> Reply {
    let (lines, gate_failed) = result.map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("eval failed: {e}")))?;
    lines_out(lines)?;
    if gate_failed {
        Err(Failure::GateFailed)
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn annotate(job: &Annotate) -> Reply {
    let path = job.annotate_out.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        std::path::Path::new(&job.mem_dir)
            .join(if job.annotate_raw {
                "baseline-raw.json"
            } else {
                "baseline-auto.json"
            })
            .to_string_lossy()
            .into_owned()
    });
    let lines = crate::memory::annotate(
        &job.mem_dir,
        job.seed,
        job.annotate_max,
        job.annotate_raw,
        &path,
    )
    .map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("annotate failed: {e}")))?;
    lines_out(lines)?;
    let out_name = std::path::Path::new(&path)
        .file_name()
        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| path.clone());
    say(format!("  out: {out_name}"))
}

/// 可插拔相似度后端：在 ops 层（I/O 层）预计算 query×每行的相似度，
/// 作为数据传入纯核心 `compress`，不破坏其零 I/O 契约。默认 `None` 不触发。
fn embed_sims(job: &Compress, text: &str) -> Result<Option<Vec<f64>>, Failure> {
    let Some(cmd) = &job.embed_cmd else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let mut buf: Option<String> = None;
    let lines = crate::compress::lines(text, &mut buf);
    let sims = crate::sim::compute(Some(cmd), &job.query, &lines).map_err(Failure::message)?;
    Ok(Some(sims))
}

fn filter(job: &Compress) -> Reply {
    let text = input(&job.files).map_err(Failure::message)?;
    // 压缩前脱敏（P7）：脱敏后正文参与压缩与记忆入库，原文不落盘。
    let (text, redact_hits) = redact_input(text, &job.redact);
    let mut config = job.config.clone();
    if job.kind_auto {
        // `--kind auto`：正文类型按隐式推断；缺省 ratio 用该类型价值梯度默认。
        config.kind = crate::ContentType::infer(&text);
        if !job.ratio_explicit {
            config.ratio = config.kind.default_ratio();
        }
    }
    config.sims = embed_sims(job, &text)?;
    let outcome = compress(&text, &job.query, &config);
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = stdout.lock();
    output(&mut out, job, &outcome)?;
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    let mut store_rx: Option<Receiver> = None;
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if job.store {
        store_rx = prepare(job, &text, &outcome)?;
    }
    #[cfg(not(feature = "memory"))]
    if job.store {
        eprintln!(
            "scx: warning: --store requires the memory feature (build with default features)"
        );
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    memory(&mut out, job)?;
    #[cfg(not(feature = "memory"))]
    if job.recall != 0 {
        eprintln!(
            "scx: warning: --recall requires the memory feature (build with default features)"
        );
    }
    if !job.no_stats {
        write(writeln!(out, "{}", stats(&outcome)))?;
        eprintln!("{}", recall_report(&outcome, &job.query));
    }
    diagnostics(job, &outcome, &redact_hits);
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if let Some(rx) = store_rx {
        let result = rx
            .recv()
            .map_err(|_| Failure::message("memory store thread lost"))?;
        report(result)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 正文输出：`--stat` 跳过；末尾补换行。
fn output(out: &mut dyn Write, job: &Compress, outcome: &Outcome) -> Reply {
    if job.stat {
        return Ok(());
    }
    write(out.write_all(outcome.text.as_bytes()))?;
    if !outcome.text.is_empty() && !outcome.text.ends_with('\n') {
        write(out.write_all(b"\n"))?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// 召回旁路输出；失败只告警，不改变正文/统计/退出码。
fn memory(out: &mut dyn Write, job: &Compress) -> Reply {
    if job.recall == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    match crate::memory::search_fused(
        &job.mem_dir,
        &job.query,
        job.recall,
        false,
        job.embed_cmd.as_deref(),
        job.config.sim_weight,
        job.minhash_weight,
    ) {
        Ok(hits) => {
            let qualified = crate::memory::hits(&job.mem_dir, hits);
            write(lines(
                out,
                &qualified,
                &job.mem_dir,
                job.recall_detail,
                true,
            ))
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx: warning: --recall skipped: {e}");
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn prepare(job: &Compress, input: &str, outcome: &Outcome) -> Reply<Option<Receiver>> {
    let fix = if let Some(path) = &job.fix_file {
        let text = fix(path, crate::memory::MAX_FIX_BYTES as u64).map_err(Failure::message)?;
        let text = text.trim_end().to_string();
        if text.is_empty() {
            eprintln!("scx: note: --fix-file {path} is empty; case stored without fix");
        }
        text
    } else {
        job.fix.clone()
    };
    if fix.is_empty() {
        eprintln!(
            "scx: note: --store without --fix; L1 cannot answer 'how was it solved' - \
pass --fix \"...\" after a verified fix (HARD discipline)"
        );
    }
    if matches!(outcome.mode, Mode::FailOpenZeroSignal) {
        eprintln!(
            "scx: note: query had no hits; --store will persist the full input \
(low-signal memory). inspect with --recall-only first"
        );
    }
    let stats = Stats {
        kept: outcome.kept,
        total: outcome.total,
        cut: outcome.cut,
        risk: outcome.risk.to_string(),
    };
    let evidence_lno = outcome.numbers.clone();
    let evidence = evidence(input, &evidence_lno);
    if job.recall > 0 {
        let mut store_input = Input::new(&job.mem_dir, &job.query, &outcome.text, &stats);
        store_input.source = &job.files;
        store_input.forces = &job.config.forces;
        store_input.fix = &fix;
        store_input.evidence_lno = &evidence_lno;
        store_input.evidence = &evidence;
        store_input.max_bytes = job.max_bytes;
        report(crate::memory::save(store_input))?;
        return Ok(None);
    }

    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let mem_dir = job.mem_dir.clone();
    let query = job.query.clone();
    let text = outcome.text.clone();
    let files = job.files.clone();
    let forces = job.config.forces.clone();
    let max_bytes = job.max_bytes;
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut store_input = Input::new(&mem_dir, &query, &text, &stats);
        store_input.source = &files;
        store_input.forces = &forces;
        store_input.fix = &fix;
        store_input.evidence_lno = &evidence_lno;
        store_input.evidence = &evidence;
        store_input.max_bytes = max_bytes;
        let _ = tx.send(crate::memory::save(store_input));
    });
    Ok(Some(rx))
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn report(result: Stored) -> Reply {
    let (added, id) = result.map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("memory store failed: {e}")))?;
    eprintln!(
        "scx: stored case={} added={}",
        id,
        if added { "yes" } else { "dedup" }
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// 按保留行原始行号从输入提取证据原文；行号越界时保留空串，不 panic。
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn evidence(input: &str, lno: &[usize]) -> Vec<String> {
    if lno.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    // 常见 LF 输入零拷贝；只有真正含 CR 时才做整文归一化。
    let normalized;
    let input = if input.contains('\r') {
        normalized = input.replace("\r\n", "\n");
        normalized.as_str()
    } else {
        input
    };
    let mut lines: Vec<&str> = input.split('\n').collect();
    if lines.last().is_some_and(|line| line.is_empty()) {
        lines.pop();
    }
    lno.iter()
        .map(|&n| {
            lines
                .get(n.saturating_sub(1))
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or("")
                .to_string()
        })
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    #[test]
    fn summary_truncates_to_300_chars() {
        let mut c = Case::new("id".into(), "q".into(), vec![], String::new());
        c.text = format!("ERROR {}", "x".repeat(400));
        let got = summary(&c);
        assert_eq!(got.chars().count(), 301, "300 字符 + 省略号");
        assert!(got.ends_with('…'));
    }

    #[test]
    fn render_json_keeps_legacy_fields_and_appends_max_tokens() {
        let cfg = crate::Config::default();
        let o = compress("a\nb\nc\n", "a", &cfg);
        let legacy = render(&o);
        assert!(legacy.starts_with("{\"kept\":"));
        assert!(!legacy.contains("max_tokens"), "默认路径不得带 max_tokens");
        let mut cfg2 = cfg;
        cfg2.limit = Some(100);
        let o2 = compress("a\nb\nc\n", "a", &cfg2);
        assert!(render(&o2).contains("\"max_tokens\":100"));
    }

    /// 60 行合成日志 + 命中查询 → sieve 卡：标题/查询/模式/证据/风险齐备，
    /// token 数字与估算口径一致。
    #[test]
    fn recall_report_sieve_card_is_complete() {
        let text = (0..60)
            .map(|i| {
                if i % 5 == 0 {
                    format!(
                        "[12:00] ERROR failed to connect to database: connection refused attempt={i}"
                    )
                } else if i % 3 == 0 {
                    format!("[12:00] WARN retrying in 5s... attempt={i}")
                } else {
                    format!("[12:00] INFO cache warmup complete ({i} entries)")
                }
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let o = compress(
            &text,
            "database connection failed",
            &crate::Config::default(),
        );
        assert_eq!(o.mode, Mode::Sieve, "60 行命中查询应走 sieve");
        assert!(
            (o.tokens_in - crate::terms::estimate(&text)).abs() < 1e-9,
            "tokens_in 恒等于输入估算"
        );
        let rep = recall_report(&o, "database connection failed");
        assert!(rep.contains("✦ SCX 压缩召回 ✦"));
        assert!(rep.contains("📌 查询"));
        assert!(rep.contains("database connection failed"));
        assert!(rep.contains("sieve 智能筛选"));
        assert!(rep.contains("📥 原始"));
        assert!(rep.contains("📤 压缩后"));
        assert!(rep.contains("💾 省下"));
        assert!(rep.contains(&format!("约 {} token", o.tokens_in as u64)));
        assert!(rep.contains("证据召回"));
        assert!(rep.contains("🛡️ 风险"));
    }

    /// 小输入（<40 行）→ passthrough 卡：说明行解释为什么不压缩。
    #[test]
    fn recall_report_passthrough_card_explains() {
        let o = compress("a\nb\nc\nd\ne\nf\ng\n", "a", &crate::Config::default());
        assert_eq!(o.mode, Mode::PassSmall);
        let rep = recall_report(&o, "a");
        assert!(rep.contains("✦ SCX 压缩召回 ✦"));
        assert!(rep.contains("小输入透传"));
        assert!(rep.contains("原样保留，一字未动"));
        assert!(rep.contains("💡 说明"));
        assert!(rep.contains("自动跳过"));
    }

    /// 查询零命中 → fail-open 卡：零丢失语义。
    #[test]
    fn recall_report_failopen_card_preserves() {
        let text = (0..60)
            .map(|i| format!("[12:00] INFO warmup entry {i}"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let o = compress(&text, "zzz_no_such_term", &crate::Config::default());
        assert_eq!(o.mode, Mode::FailOpenZeroSignal);
        let rep = recall_report(&o, "zzz_no_such_term");
        assert!(rep.contains("无命中保护"));
        assert!(rep.contains("原样保留，一字未动"));
        assert!(rep.contains("完整返回"));
    }

    /// render() v0.6.4 新字段：tokens_in/out/cut 全模式填充；passthrough cut=0。
    #[test]
    fn render_adds_token_effect_fields() {
        let cfg = crate::Config::default();
        let small = compress("a\nb\nc\n", "a", &cfg);
        let j = render(&small);
        assert!(j.contains("\"tokens_in\":"), "默认路径也带 tokens_in");
        assert!(j.contains("\"tokens_out\":"));
        assert!(j.contains("\"token_cut_pct\":0.0"), "passthrough cut 为 0");

        let big = (0..60)
            .map(|i| format!("line {i} ERROR boom"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let o = compress(&big, "boom", &cfg);
        assert!(
            o.mode == Mode::Sieve || o.mode == Mode::OverflowEvidence,
            "60 行命中走 sieve/overflow"
        );
        let tin = o.tokens_in;
        let tout = crate::terms::estimate(&o.text);
        let j2 = render(&o);
        assert!(j2.contains(&format!("\"tokens_in\":{:.0}", tin)));
        assert!(j2.contains(&format!("\"tokens_out\":{:.0}", tout)));
        assert!(j2.contains(&format!("\"token_cut_pct\":{:.1}", token_cut(tin, tout))));
    }

    /// token_cut 边界：输入 0 安全返回 0；正常削减百分比正确。
    #[test]
    fn guard_note_reports_flag_not_count() {
        // guarded 是 0/1 标志位：不得渲染成「N 条额外守护」。
        assert_eq!(guard_note(crate::Risk::High, 1), "高 · 已启用额外守护");
        assert_eq!(guard_note(crate::Risk::High, 0), "高");
        assert_eq!(guard_note(crate::Risk::Low, 0), "低");
        assert!(!guard_note(crate::Risk::High, 1).contains("1 条"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn token_cut_is_safe_and_exact() {
        assert_eq!(token_cut(0.0, 999.0), 0.0);
        assert!((token_cut(100.0, 50.0) - 50.0).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((token_cut(200.0, 180.0) - 10.0).abs() < 1e-9);
    }
}

//! 压缩管线配置（`--pipeline <path>`）：JSON 声明式装配 plan/trim/anchor 阶段。
//!
//! 三层优先级：CLI 显式参数 > pipeline.json > policy 常量（与 `--policy-file`
//! 同语义：文件只填 CLI 未显式指定的字段）。算子/策略只以配置声明存在，
//! 未知键与越界值 fail-loud 报错，绝不静默忽略。
//!
//! 设计约束：本模块零 I/O 之外不依赖 args 层——`apply` 通过 `set` 回调询问
//! 某键是否已被 CLI 显式设置，装配决策由调用方（args）持有。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use crate::json::Json;
use crate::{AnchorKind, Config};

/// 规划阶段（行级选择）：保留比例、邻域窗口、上下文行数与 token 上限。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Plan {
    pub ratio: Option<f64>,
    pub window: Option<i64>,
    pub context: Option<i64>,
    pub limit: Option<usize>,
}

/// 行内 token 级裁剪阶段：开关、保留比例与代码/数字/符号行保护。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Trim {
    pub enable: Option<bool>,
    pub ratio: Option<f64>,
    pub op_keep: Option<bool>,
    pub code_keep: Option<bool>,
    pub zh_keep: Option<bool>,
    pub num_line_keep: Option<bool>,
    pub sym_line_keep: Option<bool>,
}

/// 骨架保护阶段：结构感知邻域、结构锚点种类与填充行最低分门槛。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Anchor {
    pub structure: Option<bool>,
    pub anchors: Option<Vec<AnchorKind>>,
    pub fill_floor: Option<f64>,
}

/// 管线装配：三阶段配置，全字段 `Option`（缺省 = 保持内核默认）。
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Pipeline {
    pub plan: Plan,
    pub trim: Trim,
    pub anchor: Anchor,
}

/// 顶层允许键（含说明性 comment）。
const TOP_KEYS: &[&str] = &["comment", "plan", "trim", "anchor"];
const PLAN_KEYS: &[&str] = &["ratio", "window", "context", "limit"];
const TRIM_KEYS: &[&str] = &[
    "enable",
    "ratio",
    "op_keep",
    "code_keep",
    "zh_keep",
    "num_line_keep",
    "sym_line_keep",
];
const ANCHOR_KEYS: &[&str] = &["structure", "anchors", "fill_floor"];

/// 锚点字符串映射（与 [`AnchorKind::as_str`] 同源）。
fn anchor_of(s: &str) -> Result<AnchorKind, String> {
    match s {
        "json" => Ok(AnchorKind::Json),
        "xml" => Ok(AnchorKind::Xml),
        "idoc" => Ok(AnchorKind::Idoc),
        "yaml" => Ok(AnchorKind::Yaml),
        "markdown" | "md" => Ok(AnchorKind::Markdown),
        other => Err(format!(
            "pipeline: unknown anchor kind `{other}` (json/xml/idoc/yaml/markdown)"
        )),
    }
}

fn reject_unknown(keys: &[&str], obj: &Json, path: &str, where_: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Json::Obj(kv) = obj {
        for (k, _) in kv {
            if !keys.contains(&k.as_str()) {
                return Err(format!(
                    "pipeline {path}: {where_} unknown key `{k}` (allowed: {})",
                    keys.join("/")
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn from_json(root: &Json, path: &str) -> Result<Pipeline, String> {
    reject_unknown(TOP_KEYS, root, path, "top-level")?;
    let mut p = Pipeline::default();
    let plan = root.get("plan");
    let trim = root.get("trim");
    let anchor = root.get("anchor");
    if let Some(obj) = plan {
        reject_unknown(PLAN_KEYS, obj, path, "plan")?;
        p.plan.ratio = f64_of(obj, "ratio", path, "plan")?;
        p.plan.window = i64_of(obj, "window", path, "plan")?;
        p.plan.context = i64_of(obj, "context", path, "plan")?;
        p.plan.limit = usize_of(obj, "limit", path, "plan")?;
    }
    if let Some(obj) = trim {
        reject_unknown(TRIM_KEYS, obj, path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.enable = bool_of(obj, "enable", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.ratio = f64_of(obj, "ratio", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.op_keep = bool_of(obj, "op_keep", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.code_keep = bool_of(obj, "code_keep", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.zh_keep = bool_of(obj, "zh_keep", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.num_line_keep = bool_of(obj, "num_line_keep", path, "trim")?;
        p.trim.sym_line_keep = bool_of(obj, "sym_line_keep", path, "trim")?;
    }
    if let Some(obj) = anchor {
        reject_unknown(ANCHOR_KEYS, obj, path, "anchor")?;
        p.anchor.structure = bool_of(obj, "structure", path, "anchor")?;
        p.anchor.fill_floor = f64_of(obj, "fill_floor", path, "anchor")?;
        if let Some(arr) = obj.get("anchors") {
            let mut v = Vec::new();
            if let Json::Arr(items) = arr {
                for item in items {
                    let s = item.str().ok_or_else(|| {
                        format!("pipeline {path}: anchor: anchors entries must be strings")
                    })?;
                    v.push(anchor_of(s)?);
                }
            } else {
                return Err(format!("pipeline {path}: anchor: anchors must be an array"));
            }
            p.anchor.anchors = Some(v);
        }
    }
    validate_self(&p, path)?;
    Ok(p)
}

/// 范围校验（范围常量以 policy 为准，不在此重写）。
fn validate_self(p: &Pipeline, path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(r) = p.plan.ratio {
        if !(crate::policy::MIN_RATIO..=1.0).contains(&r) {
            return Err(format!(
                "pipeline {path}: plan.ratio must be in {}..=1.0",
                crate::policy::MIN_RATIO
            ));
        }
    }
    if let Some(w) = p.plan.window {
        if !(Config::MIN_WINDOW..=Config::MAX_WINDOW).contains(&w) {
            return Err(format!(
                "pipeline {path}: plan.window must be in {}..={}",
                Config::MIN_WINDOW,
                Config::MAX_WINDOW
            ));
        }
    }
    if let Some(c) = p.plan.context {
        if !(0..=Config::MAX_CONTEXT).contains(&c) {
            return Err(format!(
                "pipeline {path}: plan.context must be 0..={}",
                Config::MAX_CONTEXT
            ));
        }
    }
    if let Some(r) = p.trim.ratio {
        if !(crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO..=crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO).contains(&r) {
            return Err(format!(
                "pipeline {path}: trim.ratio must be in {}..={}",
                crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO,
                crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO
            ));
        }
    }
    if let Some(f) = p.anchor.fill_floor {
        if !(0.0..=crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR).contains(&f) {
            return Err(format!(
                "pipeline {path}: anchor.fill_floor must be 0.0..={}",
                crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

impl Pipeline {
    /// 读取并解析管线配置；任何越界/未知键/类型错误都 fail-loud 返回。
    pub fn load(path: &str) -> Result<Pipeline, String> {
        let body = std::fs::read_to_string(path)
            .map_err(|e| format!("pipeline: cannot read {path}: {e}"))?;
        let root = crate::json::parse(&body).map_err(|e| format!("pipeline {path}: {e}"))?;
        from_json(&root, path)
    }
    /// 应用到 `cfg`。`set(flag)` 返回 true 表示该键已被 CLI 显式设置（跳过，
    /// 保持 CLI 显式 > pipeline > DEFAULT 的三层优先级）。
    /// 返回实际写入的 flag 名列表（供调用方记录来源，防止后续默认覆盖）。
    pub fn apply(&self, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
        let mut applied = Vec::new();
        applied.extend(apply_plan(&self.plan, cfg, set));
        applied.extend(apply_trim(&self.trim, cfg, set));
        applied.extend(apply_anchor(&self.anchor, cfg, set));
        applied
    }
}

/// 单个可选字段落位：CLI 未显式设置（`set` 为 false）才写入并记录来源。
fn set1(
    applied: &mut Vec<&'static str>,
    cfg: &mut Config,
    set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool,
    flag: &'static str,
    field: impl Fn(&mut Config),
) {
    if !set(flag) {
        field(cfg);
        applied.push(flag);
    }
}

fn apply_plan(p: &Plan, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let mut a = Vec::new();
    if p.ratio.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--ratio", |c| c.ratio = p.ratio.unwrap());
    }
    if p.window.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--window", |c| {
            c.window = p.window.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if p.context.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--context", |c| {
            c.context = p.context.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if p.limit.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--max-tokens", |c| c.limit = p.limit);
    }
    a
}

fn apply_trim(t: &Trim, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let mut a = Vec::new();
    a.extend(apply_trim_switch(t, cfg, set));
    a.extend(apply_trim_keep(t, cfg, set));
    a
}

fn apply_trim_switch(t: &Trim, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let mut a = Vec::new();
    if t.enable.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--trim", |c| c.trim = t.enable.unwrap());
    }
    if t.ratio.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--trim-ratio", |c| {
            c.trim_ratio = t.ratio.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if t.op_keep.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--trim-op-keep", |c| {
            c.trim_op_keep = t.op_keep.unwrap()
        });
    }
    a
}

fn apply_trim_keep(t: &Trim, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let mut a = Vec::new();
    if t.code_keep.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--code-keep", |c| {
            c.code_keep = t.code_keep.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if t.zh_keep.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--zh-keep", |c| {
            c.zh_keep = t.zh_keep.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if t.num_line_keep.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--num-line-keep", |c| {
            c.num_line_keep = t.num_line_keep.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if t.sym_line_keep.is_some() {
        set1(&mut a, cfg, set, "--sym-line-keep", |c| {
            c.sym_line_keep = t.sym_line_keep.unwrap()
        });
    }
    a
}

fn apply_anchor(a: &Anchor, cfg: &mut Config, set: &dyn Fn(&str) -> bool) -> Vec<&'static str> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    if a.structure.is_some() {
        set1(&mut out, cfg, set, "--structure", |c| {
            c.structure = a.structure.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if a.fill_floor.is_some() {
        set1(&mut out, cfg, set, "--fill-floor", |c| {
            c.fill_floor = a.fill_floor.unwrap()
        });
    }
    if let Some(anchors) = &a.anchors {
        if !set("--structure-anchors") {
            cfg.structure_anchors = anchors.clone();
            out.push("--structure-anchors");
        }
    }
    out
}

fn f64_of(obj: &Json, key: &str, path: &str, where_: &str) -> Result<Option<f64>, String> {
    match obj.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(Json::Num(n)) => Ok(Some(*n)),
        Some(_) => Err(format!("pipeline {path}: {where_}.{key} must be a number")),
    }
}

fn i64_of(obj: &Json, key: &str, path: &str, where_: &str) -> Result<Option<i64>, String> {
    match obj.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(Json::Num(n)) => Ok(Some(*n as i64)),
        Some(_) => Err(format!("pipeline {path}: {where_}.{key} must be a number")),
    }
}

fn usize_of(obj: &Json, key: &str, path: &str, where_: &str) -> Result<Option<usize>, String> {
    match obj.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(Json::Num(n)) if *n >= 0.0 => Ok(Some(*n as usize)),
        Some(_) => Err(format!(
            "pipeline {path}: {where_}.{key} must be a non-negative number"
        )),
    }
}

fn bool_of(obj: &Json, key: &str, path: &str, where_: &str) -> Result<Option<bool>, String> {
    match obj.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(Json::Bool(b)) => Ok(Some(*b)),
        Some(_) => Err(format!("pipeline {path}: {where_}.{key} must be a boolean")),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn parse(body: &str) -> Result<Pipeline, String> {
        let root = crate::json::parse(body)?;
        from_json(&root, "<test>")
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_pipeline_applies_all_fields() {
        let p = parse(
            r#"{"plan":{"ratio":0.3,"window":2,"context":1},
            "trim":{"enable":true,"ratio":0.3,"op_keep":true,"code_keep":true,
            "num_line_keep":true,"sym_line_keep":true},
            "anchor":{"structure":true,"anchors":["md"],"fill_floor":0.0}}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let mut cfg = Config::default();
        let applied = p.apply(&mut cfg, &|_| false);
        assert!(applied.contains(&"--ratio"));
        assert!(applied.contains(&"--structure-anchors"));
        assert_eq!(cfg.ratio, 0.3);
        assert!(cfg.trim);
        assert_eq!(cfg.trim_ratio, 0.3);
        assert!(cfg.trim_op_keep && cfg.code_keep && cfg.num_line_keep && cfg.sym_line_keep);
        assert!(cfg.structure);
        assert_eq!(cfg.structure_anchors, vec![AnchorKind::Markdown]);
        assert_eq!(cfg.fill_floor, 0.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cli_explicit_wins_over_pipeline() {
        let p = parse(r#"{"plan":{"ratio":0.3}}"#).unwrap();
        let mut cfg = Config::default();
        // CLI 已显式 --ratio → pipeline 不覆盖
        let applied = p.apply(&mut cfg, &|f| f == "--ratio");
        assert!(applied.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(cfg.ratio, Config::DEFAULT_RATIO);
    }

    #[test]
    fn partial_pipeline_keeps_defaults() {
        let p = parse(r#"{"trim":{"enable":true}}"#).unwrap();
        let mut cfg = Config::default();
        let applied = p.apply(&mut cfg, &|_| false);
        assert!(applied.contains(&"--trim"));
        assert_eq!(cfg.trim_ratio, crate::policy::DEFAULT_TRIM_RATIO);
        assert!(cfg.trim);
        assert_eq!(cfg.trim_ratio, crate::policy::DEFAULT_TRIM_RATIO);
        assert_eq!(cfg.ratio, Config::DEFAULT_RATIO);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unknown_keys() {
        assert!(parse(r#"{"bogus":1}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"plan":{"bogus":1}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"trim":{"bogus":1}}"#).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_out_of_range() {
        assert!(parse(r#"{"plan":{"ratio":5.0}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"plan":{"window":99}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"trim":{"ratio":0.05}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"anchor":{"fill_floor":99.0}}"#).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_wrong_types_and_bad_anchors() {
        assert!(parse(r#"{"trim":{"enable":1}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"anchor":{"anchors":"md"}}"#).is_err());
        assert!(parse(r#"{"anchor":{"anchors":["bogus"]}}"#).is_err());
    }
}

//! 声明式策略表：压缩内核的全部可调参数与结构加分权重。
//!
//! 算子与策略只以配置声明存在，不落独立硬编码文件；`DEFAULT_*` 逐项等于
//! v0.4.1 硬编码现状，改动默认值必须同时通过 golden 门与 Gauge 门。
//! 本模块是纯数据层（零 I/O、零分配逻辑），被 `compress` 内核消费。

pub const DEFAULT_RATIO: f64 = 0.35;
pub const MIN_RATIO: f64 = 0.02;
/// 填充行/邻域行最低分数门槛（`--fill-floor`，默认 0 = 与现状逐字节一致）。
/// 大于 0 时：分数低于门槛的邻域行不再无条件保留（mark_context 跳过），
/// 且不进入可选填充（eligible 拒绝）——只留真正有证据价值的行。
pub const DEFAULT_FILL_FLOOR: f64 = 0.0;
pub const MAX_FILL_FLOOR: f64 = 10.0;
/// 行内 token 级裁剪开关（`--trim`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 1 时对保留行做 token 级重要性裁剪（数字/结构锚/命中词保留，
/// 停用词/低信息量 token 按预算摘除），压缩更深但改变输出正文。
pub const DEFAULT_TRIM: bool = false;
/// 行内 token 保留比例（`--trim-ratio`，默认 0.5 = 每行最多摘一半 token）。
pub const DEFAULT_TRIM_RATIO: f64 = 0.5;
pub const MIN_TRIM_RATIO: f64 = 0.1;
pub const MAX_TRIM_RATIO: f64 = 1.0;
/// 算术符号强制保留开关（`--trim-op-keep`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 打开时 `+ = * -` 作为结构锚保留——代码/算式语义核心（P6f）；
/// 默认关：GSM8K 数学场景实测无益（P6d，0.5 档压缩率 27.5% 最优）。
pub const DEFAULT_TRIM_OP_KEEP: bool = false;
/// 代码围栏行保护开关（`--code-keep`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 打开时 ``` 围栏区间内代码行整行强制保留（防 elide/防 trim 摘短变量），
/// 压缩率全部转移到说明行——代码场景 P6g 深度优化。
pub const DEFAULT_CODE_KEEP: bool = false;
/// 数字行保留开关（`--num-line-keep`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 打开时含 ASCII 数字的非折叠行整行保留（行内仍走 trim，数字 token 本身
/// 永不摘）——长代码问答场景：中文问题无法以词根命中英文代码行（P6j 实测
/// query 引导档答案行被整行删），数字常量/赋值行是答案高频载体。
pub const DEFAULT_NUM_LINE_KEEP: bool = false;
/// 符号/签名行保留开关（`--sym-line-keep`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 打开时含函数/类型声明特征的行整行保留（行内仍走 trim）——生成型任务
/// （算子开发/代码生成评测）的 prompt 里，函数签名是硬约束；签名行的
/// `fn`/`->`/`&`/`(` 等符号在 token 级重要性低，0.2-0.3 档会被整行摘掉，
/// 导致模型不知签名而生成错误代码（P6l 实测保持率 0.500 根因）。
pub const DEFAULT_SYM_LINE_KEEP: bool = false;
/// 中文问句行保护开关（`--zh-keep`，默认 0 = 现状逐字节一致）。
/// 打开时含疑问词/问号的中文行整行保留并标记 raw（跳过行内 trim）——
/// 中文代码问答题干被 trim 逐字摘碎是保持率 0.2 的主导机制（P8 保真
/// 曲线：r=0.3 中文段保留仅 22%），问句行必须整行保真。
pub const DEFAULT_ZH_KEEP: bool = false;
pub const MAX_CONTEXT: i64 = 4;
pub const MIN_WINDOW: i64 = 1;
pub const MAX_WINDOW: i64 = 8;

/// 小输入直通阈值：行数 < `SMALL_LINES` 且 token 估算 < `SMALL_TOK`。
pub const SMALL_LINES: usize = 40;
pub const SMALL_TOK: f64 = 400.0;
/// 超长行直通阈值：单行字节与字符均超过即返回原文。
pub const LONGLINE_BYTES: usize = 100_000;
pub const LONGLINE_CHARS: usize = 100_000;
/// 行数直通上限：筛选为每行分配位掩码/向量，纯换行等稀疏输入会按行数放大内存
/// （8 MiB 换行 ≈ 8M 行 ≈ 数百 MiB RSS），超限 fail-open 返回原文避免 OOM。
pub const MAX_LINES: usize = 4_000_000;
/// 可选内容预算下限（token 估算）。
pub const BUDGET_MIN: f64 = 200.0;
/// 种子区域合并间隔 = `window * GAP_RATIO`。
pub const GAP_RATIO: usize = 3;

/// 结构加分与排序权重表：评分 if 链的声明式等价物。
/// 全部默认值来自 v0.4.1 硬编码；改写任何一项必须重跑 golden + Gauge。
pub struct Weights {
    /// 基础分 = IDF 加权命中之和 × `sumw_mul`。
    pub sumw_mul: f64,
    /// 命中词数 >= 2 的行加分。
    pub pair_bonus: f64,
    /// 失败级错误行加分。
    pub error_bonus: f64,
    /// 标题行加分。
    pub heading_bonus: f64,
    /// diff 元信息行加分。
    pub diffmeta_bonus: f64,
    /// diff 内容行且命中加分。
    pub diffline_hit_bonus: f64,
    /// 堆栈帧 / 行引用加分。
    pub frame_bonus: f64,
    /// `--force` 命中加分。
    pub force_bonus: f64,
    /// 首 `edge_head` / 尾 `edge_tail` 身份行加分。
    pub edge_bonus: f64,
    pub edge_head: usize,
    pub edge_tail: usize,
    /// 邻域排序权重：邻域最高分 ÷ `boost_div`，上限 `boost_cap`。
    pub boost_div: f64,
    pub boost_cap: f64,
}

pub const DEFAULT_SCORES: Weights = Weights {
    sumw_mul: 3.0,
    pair_bonus: 2.0,
    error_bonus: 4.0,
    heading_bonus: 1.0,
    diffmeta_bonus: 2.0,
    diffline_hit_bonus: 2.0,
    frame_bonus: 2.0,
    force_bonus: 100.0,
    edge_bonus: 2.0,
    edge_head: 2,
    edge_tail: 3,
    boost_div: 4.0,
    boost_cap: 3.0,
};

/// 风险审计阈值表。`hit_drop_w` 保持整数以复刻原始整数表达式（bit 级一致）。
pub struct Limits {
    /// risk_raw >= `high` -> HIGH。
    pub high: f64,
    /// risk_raw >= `med` -> MED。
    pub med: f64,
    /// 丢弃命中行加权（整数，复刻 `err_dropped + hit_dropped * 3` 的整数表达式）。
    pub hit_drop_w: usize,
}

pub const DEFAULT_RISK: Limits = Limits {
    high: 0.35,
    med: 0.1,
    hit_drop_w: 3,
};

/// 结构感知邻域配置（`--structure 1` 开启时的判定参数；默认关闭时全部失效，
/// 行为与 v0.4.1 逐字节一致）。判定规则为数据表，不落独立硬编码文件。
pub struct Region {
    /// 结构区域并入上限：区域超过该行数时只保留区域内种子 ± half（max_span/2）
    /// 的窗口（其余行按 Budget 原因裁剪，不进入可选填充候选）。
    pub max_span: usize,
}

pub const REGION_DEFAULT: Region = Region { max_span: 200 };

//! 压缩前脱敏（P7）：手写确定性匹配器，零第三方 crate。
//!
//! 高置信模式（密钥/连接串/Bearer）复用 `crate::memory::sanitize`；身份类
//! （身份证/手机/邮箱）用手写匹配器（长度/边界规则）。内置匹配器仅做 Mask
//! （替换为 `<redacted>`）；`Replace`/`Hash` 动作与正则 span 替换留待后续
//! （现有 `regex.rs` 仅 `matches(bool)`，无匹配位置，无法做子串替换）。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

/// 内置脱敏种类。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum RedactKind {
    /// 密钥/连接串/Bearer（复用 `memory::sanitize`）。
    Secret,
    /// 18 位身份证号（17 位数字 + 数字/X 校验位）。
    IdCard,
    /// 11 位手机号（1 开头）。
    Phone,
    /// 邮箱 `local@domain.tld`。
    Email,
}

impl RedactKind {
    pub const fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            RedactKind::Secret => "secret",
            RedactKind::IdCard => "id-card",
            RedactKind::Phone => "phone",
            RedactKind::Email => "email",
        }
    }

    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<RedactKind> {
        match s {
            "secret" => Some(RedactKind::Secret),
            "id-card" => Some(RedactKind::IdCard),
            "phone" => Some(RedactKind::Phone),
            "email" => Some(RedactKind::Email),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

/// 单种脱敏命中统计。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Hit {
    pub kind: &'static str,
    pub count: usize,
}

const MASK: &str = "<redacted>";

/// 压缩前脱敏：逐 kind 应用内置匹配器，返回脱敏文本 + 命中统计。
/// 命中数按该 kind 新增的 `<redacted>` 数量计（各规则幂等、互不覆盖）。
pub fn redact(text: &str, kinds: &[RedactKind]) -> (String, Vec<Hit>) {
    let mut out = text.to_string();
    let mut hits = Vec::new();
    for &k in kinds {
        let before = out.matches(MASK).count();
        out = match k {
            // Secret 脱敏复用 memory 的幂等 sanitize（默认启用）；无 memory
            // 的最小内核构建下该模式降级为原样输出（feature opt-out 语义）。
            #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
            RedactKind::Secret => crate::memory::sanitize(&out),
            #[cfg(not(feature = "memory"))]
            RedactKind::Secret => out,
            RedactKind::IdCard => mask_id_card(&out),
            RedactKind::Phone => mask_phone(&out),
            RedactKind::Email => mask_email(&out),
        };
        let count = out.matches(MASK).count() - before;
        if count > 0 {
            hits.push(Hit {
                kind: k.as_str(),
                count,
            });
        }
    }
    (out, hits)
}

/// 连续 ASCII 数字段长度（从 i 起）。
fn digit_run(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> usize {
    let mut j = i;
    while j < b.len() && b[j].is_ascii_digit() {
        j += 1;
    }
    j - i
}

/// 对数字段应用命中规则：整段匹配则整体掩码，否则原样复制（避免长数字的子段误命中）。
fn mask_digit_runs(s: &str, pred: impl Fn(&[u8], usize, usize) -> Option<usize>) -> String {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        if b[i].is_ascii_digit() {
            let run = digit_run(b, i);
            match pred(b, i, run) {
                Some(len) => {
                    out.push_str(MASK);
                    i += len;
                }
                None => {
                    out.push_str(&s[i..i + run]);
                    i += run;
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        let ch = s[i..].chars().next().unwrap();
        out.push(ch);
        i += ch.len_utf8();
    }
    out
}

/// 身份证：恰 18 位数字，或 17 位数字 + `X`。
fn mask_id_card(s: &str) -> String {
    mask_digit_runs(s, |b, i, run| {
        let check_x = run == 17 && b.get(i + 17).is_some_and(|&c| c == b'X' || c == b'x');
        (run == 18 || check_x).then_some(18)
    })
}

/// 手机号：恰 11 位数字且以 `1` 开头。
fn mask_phone(s: &str) -> String {
    mask_digit_runs(s, |b, i, run| (b[i] == b'1' && run == 11).then_some(11))
}

/// 邮箱：从 `@` 向两侧按合法字符集扩展，domain 须含 `.`。
fn mask_email(s: &str) -> String {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        if b[i] == b'@' {
            if let Some(end) = email_span(b, i) {
                out.push_str(MASK);
                i = end;
                continue;
            }
        }
        let ch = s[i..].chars().next().unwrap();
        out.push(ch);
        i += ch.len_utf8();
    }
    out
}

/// 邮箱 span：`@` 两侧合法字符扩展，返回 domain 结束位置（须含点）；非邮箱返回 None。
fn email_span(b: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut start = at;
    while start > 0 && email_local(b[start - 1]) {
        start -= 1;
    }
    let mut end = at + 1;
    let mut has_dot = false;
    while end < b.len() && (email_domain(b[end]) || b[end] == b'.') {
        if b[end] == b'.' {
            has_dot = true;
        }
        end += 1;
    }
    (start < at && end > at + 1 && has_dot).then_some(end)
}

fn email_local(c: u8) -> bool {
    c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, b'.' | b'_' | b'%' | b'+' | b'-')
}

fn email_domain(c: u8) -> bool {
    c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'-'
}
