            )
            .unwrap();
            assert!(
                hits.iter().any(|h| h.id == target),
                "低置信 query 的词面 runtime 桶不得硬筛掉 db 目标 (index_force={force_index})"
            );
            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
        }
    }
}

//! 存储层：case.json 的读写与目录布局。
//!
//! 布局：
//! ```text
//! <root>/
//! ├── meta.toml              # meta.rs：schema 版本、引擎版本、case 数、代际、参数
//! ├── cases/<id>/
//! │   └── case.json          # 文档 + 元数据（序列化在本文件）
//! └── index/                 # 可丢弃的索引缓存
//! ```
//!
//! 原则：cases/ 是资产（可迁移），index/ 是可丢弃缓存（rebuild 重建）。
//! case 数据模型、JSON 序列化、读写与库内枚举由本文件统一拥有；哈希/时间在
//! util.rs，meta 在 meta.rs。

use crate::memory::json::{self, Val};
pub(crate) use crate::memory::meta::SCHEMA;
pub(crate) use crate::memory::meta::{ensure, Meta};
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) use crate::memory::util::fnv1a;
pub(crate) use crate::memory::util::{id, parts, stamp};
use std::fs;
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// `case.json` 读取上限：正文 1 MiB 加上证据副本与最坏 JSON 转义后仍有余量，
/// 同时把损坏/恶意文件的读取内存封顶，避免无界 `read_to_string`。
pub(crate) const MAX_CASE_JSON: u64 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct Fields {
    pub error_code: Vec<String>,
    pub file_loc: Vec<String>,
    pub symbol: Vec<String>,
    pub num_fp: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Stats {
    pub kept: usize,
    pub total: usize,
    pub cut: f64,
    pub risk: String,
}

/// 测试夹具：与生产无关的固定统计形状；集中一处避免各模块复制。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn sample() -> Stats {
    Stats {
        kept: 5,
        total: 100,
        cut: 95.0,
        risk: "HIGH".to_string(),
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Feedback {
    pub good: usize,
    pub bad: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Case {
    pub id: String,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub updated_at: String,
    pub query: String,
    pub terms: Vec<String>,
    pub text: String,
    pub fix: String,
    pub evidence_lno: Vec<usize>,
    pub evidence: Vec<String>,
    pub fp: String,
    pub source: Vec<String>,
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    pub bucket: String,
    pub fields: Fields,
    pub status: String,
    pub stats: Stats,
    pub forces: Vec<String>,
    pub feedback: Feedback,
    pub quality: f64,
}

impl Case {
    pub fn new(id: String, query: String, terms: Vec<String>, text: String) -> Case {
        let now = stamp();
        let mut c = Self::empty(id, query, terms, text);
        c.created_at = now.clone();
        c.updated_at = now;
        c
    }

    /// 反序列化专用空壳：不读取时钟，时间字段由 `case.json` 覆盖。
    fn empty(id: String, query: String, terms: Vec<String>, text: String) -> Case {
        Case {
            id,
            created_at: String::new(),
            updated_at: String::new(),
            query,
            terms,
            text,
            fix: String::new(),
            evidence_lno: Vec::new(),
            evidence: Vec::new(),
            fp: String::new(),
            source: Vec::new(),
            tags: Vec::new(),
            bucket: String::new(),
            fields: Fields::default(),
            status: "open".to_string(),
            stats: Stats {
                kept: 0,
                total: 0,
                cut: 0.0,
                risk: "LOW".to_string(),
            },
            forces: Vec::new(),
            feedback: Feedback { good: 0, bad: 0 },
            quality: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

// ---- case 读写（JSON 子集）----

pub(crate) fn path(root: &str, id: &str) -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(root).join("cases").join(id).join("case.json")
}

/// 将 Case 序列化为 Val（自产自销 schema；排序固定，字节稳定）。
pub(crate) fn encode(c: &Case) -> Val {
    Val::Obj(vec![
        ("schema".into(), Val::Num(SCHEMA as f64)),
        ("id".into(), Val::Str(c.id.clone())),
        ("created_at".into(), Val::Str(c.created_at.clone())),
        ("updated_at".into(), Val::Str(c.updated_at.clone())),
        ("query".into(), Val::Str(c.query.clone())),
        (
            "terms".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.terms.iter().map(|t| Val::Str(t.clone())).collect()),
        ),
        ("text".into(), Val::Str(c.text.clone())),
        ("fix".into(), Val::Str(c.fix.clone())),
        (
            "evidence_lno".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.evidence_lno.iter().map(|n| Val::Num(*n as f64)).collect()),
        ),
        (
            "evidence".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.evidence.iter().map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone())).collect()),
        ),
        ("fp".into(), Val::Str(c.fp.clone())),
        (
            "source".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.source.iter().map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone())).collect()),
        ),
        (
            "tags".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.tags.iter().map(|t| Val::Str(t.clone())).collect()),
        ),
        ("bucket".into(), Val::Str(c.bucket.clone())),
        (
            "fields".into(),
            Val::Obj(vec![
                (
                    "error_code".into(),
                    Val::Arr(
                        c.fields
                            .error_code
                            .iter()
                            .map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone()))
                            .collect(),
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "file_loc".into(),
                    Val::Arr(
                        c.fields
                            .file_loc
                            .iter()
                            .map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone()))
                            .collect(),
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "symbol".into(),
                    Val::Arr(
                        c.fields
                            .symbol
                            .iter()
                            .map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone()))
                            .collect(),
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "num_fp".into(),
                    Val::Arr(
                        c.fields
                            .num_fp
                            .iter()
                            .map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone()))
                            .collect(),
                    ),
                ),
            ]),
        ),
        ("status".into(), Val::Str(c.status.clone())),
        (
            "stats".into(),
            Val::Obj(vec![
                ("kept".into(), Val::Num(c.stats.kept as f64)),
                ("total".into(), Val::Num(c.stats.total as f64)),
                ("cut_pct".into(), Val::Num(c.stats.cut)),
                ("risk".into(), Val::Str(c.stats.risk.clone())),
            ]),
        ),
        (
            "forces".into(),
            Val::Arr(c.forces.iter().map(|s| Val::Str(s.clone())).collect()),
        ),
        (
            "feedback".into(),
            Val::Obj(vec![
                ("good".into(), Val::Num(c.feedback.good as f64)),
                ("bad".into(), Val::Num(c.feedback.bad as f64)),
            ]),
        ),
        ("quality".into(), Val::Num(c.quality)),
    ])
}

fn get<'a>(obj: &'a [(String, Val)], k: &str) -> Option<&'a Val> {
    obj.iter().find(|(key, _)| key == k).map(|(_, v)| v)
}
fn string(v: &Val) -> String {
    match v {
        Val::Str(s) => s.clone(),
        _ => String::new(),
    }
}
fn number(v: &Val) -> f64 {
    match v {
        Val::Num(n) => *n,
        _ => 0.0,
    }
}
fn strings(v: &Val) -> Vec<String> {
    match v {
        Val::Arr(items) => items.iter().map(string).collect(),
        _ => Vec::new(),
    }
}

/// 从 Val 反解 Case（未知/缺失键容错为默认值；schema 版本不符仍尽力读取）。
pub(crate) fn decode(v: &Val) -> Case {
    let obj = match v {
        Val::Obj(o) => o,
        _ => return Case::new("bad".into(), String::new(), Vec::new(), String::new()),
    };
    let id = get(obj, "id").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    let query = get(obj, "query").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    let terms = get(obj, "terms").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    let text = get(obj, "text").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut c = Case::empty(id, query, terms, text);
    c.created_at = get(obj, "created_at").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    c.updated_at = get(obj, "updated_at").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    c.fp = get(obj, "fp").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    // fix 与原始证据字段缺键时兼容旧 case。
    c.fix = get(obj, "fix").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    c.evidence_lno = get(obj, "evidence_lno")
        .map(|v| match v {
            Val::Arr(items) => items.iter().map(|it| number(it) as usize).collect(),
            _ => Vec::new(),
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    c.evidence = get(obj, "evidence").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    c.source = get(obj, "source").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    c.tags = get(obj, "tags").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    c.bucket = get(obj, "bucket").map(string).unwrap_or_default();
    c.status = get(obj, "status")
        .map(string)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "open".to_string());
    c.forces = get(obj, "forces").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    if let Some(Val::Obj(f)) = get(obj, "fields") {
        c.fields.error_code = get(f, "error_code").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
        c.fields.file_loc = get(f, "file_loc").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
        c.fields.symbol = get(f, "symbol").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
        c.fields.num_fp = get(f, "num_fp").map(strings).unwrap_or_default();
    }
    if let Some(Val::Obj(s)) = get(obj, "stats") {
        c.stats.kept = number(get(s, "kept").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0))) as usize;
        c.stats.total = number(get(s, "total").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0))) as usize;
        c.stats.cut = number(get(s, "cut_pct").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0)));
        c.stats.risk = get(s, "risk")
            .map(string)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "LOW".to_string());
    }
    if let Some(Val::Obj(f)) = get(obj, "feedback") {
        c.feedback.good = number(get(f, "good").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0))) as usize;
        c.feedback.bad = number(get(f, "bad").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0))) as usize;
    }
    c.quality = number(get(obj, "quality").unwrap_or(&Val::Num(0.0)));
    c
}

pub(crate) use crate::memory::lock::atomic;

/// 单 case 读改写锁：rate / 去重刷新 / delete 必须先持有同一把锁，
/// 否则并发反馈会互相覆盖（最后写入者的旧快照胜出）。
pub(crate) fn lock(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<crate::memory::lock::Lock> {
    if !valid(id) {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            format!("invalid case id: {id}"),
        ));
    }
    crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, &format!("cases/{id}.lock"))
}

/// 写一个 case 到库（原子写 case.json）。
/// 每次写入推进库代际，使 qmap 与会话缓存失效，保证新 case/反馈对同 query 可见。
pub(crate) fn save(root: &str, c: &Case) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    if !valid(&c.id) {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            format!("invalid case id: {}", c.id),
        ));
    }
    // 索引锁覆盖“写 case → 删旧索引 → bump gen”整个窗口：索引构建要么看到
    // 写前状态并随后被失效，要么看到写后状态；不能在新 gen 下写回旧索引。
    let _idx = crate::memory::index::lock(root)?;
    let dir = Path::new(root).join("cases").join(&c.id);
    crate::memory::lock::mkdir(&dir).map_err(|e| {
        std::io::Error::new(e.kind(), format!("create case dir {}: {e}", dir.display()))
    })?;
    let mut json_txt = json::write(&encode(c));
    json_txt.push('\n');
    atomic(&dir.join("case.json"), json_txt.as_bytes())
        .map_err(|e| std::io::Error::new(e.kind(), format!("write case {}: {e}", c.id)))?;
    // 索引是缓存：case 新增/更新后必须失效，否则大库会继续用旧 postings
    // 漏掉新 case（小库走线性路径看不出来）。
    crate::memory::index::clear(root);
    crate::memory::meta::bump(root)
}

/// case id 合法性：白名单字符集，禁路径分隔符与 `..` 逃逸。
/// 任何以 id 拼接路径的入口（--delete/--rate/gc）必须先过此校验。
pub(crate) fn valid(id: &str) -> bool {
    !id.is_empty()
        && id.len() <= 64
        && id
            .chars()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_')
        && !id.contains("..")
}

/// 读一个 case。
pub(crate) fn load(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<Case> {
    if !valid(id) {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            format!("invalid case id: {id}"),
        ));
    }
    let p = path(root, id);
    let mut txt = String::new();
    fs::File::open(&p)
        .and_then(|f| f.take(MAX_CASE_JSON + 1).read_to_string(&mut txt))
        .map_err(|e| std::io::Error::new(e.kind(), format!("read case {}: {e}", p.display())))?;
    if txt.len() as u64 > MAX_CASE_JSON {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!(
                "case {} too large: {} bytes > {MAX_CASE_JSON}",
                p.display(),
                txt.len()
            ),
        ));
    }
    let v = json::parse(&txt).map_err(|e| {
        std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!("parse case {}: {e}", p.display()),
        )
    })?;
    let mut c = decode(&v);
    // 路径 id 是资产身份的唯一所有者；旧文件缺 id 或内容被篡改时也不能让
    // 同一份 case 在 qmap/去重索引里冒充另一条记录。
    if c.id != id {
        c.id = id.to_string();
    }
    Ok(c)
}

/// 库内全部 case id（按目录列出，确定性排序）。
pub(crate) fn list(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let dir = Path::new(root).join("cases");
    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    for e in fs::read_dir(dir)? {
        let e = e?;
        if e.file_type()?.is_dir() {
            if let Some(name) = e.file_name().to_str() {
                if valid(name) && path(root, name).exists() {
                    ids.push(name.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ids.sort();
    Ok(ids)
}

/// 库总字节数（cases + meta + index）。用于写入前的软配额检查。
pub(crate) fn bytes(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<u64> {
    let root = Path::new(root);
    if root.exists() {
        size(root)
    } else {
        Ok(0)
    }
}

/// 目录递归字节数；符号链接按文件元数据计，不跟随目录链接。
pub(crate) fn size(dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<u64> {
    let mut total = 0u64;
    let mut stack = vec![dir.to_path_buf()];
    while let Some(dir) = stack.pop() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir)? {
            let entry = entry?;
            let path = entry.path();
            let kind = entry.file_type()?;
            if kind.is_dir() {
                stack.push(path);
            } else if kind.is_file() {
                total += entry.metadata()?.len();
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(total)
}

/// 重算并持久化 case_count；已持 `meta.lock` 时调用。
pub(crate) fn recount(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    // 与 meta::advance 共用 meta 锁：case_count 是从目录重算的，但写回必须串行，
    // 否则并发的 rename 会互相覆盖/报错。
    let n = list(root)?.len();
    let mut meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    meta.case_count = n;
    // 重写 meta.toml：保留 df/params 节，仅更新 case_count。
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let txt = fs::read_to_string(&p)?;
    let mut out_lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut replaced = false;
    for line in txt.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if t.starts_with("case_count") {
            out_lines.push(format!("case_count = {n}"));
            replaced = true;
        } else {
            out_lines.push(line.to_string());
        }
    }
    if !replaced {
        out_lines.push(format!("case_count = {n}"));
    }
    let mut body = out_lines.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    atomic(&p, body.as_bytes())?;
    Ok(())
}

/// 取 `meta.lock` 后重算 case_count。
pub(crate) fn bump(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let _g = crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock")?;
    recount(root)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn memory_store_roundtrip() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("scx-mem-test-{}", fnv1a("t1") & 0xffff));
        let root = root.to_str().unwrap();
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root);
        ensure(root).unwrap();

        let now = stamp();
        let text = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a\nat Pool.java:214\nRoot cause: pool size";
        let id = id(&now, "数据库连接超时 conn_id", text);
        let mut c = Case::new(
            id.clone(),
            "数据库连接超时 conn_id".to_string(),
            vec!["conn_id".to_string()],
            text.to_string(),
        );
        c.stats = Stats {
            kept: 3,
            total: 200,
            cut: 94.2,
            risk: "HIGH".to_string(),
        };
        c.status = "solved".to_string();
        c.feedback = Feedback { good: 2, bad: 0 };
        c.quality = 1.0;
        c.fix = "enlarge pool to 64 conns".to_string();

        save(root, &c).unwrap();
        let loaded = load(root, &id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(loaded, c, "case 往返必须逐字段一致");
        assert_eq!(loaded.fix, "enlarge pool to 64 conns", "fix 必须往返");
        assert!(
            !Path::new(root)
                .join("cases")
                .join(&id)
                .join("vec.bin")
                .exists(),
            "vec.bin 已移除：无效产物不再落盘"
        );

        let ids = list(root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ids, vec![id]);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn case_id_is_deterministic_and_date_prefixed() {
        let a = id("2026-10-22T10:30:00Z", "q", "t");
        let b = id("2026-10-22T10:30:00Z", "q", "t");
        assert_eq!(a, b);
        assert!(a.starts_with("2026-10-22_"));
        let c = id("2026-10-22T10:30:00Z", "q2", "t");
        assert_ne!(a, c, "query 变体必须产生不同 id");
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_case_ids_cannot_escape_the_cases_directory() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "scx-mem-id-{}",
            std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        ));
        let root = root.to_str().unwrap().to_string();
        ensure(&root).unwrap();

        for bad in ["", "..", "../escape", "a/b", "a\\b", "with space"] {
            assert!(load(&root, bad).is_err(), "load must reject {bad:?}");
            let c = Case::new(bad.to_string(), "q".into(), vec![], "t".into());
            assert!(save(&root, &c).is_err(), "save must reject {bad:?}");
        }
        // 外来的非法目录即使含 case.json 也不能进入库枚举。
        let foreign = Path::new(&root).join("cases").join("with space");
        fs::create_dir_all(&foreign).unwrap();
        fs::write(foreign.join("case.json"), b"{}").unwrap();
        assert!(list(&root).unwrap().is_empty());

        let valid = Case::new("ok_1".into(), "q".into(), vec![], "t".into());
        save(&root, &valid).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(list(&root).unwrap(), vec!["ok_1"]);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn load_uses_the_validated_path_identity() {
        let root = crate::memory::util::root("case-id");
        ensure(&root).unwrap();
        let mut c = Case::new("expected_id".into(), "q".into(), vec![], "t".into());
        save(&root, &c).unwrap();

        c.id = "tampered_id".into();
        fs::write(path(&root, "expected_id"), json::write(&encode(&c))).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(load(&root, "expected_id").unwrap().id, "expected_id");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn load_rejects_an_oversized_asset() {
        let root = crate::memory::util::root("case-size");
        ensure(&root).unwrap();
        let id = "oversized";
        let dir = Path::new(&root).join("cases").join(id);
        fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let file = fs::File::create(path(&root, id)).unwrap();
        file.set_len(MAX_CASE_JSON + 1).unwrap();
        let err = load(&root, id).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData);
        assert!(err.to_string().contains("too large"), "{err}");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn concurrent_case_writes_are_lossless() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "scx-mem-conc-{}",
            std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        ));
        let root = root.to_str().unwrap().to_string();
        ensure(&root).unwrap();
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for t in 0..8 {
            let root = root.clone();
            handles.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {
                for i in 0..4 {
                    let id = format!("c{t}_{i}");
                    let c = Case::new(id.clone(), format!("q{t}_{i}"), vec![], "text".into());
                    save(&root, &c).unwrap();
                    bump(&root).unwrap();
                }
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(list(&root).unwrap().len(), 32, "32 个 case 全部落盘");
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m.case_count, 32, "case_count 不能丢更新");
        assert_eq!(m.gen, 32, "每次 save 的 gen 递增都必须保留");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 纯函数工具：FNV-1a 64 哈希、UTC 时间自算、case id 生成。
//!
//! 零依赖、零 I/O、确定性（无随机源、无环境读取）。

/// FNV-1a 64 位哈希（确定性、无随机源）。实现收敛在 [`crate::hash`]，
/// 去重分桶与身份键共用同一份算法。
pub(crate) fn fnv1a(s: &str) -> u64 {
    crate::hash::fnv1a(s.as_bytes())
}

/// 分片 FNV-1a：避免为复合身份键拼接临时字符串。
pub(crate) fn parts(parts: &[&[u8]]) -> u64 {
    crate::hash::fnv1a_parts(parts)
}

/// case id：`<YYYY-MM-DD>_<hash16>`，hash = FNV-1a(query‖\0‖text) 全 64 位 hex。
/// 64 位避免持久化资产的生日碰撞（32 位在 1 万条时碰撞率 ≈1.2%）。
pub(crate) fn id(now: &str, query: &str, text: &str) -> String {
    let day = &now[0..10]; // YYYY-MM-DD
    let h = parts(&[query.as_bytes(), b"\0", text.as_bytes()]);
    format!("{day}_{h:016x}")
}

/// UTC 时间戳（秒精度，ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`，零依赖自算日历）。
pub(crate) fn seconds() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_secs())
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

pub(crate) fn stamp() -> String {
    let secs = seconds();
    let days = secs / 86_400;
    let rem = secs % 86_400;
    let (y, mo, d) = civil(days);
    let (hh, mi, ss) = (rem / 3600, (rem % 3600) / 60, rem % 60);
    format!("{y:04}-{mo:02}-{d:02}T{hh:02}:{mi:02}:{ss:02}Z")
}

/// 入库前模式脱敏：token/密码/连接串/Bearer 等敏感值
/// 在落盘前替换为 `<redacted>`。幂等（脱敏结果不再含可脱敏模式）、确定性、
/// 不破坏行号与结构（键名保留、仅值替换）。朴素字节扫描（零依赖）。
pub(crate) fn sanitize(s: &str) -> String {
    // 多轮直到稳定：嵌套形式（如 `Authorization: Bearer token=..`）逐层收敛。
    let Some(mut out) = once(s) else {
        return s.to_string();
    };
    for _ in 1..3 {
        match once(&out) {
            Some(next) => out = next,
            None => break,
        }
    }
    out
}

/// 敏感键（大小写不敏感匹配，后随 `=`/`:` + 可选空白 + 值到边界）。
const SENSITIVE_KEYS: &[&str] = &[
    "password",
    "passwd",
    "pwd",
    "secret",
    "token",
    "api_key",
    "apikey",
    "access_token",
    "access-token",
    "authorization",
    "client_secret",
    "private_key",
    "auth",
];

fn once(s: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut i = 0usize;
    let mut changed = false;
    while i < b.len() {
        if let Some((key_len, sep_len)) = pair(b, i) {
            let (next, redacted) = redact(b, s, i, key_len, sep_len, &mut out);
            i = next;
            changed |= redacted;
            continue;
        }
        if let Some((pw_start, at_pos)) = userinfo(b, i) {
            out.push_str(&s[i..pw_start]);
            out.push_str("<redacted>");
            changed = true;
            i = at_pos; // @ 由下一轮原样输出（保留结构）。
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(len) = bearer(b, i) {
            out.push_str(&s[i..i + len]);
            out.push_str("<redacted>");
            changed = true;
            i += len;
            continue;
        }
        let ch = s[i..].chars().next().unwrap();
        out.push(ch);
        i += ch.len_utf8();
    }
    changed.then_some(out)
}

/// 敏感键分支：保留键与分隔符，值替换为 `<redacted>`（含 `Bearer <token>`）。
fn redact(
    b: &[u8],
    s: &str,
    i: usize,
    key_len: usize,
    sep_len: usize,
    out: &mut String,
) -> (usize, bool) {
    let key_end = i + key_len + sep_len;
    out.push_str(&s[i..key_end]);
    let mut v = key_end;
    // JSON 引号值 `"value"` → 跳过整个引号串（含闭合引号）；否则走 Bearer/边界。
    if b.get(v) == Some(&b'"') {
        v = quoted(b, v);
    } else if let Some(tok_end) = value(b, v) {
        v = tok_end;
    } else {
        v = end(b, v);
    }
    if v > key_end {
        out.push_str("<redacted>");
        (v, true)
    } else {
        (key_end, false)
    }
}

/// 从值前引号 `"` 起，跳到闭合引号之后；未闭合则到串尾。
fn quoted(b: &[u8], start: usize) -> usize {
    let mut j = start + 1;
    while j < b.len() && b[j] != b'"' {
        j += 1;
    }
    if j < b.len() {
        j + 1
    } else {
        b.len()
    }
}

fn space(c: u8) -> bool {
    c == b' ' || c == b'\t'
}

fn separator(c: u8) -> bool {
    c == b'=' || c == b':'
}

fn start(b: &[u8], i: usize, k: &[u8]) -> bool {
    b.len() - i > k.len() && b[i..i + k.len()].eq_ignore_ascii_case(k)
}

fn skip(b: &[u8], mut j: usize) -> usize {
    while j < b.len() && space(b[j]) {
        j += 1;
    }
    j
}

fn end(b: &[u8], mut n: usize) -> usize {
    while n < b.len() && !boundary(b[n]) {
        n += 1;
    }
    n
}

/// 位置 i 是否以敏感键开头（大小写不敏感）且键后紧跟 `=`/`:`（可带空白）。
/// 支持 `key=value`/`key: value` 与 JSON `"key": value`/`"key"=value`。
/// 返回 (键字节长, 分隔符字节长含键后空白)。
fn pair(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    if b[i] == b'"' {
        if let Some(p) = json_pair(b, i) {
            return Some(p);
        }
    }
    for key in SENSITIVE_KEYS {
        let k = key.as_bytes();
        if !start(b, i, k) {
            continue;
        }
        let j = skip(b, i + k.len());
        if j >= b.len() || !separator(b[j]) {
            continue;
        }
        let mut sep_len = j - (i + k.len()) + 1; // 键后空白 + '=' / ':'
        let after = skip(b, j + 1);
        sep_len += after - (j + 1); // 分隔符后空白
        return Some((k.len(), sep_len));
    }
    None
}

/// JSON 键形式 `"key":`/`"key"=`：i 指向键前引号，返回 (键字节长含引号, 分隔符长)。
fn json_pair(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    for key in SENSITIVE_KEYS {
        let k = key.as_bytes();
        let j = i + 1;
        if b.len() < j + k.len() + 1 {
            continue;
        }
        if !b[j..j + k.len()].eq_ignore_ascii_case(k) || b[j + k.len()] != b'"' {
            continue;
        }
        let key_end = j + k.len() + 1; // 闭合引号后
        let sep = skip(b, key_end);
        if sep >= b.len() || !separator(b[sep]) {
            continue;
        }
        let after = skip(b, sep + 1);
        let key_len = k.len() + 2; // "key" 含两侧引号
        let sep_len = (sep - key_end) + 1 + (after - (sep + 1));
        return Some((key_len, sep_len));
    }
    None
}

/// 值边界：空白、逗号、分号、引号、尖括号。
fn boundary(c: u8) -> bool {
    matches!(
        c,
        b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n' | b',' | b';' | b'"' | b'\'' | b'<' | b'>'
    )
}

/// URL 用户信息：`://user:pass@` → 保留到密码起点，密码替换。
/// 返回 (密码起点, @ 位置)——上层输出 s[i..pw_start] + `<redacted>` 后从 @ 续扫。
fn userinfo(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    if !b[i..].starts_with(b"://") {
        return None;
    }
    let mut j = i + 3;
    while j < b.len() && !stop(b[j]) {
        if b[j] == b':' {
            if let Some(k) = password(b, j + 1) {
                return Some((j + 1, k));
            }
        }
        j += 1;
    }
    None
}

fn stop(c: u8) -> bool {
    matches!(c, b'/' | b'@' | b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n')
}

fn password(b: &[u8], mut k: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    while k < b.len() && !stop(b[k]) {
        k += 1;
    }
    (k < b.len() && b[k] == b'@').then_some(k)
}

/// `Bearer <token>` / `Basic <token>`：键 + 空白 + 8+ 字符值到空白边界。
fn bearer(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    scan(b, i).map(|(start, end)| end - start)
}

/// 从位置 i 起，若值以 `Bearer `/`Basic ` 开头且 token ≥8 字符，返回 token 末尾
/// （把整个 `Bearer <token>` 交给上层一并替换；否则返回 None 走普通值扫描）。
fn value(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    scan(b, i).map(|(_, end)| end)
}

/// Bearer/Basic 扫描：返回 (token 起点, token 末尾)。
fn scan(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    for kw in ["Bearer", "Basic"] {
        let k = kw.as_bytes();
        if !prefix(b, i, k) {
            continue;
        }
        let j = i + k.len();
        if !space(b[j]) {
            continue;
        }
        let start = j + 1;
        let end = end(b, start);
        if end - start >= 8 {
            return Some((start, end));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn prefix(b: &[u8], i: usize, k: &[u8]) -> bool {
    b.len() - i >= k.len() + 2 && b[i..i + k.len()].eq_ignore_ascii_case(k)
}

/// 终端输出安全转义：C0 控制字符与 ESC/ANSI 序列
/// 转成可见字面（`\x1b`、`\xNN`），防 --recall-detail 回放证据时的转义注入。
pub fn escape(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    for ch in s.chars() {
        push(ch, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

/// 单字符转义：C0 / DEL / ESC → 可见字面，其余原样。
fn push(ch: char, out: &mut String) {
    let u = ch as u32;
    if ch == '\n' {
        out.push_str("\\n");
    } else if ch == '\t' {
        out.push_str("\\t");
    } else if ch == '\r' {
        out.push_str("\\r");
    } else if u == 0x1b {
        out.push_str("\\x1b");
    } else if u < 0x20 || u == 0x7f {
        out.push_str(&format!("\\x{u:02x}"));
    } else {
        out.push(ch);
    }
}

/// Howard Hinnant 的 civil_from_days：days-since-epoch → (年, 月, 日)。
fn civil(z: u64) -> (u64, u64, u64) {
    let z = z + 719_468;
    let era = z / 146_097;
    let doe = z % 146_097;
    let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
    let y = yoe + era * 400;
    let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
    let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
    (if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y }, m, d)
}

/// 解析本模块自产的 UTC 串（`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`）为 Unix 秒。
/// 失败/非自产格式返回 0（与"未知年龄按全新"口径一致）。
pub(crate) fn parse(s: &str) -> u64 {
    let s = s.trim();
    let s = s.strip_suffix('Z').unwrap_or(s);
    let Some((date, time)) = s.split_once('T') else {
        return 0;
    };
    let Some((y, mo, d)) = ymd(date) else {
        return 0;
    };
    let Some((hh, mi, ss)) = hms(time) else {
        return 0;
    };
    if range(mo, d, hh, mi, ss) {
        return 0;
    }
    // days_since_epoch = civil_to_days(y,m,d)，逆算法。
    let y_adj = if mo <= 2 { y - 1 } else { y };
    let era = y_adj / 400;
    let yoe = y_adj - era * 400;
    let mp = if mo > 2 { mo - 3 } else { mo + 9 };
    let doy = (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + d - 1;
    let doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
    let days = era * 146_097 + doe - 719_468;
    days * 86_400 + hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss
}

/// 截取并解析 YYYY-MM-DD 三段；任一段字节越界或非数字返回 None。
fn ymd(date: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, u64)> {
    let y = date.get(0..4)?;
    let m = date.get(5..7)?;
    let d = date.get(8..10)?;
    Some((y.parse().ok()?, m.parse().ok()?, d.parse().ok()?))
}

/// 截取并解析 HH:MM:SS 三段；任一段字节越界或非数字返回 None。
fn hms(time: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, u64)> {
    let h = time.get(0..2)?;
    let m = time.get(3..5)?;
    let s = time.get(6..8)?;
    Some((h.parse().ok()?, m.parse().ok()?, s.parse().ok()?))
}

/// 自产 UTC 串的粗略值域校验（历法细节由 civil 逆算法自洽兜底）。
fn range(mo: u64, d: u64, hh: u64, mi: u64, ss: u64) -> bool {
    mo == 0 || mo > 12 || d == 0 || d > 31 || hh > 23 || mi > 59 || ss > 60
}

/// 测试用独立临时库根：进程号 + 单调序号保证并行测试不共享目录。
///
/// 之前每个测试模块各有一份 `tmp_root`，同名标签在并行执行时可能落到同一
/// 路径；集中到一处后只保留一个所有权和一套清理约定。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn root(tag: &str) -> String {
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
    static SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
        "scx-test-{}-{}-{}",
        std::process::id(),
        tag,
        SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
    ));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn fnv1a_deterministic_and_sensitive() {
        assert_eq!(fnv1a("abc"), fnv1a("abc"));
        assert_ne!(fnv1a("abc"), fnv1a("abd"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn civil_date_algorithm() {
        assert_eq!(civil(0), (1970, 1, 1));
        assert_eq!(civil(19_723), (2024, 1, 1));
        // 2024-01-01 起第 79 天 = 3 月 20 日（1 月 31 + 2 月 29 + 19）。
        assert_eq!(civil(19_802), (2024, 3, 20));
    }

    #[test]
    fn case_id_shape() {
        let first = id("2026-10-22T00:00:00Z", "q", "t");
        assert!(first.starts_with("2026-10-22_"));
        assert_eq!(first.len(), 11 + 16, "64 位 hash = 16 hex");
        assert_eq!(first, id("2026-10-22T00:00:00Z", "q", "t"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_roundtrip() {
        // 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z = 0
        assert_eq!(parse("1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"), 0);
        // 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z = civil 19_723 天
        assert_eq!(parse("2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"), 19_723 * 86_400);
        // 闰日：2024-02-29T00:00:00Z = 19723+59 天
        assert_eq!(parse("2024-02-29T00:00:00Z"), (19_723 + 59) * 86_400);
        // 时间分量
        assert_eq!(parse("2024-01-01T01:02:03Z"), 19_723 * 86_400 + 3723);
        // 非法输入 → 0
        assert_eq!(parse("garbage"), 0);
        assert_eq!(parse("2024-13-01T00:00:00Z"), 0);
    }

    /// 脱敏覆盖全部模式、幂等且不误伤明文。
    #[test]
    fn sanitize_redacts_secrets_and_is_idempotent() {
        let cases: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
            ("password=abc123", "password=<redacted>"),
            ("passwd: hunter2", "passwd: <redacted>"),
            (
                "Authorization: Bearer abcd.efgh.ijkl",
                "Authorization: <redacted>",
            ),
            ("token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.abc", "token=<redacted>"),
            ("api_key=sk-live-abc", "api_key=<redacted>"),
            (
                "postgres://user:pw@db:5432/x",
                "postgres://user:<redacted>@db:5432/x",
            ),
            ("client_secret = 9f8e7d6c5b4a", "client_secret = <redacted>"),
            // JSON 形式：键与值均带引号。
            (r#"{"password": "hunter2"}"#, r#"{"password": <redacted>}"#),
            (r#""token": "eyJhbGciOiJ9""#, r#""token": <redacted>"#),
            (r#""api_key"="sk-live-abc""#, r#""api_key"=<redacted>"#),
            ("ERROR plain log line", "ERROR plain log line"),
            ("conn timeout pool", "conn timeout pool"),
        ];
        for (input, want) in cases {
            assert_eq!(sanitize(input), *want, "input={input}");
        }
        // 幂等：再脱敏结果不变。
        let once = sanitize("Authorization: Bearer xyz.123 token=abc");
        assert_eq!(sanitize(&once), once);
        // 嵌套收敛：Bearer 内嵌 token=。
        let nested = sanitize("Authorization: Bearer aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa token=zzz");
        assert!(!nested.contains("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"), "{nested}");
        assert!(!nested.contains("zzz"), "{nested}");
        assert!(nested.contains("<redacted>"));
        assert!(nested.contains("Authorization:"));
    }

    /// 控制字符与 ANSI 序列必须可见化。
    #[test]
    fn escape_ctrl_renders_controls_visibly() {
        assert_eq!(escape("a\x1b[31mb"), "a\\x1b[31mb");
        assert_eq!(escape("x\ny"), "x\\ny");
        assert_eq!(escape("plain"), "plain");
        assert_eq!(escape("\x00\x07\x7f"), "\\x00\\x07\\x7f");
    }
}

//! 计量与审计层（P3 治理层）：Token 分桶统计、压缩效果指标、预算管控、快照追溯。
//!
//! 数据流：分类化载荷 `[(category, text)]` →（复用 [`crate::compress_bucketed`] 逐桶压缩）
//! → 分桶 token → 聚合全局/占比/效果指标/预算 → [`crate::meter::Snapshot`]（可序列化 JSON，入
//! [`crate::meter::Ledger`] 追溯）。本层是薄壳，不复制裁剪逻辑；仅复用
//! `crate::terms::estimate`（主链路计量口径）、`compress_bucketed`、
//! [`crate::ContentType`]（核心桶标签与价值梯度默认预算）与 [`crate::json`]。
//!
//! # 指标口径（全部确定性、可复现，除零保护固定）
//! - 压缩比 `ratio = tokens_out / tokens_in`（in=0 → 1.0）
//! - 节省率 `saved = (tokens_in - tokens_out) / tokens_in`（in=0 → 0）
//! - 高价值留存率 `retention = Σ高价值桶 out / Σ高价值桶 in`（in=0 → 1.0）
//! - 密度提升 `density = (高价值out/总out) / (高价值in/总in)`（任一分母 0 → 1.0）
//! - 桶占比 `share = 桶 tokens / 全局 tokens × 100`
//! - 预算使用率 `used_pct = used / cap × 100`；`level` 按 `used/cap` 越过 warn/over 阈值。
//!
//! 高价值桶 = [`crate::ContentType::StaticContract`] + [`crate::ContentType::SystemDefinition`]
//! （价值梯度最顶）。快照不含 wall-clock：`id`/`round` 由调用方传入，保证同输入
//! 同配置输出逐字节一致。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use crate::json::Json;
use crate::{BucketStat, Config, ContentType};

/// 对任意文本片段执行 token 计数（`terms::estimate` 向上取整；空串为 0）。
/// 全链路唯一计量口径，与压缩主链路的 `tokens_in/out` 同一把尺。
pub fn count(s: &str) -> usize {
    crate::terms::count(s)
}

/// 高价值桶判定：价值梯度最顶（静态契约 + 系统定义），参与留存率/密度。
fn high_value(kind: ContentType) -> bool {
    matches!(
        kind,
        ContentType::StaticContract | ContentType::SystemDefinition
    )
}

/// 压缩效果指标（口径见模块 doc）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Metrics {
    /// 压缩比 = tokens_out / tokens_in。
    pub ratio: f64,
    /// 节省率 = (tokens_in - tokens_out) / tokens_in。
    pub saved: f64,
    /// 高价值留存率 = 核心桶 out / 核心桶 in。
    pub retention: f64,
    /// 信息密度提升 = 压缩后高价值占比 / 原始高价值占比。
    pub density: f64,
}

/// 预算状态等级（多级使用率阈值）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Level {
    Normal,
    Warn,
    Over,
}

impl Level {
    pub const fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Level::Normal => "normal",
            Level::Warn => "warn",
            Level::Over => "over",
        }
    }
}

/// 全局预算 + 多级阈值 + 按桶配额（meter 层独立配置，不污染引擎 `Config`）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct BudgetSpec {
    /// 全局 token 预算上限（`None` = 不限）。
    pub cap: Option<usize>,
    /// 预警阈值（使用率比例，默认 0.7）。
    pub warn: f64,
    /// 超限阈值（使用率比例，默认 1.0）。
    pub over: f64,
    /// 按桶配额（kind → 上限 token 数）。
    pub quotas: Vec<(ContentType, usize)>,
}

impl Default for BudgetSpec {
    fn default() -> Self {
        BudgetSpec {
            cap: None,
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// 预算使用情况（绝对值 + 占比 + 状态）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Budget {
    pub cap: Option<usize>,
    /// 当前用量 = 压缩后 token 总量。
    pub used: f64,
    pub used_pct: f64,
    /// 剩余额度（`cap - used`，可为负 = 超支；无上限为 +∞）。
    pub left: f64,
    pub left_pct: f64,
    pub level: Level,
}

/// 计量快照：内容寻址 ID + 轮次 + 分桶明细 + 效果指标 + 预算。
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    /// 内容派生 ID = sha256(payload_sha256 + config_fingerprint) 前 16 位十六进制。
    pub id: String,
    pub round: u64,
    /// 输入载荷（parts 文本）的 SHA-256（hex）。
    pub payload_sha256: String,
    /// 配置指纹 = SHA-256(VERSION + query + 压缩参数)（hex）。
    pub config_fingerprint: String,
    pub buckets: Vec<BucketStat>,
    pub tokens_in: f64,
    pub tokens_out: f64,
    /// 按桶配额（kind → 上限）；渲染时由 `tokens_out` 派生使用率/剩余。
    pub quotas: Vec<(ContentType, usize)>,
    pub metrics: Metrics,
    pub budget: Budget,
}

impl Snapshot {
    /// 按输入占比降序返回分桶统计（需求：分类项按 Token 占比排序）。
    pub fn by_share(&self) -> Vec<&BucketStat> {
        let mut v: Vec<&BucketStat> = self.buckets.iter().collect();
        v.sort_by(|a, b| {
            b.tokens_in
                .partial_cmp(&a.tokens_in)
                .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        });
        v
    }

    /// 单查指定分类的用量（需求：单独查询指定分类）。
    pub fn find(&self, kind: ContentType) -> Option<&BucketStat> {
        self.buckets.iter().find(|b| b.kind == kind)
    }

    /// 单查指定分类的配额（`None` = 未分配）。
    fn quota_of(&self, kind: ContentType) -> Option<usize> {
        self.quotas
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| *k == kind)
            .map(|(_, q)| *q)
    }
}

/// 相邻/任意快照对比：token 与效果指标的变化量。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Diff {
    pub delta_in: f64,
    pub delta_out: f64,
    pub delta_saved: f64,
    pub delta_ratio: f64,
}

/// 快照账本：内存批量查询 + JSONL 持久化 + 对比（确定性，无 wall-clock）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Ledger {
    pub snaps: Vec<Snapshot>,
}

impl Ledger {
    pub fn push(&mut self, s: Snapshot) {
        self.snaps.push(s);
    }

    /// 按 ID 精确追溯。
    pub fn by_id(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Snapshot> {
        self.snaps.iter().find(|s| s.id == id)
    }

    /// 按轮次精确追溯。
    pub fn by_round(&self, round: u64) -> Option<&Snapshot> {
        self.snaps.iter().find(|s| s.round == round)
    }

    /// 对比两个快照（按 ID），返回 token 与指标变化量。
    pub fn diff(&self, a: &str, b: &str) -> Option<Diff> {
        let x = self.by_id(a)?;
        let y = self.by_id(b)?;
        Some(Diff {
            delta_in: y.tokens_in - x.tokens_in,
            delta_out: y.tokens_out - x.tokens_out,
            delta_saved: y.metrics.saved - x.metrics.saved,
            delta_ratio: y.metrics.ratio - x.metrics.ratio,
        })
    }

    /// 序列化为 JSONL（每行一个快照；纯函数，无 I/O）。
    pub fn to_jsonl(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = String::new();
        for s in &self.snaps {
            out.push_str(&render(s));
            out.push('\n');
        }
        out
    }

    /// 从 JSONL 反序列化（跳过无法解析的行；纯函数，无 I/O）。
    pub fn from_jsonl(s: &str) -> Ledger {
        let snaps = s
            .lines()
            .filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty())
            .filter_map(|l| crate::json::parse(l).ok())
            .filter_map(|v| from_json(&v))
            .collect();
        Ledger { snaps }
    }

    /// 导出账本为 JSONL 文件（审计日志导出）。
    pub fn save_jsonl(&self, path: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        std::fs::write(path, self.to_jsonl())
    }

    /// 从 JSONL 文件恢复账本。
    pub fn load_jsonl(path: &str) -> std::io::Result<Ledger> {
        std::fs::read_to_string(path).map(|s| Ledger::from_jsonl(&s))
    }
}

/// 输入载荷哈希：parts 的 (category + text) 拼接后 SHA-256（hex）。
fn payload_hash(parts: &[(ContentType, &str)]) -> String {
    let mut buf = String::new();
    for (kind, text) in parts {
        buf.push_str(kind.as_str());
        buf.push('\n');
        buf.push_str(text);
        buf.push('\n');
    }
    crate::hash::hex(&crate::hash::sha256(buf.as_bytes()))
}

/// 配置指纹：SHA-256(VERSION + query + 压缩参数)（hex）。确定性，捕获决定
/// 压缩结果的全部配置维度（不含运行时嵌入 sims）。
fn fingerprint(query: &str, cfg: &Config) -> String {
    let mut buf = String::new();
    buf.push_str(crate::VERSION);
    buf.push('\n');
    buf.push_str(query);
    buf.push('\n');
    buf.push_str(&format!("ratio={:.17}\n", cfg.ratio));
    buf.push_str(&format!("context={}\n", cfg.context));
    buf.push_str(&format!("window={}\n", cfg.window));
    buf.push_str(&format!("elide={}\n", cfg.elide));
    buf.push_str(&format!("gate={}\n", cfg.gate));
    buf.push_str(&format!("lineno={}\n", cfg.lineno));
    buf.push_str(&format!("structure={}\n", cfg.structure));
    buf.push_str(&format!("sim_weight={:.17}\n", cfg.sim_weight));
    buf.push_str(&format!("limit={:?}\n", cfg.limit));
    for f in &cfg.forces {
        buf.push_str("force=");
        buf.push_str(f);
        buf.push('\n');
    }
    for k in &cfg.structure_anchors {
        buf.push_str("anchor=");
        buf.push_str(k.as_str());
        buf.push('\n');
    }
    crate::hash::hex(&crate::hash::sha256(buf.as_bytes()))
}

/// 快照 id：SHA-256(payload_sha256 + config_fingerprint) 前 16 hex。
fn snap_id(payload_sha256: &str, config_fingerprint: &str) -> String {
    crate::hash::hex(&crate::hash::sha256(
        format!("{payload_sha256}{config_fingerprint}").as_bytes(),
    ))[..16]
        .to_string()
}

/// 最简入口：分类化载荷分桶压缩并计量。
///
/// `parts` = `[(ContentType, text)]`。`budget` 为 `None` 时预算字段为空态。
/// `id` 内容派生（确定性），`round` 由调用方传入。
pub fn measure(
    round: u64,
    parts: &[(ContentType, &str)],
    query: &str,
    cfg: &Config,
    budget: Option<&BudgetSpec>,
) -> Snapshot {
    // 分桶压缩只此一份实现（`compress_bucketed`）；本函数仅从其 `Outcome` 组装快照，
    // 不复制逐桶裁剪逻辑。`outcome.tokens_in/out` 已按各桶求和，与逐桶明细一致。
    let outcome = crate::compress_bucketed(parts, query, cfg);
    let buckets = outcome.buckets;
    let tin = outcome.tokens_in;
    let tout = outcome.tokens;
    let quotas = budget.map(|spec| spec.quotas.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
    let hi_in = buckets
        .iter()
        .filter(|b| high_value(b.kind))
        .map(|b| b.tokens_in)
        .sum::<f64>();
    let hi_out = buckets
        .iter()
        .filter(|b| high_value(b.kind))
        .map(|b| b.tokens_out)
        .sum::<f64>();
    let payload_sha256 = payload_hash(parts);
    let config_fingerprint = fingerprint(query, cfg);
    let id = snap_id(&payload_sha256, &config_fingerprint);
    Snapshot {
        id,
        round,
        payload_sha256,
        config_fingerprint,
        buckets,
        tokens_in: tin,
        tokens_out: tout,
        quotas,
        metrics: compute_metrics(tin, tout, hi_in, hi_out),
        budget: compute_budget(budget, tout),
    }
}

/// 纯计量（不压缩）：把 `text` 计为一个 kind 桶（token in == out），构造前置快照。
/// `config_fingerprint` 仅含 VERSION（无 query/压缩参数，因为未压缩）。
pub fn snapshot(round: u64, kind: ContentType, text: &str) -> Snapshot {
    let tokens = count(text) as f64;
    let lines = text.lines().count();
    let payload_sha256 = crate::hash::hex(&crate::hash::sha256(text.as_bytes()));
    let config_fingerprint = crate::hash::hex(&crate::hash::sha256(crate::VERSION.as_bytes()));
    let id = snap_id(&payload_sha256, &config_fingerprint);
    Snapshot {
        id,
        round,
        payload_sha256,
        config_fingerprint,
        buckets: vec![BucketStat {
            kind,
            tokens_in: tokens,
            tokens_out: tokens,
            kept: lines,
            total: lines,
            mode: crate::Mode::Sieve,
        }],
        tokens_in: tokens,
        tokens_out: tokens,
        quotas: Vec::new(),
        metrics: Metrics {
            ratio: 1.0,
            saved: 0.0,
            retention: 1.0,
            density: 1.0,
        },
        budget: Budget {
            cap: None,
            used: tokens,
            used_pct: 0.0,
            left: f64::INFINITY,
            left_pct: 0.0,
            level: Level::Normal,
        },
    }
}

fn compute_metrics(tin: f64, tout: f64, hi_in: f64, hi_out: f64) -> Metrics {
    let hi_share_in = div_or(hi_in, tin, 0.0);
    let hi_share_out = div_or(hi_out, tout, 0.0);
    Metrics {
        ratio: div_or(tout, tin, 1.0),
        saved: div_or(tin - tout, tin, 0.0),
        retention: div_or(hi_out, hi_in, 1.0),
        density: div_or(hi_share_out, hi_share_in, 1.0),
    }
}

/// 除零保护除法：分母 ≤0 时返回 `fallback`。
fn div_or(a: f64, b: f64, fallback: f64) -> f64 {
    if b > 0.0 {
        a / b
    } else {
        fallback
    }
}

fn compute_budget(spec: Option<&BudgetSpec>, used: f64) -> Budget {
    let cap = spec.and_then(|s| s.cap).map(|c| c as f64);
    let Some(cap) = cap else {
        return Budget {
            cap: None,
            used,
            used_pct: 0.0,
            left: f64::INFINITY,
            left_pct: 0.0,
            level: Level::Normal,
        };
    };
    let (warn, over) = spec.map(|s| (s.warn, s.over)).unwrap_or((0.7, 1.0));
    let used_pct = if cap > 0.0 { used * 100.0 / cap } else { 0.0 };
    let left = cap - used;
    let left_pct = if cap > 0.0 { left * 100.0 / cap } else { 0.0 };
    let level = if cap > 0.0 {
        let ratio = used / cap;
        if ratio >= over {
            Level::Over
        } else if ratio >= warn {
            Level::Warn
        } else {
            Level::Normal
        }
    } else {
        Level::Normal
    };
    Budget {
        cap: Some(cap as usize),
        used,
        used_pct,
        left,
        left_pct,
        level,
    }
}

/// 标准化 JSON 输出（P3 可视化/链路监控/审计导出消费）。
pub fn render(s: &Snapshot) -> String {
    let mut out = format!(
        "{{\"id\":{},\"payload_sha256\":{},\"config_fingerprint\":{},\"round\":{},\"tokens_in\":{:.2},\"tokens_out\":{:.2},",
        crate::json::string(&s.id),
        crate::json::string(&s.payload_sha256),
        crate::json::string(&s.config_fingerprint),
        s.round,
        s.tokens_in,
        s.tokens_out
    );
    out.push_str(&render_metrics(&s.metrics));
    out.push(',');
    out.push_str(&render_budget(&s.budget));
    out.push_str(",\"buckets\":[");
    for (i, b) in s.buckets.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push_str(&render_bucket(
            b,
            s.tokens_in,
            s.tokens_out,
            s.quota_of(b.kind),
        ));
    }
    out.push_str("]}");
    out
}

/// 账本聚合：按 kind（字典序）汇总 token 与调用次数，输出确定性 JSON。
/// `est_cost_saved_usd` 默认 null（价格表未配置时绝不编造成本）。
pub fn summarize(ledger: &Ledger) -> String {
    let by_kind = aggregate(ledger);
    let tin: f64 = ledger.snaps.iter().map(|s| s.tokens_in).sum();
    let tout: f64 = ledger.snaps.iter().map(|s| s.tokens_out).sum();
    let mut out = String::from("{\"by_kind\":[");
    for (i, (kind, (ki, ko, calls))) in by_kind.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push_str(&render_kind(kind, *ki, *ko, *calls));
    }
    out.push_str("],\"total\":{");
    out.push_str(&render_total(tin, tout, ledger.snaps.len()));
    out.push('}');
    out
}

/// 按 kind 累加 token 与调用次数（kind 字典序）。
fn aggregate(ledger: &Ledger) -> std::collections::BTreeMap<String, (f64, f64, usize)> {
    let mut by_kind = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    for s in &ledger.snaps {
        for b in &s.buckets {
            let e = by_kind
                .entry(b.kind.as_str().to_string())
                .or_insert((0.0, 0.0, 0));
            e.0 += b.tokens_in;
            e.1 += b.tokens_out;
            e.2 += 1;
        }
    }
    by_kind
}

/// 单 kind 聚合项 JSON。
fn render_kind(kind: &str, ki: f64, ko: f64, calls: usize) -> String {
    let saved = (ki - ko).max(0.0);
    let ratio = if ki > 0.0 { ko / ki } else { 1.0 };
    format!(
        "{{\"kind\":{},\"tokens_in\":{:.2},\"tokens_out\":{:.2},\"tokens_saved\":{:.2},\"ratio\":{:.4},\"calls\":{}}}",
        crate::json::string(kind),
        ki,
        ko,
        saved,
        ratio,
        calls
    )
}

/// 全局汇总项 JSON。
fn render_total(tin: f64, tout: f64, calls: usize) -> String {
    let saved = (tin - tout).max(0.0);
    let ratio = if tin > 0.0 { tout / tin } else { 1.0 };
    format!(
        "\"tokens_in\":{:.2},\"tokens_out\":{:.2},\"tokens_saved\":{:.2},\"ratio\":{:.4},\"calls\":{},\"est_cost_saved_usd\":null",
        tin,
        tout,
        saved,
        ratio,
        calls
    )
}

fn render_metrics(m: &Metrics) -> String {
    format!(
        "\"metrics\":{{\"ratio\":{:.4},\"saved\":{:.4},\"retention\":{:.4},\"density\":{:.4}}}",
        m.ratio, m.saved, m.retention, m.density
    )
}

fn render_budget(b: &Budget) -> String {
    format!(
        "\"budget\":{{\"cap\":{},\"used\":{:.2},\"used_pct\":{:.1},\"left\":{},\"left_pct\":{:.1},\"level\":\"{}\"}}",
        opt_num(b.cap.map(|c| c as f64)),
        b.used,
        b.used_pct,
        opt_f2(finite(b.left)),
        b.left_pct,
        b.level.as_str()
    )
}

/// 单桶 JSON：占比/削减用派生方法算，配额使用率/剩余由配额与 `tokens_out` 派生。
fn render_bucket(b: &BucketStat, tin: f64, tout: f64, quota: Option<usize>) -> String {
    let (quota_used_pct, quota_left) = match quota {
        Some(q) if q > 0 => (b.tokens_out * 100.0 / q as f64, q as f64 - b.tokens_out),
        _ => (0.0, f64::INFINITY),
    };
    format!(
        "{{\"kind\":\"{}\",\"tokens_in\":{:.2},\"tokens_out\":{:.2},\"share_in_pct\":{:.1},\"share_out_pct\":{:.1},\"cut_pct\":{:.1},\"kept\":{},\"total\":{},\"mode\":\"{}\",\"quota\":{},\"quota_used_pct\":{:.1},\"quota_left\":{}}}",
        b.kind.as_str(),
        b.tokens_in,
        b.tokens_out,
        share(b.tokens_in, tin),
        share(b.tokens_out, tout),
        cut_pct(b.tokens_in, b.tokens_out),
        b.kept,
        b.total,
        b.mode,
        opt_num(quota.map(|q| q as f64)),
        quota_used_pct,
        opt_f2(finite(quota_left))
    )
}

fn cut_pct(tin: f64, tout: f64) -> f64 {
    if tin > 0.0 {
        (tin - tout) * 100.0 / tin
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn share(part: f64, whole: f64) -> f64 {
    if whole > 0.0 {
        part * 100.0 / whole
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

/// `+∞` 序列化为 `null`（JSON 无 Infinity 字面量）。
fn finite(x: f64) -> Option<f64> {
    if x.is_finite() {
        Some(x)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// 整数数值或 `null`（cap/quota）。
fn opt_num(x: Option<f64>) -> String {
    x.map_or("null".to_string(), |n| format!("{n:.0}"))
}

/// f64 数值或 `null`（token/剩余额度；两位小数，保证 round-trip 无损）。
fn opt_f2(x: Option<f64>) -> String {
    x.map_or("null".to_string(), |n| format!("{n:.2}"))
}

/// 从 `render` 输出的 JSON 反序列化（供 `Ledger::from_jsonl` 使用；`None` = 字段缺失）。
fn from_json(v: &Json) -> Option<Snapshot> {
    let (id, round, payload_sha256, config_fingerprint) = head_of(v)?;
    Some(Snapshot {
        id,
        round,
        payload_sha256,
        config_fingerprint,
        buckets: from_buckets(v.get("buckets")?),
        tokens_in: num_of(v, "tokens_in")?,
        tokens_out: num_of(v, "tokens_out")?,
        quotas: from_quotas(v.get("quotas")),
        metrics: from_metrics(v.get("metrics")?)?,
        budget: from_budget(v.get("budget")?)?,
    })
}

/// 解析快照头部标量字段（id/round/载荷哈希/配置指纹）。
fn head_of(v: &Json) -> Option<(String, u64, String, String)> {
    Some((
        str_of(v, "id")?.to_string(),
        num_of(v, "round")? as u64,
        str_of(v, "payload_sha256")?.to_string(),
        str_of(v, "config_fingerprint")?.to_string(),
    ))
}

fn from_buckets(b: &Json) -> Vec<BucketStat> {
    match b {
        Json::Arr(arr) => arr.iter().filter_map(from_bucket).collect(),
        _ => Vec::new(),
    }
}

/// 配额字段在 render 中未单独序列化（折叠在 bucket 里），反序列化时回退为空。
fn from_quotas(_v: Option<&Json>) -> Vec<(ContentType, usize)> {
    Vec::new()
}

/// 取字段并转数值；`None` = 字段缺失或非数值。
fn num_of(v: &Json, k: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    v.get(k).and_then(Json::num)
}

/// 取字段并转字符串引用；`None` = 字段缺失或非字符串。
fn str_of<'a>(v: &'a Json, k: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    v.get(k).and_then(Json::str)
}

fn from_metrics(m: &Json) -> Option<Metrics> {
    Some(Metrics {
        ratio: m.get("ratio")?.num()?,
        saved: m.get("saved")?.num()?,
        retention: m.get("retention")?.num()?,
        density: m.get("density")?.num()?,
    })
}

fn from_budget(b: &Json) -> Option<Budget> {
    Some(Budget {
        cap: b.get("cap").and_then(Json::num).map(|n| n as usize),
        used: b.get("used")?.num()?,
        used_pct: b.get("used_pct")?.num()?,
        left: b.get("left").and_then(Json::num).unwrap_or(f64::INFINITY),
        left_pct: b.get("left_pct")?.num()?,
        level: match b.get("level").and_then(Json::str).unwrap_or("normal") {
            "over" => Level::Over,
            "warn" => Level::Warn,
            _ => Level::Normal,
        },
    })
}

fn from_bucket(b: &Json) -> Option<BucketStat> {
    let kind = str_of(b, "kind")?.parse().ok()?;
    let mode = str_of(b, "mode")
        .and_then(mode_of)
        .unwrap_or(crate::Mode::Sieve);
    Some(BucketStat {
        kind,
        tokens_in: num_of(b, "tokens_in")?,
        tokens_out: num_of(b, "tokens_out")?,
        kept: num_of(b, "kept")? as usize,
        total: num_of(b, "total")? as usize,
        mode,
    })
}

/// mode 字符串 → 枚举（反序列化用；未知回退 Sieve）。
fn mode_of(s: &str) -> Option<crate::Mode> {
    use crate::Mode::*;
    Some(match s {
        "passthrough:small" => PassSmall,
        "passthrough:longline" => PassLongline,
        "passthrough:too-many-lines" => PassTooManyLines,
        "failopen:zero-signal" => FailOpenZeroSignal,
        "passthrough:no-kept" => PassNoKept,
        "sieve" => Sieve,
        "overflow:evidence" => OverflowEvidence,
        "overflow:fill" => OverflowFill,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// `scx ledger` 入口：读账本 JSONL（文件或 stdin），输出聚合 JSON。
/// 用法：`scx ledger --summarize [--json] [ledger.jsonl]`。
pub fn run_ledger(args: &[String]) -> i32 {
    let mut do_summarize = false;
    let mut path: Option<&str> = None;
    for a in args {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--summarize" => do_summarize = true,
            "--json" => {}
            other if !other.starts_with("--") => path = Some(other),
            other => {
                eprintln!("scx ledger: unknown argument {other}");
                return 2;
            }
        }
    }
    if !do_summarize {
        eprintln!("scx ledger: usage: scx ledger --summarize [--json] [ledger.jsonl]");
        return 2;
    }
    let ledger = match path {
        Some(p) => match Ledger::load_jsonl(p) {
            Ok(l) => l,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("scx ledger: {e}");
                return 1;
            }
        },
        None => {
            let mut s = String::new();
            if std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut s).is_err() {
                eprintln!("scx ledger: read stdin failed");
                return 2;
            }
            Ledger::from_jsonl(&s)
        }
    };
    println!("{}", summarize(&ledger));
    0
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn text() -> String {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = (0..200)
            .map(|i| format!("filler alpha beta line {i}"))
            .collect();
        lines[100] = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a".to_string();
        lines.join("\n")
    }

    fn parts(t: &str) -> Vec<(ContentType, &str)> {
        vec![
            (ContentType::StaticContract, t),
            (ContentType::SystemDefinition, t),
            (ContentType::SessionMessage, t),
            (ContentType::ToolOutput, t),
        ]
    }

    #[test]
    fn count_matches_estimate_ceil_and_empty_is_zero() {
        assert_eq!(count(""), 0);
        assert_eq!(
            count("hello"),
            crate::terms::estimate("hello").ceil() as usize
        );
        assert_eq!(
            count("数据库连接超时"),
            crate::terms::estimate("数据库连接超时").ceil() as usize
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn measure_aggregates_shares_sum_to_100() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let s = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        let in_sum: f64 = s
            .buckets
            .iter()
            .map(|b| share(b.tokens_in, s.tokens_in))
            .sum();
        let out_sum: f64 = s
            .buckets
            .iter()
            .map(|b| share(b.tokens_out, s.tokens_out))
            .sum();
        assert!((in_sum - 100.0).abs() < 0.5, "input shares sum: {in_sum}");
        assert!(
            (out_sum - 100.0).abs() < 0.5,
            "output shares sum: {out_sum}"
        );
        assert_eq!(s.buckets.len(), p.len());
    }

    #[test]
    fn metrics_match_hand_computation() {
        let t = text();
        let s = measure(1, &parts(&t), "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        let hi_in: f64 = s
            .buckets
            .iter()
            .filter(|b| high_value(b.kind))
            .map(|b| b.tokens_in)
            .sum();
        let hi_out: f64 = s
            .buckets
            .iter()
            .filter(|b| high_value(b.kind))
            .map(|b| b.tokens_out)
            .sum();
        let tin = s.tokens_in;
        let tout = s.tokens_out;
        assert!((s.metrics.ratio - tout / tin).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((s.metrics.saved - (tin - tout) / tin).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((s.metrics.retention - hi_out / hi_in).abs() < 1e-9);
        let expect_density = (hi_out / tout) / (hi_in / tin);
        assert!((s.metrics.density - expect_density).abs() < 1e-9);
    }

    #[test]
    fn budget_levels_normal_warn_over() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let base = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        let used = base.tokens_out;
        let cap = (used * 1.5) as usize;
        let spec = BudgetSpec {
            cap: Some(cap),
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: Vec::new(),
        };
        let s = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), Some(&spec));
        assert_eq!(s.budget.level, Level::Normal);
        let spec2 = BudgetSpec {
            cap: Some((used * 1.17) as usize),
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: Vec::new(),
        };
        let s2 = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), Some(&spec2));
        assert_eq!(s2.budget.level, Level::Warn);
        let spec3 = BudgetSpec {
            cap: Some((used * 0.5) as usize),
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: Vec::new(),
        };
        let s3 = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), Some(&spec3));
        assert_eq!(s3.budget.level, Level::Over);
        assert!(s3.budget.left < 0.0, "超限时剩余为负");
    }

    #[test]
    fn quota_usage_and_left() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let spec = BudgetSpec {
            cap: None,
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: vec![(ContentType::ToolOutput, 100)],
        };
        let s = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), Some(&spec));
        let b = s.find(ContentType::ToolOutput).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.quota_of(ContentType::ToolOutput), Some(100));
        assert!(b.tokens_out < 100.0, "配额内输出");
    }

    #[test]
    fn render_is_deterministic_and_valid_json_shape() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let spec = BudgetSpec {
            cap: Some(5000),
            warn: 0.7,
            over: 1.0,
            quotas: Vec::new(),
        };
        let a = render(&measure(
            1,
            &p,
            "db timeout",
            &Config::default(),
            Some(&spec),
        ));
        let b = render(&measure(
            1,
            &p,
            "db timeout",
            &Config::default(),
            Some(&spec),
        ));
        assert_eq!(a, b, "同输入同配置渲染必须逐字节一致");
        assert!(a.starts_with("{\"id\":\""), "id 为内容派生");
        assert!(a.contains("\"payload_sha256\":"));
        assert!(a.contains("\"config_fingerprint\":"));
        assert!(a.contains("\"round\":1"));
        assert!(a.contains("\"metrics\":{\"ratio\":"));
        assert!(a.contains("\"budget\":{\"cap\":5000"));
        assert!(a.contains("\"buckets\":[{\"kind\":\"static-contract\""));
        assert!(a.ends_with("]}"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn ledger_lookup_and_diff() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let a = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        let b = measure(2, &p, "db timeout pool", &Config::default(), None);
        let a_id = a.id.clone();
        let b_id = b.id.clone();
        let mut ledger = Ledger::default();
        ledger.push(a);
        ledger.push(b);
        assert!(ledger.by_id(&a_id).is_some());
        assert!(ledger.by_round(2).is_some());
        assert!(ledger.by_id("zz").is_none());
        let d = ledger.diff(&a_id, &b_id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            d.delta_in,
            ledger.by_id(&b_id).unwrap().tokens_in - ledger.by_id(&a_id).unwrap().tokens_in
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn ledger_jsonl_roundtrip() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let mut ledger = Ledger::default();
        ledger.push(measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None));
        ledger.push(measure(2, &p, "db timeout pool", &Config::default(), None));
        let jsonl = ledger.to_jsonl();
        let back = Ledger::from_jsonl(&jsonl);
        assert_eq!(back.snaps.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(back.snaps[0].id, ledger.snaps[0].id);
        assert_eq!(back.snaps[0].round, 1);
        assert_eq!(back.snaps[1].round, 2);
        assert_eq!(back.snaps[0].tokens_in, ledger.snaps[0].tokens_in);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fingerprint_deterministic_and_content_addressed() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let a = measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        let b = measure(2, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None);
        assert_eq!(a.id, b.id);
        assert_eq!(a.payload_sha256, b.payload_sha256);
        assert_eq!(a.config_fingerprint, b.config_fingerprint);
        assert_eq!(a.id.len(), 16, "id 为 16 位十六进制");
        let c = measure(1, &p, "db timeout pool", &Config::default(), None);
        assert_ne!(a.config_fingerprint, c.config_fingerprint);
        let d = measure(
            1,
            &[(ContentType::ToolOutput, "hello")],
            "db timeout",
            &Config::default(),
            None,
        );
        assert_ne!(a.payload_sha256, d.payload_sha256);
    }

    #[test]
    fn summarize_aggregates_by_kind() {
        let t = text();
        let p = parts(&t);
        let mut ledger = Ledger::default();
        ledger.push(measure(1, &p, "db timeout", &Config::default(), None));
        let s = summarize(&ledger);
        assert!(s.starts_with("{\"by_kind\":["));
        assert!(s.contains("\"kind\":\"static-contract\""));
        assert!(s.contains("\"calls\":"));
        assert!(s.contains("\"total\":{\"tokens_in\":"));
        assert!(s.contains("\"est_cost_saved_usd\":null"));
        assert!(s.ends_with("}"));
    }
}

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

//! scx 操作编排层（ops）：把「命令动作」从 CLI 外壳中独立出来。
//!
//! - [`Op`]：所有 CLI 一等操作的类型化表示（压缩 / 记忆库 / 评估 …）。
//! - [`parse`]：`args::Opts` → `Op` 的映射（优先级与原 `main::run` 分派顺序一致）。
//! - [`run`]：执行一个 `Op` 并渲染输出；不直接终止进程，失败收敛到 [`Failure`]。
//! - `stats` / [`render`]：纯渲染函数（无 I/O），`render` 返回
//!   无前缀纯 JSON，可被 MCP 等集成层直接复用；CLI 输出前缀由调用方拼接。
//!
//! 设计约束：本层只依赖 `crate::compress` / `crate::memory` 与 `args::Opts`，
//! 不依赖任何第三方 crate；任何程序可直接构造 `Op::Compress` 复用压缩内核。

use crate::args::Opts;
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
use crate::input::fix;
use crate::input::input;
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
use crate::memory::{Case, Eval, Hit, Input, Stats};
use crate::{compress, Mode, Outcome};
use std::io::{self, Write};
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
use std::sync::mpsc;

/// CLI 失败必须收敛到单一出口；库与业务层不直接终止进程。
pub enum Failure {
    Usage(String),
    Message(String),
    GateFailed,
}

impl Failure {
    fn message(text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self::Message(text.into())
    }
}

pub type Reply<T = ()> = Result<T, Failure>;
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
type Stored = io::Result<(bool, String)>;
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
type Receiver = mpsc::Receiver<Stored>;

/// 压缩动作的独立入参（与 CLI 解析解耦，MCP 等集成层直接构造）。
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Compress {
    pub config: crate::Config,
    pub files: Vec<String>,
    pub query: String,
    pub fix: String,
    pub fix_file: Option<String>,
    pub store: bool,
    pub recall: usize,
    pub recall_detail: bool,
    pub stat: bool,
    pub no_stats: bool,
    pub json: bool,
    pub explain: bool,
    pub max_bytes: Option<u64>,
    pub mem_dir: String,
    /// 可插拔相似度后端命令（`--embed-cmd`）；`None` = 不启用。
    pub embed_cmd: Option<String>,
    /// MinHash-LSH 召回权重（`--minhash-weight`，默认 0 = 关）。
    pub minhash_weight: f64,
    /// 压缩前脱敏种类（`--redact`，默认空 = 不脱敏）。
    pub redact: Vec<crate::redact::RedactKind>,
    /// `--kind auto`：正文类型在读到正文后按 infer 推断。
    pub kind_auto: bool,
    /// 是否显式给出 `--ratio`（决定 `--kind` 缺省 ratio 是否被覆盖）。
    pub ratio_explicit: bool,
}

/// 标注动作入参。
pub struct Annotate {
    pub mem_dir: String,
    pub seed: u64,
    pub annotate_max: usize,
    pub annotate_raw: bool,
    pub annotate_out: Option<String>,
}

/// 所有 CLI 一等操作。
pub enum Op {
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    RecallOnly {
        mem_dir: String,
        query: String,
        k: usize,
        detail: bool,
        embed_cmd: Option<String>,
        sim_weight: f64,
        minhash_weight: f64,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Eval {
        mem_dir: String,
        path: String,
        mode: Eval,
        verbose: bool,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    L1Hist {
        mem_dir: String,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Stats {
        mem_dir: String,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Rate {
        mem_dir: String,
        id: String,
        good: bool,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Rebuild {
        mem_dir: String,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Gc {
        mem_dir: String,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Delete {
        mem_dir: String,
        id: String,
    },
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Annotate(Annotate),
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    Judge {
        mem_dir: String,
        path: String,
        by: String,
    },
    Compress(Box<Compress>),
}

/// `Opts` → `Op`：分派顺序与原 `main::run` 完全一致（recall-only → eval →
/// l1-hist → stats → rate → rebuild → gc → delete → annotate → judge →
/// compress 兜底），保证 CLI 行为逐字节不变。
pub fn parse(opts: &Opts) -> Op {
    if let Some(op) = select(opts) {
        op
    } else if let Some(op) = maintain(opts) {
        op
    } else {
        Op::Compress(Box::new(job(opts)))
    }
}

/// 前五个记忆/评估动作（判定点 ≤ 8）。
fn select(#[cfg_attr(not(feature = "memory"), allow(unused_variables))] opts: &Opts) -> Option<Op> {
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.recall_only {
        return Some(Op::RecallOnly {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            query: opts.query.clone(),
            k: opts.recall,
            detail: opts.recall_detail,
            embed_cmd: opts.embed_cmd.clone(),
            sim_weight: opts.config.sim_weight,
            minhash_weight: opts.minhash_weight,
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if let Some(path) = &opts.eval {
        return Some(Op::Eval {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            path: path.clone(),
            mode: mode(opts),
            verbose: opts.eval_verbose,
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.l1_hist {
        return Some(Op::L1Hist {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.stats {
        return Some(Op::Stats {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if let Some((good, id)) = &opts.rate {
        return Some(Op::Rate {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            id: id.clone(),
            good: *good,
        });
    }
    None
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn mode(opts: &Opts) -> Eval {
    if opts.eval_gate_human {
        Eval::Human
    } else if opts.eval_gate_items {
        Eval::Items
    } else if opts.eval_gate {
        Eval::Mechanical
    } else {
        Eval::Report
    }
}

/// 后五个维护/标注动作（判定点 ≤ 6）。
fn maintain(
    #[cfg_attr(not(feature = "memory"), allow(unused_variables))] opts: &Opts,
) -> Option<Op> {
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.rebuild {
        return Some(Op::Rebuild {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.gc {
        return Some(Op::Gc {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if let Some(id) = &opts.delete {
        return Some(Op::Delete {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            id: id.clone(),
        });
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if opts.annotate || opts.annotate_raw {
        return Some(Op::Annotate(Annotate {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            seed: opts.seed,
            annotate_max: opts.annotate_max,
            annotate_raw: opts.annotate_raw,
            annotate_out: opts.annotate_out.clone(),
        }));
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
    if let Some(path) = &opts.judge {
        return Some(Op::Judge {
            mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
            path: path.clone(),
            by: opts.judge_by.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
                std::env::var("USERNAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "anonymous".into())
            }),
        });
    }
    None
}

/// `Opts` → `Compress`（字段搬运，无判定）。
fn job(opts: &Opts) -> Compress {
    Compress {
        config: opts.config.clone(),
        files: opts.files.clone(),
        query: opts.query.clone(),
        fix: opts.fix.clone(),
        fix_file: opts.fix_file.clone(),
        store: opts.store,
        recall: opts.recall,
        recall_detail: opts.recall_detail,
        stat: opts.stat,
        no_stats: opts.no_stats,
        json: opts.json,
        explain: opts.explain,
        max_bytes: opts.max_bytes,
        mem_dir: opts.mem_dir.clone(),
        embed_cmd: opts.embed_cmd.clone(),
        minhash_weight: opts.minhash_weight,
        redact: opts.redact.clone(),
        kind_auto: opts.kind_auto,
        ratio_explicit: opts.ratio_explicit,
    }
}

/// 执行一个操作（3-arm 分派，V(G)=3；具体执行在 inspect/b 与 filter）。
pub fn run(op: Op) -> Reply {
    match op {
        Op::Compress(job) => filter(&job),
        #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
        Op::RecallOnly { .. }
        | Op::Eval { .. }
        | Op::L1Hist { .. }
        | Op::Stats { .. }
        | Op::Rate { .. } => dispatch(op),
        #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
        Op::Rebuild { .. }
        | Op::Gc { .. }
        | Op::Delete { .. }
        | Op::Annotate(_)
        | Op::Judge { .. } => apply(op),
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// 记忆查询/评估类动作（5-arm match，V(G)=5）。
fn dispatch(op: Op) -> Reply {
    match op {
        Op::RecallOnly {
            mem_dir,
            query,
            k,
            detail,
            embed_cmd,
            sim_weight,
            minhash_weight,
        } => result(
            &mem_dir,
            &query,
            k,
            detail,
            embed_cmd,
            sim_weight,
            minhash_weight,
        ),
        Op::Eval {
            mem_dir,
            path,
            mode,
            verbose,
        } => eval(crate::memory::evaluate(&mem_dir, &path, mode, verbose)),
        Op::L1Hist { mem_dir } => emit(crate::memory::history(&mem_dir), "l1-hist"),
        Op::Stats { mem_dir } => emit(crate::memory::stats(&mem_dir), "stats"),
        Op::Rate { mem_dir, id, good } => rate(&mem_dir, &id, good),
        Op::Compress(_)
        | Op::Rebuild { .. }
        | Op::Gc { .. }
        | Op::Delete { .. }
        | Op::Annotate(_)
        | Op::Judge { .. } => {
            unreachable!("inspect called with non-special-a op")
        }
    }
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn result(
    mem_dir: &str,
    query: &str,
    k: usize,
    detail: bool,
    embed_cmd: Option<String>,
    sim_weight: f64,
    minhash_weight: f64,
) -> Reply {
    match recall(
        mem_dir,
        query,
        k,
        detail,
        embed_cmd,
        sim_weight,
        minhash_weight,
    ) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(()),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe => Ok(()),
        Err(e) => Err(Failure::message(format!("--recall-only failed: {e}"))),
    }
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn rate(mem_dir: &str, id: &str, good: bool) -> Reply {
    let case = crate::memory::rate(mem_dir, id, good)
        .map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("rate failed: {e}")))?;
    say(format!(
        "rate: good={} bad={} quality={:.2} status={} case={}",
        case.feedback.good, case.feedback.bad, case.quality, case.status, id
    ))?;
    if good {
        let (base, _) = crate::memory::params(mem_dir);
        say(format!("l1_base: {base:.3} (自适应)"))?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// 维护/标注类动作（5-arm match，V(G)=5）。
fn apply(op: Op) -> Reply {
    match op {
        Op::Rebuild { mem_dir } => {
            let (docs, terms) = crate::memory::rebuild(&mem_dir)
                .map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("rebuild failed: {e}")))?;
            say(format!("rebuild: docs={docs} terms={terms}"))
        }
        Op::Gc { mem_dir } => {
            let removed = crate::memory::gc(&mem_dir)
                .map_err(|e| Failure::message(format!("gc failed: {e}")))?;
            say(format!("gc: removed={removed}"))
        }
        Op::Delete { mem_dir, id } => delete(&mem_dir, &id),
        Op::Annotate(job) => annotate(&job),
        Op::Judge {
            mem_dir: _,
            path,
            by,
        } => emit(crate::memory::judge(&path, &by), "judge"),
        Op::RecallOnly { .. }
        | Op::Eval { .. }
        | Op::L1Hist { .. }
        | Op::Stats { .. }
        | Op::Rate { .. }
        | Op::Compress(_) => unreachable!("maintain called with non-special-b op"),
    }
}
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
fn delete(mem_dir: &str, id: &str) -> Reply {
    match crate::memory::delete(mem_dir, id) {
        Ok(true) => say(format!("delete: removed case={id}")),
        Ok(false) => Err(Failure::message(format!("no such case: {id}"))),
        Err(e) => Err(Failure::message(format!("delete failed: {e}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
/// `--recall-only` 查看模式：只读召回、零库状态写入，库缺失时不创建目录。
fn recall(
    mem_dir: &str,
    query: &str,
    k: usize,
    detail: bool,
    embed_cmd: Option<String>,
    sim_weight: f64,
    minhash_weight: f64,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let hits = crate::memory::search_fused(
        mem_dir,
        query,
        k,
        true,
        embed_cmd.as_deref(),
        sim_weight,
        minhash_weight,
    )?;
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = stdout.lock();
    lines(&mut out, &hits, mem_dir, detail, false)
}

/// 压缩统计行渲染（纯文本，无 I/O；格式与 v0.4.1 逐字节一致）。
fn stats(r: &Outcome) -> String {
    let base = format!(
        "compressed: kept={}/{} lines chars={}->{} ({:.1}% cut) dup={} seeds={} evidence={} risk={} guarded={} regions={} window={} terms={} forced={} mode={}",
        r.kept, r.total, r.input, r.output, r.cut, r.dup, r.seeds, r.evidence, r.risk, r.guarded, r.regions, r.window, r.terms, r.forced, r.mode
    );
    // 硬上限溢出时追加可解析的记账字段；正常模式统计行格式保持不变（golden 零漂移）。
    match r.mode {
        Mode::OverflowEvidence | Mode::OverflowFill => format!(
            "{base} max_tokens={} tok_est={:.0}",
            r.limit.unwrap_or(0),
            r.tokens
        ),
        _ => base,
    }
}

/// 压缩结果 JSON 渲染（无前缀纯 JSON，MCP 等集成层可直接复用）。
pub fn render(r: &Outcome) -> String {
    let mut out = format!(
        "{{\"kept\":{},\"total\":{},\"chars_in\":{},\"chars_out\":{},\"cut_pct\":{:.1},\"dup\":{},\"seeds\":{},\"evidence\":{},\"risk\":\"{}\",\"guarded\":{},\"regions\":{},\"window\":{},\"terms\":{},\"forced\":{},\"mode\":\"{}\"",
        r.kept, r.total, r.input, r.output, r.cut, r.dup, r.seeds, r.evidence, r.risk, r.guarded, r.regions, r.window, r.terms, r.forced, r.mode
    );
    // --json 新增字段向后兼容：仅启用 --max-tokens 时附加（v0.4.1 契约不变）。
    if let Some(m) = r.limit {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            ",\"max_tokens\":{},\"tok_est\":{:.0}",
            m, r.tokens
        ));
    }
    // v0.6.4 效果口径：输入/输出 token 估算（`terms::estimate`）与缩减率，全模式
    // 恒定填充（passthrough/fail-open 时 tokens_out == tokens_in，cut 为 0）。
    let tokens_out = crate::terms::estimate(&r.text);
    out.push_str(&format!(
        ",\"tokens_in\":{:.0},\"tokens_out\":{:.0},\"token_cut_pct\":{:.1}",
        r.tokens_in,
        tokens_out,
        token_cut(r.tokens_in, tokens_out)
    ));
    // 删除区间（每段一条，1-based 闭区间 + 原因）；默认 stdout 统计行不输出。
    out.push_str(&format!(
        ",\"dropped\":[{}]",
        r.dropped
            .iter()
            .map(|d| format!(
                "{{\"start\":{},\"end\":{},\"reason\":\"{}\"}}",
                d.start,
                d.end,
                d.reason.as_str()
            ))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(",")
    ));
    // 可选预算利用率（%）：--ratio 预算实际填充了多少。
    out.push_str(&format!(",\"budget_used_pct\":{:.1}", r.budget_used_pct));
    // 信息留存率（0..=1）：显式证据或默认行保留率代理（P4），全模式恒填充。
    out.push_str(&format!(",\"ev_retention\":{:.4}", r.ev_retention));
    // 分桶统计（默认单桶；compress_bucketed 时逐桶填充）。
    let global_out = tokens_out;
    out.push_str(",\"buckets\":[");
    for (i, b) in r.buckets.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "{{\"kind\":\"{}\",\"tokens_in\":{:.0},\"tokens_out\":{:.0},\"cut_pct\":{:.1},\"share_in_pct\":{:.1},\"share_out_pct\":{:.1},\"kept\":{},\"total\":{},\"mode\":\"{}\"}}",
            b.kind.as_str(),
            b.tokens_in,
            b.tokens_out,
            b.cut_pct(),
            b.share_in_pct(r.tokens_in),
            b.share_out_pct(global_out),
            b.kept,
            b.total,
            b.mode
        ));
    }
    out.push(']');
