    #[test]
    fn ingest_keeps_numeric_query_variants_and_dedups_legacy_fp() {
        let root = root("numid");
        let s = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        let text = "ERROR port 8080 already in use\nat Sock.java:1";
        let a = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 8080 already in use",
            vec![],
            text,
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let b = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 9090 already in use",
            vec![],
            "ERROR port 9090 already in use\nat Sock.java:1",
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(a.0 && b.0, "不同端口必须各自落库");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 2);

        // 模拟旧库：fp 是旧"数字折叠"口径；动态重算仍应识别同一条记忆。
        let mut c = store::load(&root, &a.1).unwrap();
        c.fp = "0000000000000000".to_string();
        store::save(&root, &c).unwrap();
        let dup = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 8080 already in use",
            vec![],
            text,
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!dup.0, "旧 fp 也应通过动态身份键去重");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 2);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    /// 回归：remember 按索引行数推进 ready。并发进程若已写入新 case（case_count
    /// 变大、索引尚未含该行），ready 不得直接等于 case_count，否则 ensure 会信任
    /// 残缺索引而漏判重，重复 case 入库。
    /// remember 必须幂等：并发 rebuild 已收录同一 (fp, id) 时不得再追加重复行，
    /// 否则索引行数超过 case 数、ready 与 case_count 永远对不上。
    #[test]
    fn remember_is_idempotent_for_same_case() {
        let root = root("ready-idem");
        let (_, id) = ingest(
            &root,
            "qa conn",
            vec![],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &store::sample(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let fp = fingerprint("qa conn", TEXT);
        // 模拟并发 rebuild 已收录该行后，迟到的 remember 再次执行。
        remember(&root, &fp, &id).unwrap();
        remember(&root, &fp, &id).unwrap();
        let body = fs::read_to_string(index(&root)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body.lines().count(), 1, "同一 (fp,id) 只能有一行");
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(ready(&root)).unwrap().trim(),
            "1",
            "ready 必须等于索引真实行数"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn remember_does_not_claim_unindexed_cases() {
        let root = root("ready-race");
        let s = store::sample();
        let (_, id_a) = ingest(
            &root,
            "qa conn",
            vec![],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let base = store::load(&root, &id_a).unwrap();
        // 模拟并发：另外两个 case 已落库并推进 case_count，但索引尚无它们的行。
        let mut b = base.clone();
        b.id = "2026-01-01_bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb".to_string();
        b.query = "qb conn".to_string();
        let mut c = base.clone();
        c.id = "2026-01-01_cccccccccccccccc".to_string();
        c.query = "qc conn".to_string();
        for case in [&b, &c] {
            store::save(&root, case).unwrap();
            store::bump(&root).unwrap();
        }
        // 迟到的 remember：只追加自己的一行，索引此时仍不覆盖 C。
        let fp_b = fingerprint(&b.query, &b.text);
        remember(&root, &fp_b, &b.id).unwrap();
        // 索引不完整 → ensure 必须重建；find(C) 应命中而不是漏判。
        let fp_c = fingerprint(&c.query, &c.text);
        assert_eq!(find(&root, &fp_c).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(c.id.as_str()));
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_removes_case_and_meta() {
        let root = root("del");
        let s1 = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        ingest(&root, "q1", vec![], "t1", vec![], &s1, vec![]).unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        assert!(delete(&root, &id).unwrap());
        assert!(store::list(&root).unwrap().is_empty());
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m.case_count, 0);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 极简 JSON 子集解析/序列化（零依赖，仅覆盖本库自产自销的 case.json schema）。
//!
//! 只支持：object / array / string / number / bool / null；
//! 不支持：转义 \\uXXXX 之外的复杂规则、注释、尾逗号、科学计数法。
//! 解析失败返回 Err，序列化失败仅发生在字符串含未转义控制符时（用 escape 不会发生）。

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Val {
    Null,
    Bool(bool),
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Arr(Vec<Val>),
    Obj(Vec<(String, Val)>),
}

/// 字符串转义（JSON 字符串字面量所需的最小集）。
pub fn escape(s: &str, out: &mut String) {
    for c in s.chars() {
        glyph(c, out);
    }
}

fn glyph(c: char, out: &mut String) {
    match c {
        '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
        '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
        '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
        '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
        '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
        c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
        c => out.push(c),
    }
}

/// 序列化 Val 到字符串。
pub fn write(v: &Val) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    encode(v, &mut out);
    out
}

fn encode(v: &Val, out: &mut String) {
    match v {
        Val::Null => out.push_str("null"),
        Val::Bool(true) => out.push_str("true"),
        Val::Bool(false) => out.push_str("false"),
        Val::Num(n) => number(*n, out),
        Val::Str(s) => {
            out.push('"');
            escape(s, out);
            out.push('"');
        }
        Val::Arr(items) => array(items, out),
        Val::Obj(kvs) => object(kvs, out),
    }
}

/// 数值序列化：整数域内的 f64 写成整数形态（与解析容错口径一致）。
fn number(n: f64, out: &mut String) {
    if n.fract() == 0.0 && n.is_finite() && n.abs() < 1e15 {
        out.push_str(&format!("{}", n as i64));
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!("{}", n));
    }
}

fn array(items: &[Val], out: &mut String) {
    out.push('[');
    for (i, item) in items.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        encode(item, out);
    }
    out.push(']');
}

fn object(kvs: &[(String, Val)], out: &mut String) {
    out.push('{');
    for (i, (k, item)) in kvs.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push('"');
        escape(k, out);
        out.push_str("\":");
        encode(item, out);
    }
    out.push('}');
}

/// 最大嵌套深度：递归下降解析器在更深处直接报错，防恶意深嵌套触发栈溢出。
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 128;

/// 从字符串解析 JSON，返回 Val。递归下降，O(n)。
pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Val, String> {
    let mut p = Parser {
        bytes: s.as_bytes(),
        pos: 0,
        depth: 0,
    };
    p.space();
    let v = p.value()?;
    p.space();
    if p.pos != p.bytes.len() {
        return Err(format!("trailing bytes at {}", p.pos));
    }
    Ok(v)
}

struct Parser<'a> {
    bytes: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
    depth: usize,
}

impl<'a> Parser<'a> {
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> {
        self.bytes.get(self.pos).copied()
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
        let b = self.peek();
        if b.is_some() {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        b
    }
    fn space(&mut self) {
        while self
            .peek()
            .is_some_and(|b| matches!(b, b' ' | b'\t' | b'\n' | b'\r'))
        {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
    }
    fn expect(&mut self, b: u8) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.next() == Some(b) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(format!("expected {:?} at {}", b as char, self.pos))
        }
    }
    fn value(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        if matches!(self.peek(), Some(b'{') | Some(b'[')) {
            self.depth += 1;
            if self.depth > MAX_DEPTH {
                self.depth -= 1;
                return Err(format!("nesting exceeds {MAX_DEPTH} at {}", self.pos));
            }
            let v = match self.peek() {
                Some(b'{') => self.obj(),
                Some(b'[') => self.arr(),
                _ => unreachable!("guarded by matches!"),
            };
            self.depth -= 1;
            return v;
        }
        match self.peek() {
            Some(b'"') => self.str().map(Val::Str),
            Some(b't') => self.lit("true", Val::Bool(true)),
            Some(b'f') => self.lit("false", Val::Bool(false)),
            Some(b'n') => self.lit("null", Val::Null),
            Some(b'-') | Some(b'0'..=b'9') => self.num(),
            Some(other) => Err(format!(
                "unexpected byte {:?} at {}",
                other as char, self.pos
            )),
            None => Err("unexpected end of input".to_string()),
        }
    }
    fn lit(&mut self, word: &str, v: Val) -> Result<Val, String> {
        for (i, b) in word.bytes().enumerate() {
            if self.bytes.get(self.pos + i) != Some(&b) {
                return Err(format!("expected literal {} at {}", word, self.pos));
            }
        }
        self.pos += word.len();
        Ok(v)
    }
    fn str(&mut self) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.expect(b'"')?;
        let mut out = String::new();
        let mut raw: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        let flush = |out: &mut String, raw: &mut Vec<u8>| -> Result<(), String> {
            if !raw.is_empty() {
                let s =
                    std::str::from_utf8(raw).map_err(|_| "invalid utf8 in string".to_string())?;
                out.push_str(s);
                raw.clear();
            }
            Ok(())
        };
        loop {
            match self.next() {
                Some(b'"') => {
                    flush(&mut out, &mut raw)?;
                    return Ok(out);
                }
                Some(b'\\') => {
                    flush(&mut out, &mut raw)?;
                    match self.next() {
                        Some(b'"') => out.push('"'),
                        Some(b'\\') => out.push('\\'),
                        Some(b'n') => out.push('\n'),
                        Some(b'r') => out.push('\r'),
                        Some(b't') => out.push('\t'),
                        Some(b'b') => out.push('\u{8}'),
                        Some(b'f') => out.push('\u{c}'),
                        Some(b'u') => {
                            let mut code = 0u32;
                            for _ in 0..4 {
                                let c = self.next().ok_or("truncated \\u escape")?;
                                let d = (c as char).to_digit(16).ok_or("bad \\u escape")?;
                                code = code * 16 + d;
                            }
                            out.push(char::from_u32(code).ok_or("bad \\u codepoint")?);
                        }
                        Some(other) => return Err(format!("bad escape {:?}", other as char)),
                        None => return Err("truncated escape".to_string()),
                    }
                }
                Some(b) if (b as char).is_ascii_control() => {
                    return Err(format!("unescaped control byte 0x{:02x}", b));
                }
                Some(b) => raw.push(b),
                None => return Err("unterminated string".to_string()),
            }
        }
    }
    fn num(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        let start = self.pos;
        while self
            .peek()
            .is_some_and(|b| matches!(b, b'-' | b'+' | b'.' | b'e' | b'E' | b'0'..=b'9'))
        {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        let txt = std::str::from_utf8(&self.bytes[start..self.pos]).map_err(|_| "bad number")?;
        txt.parse::<f64>()
            .map(Val::Num)
            .map_err(|_| format!("bad number {:?}", txt))
    }
    fn arr(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        self.expect(b'[')?;
        let mut items = Vec::new();
        self.space();
        if self.peek() == Some(b']') {
            self.next();
            return Ok(Val::Arr(items));
        }
        loop {
            self.space();
            items.push(self.value()?);
            self.space();
            if !self.separator(b']', "array")? {
                return Ok(Val::Arr(items));
            }
        }
    }
    fn obj(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        self.expect(b'{')?;
        let mut kvs = Vec::new();
        self.space();
        if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {
            self.next();
            return Ok(Val::Obj(kvs));
        }
        loop {
            self.space();
            let key = self.str()?;
            self.space();
            self.expect(b':')?;
            self.space();
            let v = self.value()?;
            kvs.push((key, v));
            self.space();
            if !self.separator(b'}', "object")? {
                return Ok(Val::Obj(kvs));
            }
        }
    }

    /// 容器分隔符：`,` 继续、闭合符结束；其余或 EOF 报错。
    fn separator(&mut self, close: u8, name: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
        match self.next() {
            Some(b',') => Ok(true),
            Some(c) if c == close => Ok(false),
            Some(other) => Err(format!(
                "expected , or {} got {:?}",
                close as char, other as char
            )),
            None => Err(format!("unterminated {name}")),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn roundtrip(v: &Val) -> Val {
        parse(&write(v)).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn scalar_roundtrip() {
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Null), Val::Null);
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Bool(true)), Val::Bool(true));
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Num(42.0)), Val::Num(42.0));
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Num(-1.5)), Val::Num(-1.5));
        assert_eq!(
            roundtrip(&Val::Str("中文 \"q\" \\ \n".to_string())),
            Val::Str("中文 \"q\" \\ \n".to_string())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn nested_roundtrip() {
        let v = Val::Obj(vec![
            (
                "id".to_string(),
                Val::Str("2026-10-22_a1b2c3d4".to_string()),
            ),
            ("n".to_string(), Val::Num(3.0)),
            (
                "arr".to_string(),
                Val::Arr(vec![Val::Bool(true), Val::Null, Val::Str("x".to_string())]),
            ),
            (
                "fields".to_string(),
                Val::Obj(vec![(
                    "error_code".to_string(),
                    Val::Arr(vec![Val::Str("conn_id=9f2a".to_string())]),
                )]),
            ),
        ]);
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&v), v);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_errors() {
        assert!(parse("{").is_err());
        assert!(parse("{\"a\":}").is_err());
        assert!(parse("[1,2,]").is_err());
        assert!(parse("").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_and_utf8_roundtrip() {
        let v = Val::Str("数据库连接超时 conn_id=9f2a 🚀".to_string());
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&v), v);
    }

    #[test]
    fn write_format_sanity() {
        assert_eq!(
            write(&Val::Obj(vec![("a".to_string(), Val::Num(1.0))])),
            "{\"a\":1}"
        );
        assert_eq!(write(&Val::Str("a\"b".to_string())), "\"a\\\"b\"");
        assert_eq!(write(&Val::Arr(vec![])), "[]");
    }

    #[test]
    fn deep_nesting_is_rejected_not_stack_overflow() {
        let ok = format!("{}1{}", "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH), "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH));
        assert!(parse(&ok).is_ok(), "深度内应正常解析");
        let over = format!(
            "{}1{}",
            "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1),
            "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1)
        );
        let err = parse(&over).unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.contains("nesting"), "超深应报错而非栈溢出: {err}");
    }

    /// 确定性生成器：覆盖标量、嵌套数组/对象与需要转义的字符串。
    fn gen(next: &mut dyn FnMut() -> u32, depth: usize) -> Val {
        match next() % if depth >= 3 { 4 } else { 6 } {
            0 => Val::Null,
            1 => Val::Bool(next() % 2 == 0),
            2 => Val::Num((next() % 10_000) as f64 / 8.0),
            _ => {
                if next() % 2 == 0 && depth < 3 {
                    let n = next() % 4;
                    Val::Arr((0..n).map(|_| gen(next, depth + 1)).collect())
                } else if next() % 3 == 0 && depth < 3 {
                    let n = next() % 4;
                    Val::Obj(
                        (0..n)
                            .map(|i| (format!("k{i}"), gen(next, depth + 1)))
                            .collect(),
                    )
                } else {
                    // 覆盖需要转义的字符与多字节文本。
                    let pool: Vec<char> = "a\"\\\n\r\t\u{1}中文🚀 ".chars().collect();
                    let n = next() as usize % 8;
                    let mut s = String::new();
                    for _ in 0..n {
                        s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
                    }
                    Val::Str(s)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip_write_parse_on_generated_values() {
        let mut state = 0x1234_abcdu32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..500 {
            let v = gen(&mut next, 0);
            let txt = write(&v);
            assert_eq!(parse(&txt), Ok(v), "往返不一致: {txt}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_never_panics_on_garbage() {
        let pool: Vec<char> = "{}[]\",:.-+0123456789eE_ \n\t\\/:中文🚀\u{0}naNs"
            .chars()
            .collect();
        let mut state = 0x0bad_f00du32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..1500 {
            let n = next() as usize % 40;
            let mut s = String::new();
            for _ in 0..n {
                s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
            }
            // 不得 panic；Ok/Err 都合法。
            let _ = parse(&s);
        }
    }
}

//! 跨进程写锁与原子写（零依赖）。
//!
//! 记忆库允许多个 `scx` 进程共享同一 `--mem-dir`（例如并行 agent / 终端）。
//! 原先的 `fs::write(tmp) + rename` 使用固定临时名，且 `meta.toml` 的
//! read-modify-write 没有跨进程互斥：并发写会互相 rename、丢 gen 更新。
//!
//! 本模块提供两件互补的机制：
//! - `atomic`：每次写入使用唯一临时名 + rename，保证读者只看到旧文件
//!   或完整新文件（防半写）；Windows 上对短暂 sharing violation 做有限重试。
//! - `acquire`：`create_new` 锁文件 + 超时/陈旧锁回收，保护 meta/qmap/index
//!   这类 read-modify-write 或追加写。锁内容带唯一 token，Drop 只删除自己的锁，
//!   避免“陈旧锁被抢走后误删新持有者”的竞态。

use std::fs::{self, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::thread;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// 等锁上限：meta/qmap 写都是毫秒级，10s 足够覆盖磁盘抖动。
const LOCK_WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// 陈旧锁阈值：持锁超过 15s 视为进程崩溃遗留（正常写远小于此）。
const LOCK_STALE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
const RETRY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(10);

static TOKEN_SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

/// 建目录（Windows 杀毒/索引器短暂占用时重试 PermissionDenied）。
pub(crate) fn mkdir(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    for attempt in 0..3 {
        match fs::create_dir_all(path) {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                let transient = e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied;
                last = Some(e);
                if !transient || attempt == 2 {
                    break;
                }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("create_dir_all always records an error"))
}

/// 锁守卫：作用域结束自动释放（只删自己 token 的锁文件）。
pub(crate) struct Lock {
    path: PathBuf,
    token: String,
}

impl Drop for Lock {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // 被判定陈旧后可能已被新持有者替换：只删自己的 token。
        if let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&self.path) {
            if txt.trim() == self.token {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// 获取 `<root>/<name>` 锁；超时返回 `WouldBlock`。
pub(crate) fn acquire(root: &str, name: &str) -> io::Result<Lock> {
    let path = Path::new(root).join(name);
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        mkdir(dir)?;
    }
    let seq = TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let token = format!("{}-{seq}", std::process::id());
    let deadline = Instant::now() + LOCK_WAIT;
    let mut permission_retries = 0u32;
    loop {
        match OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(&path) {
            Ok(f) => return finish(&path, f, &token),
            Err(e) if contended(e.kind()) => {
                wait(&path, deadline, &e, &mut permission_retries)?;
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
}

fn contended(kind: io::ErrorKind) -> bool {
    kind == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists || kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied
}

fn finish(path: &Path, mut f: fs::File, token: &str) -> io::Result<Lock> {
    // token 落盘后其它进程才可能看到锁；写失败则移除，避免假锁。
    if let Err(e) = writeln!(f, "{token}") {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
        return Err(e);
    }
    Ok(Lock {
        path: path.to_path_buf(),
        token: token.to_string(),
    })
}

fn wait(
    path: &Path,
    deadline: Instant,
    original: &io::Error,
    permission_retries: &mut u32,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let kind = original.kind();
    // Windows：锁文件 pending-delete 时 CreateFile(CREATE_NEW) 返回
    // ACCESS_DENIED；给 1s 让删除完成，超过按真实权限错误返回。
    if kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied {
        *permission_retries += 1;
        if *permission_retries > 100 {
            return Err(io::Error::new(kind, format!("memory lock: {original}")));
        }
    }
    if stale(path) {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
        return Ok(());
    }
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
            format!("memory lock busy: {}", path.display()),
        ));
    }
    thread::sleep(RETRY);
    Ok(())
}

/// 按固定序一次性获取多把锁（锁序契约见 `docs/locking.md`）。
///
/// 任一锁获取失败时，已持有的锁随守卫 `Drop` 逆序自动释放——绝不半持锁返回。
/// 调用方必须按契约顺序传 `names`（细粒度在前、粗粒度在后），禁止自行穿插。
pub(crate) fn locks(root: &str, names: &[&str]) -> io::Result<Vec<Lock>> {
    let mut guards = Vec::with_capacity(names.len());
    for name in names {
        guards.push(acquire(root, name)?);
    }
    Ok(guards)
}

fn stale(path: &Path) -> bool {
    fs::metadata(path)
        .and_then(|m| m.modified())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|t| t.elapsed().ok())
        .is_some_and(|age| age > LOCK_STALE)
}

/// 唯一临时名 + rename 的原子写。
///
/// 说明：保证“不会读到半写文件”，不做 fsync 级别的掉电持久化；case/meta 都是
/// 可再生/可重建数据，崩溃后最坏回到上一个完整版本。每次写使用
/// `<name>.tmp.<pid>.<seq>`，并发写不会互相覆盖临时文件。
pub(crate) fn atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        mkdir(dir)?;
    }
    let base = path.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("data");
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    // Windows 杀毒/索引器会短暂锁住目标或临时文件；PermissionDenied 时换新
    // 临时名重试整次写，避免把可恢复的文件占用报成记忆写入失败。
    for attempt in 0..3 {
        let seq = TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let tmp = path.with_file_name(format!("{base}.tmp.{}.{seq}", std::process::id()));
        let result = once(&tmp, path, bytes);
        match result {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
                let transient = retry(e.kind());
                last = Some(io::Error::new(
                    e.kind(),
                    format!("atomic write {}: {e}", path.display()),
                ));
                if !transient || attempt == 2 {
                    break;
                }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("atomic always records an error"))
}

fn once(tmp: &Path, path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut f = OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(tmp)?;
    f.write_all(bytes)?;
    drop(f);
    rename(tmp, path)
}

fn retry(kind: io::ErrorKind) -> bool {
    kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied || kind == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
}

/// Windows 上目标文件可能被短暂打开（杀毒/索引/读者），rename 做有限重试。
fn rename(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    for attempt in 0..10 {
        match fs::rename(from, to) {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                last = Some(e);
                if attempt < 9 {
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("rename retry always records an error"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::thread;

    #[test]
    fn atomic_keeps_last_complete_value() {
        let root = root("atomic");
        let p = Path::new(&root).join("value.txt");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for i in 0..8 {
            let p = p.clone();
            handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {
                atomic(&p, format!("value-{i}").as_bytes()).unwrap();
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        let got = fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap();
        assert!(got.starts_with("value-"), "必须是某次完整写入: {got}");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn lock_serializes_and_releases() {
        let root = root("lock");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        let root = Arc::new(root);
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..4 {
            let root = root.clone();
            handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {
                for _ in 0..10 {
                    let _g = acquire(&root, "test.lock").unwrap();
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
                }
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert!(!Path::new(root.as_str()).join("test.lock").exists());
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root.as_str());
    }

    #[test]
    fn locks_fixed_order_and_failure_releases() {
        let root = root("lock_all");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        // 固定序获取成功，Drop 逆序释放后锁文件全部消失。
        {
            let _g = locks(&root, &["a.lock", "b.lock", "c.lock"]).unwrap();
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists());
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("b.lock").exists());
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("c.lock").exists());
        }
        assert!(!Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists());
        // 中途失败：已持锁逆序释放，不留半持状态。
        let _held = acquire(&root, "b.lock").unwrap();
        let err = match locks(&root, &["a.lock", "b.lock"]) {
            Ok(_) => panic!("locks 必须失败"),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        assert_eq!(err.kind(), io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock);
        assert!(!Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists(), "a 必须已释放");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 库维护：索引重建、过期清理、case 删除与 `--stats` 盘点。
//!
//! - rebuild：全量重建 postings.bin（index::build）+ qmap 合并（同指纹取 recency
//!   最新）+ df 快照写回 meta.toml [df]（评估与召回共用的 IDF 数据源）+ 写
//!   不改变索引启用策略（索引只是可丢弃缓存）。
//! - gc：expire 双条件（meta [params] gc_ttl_regressed=180 / gc_ttl_stale=365）：
//!   regressed 且超期，或从未反馈（quality=0）且陈旧 → 物理删除 + 索引作废。
//! - delete：物理删除 + 惰性作废索引（删 postings.bin，回退线性；重建由
//!   rebuild/自动构建恢复）。
//!
//! 索引是可丢弃缓存（index/）：任何维护操作不触碰 cases/ 资产；坏段由
//! index::load 校验报告，重建覆盖。

use crate::memory::cache;
use crate::memory::index;
use crate::memory::store;
use crate::memory::util::{parse, stamp};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::io;
use std::path::Path;

/// 全量重建索引 + qmap 合并 + df 快照。返回 (n_docs, n_terms)。
pub(crate) fn rebuild(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    store::ensure(root)?;
    // 1) 倒排索引全量重建（确定性：case id 排序 + term 字典序）；df 快照随建随取。
    let (n_docs, n_terms, df) = index::build(root)?;
    // 2) qmap 合并：同归一化 query 只留 recency 最新一条。
    cache::merge(root)?;
    // 3) df 快照写 meta.toml [df]；不改 index_force（重建不得改变召回语义）。
    write(root, n_docs, &df);
    Ok((n_docs, n_terms))
}

/// 过期清理：删除满足 expire 双条件的 case。返回删除数。
pub(crate) fn gc(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let ttl_regressed = meta.param("gc_ttl_regressed");
    let ttl_stale = meta.param("gc_ttl_stale");
    let now_s = parse(&stamp());
    let mut removed = 0usize;
    for id in store::list(root)? {
        let Ok(c) = store::load(root, &id) else {
            continue;
        };
        if expired(&c, now_s, ttl_regressed, ttl_stale) && delete(root, &id).unwrap_or(false) {
            removed += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok(removed)
}

/// 过期双条件：regressed 超短 TTL，或从未反馈且无 fix 且陈旧。
fn expired(c: &store::Case, now_s: u64, ttl_regressed: f64, ttl_stale: f64) -> bool {
    let age_days = now_s.saturating_sub(parse(&c.updated_at)) as f64 / 86_400.0;
    (c.status == "regressed" && age_days > ttl_regressed)
        || (c.quality == 0.0 && c.fix.is_empty() && age_days > ttl_stale)
}

/// 删除一个 case（物理删除 + 惰性作废索引 + 库代际前进）。
/// id 先过白名单校验，禁止 `..` 与路径分隔符逃逸。
/// 返回是否存在。
pub(crate) fn delete(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    // id 白名单必须先于取锁：锁名 `cases/{id}.lock` 与目录 `cases/{id}` 都以
    // 用户输入拼接，`Path::join` 遇绝对路径会整段替换、遇 `../` 会逃逸目录。
    if !store::valid(id) {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            format!("invalid case id: {id}"),
        ));
    }
    // 锁序契约（docs/locking.md）：case → index → meta → qmap，细粒度在前。
    // locks 按固定序一次性取齐，任一把失败即整体放弃（已持锁逆序释放），
    // 绝不半持锁返回；meta 的写入用 *_locked 变体避免自死锁。
    let _guards = crate::memory::lock::locks(
        root,
        &[
            &format!("cases/{id}.lock"),
            "index.lock",
            "meta.lock",
            "qmap.lock",
        ],
    )?;
    let dir = Path::new(root).join("cases").join(id);
    if !dir.exists() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    fs::remove_dir_all(dir)?;
    index::clear(root);
    store::recount(root)?;
    crate::memory::ingest::invalidate(root);
    crate::memory::meta::advance(root)?;
    let _ = fs::remove_file(cache::path(root));
    Ok(true)
}

/// 写 meta.toml [df] 快照（来自 index::build）。
/// 不写 `index_force`：索引只是缓存，重建不得改变召回语义
/// （线性/索引两条路径的 df/avgdl 均为全库口径，桶过滤只裁候选；强制索引只用于
/// A/B 对拍，不写回 meta）。索引启用只由规模阈值决定。失败静默旁路。
fn write(root: &str, n_docs: usize, df: &[(String, usize)]) {
    let Ok(_g) = crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock") else {
        return;
    };
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&p) else {
        return;
    };
    // 持 meta.lock 重数一遍：build 起点到此处之间可能有并发 ingest 新增 case 并
    // 已 recount 回写，用 build 时的 n_docs 会把计数覆盖回旧值。
    let n_docs = store::list(root).map(|v| v.len()).unwrap_or(n_docs);
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut wrote_df = false;
    for line in txt.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if section(t) {
            if t == "[df]" {
                // 跳过旧 df 节，统一在末尾重写。
                wrote_df = true;
                continue;
            }
            if insert(wrote_df, df) {
                out.extend(block(df));
                wrote_df = true;
            }
        }
        if t.starts_with("case_count") {
            out.push(format!("case_count = {n_docs}"));
            continue;
        }
        out.push(line.to_string());
    }
    if insert(wrote_df, df) {
        out.extend(block(df));
    }
    let mut body = out.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    let _ = crate::memory::lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes());
}

fn section(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.starts_with('[') && t.ends_with(']')
}

fn insert(wrote_df: bool, df: &[(String, usize)]) -> bool {
    !wrote_df && !df.is_empty()
}

fn block(df: &[(String, usize)]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = vec!["[df]".to_string()];
    for (k, v) in df {
        out.push(format!("{k} = {v}"));
    }
    out.push(String::new());
    out
}

/// `--stats` 盘点：case/桶/状态/fix 覆盖率/质量/磁盘占用。
pub(crate) fn stats(root: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let ids = store::list(root)?;
    let mut buckets: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut statuses: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut fixes = 0usize;
    let mut quality_sum = 0.0f64;
    let mut disk = 0u64;
    for id in &ids {
        sample(
            root,
            id,
            &mut buckets,
            &mut statuses,
            &mut fixes,
            &mut quality_sum,
            &mut disk,
        )?;
    }
    let n = ids.len();
    let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(6);
    lines.push(format!("stats: cases={} gen={}", n, meta.gen));
    lines.push(format!("  bucket: {}", join(&buckets)));
    lines.push(format!("  status: {}", join(&statuses)));
    lines.push(format!(
        "  fix: {}/{} ({:.0}%)",
        fixes,
        n,
        if n == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            100.0 * fixes as f64 / n as f64
        }
    ));
    lines.push(format!(
        "  quality: mean={:.2}",
        if n == 0 { 0.0 } else { quality_sum / n as f64 }
    ));
    lines.push(format!("  disk: {:.1} KiB", disk as f64 / 1024.0));
    Ok(lines)
}

fn sample(
    root: &str,
    id: &str,
    buckets: &mut HashMap<String, usize>,
    statuses: &mut HashMap<String, usize>,
    fixes: &mut usize,
    quality_sum: &mut f64,
    disk: &mut u64,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let c = store::load(root, id)?;
    *buckets.entry(c.bucket.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    *statuses.entry(c.status.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    if !c.fix.is_empty() {
        *fixes += 1;
    }
    *quality_sum += c.quality;
    let dir = store::path(root, id)
        .parent()
        .expect("path 必含 cases/<id>/case.json")
        .to_path_buf();
    *disk += store::size(&dir)?;
    Ok(())
}

/// map 按 key 字典序输出（确定性）：`db=5 network=3 ...`。
fn join(counts: &HashMap<String, usize>) -> String {
    let mut keys: Vec<&String> = counts.keys().collect();
    keys.sort();
    keys.iter()
        .map(|k| format!("{}={}", k, counts[*k]))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::ingest::{fix, ingest};
    use crate::memory::store::{self, Stats};
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::fs;

    fn stats() -> Stats {
        crate::memory::store::sample()
    }

    #[test]
    fn rebuild_builds_index_without_forcing_flag() {
        let root = root("rb");
        let s = stats();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库超时",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a alpha",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        crate::memory::meta::set(&root, "index_force", 1.0).unwrap();
        let (n_docs, n_terms) = rebuild(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(n_docs, 1);
        assert!(n_terms > 0);
        assert!(index::load(&root).unwrap().is_some(), "索引已建");
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            m.param("index_force"),
            1.0,
            "rebuild 不得改写 index_force（索引只是缓存，重建不得改变召回语义）"
        );
        assert!(
            m.df.iter().any(|(k, _)| k == "alpha"),
            "rebuild 落 df 快照（领域 IDF 数据源）"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn gc_removes_expired_only() {
        let root = root("gc");
        let s = stats();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库超时",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a gamma",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "磁盘满",
            vec!["disk".into()],
            "ERROR disk full delta",
            vec!["/b.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // 把第一个 case 拨成 regressed + 超期（gc_ttl_regressed=180）。
        let ids = store::list(&root).unwrap();
        let mut c = store::load(&root, &ids[0]).unwrap();
        c.status = "regressed".to_string();
        let now = store::stamp();
        let older = format!("2020-01-01{}", &now[10..]);
        c.updated_at = older;
        store::save(&root, &c).unwrap();
        let removed = gc(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(removed, 1, "regressed 超期应被清");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 1);
        // 索引已作废（惰性）。
        assert!(!index::load(&root).unwrap().is_some(), "gc 后索引作废");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    /// 带 fix 的 case 不因 stale 过期（经验价值最高）。
    #[test]
    fn gc_keeps_stale_case_with_fix() {
        let root = root("gc-fix");
        let s = stats();
        let mut c = ingest_fix_direct(&root, &s);
        c.quality = 0.0; // 从未反馈
        let now = store::stamp();
        let older = format!("2020-01-01{}", &now[10..]);
        c.updated_at = older; // 远超 gc_ttl_stale=365
        store::save(&root, &c).unwrap();
        let removed = gc(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(removed, 0, "带 fix 的 case 不应被 stale GC 清理");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 1);
        // 去掉 fix 后同条件应被清（对照）。
        let mut c2 = store::load(&root, &store::list(&root).unwrap()[0]).unwrap();
        c2.fix = String::new();
        store::save(&root, &c2).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(gc(&root).unwrap(), 1);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    /// 直接落一个带 fix 的 case（经 ingest_with_fix，目录/指纹/写盘齐全）。
    fn ingest_fix_direct(root: &str, s: &store::Stats) -> store::Case {
        fix(
            root,
            "磁盘满",
            vec!["disk".into()],
            "ERROR disk full delta",
            vec!["/b.log".into()],
            s,
            vec![],
            "扩容并清理 inode",
        )
        .unwrap();
        store::load(root, &store::list(root).unwrap()[0]).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_invalidates_index() {
        let root = root("del");
        let s = stats();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库超时",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a zeta",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        rebuild(&root).unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        assert!(delete(&root, &id).unwrap());
        assert!(store::list(&root).unwrap().is_empty());
        assert!(!index::load(&root).unwrap().is_some(), "删除后索引惰性作废");
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m.case_count, 0);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_rejects_path_traversal_and_absolute_paths() {
        let root = root("del-traverse");
        // victim 放在 mem-dir 根下、cases 之外：`cases/../victim` 会落到这里。
        let victim = Path::new(&root).join("victim");
        fs::create_dir_all(&victim).unwrap();
        fs::write(victim.join("keep.txt"), b"important").unwrap();

        // 绝对路径：`Path::join` 遇绝对路径整段替换，白名单必须先拦。
        let abs = victim.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let err = delete(&root, &abs).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput);
        assert!(
            victim.join("keep.txt").exists(),
            "绝对路径 id 不得删除外部目录"
        );

        // 相对逃逸：`cases/../victim` 会逃逸出 cases 目录。
        let err = delete(&root, "../victim").unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput);
        assert!(
            victim.join("keep.txt").exists(),
            ".. 逃逸 id 不得删除外部目录"
        );

        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! meta.toml 读写与库根初始化（零依赖行式子集）。
//!
//! 布局见 store.rs 头注释。meta 是"库元信息"（schema/引擎版本/case 数/DF 快照/参数），
//! 与 case 资产分离：损坏时整库仍可用，rebuild 可重建。

use crate::memory::lock;
/// case.json 的当前 schema 版本。旧版本读取按缺字段默认值兼容。
pub(crate) const SCHEMA: u32 = 2;
pub(crate) const ENG_VER: &str = "stat-v1";
use crate::memory::util::stamp;
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

/// 建库根目录（含 cases/、index/）与初始 meta.toml。
pub(crate) fn ensure(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    for sub in ["", "cases", "index"] {
        let p = Path::new(root).join(sub);
        if !p.exists() {
            lock::mkdir(&p)?;
        }
    }
    let meta_p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    if !meta_p.exists() {
        // 多进程同时首次打开：锁内二次检查，避免两边写坏同一 meta。
        let _g = lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock")?;
        if !meta_p.exists() {
            lock::atomic(&meta_p, render(0).as_bytes())?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) struct Meta {
    /// 建库时间（UTC）。评估/自检用它冻结衰减时钟，保证同一库快照可重放；
    /// 线上召回仍使用当前时间。
    pub created_at: String,
    pub case_count: usize,
    /// 库代际：任何 case 写入 / 删除都 +1；
    /// qmap 快照与会话缓存条目记录写入时的 gen，`gen < 当前` 视为过期
    /// （新 case / 反馈 / 删除必须对同 query 召回可见）。
    pub gen: u64,
    pub df: Vec<(String, usize)>,
    pub params: Vec<(String, f64)>,
    /// 词级调权表：词 → 增量权重（Rocchio 简化版），无词条=0。
    pub word_w: Vec<(String, f64)>,
    /// L1 自适应：最近 top1_sim 滑动历史（上限 L1_HIST_CAP，存于 [l1] 节）。
    pub l1_hist: Vec<f64>,
}

impl Meta {
    /// 参数读取的唯一入口：库内值优先，缺省值来自同一张默认表。
    pub(crate) fn param(&self, key: &str) -> f64 {
        if let Some((_, value)) = self.params.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == key) {
            return *value;
        }
        debug_assert!(
            DEFAULT_PARAMS.iter().any(|(k, _)| *k == key),
            "unknown config key: {key}"
        );
        fallback(key)
    }
}

/// 默认参数查表；未知键返回 0.0（老库兼容），开发期由 `Meta::param` 的断言兜住。
pub(crate) fn fallback(key: &str) -> f64 {
    DEFAULT_PARAMS
        .iter()
        .find(|(k, _)| *k == key)
        .map_or(0.0, |(_, value)| *value)
}

/// 新库参数模板，也是所有缺省读取的唯一来源。
pub(crate) const DEFAULT_PARAMS: &[(&str, f64)] = &[
    ("bm25_k1", 1.2),
    // b 控制长度归一化强度：日志/事故是短文档，长度与相关性无关，
    // 0.3 显著优于通用文本默认 0.75（Gauge semantic MRR +0.072，perm p=0.0001）。
    ("bm25_b", 0.3),
    ("field_weight_error_code", 3.0),
    ("field_weight_file_loc", 2.5),
    ("field_weight_symbol", 2.0),
    ("field_weight_num_fp", 2.0),
    ("decay_tau_days", 90.0),
    ("decay_tau_solved", 180.0),
    ("decay_tau_regressed", 30.0),
    ("mmr_lambda", 0.5),
    ("mmr_enable", 0.0),
    ("bucket_enable", 1.0),
    ("bucket_allow_other", 1.0),
    ("bucket_bypass_sim", 0.30),
    ("prf_enable", 1.0),
    ("confidence_high_sim", 0.99),
    ("index_force", 0.0),
    ("feedback_step", 0.1),
    ("feedback_step_bad", 0.15),
    ("word_w_limit", 0.5),
    ("session_cache_minutes", 30.0),
    ("l1_base", 0.55),
    ("l1_margin_min", 0.15),
    ("l1_adapt_min", 0.30),
    ("l1_adapt_max", 0.90),
    ("l1_adapt_min_history", 4.0),
    ("quality_prior", 0.5),
    ("gc_ttl_regressed", 180.0),
    ("gc_ttl_stale", 365.0),
    ("edge_enable", 1.0),
    ("edge_weight", 1.0),
    ("query_field_weight", 0.80),
    ("query_field_min_sim", 0.07),
    ("query_field_trigger_sim", 0.30),
    ("sibling_coherence", 1.0),
    ("sibling_min_sim", 0.30),
    ("synonyms_enable", 1.0),
    ("synonym_weight", 0.5),
    // 英文屈折词干补召回：默认关（0），需显式 stem_enable=1 开启；
    // 仅 feature=semantic 编译期参与，默认构建路径不变。
    ("stem_enable", 0.0),
];

pub(crate) const L1_HIST_CAP: usize = 64;

pub(crate) fn load(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Meta> {
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let txt = fs::read_to_string(p)?;
    let mut meta = Meta {
        created_at: String::new(),
        case_count: 0,
        gen: 0,
        df: Vec::new(),
        params: Vec::new(),
        word_w: Vec::new(),
        l1_hist: Vec::new(),
    };
    // 行式解析统一由 scx::toml 提供（节感知 TOML 子集），语义与历史实现一致。
    for e in crate::toml::parse(txt.lines()) {
        apply(e, &mut meta);
    }
    Ok(meta)
}

fn apply(e: crate::toml::Entry<'_>, meta: &mut Meta) {
    match e.section {
        "" => scalar(e.key, e.value, meta),
        "df" => size(&mut meta.df, e.key, e.value),
        "params" => float(&mut meta.params, e.key, e.value),
        "word_w" => float(&mut meta.word_w, e.key, e.value),
        "l1" if e.key == "hist" => history(e.value, &mut meta.l1_hist),
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// 无节标量（created_at / case_count / gen）：未知键忽略（老库缺字段按默认）。
fn scalar(key: &str, value: &str, meta: &mut Meta) {
    match key {
        "created_at" => meta.created_at = crate::toml::strip(value).to_string(),
        "case_count" => meta.case_count = crate::toml::size(value).unwrap_or(0),
        "gen" => meta.gen = crate::toml::integer(value).unwrap_or(0),
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn size(out: &mut Vec<(String, usize)>, key: &str, value: &str) {
    if let Some(n) = crate::toml::size(value) {
        out.push((key.to_string(), n));
    }
}

fn float(out: &mut Vec<(String, f64)>, key: &str, value: &str) {
    if let Some(f) = crate::toml::float(value) {
        out.push((key.to_string(), f));
    }
}

/// 逗号分隔的 L1 历史串；每条 hist 行解析后截断到上限（保持逐行截断口径）。
fn history(value: &str, hist: &mut Vec<f64>) {
    let body = crate::toml::strip(value);
    for tok in body.split(',') {
        if let Some(f) = crate::toml::float(tok.trim()) {
            hist.push(f);
        }
    }
    hist.truncate(L1_HIST_CAP);
}

/// 库代际 +1 并原子写回（case 写入/删除的兜底失效信号；失败返回 Err，
/// 由调用方决定是否致命——case 已写盘，gen 落后只会多一次重算，不丢数据）。
/// 已持 `meta.lock` 时调用（delete 等多锁路径用 `locks` 一次取齐后调此变体）。
pub(crate) fn advance(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let txt = fs::read_to_string(&p)?;
    let mut next: Option<u64> = None;
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for line in txt.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if comment(t) {
            out.push(line.to_string());
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(v) = value(t) {
            next = Some(v.saturating_add(1));
            out.push(format!("gen = {}", next.unwrap()));
            continue;
        }
        out.push(line.to_string());
    }
    let gen = next.unwrap_or(1);
    if next.is_none() {
        line(&mut out, gen);
    }
    let mut body = out.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes())
}

fn comment(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.starts_with('[') || t.starts_with('#')
}

fn value(t: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let eq = t.find('=')?;
    if t[..eq].trim() != "gen" {
        return None;
    }
    t[eq + 1..].trim().parse::<u64>().ok()
}

fn line(out: &mut Vec<String>, gen: u64) {
    if let Some(ci) = out.iter().position(|l| l.trim().starts_with("case_count")) {
        out.insert(ci + 1, format!("gen = {gen}"));
    } else {
        out.push(format!("gen = {gen}"));
    }
}

/// 代际递增（包装 `advance`：取 `meta.lock` 后执行）。
pub(crate) fn bump(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let _g = lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock")?;
    advance(root)
}

/// 追加一条 top1_sim 到 L1 历史并重写 meta.toml。
/// 失败静默（旁路：历史只是置信校准的输入，不影响召回正确性）。
pub(crate) fn record(root: &str, sim: f64) {
    let Ok(_g) = lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock") else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(mut meta) = load(root) else {
        return;
    };
    meta.l1_hist.push(sim);
    if meta.l1_hist.len() > L1_HIST_CAP {
        let drop = meta.l1_hist.len() - L1_HIST_CAP;
        meta.l1_hist.drain(..drop);
    }
    let hist_txt = meta
        .l1_hist
        .iter()
        .map(|f| format!("{f:.4}"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(",");
    // 重写 meta.toml：保留 df/params/word_w 节，仅更新 [l1] hist。
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&p) else {
        return;
    };
    let key_line = format!("hist = \"{hist_txt}\"");
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = txt.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    if let Some(pi) = lines.iter().position(|l| l.trim() == "[l1]") {
        if !replace(&mut lines, pi, "hist", &key_line) {
            insert(&mut lines, pi, key_line);
        }
    } else {
        lines.push("[l1]".to_string());
        lines.push(key_line);
    }
    let mut body = lines.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    let _ = lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes());
}

/// 词级调权：good 词 +step / bad 词 −step（默认上下限 ±0.5，§3.9），重写 [word_w] 节。
pub(crate) fn learn(root: &str, terms: &[String], good: bool) {
    let Ok(_g) = lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock") else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(mut meta) = load(root) else {
        return;
    };
    let step = if good {
        meta.param("feedback_step")
    } else {
        -meta.param("feedback_step_bad")
    };
    let limit = meta.param("word_w_limit").max(0.0);
    steps(&mut meta, terms, step, limit);
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&p) else {
        return;
    };
    let out = rewrite(&txt, &meta.word_w);
    let mut body = out.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    let _ = lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes());
}

/// 逐词应用调权：跳过单字符词；在表中则原位 clamp，否则追加。
fn steps(meta: &mut Meta, terms: &[String], step: f64, limit: f64) {
    for t in terms {
        if t.len() < 2 {
            continue;
        }
        let cur = meta
            .word_w
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| k == t)
            .map(|(_, v)| *v)
            .unwrap_or(0.0);
        let next = (cur + step).clamp(-limit, limit);
        if let Some(e) = meta.word_w.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| k == t) {
            e.1 = next;
        } else {
            meta.word_w.push((t.clone(), next));
        }
    }
}

/// [word_w] 节重写：旧节整体跳过，在其后第一个节头前插入新节；
/// 文件无节头时在末尾追加。
fn rewrite(txt: &str, word_w: &[(String, f64)]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut wrote_w = false;
    for line in txt.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if t.starts_with('[') && t.ends_with(']') {
            if t == "[word_w]" {
                // 跳过旧节，统一在末尾重写。
                wrote_w = true;
                continue;
            }
            if !wrote_w && !word_w.is_empty() {
                out.extend(block(word_w));
                out.push("".to_string());
                wrote_w = true;
            }
        }
        out.push(line.to_string());
    }
    if !wrote_w {
        out.extend(block(word_w));
    }
    out
}

fn block(word_w: &[(String, f64)]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = vec!["[word_w]".to_string()];
    for (k, v) in word_w {
        out.push(format!("{k} = {v:.3}"));
    }
    out
}

/// 写/更新 [params] 单个参数：节内有 key 原位替换，无则节内末尾插入，无节则文件尾建节。
/// 参数写入的唯一入口；建库模板、L1 自适应与测试共用。
pub(crate) fn set(root: &str, key: &str, val: f64) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let _g = lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock")?;
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let txt = fs::read_to_string(&p)?;
    let key_line = format!("{key} = {val:.3}");
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = txt.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    if let Some(pi) = lines.iter().position(|l| l.trim() == "[params]") {
        if !replace(&mut lines, pi, key, &key_line) {
            insert(&mut lines, pi, key_line);
        }
    } else {
        lines.push("[params]".to_string());
        lines.push(key_line.clone());
    }
    let mut body = lines.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes())
}

fn replace(lines: &mut [String], pi: usize, key: &str, key_line: &str) -> bool {
    for l in lines.iter_mut().skip(pi + 1) {
        let t = l.trim();
        if t.starts_with('[') {
            return false;
        }
        if matches(t, key) {
            *l = key_line.to_string();
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn insert(lines: &mut Vec<String>, pi: usize, key_line: String) {
    let end = lines
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .skip(pi + 1)
        .find(|(_, l)| l.trim().starts_with('['))
        .map(|(i, _)| i)
        .unwrap_or(lines.len());
    lines.insert(end, key_line);
}

fn matches(t: &str, key: &str) -> bool {
    t.find('=').is_some_and(|eq| t[..eq].trim() == key)
}

fn render(case_count: usize) -> String {
    let mut body = format!(
        "schema = {SCHEMA}\nembed_engine = \"{ENG_VER}\"\ncreated_at = \"{}\"\ncase_count = {case_count}\ngen = 0\n\n[params]\n",
        stamp()
    );
    for (key, value) in DEFAULT_PARAMS {
        body.push_str(&format!("{key} = {value}\n"));
    }
    body
}

//! 纯算法近似语义召回：加权 MinHash-LSH 签名 + band 分桶 + 精确 Jaccard 精排。
//!
//! 采用文献/工业界成熟的 weighted MinHash-LSH 方案：128 哈希、IDF 加权、band
//! 分桶、固定种子哈希（splitmix64）。零第三方依赖、零随机源、确定性（无
//! clock/rand）。shingle = 词元（按 IDF 加权，`terms::memory` 切词）+ 字符
//! 3-gram（定权 1.0）。
//!
//! 加权 MinHash 采用 ICWS（Improved Consistent Weighted Sampling）一致性加权
//! 采样：对每个哈希位置取 `-ln(u)/w` 最小的 shingle 作为签名元素，高 IDF 术语
//! 对指纹的影响更大。**加权只在签名（LSH 候选初筛）生效**；最终相似度用精确
//! 无权 Jaccard（`|A∩B|/|A∪B|`）计算，对齐方案 §2.2.3「完整 Jaccard 精排」。
//!
//! LSH 分桶阈值：`s = (1/b)^(1/r)`，b=`N_BANDS`、r=`BAND_ROWS`。当前
//! 8 段 × 16 行 → s ≈ 0.88（近重复导向、高阈值保守）；调大 `N_BANDS` 可降低
//! 阈值以多召回（候选集变大、剪枝减弱）。小库（< `LSH_THRESHOLD`）走精确
//! Jaccard，不受该阈值影响、无 LSH 假阴性。

use std::collections::HashMap;

pub(crate) const N_HASHES: usize = 128;
pub(crate) const N_BANDS: usize = 8;
const BAND_ROWS: usize = N_HASHES / N_BANDS;
/// 超过该规模才走 LSH 候选初筛；小库全量精确加权 Jaccard（无 LSH 假阴性）。
const LSH_THRESHOLD: usize = 4096;
/// 字符 3-gram 的固定权重（词元权重 = IDF，二者同处一个 shingle 表）。
const CHARGRAM_WEIGHT: f64 = 1.0;
/// shingle 上限：词元已由 `terms` 限 256，字符 3-gram 无上限，需独立封顶防超大正文。
const MAX_SHINGLES: usize = 1 << 16;

/// query 与每个 doc 的加权 Jaccard 相似度（词元 IDF 加权 + 字符 3-gram）。
pub(crate) fn scores(query: &str, docs: &[&str]) -> Vec<f64> {
    if docs.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let n = docs.len();
    let (df, terms) = doc_freq(docs);
    let q = shingles(query, &df, n);
    // 复用 doc_freq 已切好的词表：同一 doc 在 df 预扫描与 shingle 构建各切一次
    // 纯属重复（切词是本路径最重的 CPU 部分）。
    let ds: Vec<HashMap<u64, f64>> = docs
        .iter()
        .zip(&terms)
        .map(|(d, ts)| shingles_of(ts, d, &df, n))
        .collect();
    if n < LSH_THRESHOLD {
        return ds.iter().map(|d| jaccard(&q, d)).collect();
    }
    let q_sig = weighted_signature(&q);
    let sigs: Vec<[u64; N_HASHES]> = ds.iter().map(weighted_signature).collect();
    let cand = candidates(&q_sig, &sigs);
    ds.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, d)| {
            if cand.contains(&i) {
                jaccard(&q, d)
            } else {
                0.0
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// 词元 df 预扫描：每个词元出现在多少个 doc（单 doc 内去重）。
/// 同时返回各 doc 的去重词表，供 shingle 构建复用（避免重复切词）。
fn doc_freq(docs: &[&str]) -> (HashMap<String, usize>, Vec<Vec<String>>) {
    let mut df = HashMap::new();
    let mut per_doc = Vec::with_capacity(docs.len());
    for d in docs {
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        let mut uniq = Vec::new();
        for t in crate::terms::memory(d) {
            if seen.insert(t.clone()) {
                *df.entry(t.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
                uniq.push(t);
            }
        }
        per_doc.push(uniq);
    }
    (df, per_doc)
}

/// 单文本加权 shingle 表：词元 → IDF 权重（词元先入为主，字符 gram 不覆盖）。
fn shingles(text: &str, df: &HashMap<String, usize>, n: usize) -> HashMap<u64, f64> {
    shingles_of(&crate::terms::memory(text), text, df, n)
}

/// 已切词文本的加权 shingle 表。词表须是去重后的词元（去重不改变结果：
/// `map.entry(..).or_insert` 本就只取首次出现，同一词元权重也相同）。
fn shingles_of(
    terms: &[String],
    text: &str,
    df: &HashMap<String, usize>,
    n: usize,
) -> HashMap<u64, f64> {
    let mut map = HashMap::new();
    for t in terms {
        let df_t = df.get(t).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        // 库级噪声词（出现在全部 doc）不参与：IDF 加权只能降到 1.0、无法剔除，
        // 硬过滤掉可避免它稀释加权 Jaccard 的分母（语义层实测退化根因）。
        if n >= 2 && df_t >= n {
            continue;
        }
        let key = crate::memory::util::fnv1a(t);
        let w = idf(df_t, n);
        map.entry(key).or_insert(w);
    }
    chargrams(text, &mut map);
    map
}

/// 平滑 IDF：`ln((n+1)/(df+1)) + 1`，恒 ≥ 1；高频词低权重（不归零，属加权而非剔除）。
fn idf(df: usize, n: usize) -> f64 {
    ((n as f64 + 1.0) / (df as f64 + 1.0)).ln() + 1.0
}

/// 字符 3-gram（字母/数字/下划线连续段，小写化）以定权并入 shingle 表；
/// 已有词元键不覆盖（词元 IDF 权重优先）。
fn chargrams(text: &str, map: &mut HashMap<u64, f64>) {
    if map.len() >= MAX_SHINGLES {
        return;
    }
    let chars: Vec<char> = text.to_lowercase().chars().collect();
    let mut gram = String::with_capacity(3);
    for w in chars.windows(3) {
        if map.len() >= MAX_SHINGLES {
            break;
        }
        if !w.iter().all(|&c| eligible(c)) {
            continue;
        }
        gram.clear();
        for &c in w {
            gram.push(c);
        }
        map.entry(crate::memory::util::fnv1a(&gram))
            .or_insert(CHARGRAM_WEIGHT);
    }
}

fn eligible(c: char) -> bool {
    c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_'
}

/// 加权 MinHash 签名（ICWS）：每个哈希位置取 `-ln(u)/w` 最小的 shingle。
fn weighted_signature(shingles: &HashMap<u64, f64>) -> [u64; N_HASHES] {
    let mut sig = [0u64; N_HASHES];
    let mut best = [f64::INFINITY; N_HASHES];
    for (&s, &w) in shingles {
        if w <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        for (i, slot) in sig.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            let y = -u01(i as u64, s).ln() / w;
            if y < best[i] {
                best[i] = y;
                *slot = s;
            }
        }
    }
    sig
}

/// `mix(seed, x)` 归一化到 (0, 1] 的确定性伪均匀值。
fn u01(seed: u64, x: u64) -> f64 {
    (mix(seed, x) as f64 + 1.0) / 2.0_f64.powi(64)
}

/// splitmix64：固定种子确定性哈希族（seed=哈希序号，x=shingle 键）。
fn mix(seed: u64, x: u64) -> u64 {
    let mut z = x.wrapping_add(seed.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15));
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
    z ^ (z >> 31)
}

/// 第 `band` 段的桶键：段内 16 个签名 shingle XOR 后经 `mix` 定型。
fn band_key(band: usize, sig: &[u64; N_HASHES]) -> u64 {
    let mut acc = 0u64;
    for &v in &sig[band * BAND_ROWS..(band + 1) * BAND_ROWS] {
        acc ^= v;
    }
    mix(band as u64, acc)
}

/// LSH 候选初筛：与 query 共享至少一个 band 桶的 doc 下标集合。
fn candidates(
    q_sig: &[u64; N_HASHES],
    doc_sigs: &[[u64; N_HASHES]],
) -> std::collections::HashSet<usize> {
    let mut buckets: HashMap<u64, Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
    for (di, sig) in doc_sigs.iter().enumerate() {
        for b in 0..N_BANDS {
            buckets.entry(band_key(b, sig)).or_default().push(di);
        }
    }
    let mut cand = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    for b in 0..N_BANDS {
        if let Some(list) = buckets.get(&band_key(b, q_sig)) {
            cand.extend(list.iter().copied());
        }
    }
    cand
}

/// 精确（无权）Jaccard：`|A∩B| / |A∪B|`，空集返回 0。
///
/// 精排用无权 Jaccard（对齐方案 §2.2.3「完整 Jaccard 精排」）；IDF 加权只作用在
/// 加权 MinHash 签名（LSH 候选初筛）上，不进入最终相似度。
fn jaccard(a: &HashMap<u64, f64>, b: &HashMap<u64, f64>) -> f64 {
    let (small, large) = if a.len() <= b.len() { (a, b) } else { (b, a) };
    if large.is_empty() {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let inter = small.keys().filter(|k| large.contains_key(k)).count();
    let union = a.len() + b.len() - inter;
    if union == 0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        inter as f64 / union as f64
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn ids(text: &str) -> HashMap<u64, f64> {
        shingles(text, &HashMap::new(), 1)
    }

    #[test]
    fn identical_text_scores_one() {
        let d = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a errno=28";
        let s = scores(d, &[d]);
        assert!(
            (s[0] - 1.0).abs() < 1e-9,
            "identical text must be Jaccard 1: {}",
            s[0]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn disjoint_text_scores_zero() {
        let s = scores("aaaa bbbb", &["zzzz yyyy"]);
        assert!(
            (s[0] - 0.0).abs() < 1e-9,
            "disjoint text must be Jaccard 0: {}",
            s[0]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn shared_terms_score_higher_than_disjoint() {
        let q = "db connection timeout";
        let related = "connection timeout root cause";
        let unrelated = "disk full errno 28";
        let s = scores(q, &[related, unrelated]);
        assert!(s[0] > s[1], "{} should beat {} for {:?}", s[0], s[1], q);
    }

    #[test]
    fn chargrams_bridge_surface_rewrites() {
        let q = "connection timeout";
        let rewrite = "connect timeout";
        let unrelated = "disk full";
        let s = scores(q, &[rewrite, unrelated]);
        assert!(
            s[0] > s[1],
            "char-gram should bridge rewrite: {} vs {}",
            s[0],
            s[1]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn deterministic_across_runs() {
        let docs = ["ERROR db timeout", "disk full errno=28", "连接池耗尽"];
        let q = "db timeout 连接池";
        assert_eq!(scores(q, &docs), scores(q, &docs));
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_docs_returns_empty() {
        assert!(scores("q", &[]).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn jaccard_is_unweighted() {
        // 精排无权：a 与 b 仅共享键 1，J = |{1}| / |{1,2,3}| = 1/3（权重不参与）。
        let a: HashMap<u64, f64> = [(1, 100.0), (2, 1.0)].into_iter().collect();
        let b: HashMap<u64, f64> = [(1, 0.5), (3, 3.0)].into_iter().collect();
        let j = jaccard(&a, &b);
        assert!(
            (j - 1.0 / 3.0).abs() < 1e-9,
            "unweighted Jaccard should be 1/3: {j}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn word_token_weight_wins_over_chargram_collision() {
        // "abc" 同时是词元与字符 gram；词元 IDF 权重应优先（不被 1.0 覆盖）。
        let map = ids("abc abcd");
        let key = crate::memory::util::fnv1a("abc");
        assert!(
            map.get(&key).copied().unwrap_or(0.0) > 1.0,
            "word token idf weight must beat chargram weight"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn weighted_signature_is_deterministic() {
        let a = ids("ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a");
        assert_eq!(weighted_signature(&a), weighted_signature(&a));
        assert_eq!(weighted_signature(&a).len(), N_HASHES);
    }

    #[test]
    fn lsh_candidates_include_identical_doc() {
        let a = ids("ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a errno=28");
        let b = ids("ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a errno=28");
        let c = ids("zzzz yyyy xxxx");
        let sa = weighted_signature(&a);
        let cand = candidates(&sa, &[weighted_signature(&b), weighted_signature(&c)]);
        assert!(
            cand.contains(&0),
            "identical doc must share a band with the query"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn band_key_is_deterministic() {
        let set = ids("some text here");
        let sig = weighted_signature(&set);
        assert_eq!(band_key(0, &sig), band_key(0, &sig));
    }
}

//! memory 模块门面：记忆知识库的公开接口与顶层封装。
//!
//! 与 `compress` 完全隔离：compress 是纯函数（零 I/O），memory 是 I/O 侧模块，
//! 只做旁路召回与评分先验，绝不注入压缩正文。
//!
//! 子模块按职责分为存储（`store`/`meta`/`index`/`lock`）、摄取与分类
//! （`ingest`/`classify`）、召回排序（`recall`/`ranking`/`edge`/`cache`）、
//! 反馈维护（`feedback`/`maintenance`）以及评估（`eval`/`gate`/`annotate`）；
//! 具体文件职责见 `docs/memory.md`。

mod annotate;
mod cache;
mod classify;
mod edge;
mod eval;
mod feedback;
pub(crate) mod gate;
mod index;
mod ingest;
mod json;
pub(crate) mod lock;
mod maintenance;
mod meta;
mod minhash;
pub(crate) mod ranking;
mod recall;
mod store;
mod util;
pub(crate) use util::sanitize;

pub use recall::Hit;
pub use store::{Case, Feedback, Fields, Stats};

use std::collections::HashMap;

/// `--fix` / `--fix-file` 的字节上限；CLI 读取与存储校验共享同一约束。
pub const MAX_FIX_BYTES: usize = ingest::MAX_FIX_LEN;

/// 一次写入所需的完整输入。可选字段默认空，调用方只填充实际拥有的信息；
/// 新增存储能力不应再产生 `save_*` 函数族。
pub struct Input<'a> {
    pub root: &'a str,
    pub query: &'a str,
    pub text: &'a str,
    pub source: &'a [String],
    pub stats: &'a Stats,
    pub forces: &'a [String],
    pub fix: &'a str,
    pub evidence_lno: &'a [usize],
    pub evidence: &'a [String],
    /// 写入前允许的库总字节数上限；`None` 表示不限制。
    pub max_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

impl<'a> Input<'a> {
    /// 最小输入：仅 query、证据块与统计；其余字段为空。
    pub fn new(root: &'a str, query: &'a str, text: &'a str, stats: &'a Stats) -> Self {
        Self {
            root,
            query,
            text,
            source: &[],
            stats,
            forces: &[],
            fix: "",
            evidence_lno: &[],
            evidence: &[],
            max_bytes: None,
        }
    }
}

/// 摄取一个压缩结果 → 记忆 case。
///
/// 所有文本在同一存储边界脱敏；query 词表由门面生成，保证指纹、索引和召回
/// 使用同一口径。返回 `(added, case_id)`。
pub fn save(input: Input<'_>) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    let query = crate::memory::util::sanitize(input.query);
    let text = crate::memory::util::sanitize(input.text);
    let fix = crate::memory::util::sanitize(input.fix);
    let evidence: Vec<String> = input
        .evidence
        .iter()
        .map(|e| crate::memory::util::sanitize(e))
        .collect();
    let terms = crate::terms::memory(&query);
    ingest::persist(ingest::Payload {
        root: input.root,
        query: &query,
        terms,
        text: &text,
        source: input.source,
        stats: input.stats,
        forces: input.forces,
        fix: &fix,
        evidence_lno: input.evidence_lno,
        evidence: &evidence,
        max_bytes: input.max_bytes,
    })
}

/// 门面：读取完整 case，包括可回放的原始证据行。
pub fn load(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<Case> {
    store::load(root, id)
}

/// 转义从记忆库回放到终端的控制字符，防止日志注入 ANSI 序列。
pub fn escape(s: &str) -> String {
    util::escape(s)
}

/// 门面：按 query 召回 top-k case（会话缓存 → qmap 直达 → BM25+字段加权+衰减+桶过滤）。
///
/// 会话缓存：进程内存可配置窗口（默认 30 分钟），窗口内同 query 直接返回快照；
/// 快照记录写入时的库代际，store/rate/delete 后自动失效。快照还带结果条数：
/// 请求的 `k` 超过快照条数时回退完整召回，避免小 k 查询污染后续大 k 查询。
/// query 记忆图：recall 成功后把 (query → top-k id/score/sim) 回流写入 qmap.bin
/// （append-only，带代际），二次同指纹 query 直接命中（跳过 BM25）。变体 query
/// 不复用快照：缓存只含 top-k，无法在不重扫全库的前提下保证变体排序正确。
/// 快照只复用 1 小时，避免时间衰减排序长期停留在旧状态。
/// 回流失败静默（旁路原则：记忆图只是加速，不影响召回正确性）。
///
/// `read_only`：`--recall-only` 不写 qmap、会话缓存、L1 历史或索引缓存；
/// 索引缺失/损坏时直接回退线性扫描，保证只读查看零磁盘副作用。
pub fn search(root: &str, query: &str, k: usize, read_only: bool) -> std::io::Result<Vec<Hit>> {
    if k == 0 {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    }
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    // 会话缓存命中直接返回快照（含 score/sim，L1 过滤可复用）。
    let cache_window = (meta.param("session_cache_minutes").max(0.0) * 60.0) as u64;
    if let Some(out) = session(root, query, &meta, cache_window, k) {
        return Ok(out);
    }
    let hits = if read_only {
        recall::read(root, query, k, &meta)?
    } else {
        recall::recall(root, query, k, &meta)?
    };
    writeback(root, query, &hits, &meta, read_only);
    Ok(hits)
}

/// RRF 融合常数（k=60）。
const RRF_K: f64 = 60.0;

/// 融合召回：BM25 top-k 与 embedding 余弦排名、MinHash-LSH Jaccard 的 RRF 融合。
///
/// `embed_cmd: None`/`embed_weight <= 0.0` 且 `minhash_weight <= 0.0` 时直接返回
/// `search` 结果，行为不变。否则枚举全库 case 文本，计算 query×文本相似度排名，
/// 与 BM25 排名做 RRF 融合后取 top-k。BM25 命中保留原 `score`/`sim`；仅靠 side
/// 信号救回的 case（不在 BM25 top-k）`score`/`sim` 记 0——不触发 L1 直答，符合
/// 低词面置信语义。本函数不触碰评测路径（`--eval` 走 `recall::clock`/`read`）。
pub fn search_fused(
    root: &str,
    query: &str,
    k: usize,
    read_only: bool,
    embed_cmd: Option<&str>,
    embed_weight: f64,
    minhash_weight: f64,
) -> std::io::Result<Vec<Hit>> {
    let bm25 = search(root, query, k, read_only)?;
    let use_embed = embed_cmd.is_some() && embed_weight > 0.0;
    let use_minhash = minhash_weight > 0.0;
    if k == 0 || (!use_embed && !use_minhash) {
        return Ok(bm25);
    }
    let ids = store::list(root)?;
    if ids.is_empty() {
        return Ok(bm25);
    }
    let texts: Vec<String> = ids
        .iter()
        .map(|id| store::load(root, id).map(|c| c.text))
        .collect::<std::io::Result<_>>()?;
    let refs: Vec<&str> = texts.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();

    // BM25 排名项与 score/sim 快照。
    let bm25_term: HashMap<String, f64> = bm25
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(r, h)| (h.id.clone(), 1.0 / (RRF_K + r as f64 + 1.0)))
        .collect();
    let bm25_meta: HashMap<String, (f64, f64)> = bm25
        .iter()
        .map(|h| (h.id.clone(), (h.score, h.sim)))
        .collect();

    let embed_term = if use_embed {
        let sims = crate::sim::compute(embed_cmd, query, &refs).map_err(std::io::Error::other)?;
        Some(full_rank_term(&ids, &sims))
    } else {
        None
    };
    let minhash_term = if use_minhash {
        Some(full_rank_term(&ids, &minhash::scores(query, &refs)))
    } else {
        None
    };

    let mut fused: Vec<(f64, String)> = ids
        .iter()
        .map(|id| {
            let mut s = bm25_term.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
            if let Some(t) = &embed_term {
                s += embed_weight * t.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
            }
            if let Some(t) = &minhash_term {
                s += minhash_weight * t.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
            }
            (s, id.clone())
        })
        .collect();
    fused.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0)
            .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| a.1.cmp(&b.1))
    });
    fused.truncate(k);

    Ok(fused
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(_, id)| {
            let (score, sim) = bm25_meta.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0));
            Hit { id, score, sim }
        })
        .collect())
}

/// side 信号（embedding/MinHash）的 RRF 排名项：sim 降序，同分按 id 升序（确定性）。
fn full_rank_term(ids: &[String], sims: &[f64]) -> HashMap<String, f64> {
    let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..ids.len()).collect();
    order.sort_by(|&a, &b| {
        sims[b]
            .partial_cmp(&sims[a])
            .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| ids[a].cmp(&ids[b]))
    });
    order
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(r, &i)| (ids[i].clone(), 1.0 / (RRF_K + r as f64 + 1.0)))
        .collect()
}

fn session(
    root: &str,
    query: &str,
    meta: &store::Meta,
    cache_window: u64,
    k: usize,
) -> Option<Vec<Hit>> {
    let hits = cache::get(root, query, meta.gen, cache_window, k)?;
    let out: Vec<Hit> = hits
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(id, score, sim)| Hit { id, score, sim })
        .collect();
    debug_assert!(out.len() <= k, "session snapshot must respect k");
    Some(out)
}

fn writeback(root: &str, query: &str, hits: &[Hit], meta: &store::Meta, read_only: bool) {
    if hits.is_empty() || read_only {
        return;
    }
    let snap: Vec<(String, f64, f64)> = hits
        .iter()
        .map(|h| (h.id.clone(), h.score, h.sim))
        .collect();
    let _ = cache::append(root, query, &snap, meta.gen); // 回流失败忽略
    cache::put(root, query, snap, meta.gen);
    meta::record(root, hits[0].sim);
}

/// 门面：反馈标注（状态机 + 质量分 + 词级调权 + L1 自适应基线）。
/// 返回更新后的 case，供 CLI 输出核对。
pub fn rate(root: &str, id: &str, good: bool) -> std::io::Result<store::Case> {
    feedback::rate(root, id, good)
}

/// 门面：meta 中 L1 参数；缺省值由 `meta::DEFAULT_PARAMS` 单一来源提供。
pub fn params(root: &str) -> (f64, f64) {
    match crate::memory::meta::load(root) {
        Ok(m) => feedback::params(&m),
        Err(_) => (
            crate::memory::meta::fallback("l1_base"),
            crate::memory::meta::fallback("l1_margin_min"),
        ),
    }
}

/// 只保留达到 L1 直答条件的召回命中（top1 基线 + top1/top2 间隔）。
pub fn hits(root: &str, hits: Vec<Hit>) -> Vec<Hit> {
    let (base, margin) = params(root);
    let top1 = hits.first().map(|h| h.sim).unwrap_or(0.0);
    let top2 = hits.get(1).map(|h| h.sim).unwrap_or(0.0);
    if feedback::qualified(top1, top2, base, margin) {
        hits
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    }
}

/// 门面：重建索引（postings 全量重建 + qmap 合并 + df 快照）。
/// 返回 (n_docs, n_terms)。索引是可丢弃缓存，任何时刻可安全重建。
pub fn rebuild(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    maintenance::rebuild(root)
}

/// 门面：过期清理（regressed>180d 或从未反馈且 stale>365d）。返回删除数。
pub fn gc(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
    maintenance::gc(root)
}

/// 门面：删除 case（物理删除 + 惰性作废索引）。返回是否存在。
pub fn delete(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    maintenance::delete(root, id)
}

/// 评估/门禁模式。报告模式返回的 gate 标志恒为 false。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Eval {
    Report,
    Mechanical,
    Human,
    Items,
}

/// 单一评估门面：冻结 baseline 重放并按模式选择报告或门禁。
pub fn evaluate(
    root: &str,
    path: &str,
    mode: Eval,
    verbose: bool,
) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<String>, bool)> {
    eval::run(root, path, mode, verbose)
}

/// 门面：输出运行期 `[l1]` 直答命中分布（`--l1-hist`）。
pub fn history(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    eval::history(root)
}

/// 门面：库盘点（`--stats`）：case、桶、状态、fix 覆盖率、质量与磁盘。
pub fn stats(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    maintenance::stats(root)
}

/// 生成标注集、原子写入目标文件，并返回 CLI 报告行。
/// `raw` 跳过自检以生成盲测材料。
pub fn annotate(
    root: &str,
    seed: u64,
    max_cases: usize,
    raw: bool,
    path: &str,
) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let report = annotate::report(root, seed, max_cases, raw)?;
    let body = annotate::baseline(&report.cases);
    lock::atomic(std::path::Path::new(path), body.as_bytes())?;
    Ok(annotate::summary(&report))
}

/// 交互式逐候选裁决入口（`--judge`）。
pub fn judge(path: &str, by: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    annotate::judge(path, by)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn tmp(tag: &str) -> String {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("scx-fused-{tag}-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        root.to_str().unwrap().to_string()
    }

    fn seed(root: &str, query: &str, text: &str) -> String {
        let stats = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 1,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        let (added, id) = save(Input::new(root, query, text, &stats)).unwrap();
        assert!(added, "seed must add a case");
        id
    }

    #[test]
    fn search_fused_none_equals_search() {
        let root = tmp("none");
        seed(
            &root,
            "db timeout",
            "db timeout conn pool\nroot cause: pool exhausted",
        );
        seed(&root, "disk full", "disk full errno=28\nfix: clean up");
        let plain = search(&root, "db timeout", 2, true).unwrap();
        let fused = search_fused(&root, "db timeout", 2, true, None, 1.0, 0.0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plain, fused, "embed_cmd=None 必须与 search 逐字节一致");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn search_fused_with_provider_returns_valid_hits() {
        let root = tmp("prov");
        seed(&root, "db timeout", "db timeout conn pool");
        seed(&root, "disk full", "disk full errno=28");
        let cmd = "printf '0.5\\n0.5\\n'";
        let hits = search_fused(&root, "db timeout", 2, true, Some(cmd), 1.0, 0.0).unwrap();
        assert!(!hits.is_empty(), "融合召回不应为空");
        assert!(hits.len() <= 2, "融合召回须受 k 约束");
        assert!(
            hits.iter().all(|h| h.id.contains('_')),
            "case id 形如 YYYY-MM-DD_hex"
        );
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn search_fused_with_minhash_returns_valid_hits() {
        let root = tmp("mh");
        seed(
            &root,
            "db connection timeout",
            "db connection timeout conn pool",
        );
        seed(&root, "disk full", "disk full errno=28");
        let hits = search_fused(&root, "db connection timeout", 2, true, None, 0.0, 1.0).unwrap();
        assert!(!hits.is_empty(), "MinHash 融合召回不应为空");
        assert!(hits.len() <= 2, "MinHash 融合召回须受 k 约束");
        assert!(
            hits.iter().all(|h| h.id.contains('_')),
            "case id 形如 YYYY-MM-DD_hex"
        );
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 检索排序：BM25、PRF 查询扩展与 MMR 多样性去冗余的唯一实现。
//!
//! BM25 共享公式供召回、PRF 与评估 B 基线复用，避免口径漂移。
//! PRF 伪相关反馈：粗召回 top-K 后取高 IDF 高频词并入 query 再召一轮。
//!
//! 统计方法独有优势：embedding 做查询扩展很难。扩展词选取规则（确定性）：
//! 只统计与 query 词面相关（sim > 0）的粗召回 case 词表（query ∪ text 同口径）；
//! 全局 df 现算（线性阶段），批内 tf ≥2 且全局 idf 高（idf > 阈值）的词入选；
//! 排除已含在 query 词表中的词。
//! 只在召回低置信（top1.sim < 0.99）时触发：同 query 高置信已直接命中，无需扩展。
//!
//! 按 sim>0 过滤粗召回 case——无关 case（词面零重叠）的私有词
//! 不得进入扩展词表（否则扩展会把不相干桶/词拉进 query，重排噪声压过真目标）。
//!
//! MMR：贪心选择 `argmax(score_norm − λ · max(sim(c, selected)))`，以词袋
//! Jaccard 衡量冗余，确定性、零依赖。

use crate::memory::recall::Hit;
use crate::memory::store::{self, Meta};
use crate::terms::{document, memory};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Robertson/Sparck Jones IDF（平滑、非负）。
pub(crate) fn idf(n: f64, df: f64) -> f64 {
    (1.0 + (n - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)).ln().max(0.0)
}

/// BM25 长度归一化分母；空库（avgdl=0）退化为 1.0，避免 NaN。
pub(crate) fn denom(k1: f64, b: f64, dl: f64, avgdl: f64) -> f64 {
    let norm = if avgdl > 0.0 { dl / avgdl } else { 0.0 };
    1.0 + k1 * (1.0 - b + b * norm)
}

/// 单词语义分（tf 恒为 1 的去重词表口径）。
pub(crate) fn score(idf: f64, k1: f64, denom: f64) -> f64 {
    idf * (k1 + 1.0) / denom
}

/// 扩展候选：批内出现 ≥2 次（高频）且全局稀有（idf 高）。
const MIN_BATCH_TF: usize = 2;
/// idf 阈值：仅保留 idf > 0.6 的词（df 不能过大）。
const IDF_MIN: f64 = 0.6;
/// 扩展词数量上限。
const EXPAND_MAX: usize = 6;

/// 小库线性兜底：全库现算 df，返回 (库规模 n, df 表)。
fn scan(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<(f64, HashMap<String, usize>)> {
    let all_ids = store::list(root)?;
    let n = all_ids.len() as f64;
    let mut df: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    for id in &all_ids {
        let c = store::load(root, id)?;
        let (_, terms) = document(&c.query, &c.text);
        for t in &terms {
            *df.entry(t.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok((n, df))
}

/// 统计批内词频：只算 sim>0 的相关 case；索引路径复用 postings 词表快照。
fn batch(
    root: &str,
    hits: &[Hit],
    idx: Option<&super::index::Index>,
) -> std::io::Result<HashMap<String, usize>> {
    let mut batch: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    for h in hits {
        if h.sim <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(idx) = idx {
            if let Some(di) = super::index::find(idx, &h.id) {
                for t in idx.docs[di].terms.iter() {
                    *batch.entry(t.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
                }
                continue;
            }
        }
        case(root, &h.id, &mut batch)?;
    }
    Ok(batch)
}

/// 线性回退：读 case 并把 query+text 词表并入批内词频。
fn case(root: &str, id: &str, batch: &mut HashMap<String, usize>) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let c = store::load(root, id)?;
    let mut terms = memory(&c.query);
    terms.extend(memory(&c.text));
    for t in &terms {
        *batch.entry(t.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 按 df 来源（索引 postings / meta 快照 / 线性现算）查单词 df。
fn lookup(
    idx: Option<&super::index::Index>,
    snapshot: Option<(&[(String, usize)], bool)>,
    df_map: Option<&HashMap<String, usize>>,
    t: &str,
) -> f64 {
    if let Some(idx) = idx {
        super::index::df(idx, t) as f64
    } else if let Some((snapshot, sorted)) = snapshot {
        let df = if sorted {
            snapshot
                .binary_search_by(|(k, _)| k[..].cmp(t))
                .ok()
                .map(|i| snapshot[i].1)
                .unwrap_or(0)
        } else {
            snapshot
                .iter()
                .find(|(k, _)| k == t)
                .map(|(_, n)| *n)
                .unwrap_or(0)
        };
        df as f64
    } else {
        df_map
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|map| map.get(t).copied())
            .unwrap_or(0) as f64
    }
}

/// 从批内 tf 表筛出扩展候选（tf≥MIN、idf>IDF_MIN、不在 query 词表）。
fn filter(
    batch: &HashMap<String, usize>,
    qterms: &[String],
    n: f64,
    idx: Option<&super::index::Index>,
    snapshot: Option<(&[(String, usize)], bool)>,
    df_map: Option<&HashMap<String, usize>>,
) -> Vec<(String, f64)> {
    let mut cand: Vec<(String, f64)> = Vec::new();
    for (t, tf) in batch {
        if *tf < MIN_BATCH_TF {
            continue;
        }
        if qterms.contains(t) {
            continue;
        }
        let d = lookup(idx, snapshot, df_map, t);
        let idf = idf(n, d);
        if idf > IDF_MIN {
            cand.push((t.clone(), idf));
        }
    }
    cand
}

/// 返回扩展词（未含 query 原词的、库内高判别词）。
/// `hits`：粗召回 top-K 候选（含 sim；仅 sim>0 的 case 参与词频统计）。
