        "  --max-tokens N       hard token ceiling; evidence floor wins, overflow is reported as\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "                       mode=overflow:evidence/fill, never silently drops evidence\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --structure 1        structural-aware neighborhood: fenced blocks, import/use/#include\n");
    s.push_str("                       blocks, stack-trace at-chains (default off, byte-identical to v0.4.1)\n");
    s.push_str("  --strict 1    HIGH-risk guard detects structural errors only (leading\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       error label / strong markers), not lines that merely mention\n",
    );
    s.push_str("                       'error' (default off = wide recall)\n");
    s.push_str("  --scoped 1     HIGH-risk guard only keeps error/marker lines inside the\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       evidence neighborhood (default off = keep all, byte-identical)\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --policy-file PATH   policy text override: ratio/context/window/elide/risk_gate/lineno/\n");
    s.push_str("                       max_tokens/structure; precedence CLI > file > DEFAULT\n");
    s.push_str("  --pipeline PATH      JSON pipeline config: plan/trim/anchor stage assembly\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       (config/bench/profiles/*.json); precedence CLI > file > DEFAULT\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "  --embed-cmd CMD      pluggable similarity backend: sh -c CMD reads Q\\t<query> then\n",
    );
    s.push_str("                       L\\t<line> on stdin, emits one score per line (default off, zero-dep)\n");
    s.push_str(
        "  --sim-weight F       weight of injected similarity in ranking (default 1.0; >=0)\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "  --minhash-weight F   weight of MinHash-LSH Jaccard recall in RRF fusion (default 0; >=0)\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --force P            keep lines matching substring (case-insensitive); prefix re: enters\n");
    s.push_str("                       a finite regex subset: | alternation, [..] classes, * + ? quantifiers\n");
    s.push_str(
        "  --fill-floor F       min score for context/fill lines (default 0 = current behavior);\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "                       F>0 drops low-value neighborhood/fill lines for deeper compression\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "  --trim 1             token-level trim of kept lines (default 0 = current behavior);\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "                       keeps numerics/structure anchors/query hits, drops stopwords\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "  --trim-ratio F       per-line token keep ratio for --trim (default 0.5; 0.1..=1.0)\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --trim-op-keep 1     keep arithmetic ops (+ = * -) as anchors in --trim\n");
    s.push_str("                       (default 0; GSM8K lossless optimum, enable 1 for code)\n");
    s.push_str("  --code-keep 1        keep ``` fenced code lines whole in --trim\n");
    s.push_str("                       (default 0; fence-aware line keep, prose-only trim)\n");
    s.push_str("  --num-line-keep 1    keep lines containing ASCII digits in --trim\n");
    s.push_str("  --sym-line-keep 1   keep fn/type signature lines in --trim\n");
    s.push_str("                       (default 0; long-code QA: digit lines carry answers)\n");
    s.push_str("  --preserve T         keep lines with builtin entity T (url/ip/email/errno); repeatable\n");
    s.push_str("  --evidence N|substr  declare must-keep evidence: positive int = line no, else substring;\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       repeatable; only meters ev_retention, never changes trimming\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --structure-anchors L comma-separated: json/xml/idoc/yaml/md; keep structural\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       boundary lines (braces/tags/keys/md headings) as anchors below evidence\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "  --redact L           comma-separated: secret/id-card/phone/email; redact before\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "                       compression (mask secrets/PII as <redacted>), audit to stderr\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --kind T             content-type tag: static-contract/system-definition/\n");
    s.push_str(
        "                       session-message/tool-output/auto (auto = infer from text);\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "                       per-kind default ratio unless --ratio given (default off =\n",
    );
    s.push_str("                       single tool-output bucket, byte-identical to v0.4.1)\n");
    #[cfg(feature = "semantic")]
    {
        s.push_str("  --semantic <weights>    optional neural re-score (cargo feature=semantic); weights file\n");
        s.push_str("                       self-describing JSON {schema,dim,weights,sha256}, SHA256 verified\n");
    }
    s.push_str(
        "  --store 1 --fix S    persist evidence block + fix conclusion into local memory\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  --recall K           side-channel recall from memory (mem: section)\n");
    s.push_str("  --json               structured JSON stats (outcome + dropped ledger)\n");
    s.push_str(
        "  --eval/--gate        replay frozen baseline / mechanical evidence gate (see config/)\n",
    );
    s.push_str("  file...              input file(s); stdin when none\n");
    s
}

pub(crate) fn value(
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
    name: &str,
    inline: Option<String>,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    if let Some(v) = inline {
        return Ok(v);
    }
    *i += 1;
    if *i >= args.len() {
        return Err(format!("{} requires a value", name));
    }
    let v = &args[*i];
    if v == "--" || v.starts_with("--") {
        return Err(format!(
            "{} requires a value (use {}=VALUE for values starting with --)",
            name, name
        ));
    }
    Ok(v.clone())
}

pub(crate) fn boolean(value: &str, name: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
    match value {
        "0" => Ok(false),
        "1" => Ok(true),
        _ => Err(format!("{} expects 0 or 1", name)),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn once<'a>(seen: &mut HashSet<&'a str>, name: &'a str) -> Result<(), String> {
    if seen.insert(name) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(format!("{name} specified more than once"))
    }
}

pub(crate) fn free(s: &mut ParseState, f: &Flag, v: String) {
    match f.name {
        "--query" => s.query = Some(v),
        "--fix" => s.fix = v,
        "--embed-cmd" => s.embed_cmd = Some(v),
        _ => s.mem_dir = v,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn path(s: &mut ParseState, f: &Flag, v: String) {
    match f.name {
        "--fix-file" => s.fix_file = Some(v),
        "--eval" => s.eval = Some(v),
        "--annotate-out" => s.annotate_out = Some(v),
        "--judge" => s.judge = Some(v),
        "--judge-by" => s.judge_by = Some(v),
        _ => s.delete = Some(v),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn output(s: &mut ParseState, name: &str) {
    match name {
        "--json" => s.json = true,
        "--stat" => s.stat = true,
        "--explain" => s.explain = true,
        _ => s.no_stats = true,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn house(s: &mut ParseState, name: &str) {
    match name {
        "--rebuild" => s.rebuild = true,
        _ => s.gc = true,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn evaluate(s: &mut ParseState, name: &str) {
    match name {
        "--annotate" => s.annotate = true,
        "--annotate-raw" => s.annotate_raw = true,
        "--gate" => s.eval_gate = true,
        "--gate-human" => s.eval_gate_human = true,
        _ => s.eval_gate_items = true,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn repeat(s: &mut ParseState, name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    match name {
        "--recall-only" => s.recall_only = true,
        "--recall-detail" => s.recall_detail = true,
        "--l1-hist" => s.l1_hist = true,
        "--stats" => s.stats = true,
        _ => {
            if s.eval.is_none() {
                return Err("--eval-verbose requires --eval <baseline.json>".to_string());
            }
            s.eval_verbose = true;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn flag(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    match f.kind {
        Kind::NoValue
        | Kind::Value
        | Kind::Force
        | Kind::RatePair
        | Kind::Evidence
        | Kind::Anchors
        | Kind::Redact
        | Kind::ContentType => raw(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::F64 | Kind::I64 | Kind::U64 | Kind::Bool01 => numeric(s, f, inline, args, i),
        #[cfg(feature = "semantic")]
        Kind::Semantic => weights(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::PolicyFile => policy(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Pipeline => pipeline(s, f, inline, args, i),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn raw(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    match f.kind {
        Kind::NoValue => none(s, f, inline),
        Kind::Value => word(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Force => force(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::RatePair => pair(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Evidence => evidence(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Anchors => anchors(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Redact => redact(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::ContentType => content_kind(s, f, inline, args, i),
        _ => unreachable!("valueish flag without handler: {}", f.name),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn numeric(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    match f.kind {
        Kind::F64 => float(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::I64 => signed(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::U64 => count(s, f, inline, args, i),
        Kind::Bool01 => either(s, f, inline, args, i),
        _ => unreachable!("numeric flag without handler: {}", f.name),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn none(s: &mut ParseState, f: &Flag, inline: Option<String>) -> Result<(), String> {
    if inline.is_some() {
        return Err(format!("{} does not take a value", f.name));
    }
    match f.name {
        "--json" | "--stat" | "--no-stats" | "--explain" => output(s, f.name),
        "--rebuild" | "--gc" => house(s, f.name),
        "--annotate" | "--annotate-raw" | "--gate" | "--gate-human" | "--gate-items" => {
            evaluate(s, f.name)
        }
        _ => repeat(s, f.name)?,
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn word(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if f.once {
        once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    }
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    if !f.err_empty.is_empty() && v.is_empty() {
        return Err(format!("{} {}", f.name, f.err_empty));
    }
    match f.name {
        "--query" | "--fix" | "--mem-dir" | "--embed-cmd" => free(s, f, v),
        _ => path(s, f, v),
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn float(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let parsed: f64 = v
        .parse()
        .map_err(|_| format!("{} expects {}, got {:?}", f.name, f.what, v))?;
    if !parsed.is_finite() {
        return Err(format!("{} expects {}, got {:?}", f.name, f.what, v));
    }
    match f.name {
        "--ratio" => {
            if !(Config::MIN_RATIO..=1.0).contains(&parsed) {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} must be a finite number in {}..=1.0",
                    f.name,
                    Config::MIN_RATIO
                ));
            }
            s.config.ratio = parsed;
        }
        "--sim-weight" => {
            if parsed < 0.0 {
                return Err(format!("{} must be a finite number >= 0", f.name));
            }
            s.config.sim_weight = parsed;
        }
        "--minhash-weight" => {
            if parsed < 0.0 {
                return Err(format!("{} must be a finite number >= 0", f.name));
            }
            s.minhash_weight = parsed;
        }
        "--fill-floor" => {
            if !(0.0..=crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR).contains(&parsed) {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} must be a finite number in 0..={}",
                    f.name,
                    crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR
                ));
            }
            s.config.fill_floor = parsed;
        }
        "--trim-ratio" => {
            if !(crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO..=crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO).contains(&parsed) {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} must be a finite number in {}..={}",
                    f.name,
                    crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO,
                    crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO
                ));
            }
            s.config.trim_ratio = parsed;
        }
        _ => unreachable!("F64 flag without arm: {}", f.name),
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn signed(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let parsed: i64 = v
        .parse()
        .map_err(|_| format!("{} expects {}, got {:?}", f.name, f.what, v))?;
    let max = if f.name == "--window" {
        Config::MAX_WINDOW
    } else {
        Config::MAX_CONTEXT
    };
    if !(0..=max).contains(&parsed) {
        return Err(format!("{} must be in 0..={}", f.name, max));
    }
    if f.name == "--window" {
        s.config.window = parsed.max(Config::MIN_WINDOW);
    } else {
        s.config.context = parsed;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn count(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let parsed: u64 = v
        .parse()
        .map_err(|_| format!("{} expects {}, got {:?}", f.name, f.what, v))?;
    if parsed < f.min {
        return Err(format!("{} {}", f.name, f.err_zero));
    }
    unsigned(s, f, parsed);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn unsigned(s: &mut ParseState, f: &Flag, parsed: u64) {
    match f.name {
        "--seed" => s.seed = parsed,
        "--annotate-max" => s.annotate_max = parsed as usize,
        "--recall" => s.recall = parsed as usize,
        "--max-bytes" => s.max_bytes = Some(parsed),
        "--max-tokens" => s.limit = Some(parsed),
        _ => unreachable!("U64 flag without arm: {}", f.name),
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "semantic")]
pub(crate) fn weights(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let w = crate::semantic::Weights::load(&v).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", f.name))?;
    s.config.semantic = Some(w);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn policy(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let path = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let body = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
        .map_err(|e| format!("{}: cannot read {}: {}", f.name, path, e))?;
    let entries = crate::toml::numbered(body.lines().enumerate().map(|(n, l)| (n + 1, l)));
    for le in entries {
        if !le.entry.section.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!(
                "{}: {}:{}: section [{}] not supported",
                f.name, path, le.line, le.entry.section
            ));
        }
        let key = le.entry.key;
        let v = le.entry.value;
        let Some(flag) = lookup(key) else {
            return Err(format!(
                "{}: {}:{}: unknown policy key `{}` (allowed: ratio/context/window/elide/risk_gate/scoped/strict/lineno/max_tokens/structure)",
                f.name, path, le.line, key
            ));
        };
        // CLI 显式参数优先：文件只填 DEFAULT 层（CLI 未指定的字段）。
        if s.seen.contains(flag) {
            continue;
        }
        apply(s, key, v, &path, le.line)?;
        // 记录来源：后续参数（如 --kind 的类型默认 ratio）不得覆盖文件值。
        s.sourced.insert(flag);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn pipeline(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let path = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let p = crate::pipeline::Pipeline::load(&path).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", f.name))?;
    // CLI 显式参数优先：文件只填 DEFAULT 层（CLI 未指定的字段）。
    let applied = p.apply(&mut s.config, &|flag| {
        s.seen.contains(flag) || s.sourced.contains(flag)
    });
    for flag in applied {
        s.sourced.insert(flag);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) const POLICY_TABLE: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("ratio", "--ratio"),
    ("context", "--context"),
    ("window", "--window"),
    ("elide", "--elide"),
    ("risk_gate", "--risk-gate"),
    ("scoped", "--scoped"),
    ("strict", "--strict"),
    ("lineno", "--lineno"),
    ("max_tokens", "--max-tokens"),
    ("structure", "--structure"),
    ("fill_floor", "--fill-floor"),
    ("trim", "--trim"),
    ("trim_ratio", "--trim-ratio"),
    ("trim_op_keep", "--trim-op-keep"),
    ("code_keep", "--code-keep"),
    ("zh_keep", "--zh-keep"),
    ("num_line_keep", "--num-line-keep"),
    ("sym_line_keep", "--sym-line-keep"),
];

pub(crate) fn lookup(key: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    POLICY_TABLE
        .iter()
        .find(|(k, _)| *k == key)
        .map(|(_, flag)| *flag)
}

pub(crate) fn apply(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    key: &str,
    v: &str,
    path: &str,
    line: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    match key {
        "ratio" | "context" | "window" => number(s, key, v, path, line)?,
        "elide" | "risk_gate" | "scoped" | "strict" | "lineno" | "structure" | "trim"
        | "trim_op_keep" | "code_keep" | "zh_keep" | "num_line_keep" | "sym_line_keep" => {
            toggle(s, key, v, path, line)?
        }
        "max_tokens" => tokens(s, v, path, line)?,
        "fill_floor" => fill_floor(s, v, path, line)?,
        "trim_ratio" => trim_ratio_key(s, v, path, line)?,
        _ => unreachable!("policy key whitelist"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn number(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    key: &str,
    v: &str,
    path: &str,
    line: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    match key {
        "ratio" => ratio(s, v, path, line),
        "context" => context(s, v, path, line),
        "window" => window(s, v, path, line),
        _ => unreachable!("numeric policy key whitelist"),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn error(path: &str, line: usize, msg: String) -> String {
    format!("--policy-file: {path}:{line}: {msg}")
}

pub(crate) fn ratio(s: &mut ParseState, v: &str, path: &str, line: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    let r: f64 = crate::toml::float(v)
        .ok_or_else(|| error(path, line, format!("ratio must be a finite f64, got {v:?}")))?;
    if !(crate::policy::MIN_RATIO..=1.0).contains(&r) {
        return Err(error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("ratio must be in {}..=1.0", crate::policy::MIN_RATIO),
        ));
    }
    s.config.ratio = r;
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn context(s: &mut ParseState, v: &str, path: &str, line: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    let c = range(v, 0, crate::policy::MAX_CONTEXT).ok_or_else(|| {
        error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("context must be 0..={}", crate::policy::MAX_CONTEXT),
        )
    })?;
    s.config.context = c;
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn window(s: &mut ParseState, v: &str, path: &str, line: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    // 与 CLI 同口径：文档契约为 0..=8，0 归一化为 1（此前策略文件拒绝 0，
    // 与 `--window 0` 行为不一致）。
    let w = range(v, 0, crate::policy::MAX_WINDOW).ok_or_else(|| {
        error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("window must be 0..={}", crate::policy::MAX_WINDOW),
        )
    })?;
    s.config.window = w.max(crate::policy::MIN_WINDOW);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn toggle(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    key: &str,
    v: &str,
    path: &str,
    line: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let b = zero(v).ok_or_else(|| error(path, line, format!("{key} must be 0/1")))?;
    match key {
        "elide" => s.config.elide = b,
        "risk_gate" => s.config.gate = b,
        "scoped" => s.config.scoped = b,
        "strict" => s.config.strict = b,
        "lineno" => s.config.lineno = b,
        "structure" => s.config.structure = b,
        "trim" => s.config.trim = b,
        "trim_op_keep" => s.config.trim_op_keep = b,
        "code_keep" => s.config.code_keep = b,
        "zh_keep" => s.config.zh_keep = b,
        "num_line_keep" => s.config.num_line_keep = b,
        "sym_line_keep" => s.config.sym_line_keep = b,
        _ => unreachable!("bool policy key whitelist"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn tokens(s: &mut ParseState, v: &str, path: &str, line: usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    let m: usize = crate::toml::size(v).ok_or_else(|| {
        error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("max_tokens must be a non-negative integer, got {v:?}"),
        )
    })?;
    s.config.limit = Some(m);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn fill_floor(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    v: &str,
    path: &str,
    line: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let f: f64 = crate::toml::float(v).ok_or_else(|| {
        error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("fill_floor must be a finite f64, got {v:?}"),
        )
    })?;
    if !(0.0..=crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR).contains(&f) {
        return Err(error(
            path,
            line,
            format!(
                "fill_floor must be in 0..={}",
                crate::policy::MAX_FILL_FLOOR
            ),
        ));
    }
    s.config.fill_floor = f;
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn trim_ratio_key(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    v: &str,
    path: &str,
    line: usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let f: f64 = crate::toml::float(v).ok_or_else(|| {
        error(
            path,
            line,
            format!("trim_ratio must be a finite f64, got {v:?}"),
        )
    })?;
    if !(crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO..=crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO).contains(&f) {
        return Err(error(
            path,
            line,
            format!(
                "trim_ratio must be in {}..={}",
                crate::policy::MIN_TRIM_RATIO,
                crate::policy::MAX_TRIM_RATIO
            ),
        ));
    }
    s.config.trim_ratio = f;
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn zero(v: &str) -> Option<bool> {
    match v {
        "0" => Some(false),
        "1" => Some(true),
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub(crate) fn range(v: &str, lo: i64, hi: i64) -> Option<i64> {
    let n: i64 = v.parse().ok()?;
    (lo..=hi).contains(&n).then_some(n)
}

pub(crate) fn either(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let b = boolean(&v, f.name)?;
    match f.name {
        "--elide" => s.config.elide = b,
        "--risk-gate" => s.config.gate = b,
        "--scoped" => s.config.scoped = b,
        "--strict" => s.config.strict = b,
        "--lineno" => s.config.lineno = b,
        "--structure" => s.config.structure = b,
        "--trim" => s.config.trim = b,
        "--trim-op-keep" => s.config.trim_op_keep = b,
        "--code-keep" => s.config.code_keep = b,
        "--zh-keep" => s.config.zh_keep = b,
        "--num-line-keep" => s.config.num_line_keep = b,
        "--sym-line-keep" => s.config.sym_line_keep = b,
        _ => s.store = b,
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) const PRESERVE_PATTERNS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("url", "re://"), // 任意协议 ://（http/https/postgres/mysql/redis/...）
    ("ip", "re:[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"), // IPv4 点分十进制
    ("email", "re:[a-z0-9._%+-]+@"), // email local part + @
    ("errno", "re:errno[= ]*[0-9]+"), // errno=28 / errno 28
];

pub(crate) fn preserve_into(config: &mut Config, ty: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let ty = ty.trim();
    if ty.is_empty() {
        return Err("preserve requires a type (url/ip/email/errno)".to_string());
    }
    let pat = PRESERVE_PATTERNS
        .iter()
        .find(|(name, _)| *name == ty)
        .map(|(_, p)| *p)
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            let allowed: Vec<&str> = PRESERVE_PATTERNS.iter().map(|(n, _)| *n).collect();
            format!(
                "preserve unknown type {ty:?} (allowed: {})",
                allowed.join("/")
            )
        })?;
    config.forces.push(pat.to_string());
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn force(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    if f.name == "--preserve" {
        preserve_into(&mut s.config, &v).map_err(|e| format!("{} {}", f.name, e))?;
        return Ok(());
    }
    let trimmed = v.trim();
    // 引擎（compress::forces）先整体小写再识别 `re:` 前缀，此处必须同口径校验，
    // 否则 `RE:[` 之类会绕过前置校验，在引擎侧触发断言/静默丢弃。
    if let Some(rest) = trimmed.to_lowercase().strip_prefix("re:") {
        // `re:` 前缀：整个值是单个正则，`|` 是正则交替不拆分。CLI 层前置
        // 校验手写正则子集，非法即报错拒绝运行。
        if rest.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!("{} {}", f.name, f.err_empty));
        }
        crate::regex::parse(rest).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", f.name))?;
    } else if v.split('|').all(|p| p.trim().is_empty()) {
        return Err(format!("{} {}", f.name, f.err_empty));
    }
    s.config.forces.push(v);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn evidence(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let trimmed = v.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        return Err(format!("{} {}", f.name, f.err_empty));
    }
    let ev = match trimmed.parse::<usize>() {
        Ok(n) if n >= 1 => crate::Evidence::Line(n),
        _ => crate::Evidence::Substr(trimmed.to_string()),
    };
    s.config.evidence.push(ev);
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn anchors(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    for part in v.split(',') {
        let p = part.trim();
        if p.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        match crate::AnchorKind::parse(p) {
            Some(k) if !s.config.structure_anchors.contains(&k) => {
                s.config.structure_anchors.push(k);
            }
            Some(_) => {}
            None => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} unknown anchor type {p:?} (allowed: json/xml/idoc/yaml/md)",
                    f.name
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn redact(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    for part in v.split(',') {
        let p = part.trim();
        if p.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        match crate::redact::RedactKind::parse(p) {
            Some(k) if !s.redact.contains(&k) => {
                s.redact.push(k);
            }
            Some(_) => {}
            None => {
                return Err(format!(
                    "{} unknown redact kind {p:?} (allowed: secret/id-card/phone/email)",
                    f.name
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn content_kind(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let v = v.trim();
    if v == "auto" {
        s.kind_auto = true;
        return Ok(());
    }
    let kind: crate::ContentType = v.parse().map_err(|_| {
        format!(
            "{} expects static-contract/system-definition/session-message/tool-output/auto, got {v:?}",
            f.name
        )
    })?;
    s.config.kind = kind;
    // 优先级 CLI > 策略文件 > 类型默认：`--ratio` 无论来自 CLI 还是文件，
    // 都不得被类型默认值覆盖（此前文件值在 --kind 之后出现时会被静默覆盖）。
    if !s.seen.contains("--ratio") && !s.sourced.contains("--ratio") {
        s.config.ratio = kind.default_ratio();
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn pair(
    s: &mut ParseState,
    f: &Flag,
    inline: Option<String>,
    args: &[String],
    i: &mut usize,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    once(&mut s.seen, f.name)?;
    let v = value(args, i, f.name, inline)?;
    let good = match v.as_str() {
        "good" => true,
        "bad" => false,
        _ => return Err("--rate expects good or bad".to_string()),
    };
    let id = value(args, i, f.name, None)?;
    if id.is_empty() {
        return Err("--rate requires a case-id".to_string());
    }
    s.rate = Some((good, id));
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn idle(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.rate.is_none()
        && !s.rebuild
        && !s.gc
        && s.delete.is_none()
        && s.eval.is_none()
        && !s.l1_hist
        && !s.stats
        && s.judge.is_none()
}

pub(crate) fn exempt(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    !s.annotate && !s.annotate_raw
}

pub(crate) fn query(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    let query_empty = s.query.as_deref().unwrap_or("").is_empty();
    if idle(s) && exempt(s) && query_empty && s.config.forces.is_empty() {
        return Err("missing --query (or provide at least one --force pattern)".to_string());
    }
    if s.recall_only && query_empty {
        return Err("--recall-only requires --query".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn judge(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    if s.judge.is_some() && (s.annotate || s.annotate_raw || s.eval.is_some()) {
        return Err("--judge cannot be combined with --annotate/--annotate-raw/--eval".to_string());
    }
    if s.judge_by.is_some() && s.judge.is_none() {
        return Err("--judge-by requires --judge".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn annotation(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    if conflict(s) {
        return Err(
            "--annotate/--annotate-raw cannot be combined with --eval/--l1-hist".to_string(),
        );
    }
    if s.annotate && s.annotate_raw {
        return Err("--annotate and --annotate-raw are mutually exclusive".to_string());
    }
    if missing(s) {
        return Err("--annotate-out/--seed/--annotate-max require --annotate".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn conflict(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    (s.annotate || s.annotate_raw) && (s.eval.is_some() || s.l1_hist)
}

pub(crate) fn missing(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    (s.annotate_out.is_some() || s.seen.contains("--seed") || s.seen.contains("--annotate-max"))
        && !(s.annotate || s.annotate_raw)
}

pub(crate) fn actions(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    let actions = [
        s.rate.is_some(),
        s.rebuild,
        s.gc,
        s.delete.is_some(),
        s.eval.is_some(),
        s.l1_hist,
        s.stats,
        s.annotate || s.annotate_raw,
        s.judge.is_some(),
        s.recall_only,
    ];
    if actions.iter().filter(|active| **active).count() > 1 {
        return Err("action options are mutually exclusive; choose one".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn gates(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    let gate_count = [s.eval_gate, s.eval_gate_human, s.eval_gate_items]
        .iter()
        .filter(|v| **v)
        .count();
    if gate_count > 0 && s.eval.is_none() {
        return Err("--gate/--gate-human/--gate-items requires --eval <baseline.json>".to_string());
    }
    if gate_count > 1 {
        return Err("--gate, --gate-human and --gate-items are mutually exclusive".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn store(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    if fix(s) {
        return Err("--fix requires --store 1".to_string());
    }
    if file(s) {
        return Err("--fix-file requires --store 1".to_string());
    }
    if bytes(s) {
        return Err("--max-bytes requires --store 1".to_string());
    }
    if clash(s) {
        return Err("--fix and --fix-file are mutually exclusive".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn fix(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.seen.contains("--fix") && !s.store
}

pub(crate) fn file(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.fix_file.is_some() && !s.store
}

pub(crate) fn bytes(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.max_bytes.is_some() && !s.store
}

pub(crate) fn clash(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.seen.contains("--fix") && s.fix_file.is_some()
}

pub(crate) fn recall(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    if s.recall_only && s.store {
        return Err("--recall-only cannot be combined with --store 1".to_string());
    }
    if s.recall_detail && s.recall == 0 && !s.recall_only {
        return Err("--recall-detail requires --recall or --recall-only".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn check(s: &ParseState) -> Result<(), String> {
    if stat(s) {
        return Err("--stat and --no-stats cannot be used together".to_string());
    }
    type Check = fn(&ParseState) -> Result<(), String>;
    pub(crate) const CHECKS: [Check; 7] = [query, judge, annotation, actions, gates, store, recall];
    for check in CHECKS {
        check(s)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn stat(s: &ParseState) -> bool {
    s.stat && s.no_stats
}

pub(crate) fn finish(s: ParseState) -> Opts {
    let recall = if s.recall_only && !s.seen.contains("--recall") {
        3 // recall-only 未指定 K 时默认 top-3（与主流程 --recall 语义一致）
    } else {
        s.recall
    };
    let mut config = s.config;
    // 仅 CLI 显式 `--max-tokens` 覆盖（优先级 CLI > 文件 > DEFAULT）；
    // 未显式时保留 `--policy-file` 写入的值，避免 None 覆盖文件设置。
    if s.seen.contains("--max-tokens") {
        config.limit = s.limit.map(|v| v as usize);
    }
    Opts {
        query: s.query.unwrap_or_default(),
        config,
        json: s.json,
        stat: s.stat,
        no_stats: s.no_stats,
        explain: s.explain,
        store: s.store,
        fix: s.fix,
        fix_file: s.fix_file,
        recall,
        recall_only: s.recall_only,
        recall_detail: s.recall_detail,
        rate: s.rate,
        rebuild: s.rebuild,
        gc: s.gc,
        delete: s.delete,
        eval: s.eval,
        eval_verbose: s.eval_verbose,
        eval_gate: s.eval_gate,
        eval_gate_human: s.eval_gate_human,
        eval_gate_items: s.eval_gate_items,
        l1_hist: s.l1_hist,
        stats: s.stats,
        annotate: s.annotate,
        annotate_raw: s.annotate_raw,
        annotate_out: s.annotate_out,
        seed: s.seed,
        annotate_max: s.annotate_max,
        judge: s.judge,
        judge_by: s.judge_by,
        max_bytes: s.max_bytes,
        mem_dir: s.mem_dir,
        files: s.files,
        embed_cmd: s.embed_cmd,
        minhash_weight: s.minhash_weight,
        redact: s.redact,
        kind_auto: s.kind_auto,
        ratio_explicit: s.seen.contains("--ratio"),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn all(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Opts, String> {
    let mut s = ParseState::new();
    let mut i = 0usize;
    while i < args.len() {
        if args[i] == "--" {
            s.files.extend(args[i + 1..].iter().cloned());
            break;
        }
        one(&mut s, &args, &mut i)?;
        i += 1;
    }
    check(&s)?;
    Ok(finish(s))
}

pub(crate) fn one(s: &mut ParseState, args: &[String], i: &mut usize) -> Result<(), String> {
    let raw = &args[*i];
    let (name, inline) = split(raw);
    match find(name) {
        Some(f) => flag(s, f, inline, args, i),
        None if option(raw) => Err(format!("unknown option: {}", raw)),
        None => {
            s.files.push(raw.clone());
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn split(raw: &str) -> (&str, Option<String>) {
    match raw.split_once('=') {
        Some((n, v)) if n.starts_with("--") => (n, Some(v.to_string())),
        _ => (raw, None),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn option(raw: &str) -> bool {
    raw.starts_with("--") || (raw.starts_with('-') && raw.len() > 1)
}

//! 类型路由 + 分桶压缩（P1 治理层）。
//!
//! 把全量上下文载荷按 [`ContentType`] 分桶，复用 [`crate::compress_bucketed`]
//! 逐桶压缩（各桶按价值梯度 ratio），聚合到单一 [`Outcome`]（`buckets` 携带逐桶
//! 统计）。本层是薄壳，不复制裁剪逻辑；分桶类型缺失时走隐式推断。

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use crate::{compress_bucketed, ContentType};

/// `scx bucket` 入口：读 stdin 类型化载荷 JSON，分桶压缩输出 `Outcome` JSON；
/// `--record` 追加收益记录。
pub fn run(args: &[String]) -> i32 {
    let mut record_path: Option<&str> = None;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < args.len() {
        match args[i].as_str() {
            "--record" => {
                i += 1;
                let Some(p) = args.get(i) else {
                    eprintln!("scx bucket: --record requires a path");
                    return 2;
                };
                record_path = Some(p.as_str());
            }
            other => {
                eprintln!("scx bucket: unknown argument {other}");
                return 2;
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    let mut input = String::new();
    if std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut input).is_err() {
        eprintln!("scx bucket: read stdin failed");
        return 2;
    }
    let (query, parts) = match parse_manifest(&input) {
        Ok(x) => x,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("scx bucket: {e}");
            return 2;
        }
    };
    let refs: Vec<(ContentType, &str)> = parts.iter().map(|(t, s)| (*t, s.as_str())).collect();
    let cfg = crate::Config::default();
    let outcome = compress_bucketed(&refs, &query, &cfg);
    if let Err(e) = crate::ops::out_line(&crate::ops::render(&outcome)) {
        eprintln!("scx bucket: write stdout failed: {e}");
        return 1;
    }
    if let Some(path) = record_path {
        // 收益记录写 Snapshot JSONL（与 `scx ledger --summarize` 同格式、确定性、无 wall-clock）。
        let snap = crate::meter::measure(0, &refs, &query, &cfg, None);
        record(path, &snap);
    }
    0
}

/// 解析 stdin 类型化载荷 JSON：`{query, parts:[{type?,text}]}`；`type` 缺失时隐式推断。
fn parse_manifest(input: &str) -> Result<(String, Vec<(ContentType, String)>), String> {
    let v = crate::json::parse(input).map_err(|e| format!("parse: {e}"))?;
    let query = v
        .get("query")
        .and_then(crate::json::Json::str)
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_string();
    let arr = v.get("parts").ok_or("missing parts array")?;
    let crate::json::Json::Arr(arr) = arr else {
        return Err("missing parts array".to_string());
    };
    let mut parts = Vec::with_capacity(arr.len());
    for p in arr {
        let text = p
            .get("text")
            .and_then(crate::json::Json::str)
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_string();
        let tag = p.get("type").and_then(crate::json::Json::str);
        let ty = ContentType::resolve(tag, &text);
        parts.push((ty, text));
    }
    Ok((query, parts))
}

/// 追加一条快照 JSONL 到账本文件（供 `scx ledger --summarize` 聚合），失败静默
/// （账本是旁路，不影响压缩正文/统计/退出码）。
fn record(path: &str, snap: &crate::meter::Snapshot) {
    use std::io::Write;
    let line = format!("{}\n", crate::meter::render(snap));
    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open(path)
    {
        let _ = f.write_all(line.as_bytes());
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn text() -> String {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = (0..200)
            .map(|i| format!("filler alpha beta line {i}"))
            .collect();
        lines[100] = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a".to_string();
        lines.join("\n")
    }

    #[test]
    fn compress_bucketed_aggregates_and_buckets() {
        let t = text();
        let parts = [
            (ContentType::StaticContract, t.as_str()),
            (ContentType::ToolOutput, t.as_str()),
        ];
        let o = compress_bucketed(&parts, "db timeout", &crate::Config::default());
        assert_eq!(o.buckets.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(o.buckets[0].kind, ContentType::StaticContract);
        assert_eq!(o.buckets[1].kind, ContentType::ToolOutput);
        assert!(o.tokens_in > 0.0);
        assert!(o.tokens < o.tokens_in);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_manifest_infers_missing_type() {
        let input = r#"{"query":"db timeout","parts":[{"text":"{\"type\":\"object\"}"},{"text":"INFO heartbeat ok"}]}"#;
        let (_, parts) = parse_manifest(input).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(parts[0].0, ContentType::StaticContract);
        assert_eq!(parts[1].0, ContentType::ToolOutput);
    }
}

//! compress 引擎主体：证据筛选压缩的完整算法。
//!
//! 纯函数、无 I/O、无随机源；本文件不定义 Config/Outcome（在 crate 根），只实现
//! 从文本到压缩结果的单趟管线。管线拆分为独立阶段函数（切行 / 扫描 / 折叠 /
//! 权重 / 种子 / 区域 / 打分 / 邻域 / 落地 / 预算 / 审计 / 守卫 / 渲染），
//! 各阶段函数圈复杂度 < 10；可调参数与加分权重全部声明于 `policy` 表，
//! 不在函数体内硬编码。独立成文件以维持 crate 根 <500 行门禁。

use crate::analysis::error_line;
use crate::policy::{DEFAULT_RISK, DEFAULT_SCORES};
use crate::terms::terms;
use crate::{prefix, Config, Mode, Outcome, Risk};

/// 确定性快速哈希（FxHash 风格）：压缩内核的查找/计数型 map 统一使用，
/// 避免 std SipHash 的随机种子破坏“同输入同输出”的确定性承诺，同时更快。
/// 使用方均为“先查表计数、按键引用或排序输出”，不依赖裸迭代顺序。
mod plan;
mod render;
mod score;
use plan::*;
use render::*;
use score::*;

mod hash {
    use std::hash::{BuildHasherDefault, Hasher as Digest};

    /// rustc 内部 FxHasher 的等价实现（乘法散列，零依赖）。
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub(crate) struct Hasher {
        hash: u64,
    }

    const SEED: u64 = 0x517c_c1b7_2722_0a95;

    impl Hasher {
        #[inline]
        fn add(&mut self, word: u64) {
            self.hash = (self.hash.rotate_left(5) ^ word).wrapping_mul(SEED);
        }
    }

    impl Digest for Hasher {
        #[inline]
        fn finish(&self) -> u64 {
            self.hash
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
            let mut chunks = bytes.chunks_exact(8);
            for c in &mut chunks {
                self.add(u64::from_ne_bytes(c.try_into().unwrap()));
            }
            let rest = chunks.remainder();
            if !rest.is_empty() {
                let mut last = [0u8; 8];
                last[..rest.len()].copy_from_slice(rest);
                self.add(u64::from_ne_bytes(last));
            }
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write_u8(&mut self, i: u8) {
            self.add(i as u64);
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write_u16(&mut self, i: u16) {
            self.add(i as u64);
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write_u32(&mut self, i: u32) {
            self.add(i as u64);
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write_u64(&mut self, i: u64) {
            self.add(i);
        }

        #[inline]
        fn write_usize(&mut self, i: usize) {
            self.add(i as u64);
        }
    }

    pub(crate) type Build = BuildHasherDefault<Hasher>;
    pub(crate) type Hash<K, V> = std::collections::HashMap<K, V, Build>;
}
fn chars(text: &str) -> usize {
    if text.is_ascii() {
        text.len()
    } else {
        text.chars().count()
    }
}
pub(crate) fn lines<'b, 'a: 'b>(text: &'a str, buf: &'b mut Option<String>) -> Vec<&'b str> {
    let src: &str = if text.contains('\r') {
        buf.replace(text.replace("\r\n", "\n"));
        buf.as_ref().unwrap().as_str()
    } else {
        text
    };
    let mut lines: Vec<&str> = src.split('\n').collect();
    if lines.last().is_some_and(|l| l.is_empty()) {
        lines.pop();
    }
    lines
}
pub(crate) enum Force {
    /// 字面子串（大小写不敏感，对小写缓冲匹配）。
    Sub(String),
    /// 手写正则（已解析并预编译；非法模式不参与匹配，CLI 层解析时已报错）。
    Re(crate::regex::Compiled),
}
fn forces(forces: &[String]) -> Vec<Force> {
    let mut pats: Vec<Force> = Vec::new();
    for f in forces {
        let p = f.trim().to_lowercase();
        if p.starts_with("re:") {
            if !p.is_empty() {
                force(&mut pats, p);
            }
        } else {
            for part in f.split('|') {
                let p = part.trim().to_lowercase();
                if !p.is_empty() {
                    force(&mut pats, p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    pats
}
fn force(pats: &mut Vec<Force>, p: String) {
    if let Some(rest) = p.strip_prefix("re:") {
        match crate::regex::parse(rest) {
            Ok(node) => pats.push(Force::Re(crate::regex::compile(&node))),
            Err(e) => {
                // CLI（args::parse_force）已前置校验；库内核绕过 CLI
                // 直接构造 Config 时，非法模式不参与匹配（debug 断言提示）。
                debug_assert!(false, "invalid re: force pattern: {e}");
            }
        }
    } else {
        pats.push(Force::Sub(p));
    }
}
pub fn compress(text: &str, query: &str, cfg: &Config) -> Outcome {
    let (ratio, context, window) = config(cfg);
    let kind = cfg.kind;
    // --max-tokens 保守上界：可选填充预算按「用户上限 ÷ 安全系数」计（宁高估勿超预算）；
    // 证据地板/守卫溢出诊断仍按诚实上限（cfg.limit），不翻转模式标签。
    let budget_limit = cfg
        .limit
        .map(|m| m as f64 / crate::terms::BUDGET_SAFETY_FACTOR);
    // 分析使用 LF 归一化文本；passthrough/fail-open 返回输入原文，保持“原样保留”语义。
    let original = text;
    // 零拷贝快路径：无 CR 时直接借用原文本；行以 &str 切片保存，避免整文复制与逐行分配。
    let mut nl_buf: Option<String> = None;
    let lines = lines(original, &mut nl_buf);
    let uniq_terms = terms(query);
    let force_pats = forces(&cfg.forces);
    let total = lines.len();
    // token 估算只服务小输入直通与可选预算；针尖档大盘无需整份扫描。
    // 小输入先算一次即可（随后可能直接 passthrough）；大输入把估算并入
    // 逐行分析循环，避免为同一批行再走一趟缓存。
    let small_tok = survey(&lines, total);
    let chars_a = chars(original);
    let evidence = &cfg.evidence;
    // 输入 token 估算只依赖原文，且 Outcome.tokens_in 与单桶 tokens_in 同值：
    // 算一次共用（CJK 输入上 estimate 是整篇 O(n) 扫描）。
    let tokens_in = crate::terms::estimate(original);

    let mk = |text_owned: String,
              kept: usize,
              chars_b: usize,
              cut: f64,
              dup: usize,
              seeds: usize,
              risk: Risk,
              guarded: u8,
              regions: usize,
              numbers: Vec<usize>,
              mode: Mode,
              limit: Option<usize>,
              tokens: f64,
              dropped: Vec<crate::Dropped>|
     -> Outcome {
        let ev = ev_retention(evidence, &numbers, &text_owned, kept, total);
        let tokens_out = crate::terms::estimate(&text_owned);
        Outcome {
            text: text_owned,
            numbers,
            kept,
            total,
            input: chars_a,
            output: chars_b,
            cut,
            dup,
            seeds,
            evidence: seeds,
            risk,
            guarded,
            regions,
            window,
            terms: uniq_terms.len(),
            forced: force_pats.len(),
            mode,
            limit,
            tokens,
            tokens_in,
            dropped,
            budget_used_pct: 0.0,
            ev_retention: ev,
            buckets: vec![crate::BucketStat {
                kind,
                tokens_in,
                tokens_out,
                kept,
                total,
                mode,
            }],
            explain: Vec::new(),
        }
    };

    // 直通早退：小输入 / 超长行（无查询参与，原样返回）。
    if let Some(mode) = shape(total, small_tok, &lines) {
        return mk(
            original.to_string(),
            total,
            chars_a,
            0.0,
            0,
            0,
            Risk::Low,
            0,
            0,
            Vec::new(),
            mode,
            cfg.limit,
            0.0,
            Vec::new(),
        );
    }

    let do_tok = total >= crate::policy::SMALL_LINES && context != 0;
    let masks = masks(
        &lines,
        &uniq_terms,
        &force_pats,
        small_tok,
        do_tok,
        cfg.strict,
    );
    let (dup, folds) = dedup(
        &lines,
        &masks.mask,
        masks.words,
        &masks.errs,
        &masks.pinned,
        cfg.code_keep,
    );
    let stat = weights(&masks.mask, masks.words, &dup, uniq_terms.len(), folds);
    let seeds = marks(
        &masks.mask,
        masks.words,
        &dup,
        &stat.df,
        &stat.weights,
        stat.rare_thr,
        &masks.pinned,
    );
    let seeds_total = (0..total).filter(|&i| seeds.seed[i]).count();

    // 无信号 fail-open：零命中且无 --force 命中 => 原样保留。
    if failopen(seeds.hit_lines, seeds.force_any) {
        return mk(
            original.to_string(),
            total,
            chars_a,
            0.0,
            folds,
            seeds_total,
            Risk::Low,
            0,
            0,
            Vec::new(),
            Mode::FailOpenZeroSignal,
            cfg.limit,
            0.0,
            Vec::new(),
        );
    }

    // 结构感知邻域（--structure 1）：fence/import/堆栈区域整段并入种子区域。
    let regions = spans(cfg, &seeds.seed, window as usize, total, &lines);
    #[cfg_attr(not(feature = "semantic"), allow(unused_mut))]
    let mut scores = scores(
        &lines,
        &dup,
        &seeds.hits,
        &seeds.sumw,
        &masks.errs,
        &masks.pinned,
        &DEFAULT_SCORES,
    );
    // 语义增强（可选）：feature=semantic 且显式加载权重时，对非 dup 候选行
    // 叠加 sigmoid 打分作为排序加分；不启用时与 v0.4.1 逐字节一致。
    semantic(cfg, &lines, &uniq_terms, total, &dup, &mut scores);
    apply_sims(cfg, &mut scores, &dup, total);
    let boost = boost(&scores, &dup, window as usize, &DEFAULT_SCORES);
    // 逐行保留原因（--explain 用）：0=删除，其余见 R_* 常量。
    let mut reason = vec![0u8; total];
    let (mut keep, mut kept) = floor(
        &seeds.seed,
        context,
        total,
        &scores,
        cfg.fill_floor,
        &mut reason,
    );

    // 结构锚点（P6 骨架保护）：结构边界行无条件保留，优先级低于证据（seed/context）、
    // 高于可选填充。默认空 kinds 时为空操作，与现状逐字节一致。
    mark_structure_anchors(cfg, &lines, &mut keep, &mut kept, &mut reason);

    // 行保护策略（--code-keep / --num-line-keep / --sym-line-keep / --zh-keep）：
    // 整行保留并标记 raw（render 跳过行内 trim）。默认全 0 时为空操作，与现状逐字节一致。
    let mut raw = vec![false; total];
    if cfg.code_keep || cfg.num_line_keep || cfg.sym_line_keep || cfg.zh_keep {
        apply_keep_policies(
            cfg,
            &lines,
            &dup,
            &mut keep,
            &mut kept,
            &mut reason,
            &mut raw,
        );
    }

    // --max-tokens 硬上限：证据地板最高优先。证据 + 最小邻域先落，其 token
    // 估算超限时直接进入 OverflowEvidence（保留全部证据，如实报告），不再
    // 填充可选内容；未超限时可选填充受 `min(budget, max - floor)` 双重约束。
    let tok_floor = tokens(&lines, &keep, &masks.tok);
    let mut overflow = cap(tok_floor, cfg.limit);

    // --context 0（针尖模式）：完全跳过可选预算填充，只保留证据行与守卫行。
    let used_optional = optional(
        &Select {
            lines: &lines,
            scores: &scores,
            boost: &boost,
            dup: &dup,
            in_region: &regions.in_region,
            struct_region: &regions.struct_region,
            tok: &masks.tok,
        },
        &Fill {
            region_gate: regions.gate,
            total_tok: masks.total_tok,
            ratio,
            edge_head: DEFAULT_SCORES.edge_head,
            remaining: remaining(tok_floor, budget_limit),
            floor: cfg.fill_floor,
        },
        context,
        overflow,
        &mut keep,
        &mut kept,
        &mut reason,
    );
    // 可选预算利用率（%）：实际填充 ÷ 预算上限，展示 `--ratio` 的实际作用。
    // 与 fill 同口径（budget = max(total_tok × ratio, BUDGET_MIN)）。
    let budget_used_pct = budget_used(used_optional, masks.total_tok, ratio);

    let risk = audit(&keep, &masks.errs, &seeds.hits, &DEFAULT_RISK);
    let mut guarded = 0u8;
    if active(risk, cfg) {
        let scoped = cfg.scoped.then_some(regions.in_region.as_slice());
        guarded = guard(
            &mut keep,
            &mut kept,
            &dup,
            &masks.guards,
            &masks.marked,
            scoped,
            &mut reason,
        );
    }

    // 守卫后最终检查：填充受上限约束，但风险守卫可能追加证据性行；如实报告 OverflowFill。
    let final_tok = tokens(&lines, &keep, &masks.tok);
    if overflow.is_none() {
        overflow = last(final_tok, cfg.limit);
    }

    // 预算过紧或只有高频单查询命中时可能选不出任何行；此时回退原文，不返回静默空结果。
    if kept == 0 {
        return mk(
            original.to_string(),
            total,
            chars_a,
            0.0,
            folds,
            seeds_total,
            risk,
            0,
            regions.count,
            Vec::new(),
            Mode::PassNoKept,
            cfg.limit,
            0.0,
            Vec::new(),
        );
    }

    let (out_text, numbers) = render(&lines, &keep, cfg, &raw, &uniq_terms);
    let (chars_b, cut) = cut(&out_text, chars_a);
    let mut o = mk(
        out_text,
        kept,
        chars_b,
        cut,
        folds,
        seeds_total,
        risk,
        guarded,
        regions.count,
        numbers,
        overflow.unwrap_or(Mode::Sieve),
        cfg.limit,
        final_tok,
        runs(&keep, &dup, overflow.is_some()),
    );
    o.budget_used_pct = budget_used_pct;
    o.explain = explain(&reason, &dup);
    o
}
pub fn compress_bucketed(
    parts: &[(crate::ContentType, &str)],
    query: &str,
    cfg: &Config,
) -> Outcome {
    let mut out_text = String::new();
    let mut buckets = Vec::with_capacity(parts.len());
    let (mut tin, mut tout) = (0.0, 0.0);
    let (mut cin, mut cout) = (0usize, 0usize);
    let (mut kept, mut total) = (0usize, 0usize);
    for (kind, text) in parts {
        let mut c = cfg.clone();
        c.ratio = kind.default_ratio();
        let o = compress(text, query, &c);
        let tok_out = crate::terms::estimate(&o.text);
        buckets.push(crate::BucketStat {
            kind: *kind,
            tokens_in: o.tokens_in,
            tokens_out: tok_out,
            kept: o.kept,
            total: o.total,
            mode: o.mode,
        });
        tin += o.tokens_in;
        tout += tok_out;
        cin += o.input;
        cout += o.output;
        kept += o.kept;
        total += o.total;
        out_text.push_str(&o.text);
        if !o.text.is_empty() && !o.text.ends_with('\n') {
            out_text.push('\n');
        }
    }
    let cut = if cin > 0 {
        (cin as f64 - cout as f64) * 100.0 / cin as f64
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    Outcome {
        text: out_text,
        numbers: Vec::new(),
        kept,
        total,
        input: cin,
        output: cout,
        cut,
        dup: 0,
        seeds: 0,
        evidence: 0,
        risk: Risk::Low,
        guarded: 0,
        regions: 0,
        window: cfg.window,
        terms: 0,
        forced: 0,
        mode: Mode::Sieve,
        limit: cfg.limit,
        tokens: tout,
        tokens_in: tin,
        dropped: Vec::new(),
        budget_used_pct: 0.0,
        ev_retention: 1.0,
        buckets,
        explain: Vec::new(),
    }
}
/// 行保护策略整体应用（--code-keep / --num-line-keep / --sym-line-keep 三段，
/// 语义与内联时逐字节一致；raw 标记行在 render 跳过行内 trim）。
// 四个平级策略段落（code/num/sym/zh keep）共用同一签名；每段是独立声明式
// 策略，拆函数反而损害可读性，故按项目圈复杂度偏好（<10，当前 7）局部放行
// 认知复杂度 lint。
#[allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
fn apply_keep_policies(
    cfg: &Config,
    lines: &[&str],
    dup: &[bool],
    keep: &mut [bool],
    kept: &mut usize,
    reason: &mut [u8],
    raw: &mut [bool],
) {
    // --code-keep 1（P6g）：先踢掉折叠的 prose 行（重复格式模板）——window 邻域
    // 保底会把 dup 行拉回 keep，这里强制剔除；模板行不是证据（P6g 代码场景深压）。
    // 代码行永不 dup（dedup 围栏禁折叠），不受影响。围栏内代码行整行强制保留并
    // 标记 raw，防短变量/运算符被摘、防 gap elide 整行删代码。
    if cfg.code_keep {
        for i in 0..keep.len() {
            if dup[i] {
                keep[i] = false;
                reason[i] = 0;
            }
        }
        *kept = (0..keep.len()).filter(|&i| keep[i]).count();
        mark_code_fence(lines, keep, kept, reason, raw);
    }
    // --num-line-keep 1（P6j）：数字行整行保留（行内仍 trim）。
    if cfg.num_line_keep {
        mark_num_lines(lines, dup, keep, kept, reason);
    }
    // --sym-line-keep 1（P6m）：符号/签名行整行保留（行内仍 trim）。
    if cfg.sym_line_keep {
        mark_sym_lines(lines, dup, keep, kept, reason, raw);
    }
    // --zh-keep 1（P8-E）：中文问句行整行保留并标记 raw（跳过行内 trim）——
    // 中文代码问答题干被 trim 逐字摘碎是保持率 0.2 主导机制，问句行必须保真。
    if cfg.zh_keep {
        mark_zh_lines(lines, dup, keep, kept, reason, raw);
    }
}

/// 可选预算利用率（%）：实际填充 ÷ 预算上限，与 fill 同口径
/// （budget = max(total_tok × ratio, BUDGET_MIN)）。
fn budget_used(used: f64, total_tok: f64, ratio: f64) -> f64 {
    let budget = (total_tok * ratio).max(crate::policy::BUDGET_MIN);
    if budget > 0.0 {
        (used / budget * 100.0).clamp(0.0, 100.0)
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn config(cfg: &Config) -> (f64, i64, i64) {
    let ratio = if cfg.ratio.is_nan() {
        crate::policy::DEFAULT_RATIO
    } else {
        cfg.ratio.clamp(crate::policy::MIN_RATIO, 1.0)
    };
    let context = cfg.context.clamp(0, crate::policy::MAX_CONTEXT);
    let window = if cfg.window < crate::policy::MIN_WINDOW {
        crate::policy::MIN_WINDOW
    } else {
        cfg.window.min(crate::policy::MAX_WINDOW)
    };
    (ratio, context, window)
}
fn survey(lines: &[&str], total: usize) -> f64 {
    if total < crate::policy::SMALL_LINES {
        lines.iter().map(|s| crate::terms::estimate(s)).sum()
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}
fn long(lines: &[&str]) -> bool {
    lines.iter().any(|s| {
        s.len() > crate::policy::LONGLINE_BYTES && s.chars().count() > crate::policy::LONGLINE_CHARS
    })
}
fn shape(total: usize, small_tok: f64, lines: &[&str]) -> Option<Mode> {
    // long() 是全行扫描，放在最便宜的两个判定之后：行数超限/小输入直接短路，
    // 不必为必然直通的输入再扫一遍全部行。
    if total >= crate::policy::MAX_LINES {
        Some(Mode::PassTooManyLines)
    } else if total < crate::policy::SMALL_LINES && small_tok < crate::policy::SMALL_TOK {
        Some(Mode::PassSmall)
    } else if long(lines) {
        Some(Mode::PassLongline)
    } else {
        None
    }
}
fn failopen(signals: usize, force_any: bool) -> bool {
    signals == 0 && !force_any
}
fn rare(h: usize, lone: usize, df: &[usize], rare_thr: usize, fm: bool) -> bool {
    h >= 2 || (h == 1 && lone != usize::MAX && df[lone] <= rare_thr) || fm
}
fn cap(tok_floor: f64, limit: Option<usize>) -> Option<Mode> {
    match limit {
        Some(max) if tok_floor > max as f64 => Some(Mode::OverflowEvidence),
        _ => None,
    }
}
fn remaining(tok_floor: f64, limit: Option<f64>) -> f64 {
    limit.map(|m| m - tok_floor).unwrap_or(f64::INFINITY)
}
fn last(final_tok: f64, limit: Option<usize>) -> Option<Mode> {
    match limit {
        Some(max) if final_tok > max as f64 => Some(Mode::OverflowFill),
        _ => None,
    }
}
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[allow(unused_imports)] // clippy 对 test 内 use 误报（is_import 被 870-873 调用）
    use crate::analysis::import as is_import;
    use crate::analysis::normalize;

    #[allow(dead_code)] // clippy 对 test 参考实现误报
    fn sample_lines<'a>(v: &[&'a str]) -> Vec<&'a str> {
        v.to_vec()
    }

    /// 朴素参考实现：线性查找重复，独立于生产实现的 HashMap/复用路径。
    #[allow(dead_code)] // clippy 对 test 参考实现误报
    fn naive_dedup(
        lines: &[&str],
        mask: &[u64],
        words: usize,
        err: &[bool],
        force: &[bool],
        _code_keep: bool,
    ) -> (Vec<bool>, usize) {
        let mut keys: Vec<(String, usize)> = Vec::with_capacity(lines.len());
        let mut dup = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let mut n = 0usize;
        let mut key = String::new();
        for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
            key.clear();
            normalize(line, &mut key);
            if short(&key) {
                continue;
            }
            match keys.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| *k == key) {
                Some((_, count)) => {
                    *count += 1;
                    let h = hit(mask, words, i);
                    if foldable(count, h, err[i], force[i], _code_keep, false) {
                        dup[i] = true;
                        n += 1;
                    }
                }
                None => keys.push((std::mem::take(&mut key), 1)),
            }
        }
        (dup, n)
    }

    #[test]
    fn zh_keep_preserves_question_lines_and_skips_trim() {
        // zh-keep=1：中文问句行整行保留并跳过行内 trim（题干不被摘碎）。
        let text = [
            "CUDA 编程模型里，kernel<<<4,32>>> 启动后第 2 号块 blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？",
            "请用答案格式作答：答案是 X #### X。",
            "背景知识行：共享内存是块内线程共享的高速存储区域。",
        ]
        .join("\n");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg);
        let q_line = "blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？";
        assert!(
            out.text.contains(q_line),
            "zh-keep 问句行必须整行保留: {}",
            out.text
        );
        assert!(
            out.text.contains("答案是 X #### X"),
            "格式要求行必须整行保留: {}",
            out.text
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn zh_keep_off_keeps_previous_behavior() {
        // 默认 zh_keep=0：问句行被行内 trim 摘碎（对照）；zh_keep=1 整行保留。
        // 多行输入避开小输入透传（单行 <SMALL_TOK 会 fail-open 原样返回）。
        let ctx = (0..45)
            .map(|_| "背景：CUDA 编程模型 kernel GPU 线程，共享内存是块内线程共享的高速存储，原子操作保证并发安全。")
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let q = "问题：kernel<<<4,32>>> 启动后第 2 号块 blockIdx.x=2 内 threadIdx.x=5 的全局线性线程 ID 是多少？请用答案是 69 #### 69 格式作答。";
        let text = format!("{ctx}\n{q}");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: false,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg);
        assert!(
            !out.text.contains("全局线性线程 ID 是多少"),
            "zh-keep=0 时问句行应被 trim 摘碎（对照行为）: {}",
            out.text
        );
        let cfg2 = crate::Config {
            trim: true,
            trim_ratio: 0.3,
            zh_keep: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let out2 = compress(&text, "CUDA 内核 线程 共享内存 原子 warp", &cfg2);
        assert!(
            out2.text.contains("全局线性线程 ID 是多少"),
            "zh-keep=1 时问句行必须整行保留: {}",
            out2.text
        );
    }

    }

    #[test]
    fn drop_runs_budget_runs() {
        let keep = vec![true, false, false, true, false, true];
        let dup = vec![false; 6];

        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr[0].start, dr[0].end), (2, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);

    }

    #[test]
    fn drop_runs_overflow_reason() {
        let keep = vec![false, false, true];
        let dr = runs(&keep, &[false; 3], true);
        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::MaxTokens);
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason.as_str(), "max-tokens");
        assert_eq!(crate::Reason::Budget.as_str(), "budget");
        assert_eq!(crate::Reason::Dedup.as_str(), "dedup");
    }

    #[test]
    fn drop_runs_dedup_splits_from_budget() {
        // dup 行记 Dedup，与相邻 budget 行拆分为不同区间。
        let keep = vec![true, false, false];
        let dup = vec![false, true, false];
        let dr = runs(&keep, &dup, false);
        assert_eq!(dr.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr[0].start, dr[0].end), (2, 2));
        assert_eq!(dr[0].reason, crate::Reason::Dedup);
        assert_eq!((dr[1].start, dr[1].end), (3, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr[1].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);
        // 同一原因延续不拆分：两个相邻 dup 合并为一个 Dedup 区间。
        let keep2 = vec![true, false, false, false];
        let dup2 = vec![false, true, true, false];
        let dr2 = runs(&keep2, &dup2, false);
        assert_eq!(dr2.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!((dr2[0].start, dr2[0].end), (2, 3));
        assert_eq!(dr2[0].reason, crate::Reason::Dedup);
        assert_eq!((dr2[1].start, dr2[1].end), (4, 4));
        assert_eq!(dr2[1].reason, crate::Reason::Budget);
    }

    #[test]
    fn dedup_matches_naive_reference_on_generated_corpora() {
        // 确定性 LCG 生成含连续重复、数字/十六进制、空白与短行的语料，
        // 生产实现（含「与上一行相同则复用归一化」快速路径）必须与朴素参考一致。
        let alphabet = b" abcef0129\t#=:xX-";
        let mut state = 0x1234_5678u32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..300 {
            let len = (next() as usize >> 8) % 24;
            let mut raw: Vec<String> = Vec::with_capacity(len);
            let mut prev = String::new();
            for _ in 0..len {
                let roll = next() as usize;
                // 30% 概率重复上一行，触达快速路径。
                if roll % 10 < 3 && !prev.is_empty() {
                    raw.push(prev.clone());
                    continue;
                }
                let n = (next() as usize >> 8) % 20;
                let mut s = String::new();
                for _ in 0..n {
                    s.push(alphabet[(next() as usize >> 16) % alphabet.len()] as char);
                }
                prev = s.clone();
                raw.push(s);
            }
            let lines: Vec<&str> = raw.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
            // 掩码随机置位（模拟查询命中），错误/force 同理。
            let mut mask = vec![0u64; lines.len() * 2];
            for slot in mask.iter_mut() {
                if next() % 7 == 0 {
                    *slot = 1;
                }
            }
            let err: Vec<bool> = (0..lines.len()).map(|_| next() % 11 == 0).collect();
            let force: Vec<bool> = (0..lines.len()).map(|_| next() % 13 == 0).collect();
            let got = dedup(&lines, &mask, 2, &err, &force, false);
            let want = naive_dedup(&lines, &mask, 2, &err, &force, false);
            assert_eq!(got, want, "dedup mismatch on {:?}", raw);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn token_table_matches_estimate_and_falls_back() {
        let lines = ["abc", "数据库连接超时", "x y z 42"];
        let (tok, total) = tally(&lines, 3, 0.0, true);
        let want: f64 = lines.iter().map(|l| crate::terms::estimate(l)).sum();
        assert_eq!(total, want);
        for (i, l) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(est(&tok, &lines, i), crate::terms::estimate(l));
        }
        // do_tok=false：空表 + small_tok，调用方回退现算。
        let (empty, small) = tally(&lines, 3, 7.5, false);
        assert!(empty.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(small, 7.5);
        assert_eq!(est(&empty, &lines, 1), crate::terms::estimate(lines[1]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn dedup_skips_short_and_padded_lines() {
        // 归一化键 < 6 字符（含首尾空白填充）的行从不参与折叠；长行仍按
        // 第 3 次起折叠。快速路径（trim 后 < 6 字节直接跳过）不得改变判定。
        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![
            "abc",
            "   abc   ",
            "a\tb",
            "错误",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
            "abcdef",
        ];
        let mask = vec![0u64; lines.len()];
        let err = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let force = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let (dup, n) = dedup(&lines, &mask, 0, &err, &force, false);
        assert!(!dup[0] && !dup[1] && !dup[2] && !dup[3], "短/填充行不折叠");
        assert!(dup[6] && dup[7], "长行第 3、4 次出现应折叠");
        assert_eq!(n, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn code_keep_folds_hit_templates_but_never_code() {
        // code_keep=1：重复格式模板（命中 query）折叠；围栏内代码行永不折叠。
        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
            "Q: 以下代码输出什么？请用答案是X格式作答。",
            "```python",
            "x = 5",
            "```",
        ];
        // mask 置满 → 所有行都命中 query（hit 豁免），验证 code_keep 覆盖命中。
        let words = 2usize;
        let mask = vec![u64::MAX; lines.len() * words];
        let err = vec![false; lines.len()];
        let force = vec![false; lines.len()];
        // 关：命中行不折叠（现状行为）。
        let (dup0, n0) = dedup(&lines, &mask, words, &err, &force, false);
        assert_eq!(n0, 0, "命中豁免：默认不折叠任何行");
        assert!(dup0.iter().all(|&d| !d));
        // 开：Q 模板第 3 次起折叠，围栏行与代码行永不折叠。
        let (dup1, n1) = dedup(&lines, &mask, words, &err, &force, true);
        assert_eq!(n1, 1, "第 3 个 Q 模板行折叠");
        assert!(dup1[8], "第 3 个 Q 模板行折叠");
        assert!(!dup1[4], "第 2 个 Q 模板行保留（前两次不折叠）");
        assert!(
            !dup1[1] && !dup1[2] && !dup1[6] && !dup1[10],
            "围栏行与代码行永不折叠"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn nan_sims_do_not_poison_scores() {
        // 外部嵌入命令输出 NaN 时不得进入排序分（比较器会失去全序）。
        let text = (0..200)
            .map(|i| format!("line {i}: conn pool timeout db error 9f2a"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n");
        let cfg = crate::Config {
            sims: Some(vec![f64::NAN; 200]),
            ..crate::Config::default()
        };
        let out = compress(&text, "conn timeout", &cfg);
        assert!(out.kept >= 1, "NaN 相似度不应破坏压缩结果");
        assert!(out.text.is_char_boundary(0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn structure_fence_merges_region_into_candidate() {
        // 结构并入是叠加：种子邻域基础窗 + 含种子的 fence 区域整段进入候选。
        let lines: Vec<&str> = vec![
            "```",
            "import os",
            "conn 9f2a broken db crash",
            "return pool",
            "```",
            "INFO filler",
        ];
        let seed = vec![false, false, true, false, false, false];
        let _base = expand(&seed, 1, lines.len(), None);
        let map = structures(&lines);
        let merged = expand(&seed, 1, lines.len(), Some(&map));
        assert!(merged.in_region[0], "fence 开启行并入");
        assert!(merged.in_region[4], "fence 闭合行并入");
        assert!(!merged.in_region[5], "fence 外行不并入");
    }
