/// case 主桶：按家族顺序取首个命中。
/// `text` 参与判定是为了覆盖 fields 未抽到的家族词（如 build 日志里只有 "cargo"）。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn bucket(fields: &[String], terms: &[String], text: &str) -> String {
    query(fields, terms, text)
}

/// query-aware 主桶：先用 case query 词表与字段判家族，query 没有家族证据时
/// 再回退正文。根因正文常含比 query 更宽的域词（例如“数据库权限变更生成超大
/// 文件”），只用正文会把 query 明明写 network/file 的 case 归到 db，随后被
/// 候选桶过滤误删。旧库仍按已存 bucket 使用；新摄取走本函数。
pub(crate) fn query(fields: &[String], query_terms: &[String], text: &str) -> String {
    // 裸 "db" 词级精确匹配（terms 是 query∪text 的切词表，"db.java:4" 是单一
    // token ≠ "db"，不会被误归 db 场景桶）：修 query "db timeout" 漏召的同时
    // 避免文件实体把编译等场景误归类。
    if query_terms.iter().any(|t| t == "db") {
        return "db".to_string();
    }
    let mut hay: Vec<String> = fields.iter().map(|s| fold(s)).collect();
    hay.extend(query_terms.iter().map(|s| fold(s)));
    if let Some(fam) = family(&hay, true) {
        return fam;
    }
    // query 只有通用 network 症状（timeout/connection）时，正文里的具体家族
    // 证据优先；否则 `Jdbc.java ... timeout` 会被 network 吞掉。
    let mut combined = hay;
    combined.push(fold(text));
    if let Some(fam) = family(&combined, false) {
        return fam;
    }
    "other".to_string()
}

/// case 的多标签场景桶：query 与正文任一命中即入选。
///
/// 单主桶无法表达跨域事故（例如“数据库权限变更生成超大文件并传播全网”既是 db
/// 也是 network）。召回过滤用多标签做“任一交集即保留”，避免同一事故的不同问法
/// 因单桶优先级不同而互相漏召；`bucket` 主桶仍保留给 stats/兼容旧布局。
pub(crate) fn buckets(fields: &[String], query_terms: &[String], text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut hay: Vec<String> = fields.iter().map(|s| fold(s)).collect();
    hay.extend(query_terms.iter().map(|s| fold(s)));
    hay.push(fold(text));
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    if query_terms.iter().any(|t| t == "db") {
        out.push("db".to_string());
    }
    for (fam, keys) in FAMILIES {
        if keys.iter().any(|k| hay.iter().any(|h| contains(h, k))) && !out.iter().any(|f| f == fam)
        {
            out.push(fam.to_string());
        }
    }
    out
}

fn family(hay: &[String], query_only: bool) -> Option<String> {
    for (fam, keys) in FAMILIES {
        let hit = keys.iter().any(|k| hay.iter().any(|h| contains(h, k)));
        if !hit {
            continue;
        }
        // query 侧只有通用 network 词时不算“明确网络”，交给正文回退。
        if query_only && fam == "network" {
            let specific = [
                "socket", "http", "http2", "http3", "tcp", "udp", "dns", "network", "网络",
            ]
            .iter()
            .any(|k| hay.iter().any(|h| contains(h, k)));
            if !specific {
                continue;
            }
        }
        return Some(fam.to_string());
    }
    None
}

/// ASCII 关键词按词边界匹配，避免 `ebs` 命中 `website`、`link` 命中 `links`；
/// CJK 关键词保持子串匹配（中文没有空格分词）。
fn contains(hay: &str, key: &str) -> bool {
    if !key.is_ascii() {
        return hay.contains(key);
    }
    let bytes = hay.as_bytes();
    let kb = key.as_bytes();
    if kb.is_empty() || kb.len() > bytes.len() {
        return false;
    }
    for i in 0..=bytes.len() - kb.len() {
        if &bytes[i..i + kb.len()] != kb {
            continue;
        }
        let before_ok = i == 0 || !word(bytes[i - 1]);
        let after_ok = i + kb.len() == bytes.len() || !word(bytes[i + kb.len()]);
        if before_ok && after_ok {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn word(b: u8) -> bool {
    b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_'
}

/// query 候选桶集合：任一家族命中即入选（宁多勿漏，防漏召）。
pub(crate) fn seeds(query: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let q = fold(query);
    let mut out: Vec<String> = FAMILIES
        .iter()
        .filter(|(_, keys)| keys.iter().any(|k| contains(&q, k)))
        .map(|(fam, _)| fam.to_string())
        .collect();
    // 裸 "db" 词级精确匹配（与 bucket 同口径）：query 含独立词 "db" 即
    // 候选 db 桶（子串会误判 "kubectl/obd" 等，宁多勿漏但别乱扩桶）。
    if q.split_whitespace().any(|w| w == "db") && !out.contains(&"db".to_string()) {
        out.push("db".to_string());
    }
    // `timeout`/`connection` 是跨 db/network/disk/build 的通用症状。query 只有
    // 这类通用词时硬筛 network 会把 `database query timeout` / `storage timeout`
    // 直接滤掉；返回空候选桶 = 全量扫，宁多勿漏。出现 socket/dns/tcp 等网络
    // 专用词时才筛 network。
    let only_generic_network = out.len() == 1
        && out[0] == "network"
        && ![
            "socket", "http", "http2", "http3", "tcp", "udp", "dns", "network", "网络",
        ]
        .iter()
        .any(|k| contains(&q, k));
    if only_generic_network {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    out
}

/// 归一化小写（剥离 ANSI/CR 后做 Unicode 小写）。
///
/// 旧实现误用 `normalize`：它不做小写，`Jdbc.java`/`DATABASE` 等大写词
/// 匹配不到小写关键词表，导致本该归 db 的 case 被 timeout 抢先归到 network。
fn fold(s: &str) -> String {
    // 来源 URL 里的 `https` 含 network 关键词 `http`，会把所有带公开复盘
    // 链接的 case 误归 network 桶。桶判定只看正文/实体，不看 URL。
    let mut cleaned = String::new();
    for (i, tok) in s.split_whitespace().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            cleaned.push(' ');
        }
        let cut = tok.find("http://").or_else(|| tok.find("https://"));
        match cut {
            Some(pos) => cleaned.push_str(&tok[..pos]),
            None => cleaned.push_str(tok),
        }
    }
    let mut out = String::new();
    crate::analysis::lowercase(&cleaned, &mut out);
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod bucket_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn bucket_detects_family() {
        assert_eq!(bucket(&["conn_id=9f2a".into()], &[], ""), "db");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["连接池".into()], ""), "db");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &[], "socket timeout 网络"), "network");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &[], "磁盘 空间不足"), "disk");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["cargo".into()], "error"), "build");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &[], "NullPointerException stack"), "runtime");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &[], "hello world"), "other");
        // 数据库 HA 拓扑词必须归 db：主库 failover / 主从复制 / 裂脑。
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["failover".into()], ""), "db");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["replication".into()], ""), "db");
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["主从".into()], ""), "db");
        // 大小写不能改变桶判定：`Jdbc.java` 必须先命中 db，而不是被
        // 后面的 timeout 抢先归到 network。
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(&[], &["query".into(), "timeout".into()], "at Jdbc.java:88"),
            "db"
        );
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &[], "DISK FULL"), "disk");
        // 来源 URL 的 `https` 不是 network 证据：带复盘链接的 case 仍按正文分类。
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(
                &[],
                &[],
                "升级配置冲突\n公开复盘, 来源: https://example.com/post"
            ),
            "other"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(
                &[],
                &[],
                "数据库连接失败\n公开复盘, 来源: https://example.com/post"
            ),
            "db"
        );
        // EBS 重新镜像属于存储域；根因里出现“网络事件”不能把它归 network。
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(&[], &[], "网络事件引发 EBS re-mirroring 风暴与容量耗尽"),
            "disk"
        );
        // DNS resolver / SERVFAIL / BGP 路由 / Blob 存储在复盘文本里可能没有
        // 通用词 dns/storage，仍须归到对应家族，避免桶过滤漏召。
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(
                &[],
                &[],
                "an internal software error made the public resolver return servfail"
            ),
            "network"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(&[], &[], "亚特兰大路由器一行配置错误导致 BGP 路由泄漏"),
            "network"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(
                &[],
                &[],
                "reverting the metadata change restored blob lookups"
            ),
            "disk"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(&[], &[], "网络事件引发 cloud 云盘 volume 大规模重新镜像"),
            "disk"
        );
        // `timeout` 不能盖过具体存储场景：disk/storage 优先于通用 network。
        assert_eq!(
            bucket(&[], &["disk".into(), "read".into(), "timeout".into()], ""),
            "disk"
        );
        // 裸 "db" 走词级精确匹配：独立 token "db" 归 db 桶；
        // "db.java:4" 是单一 token，不得误归 db 场景桶（编译失败场景归 build）。
        assert_eq!(bucket(&[], &["db".into()], ""), "db");
        let got = bucket(&[], &["db.java:4".into()], "compile fail");
        assert_eq!(got, "build", "文件实体不得把编译场景误归 db 桶");
        // query 明确写 network 时，根因里的“数据库”不得把 case 带偏到 db。
        assert_eq!(
            query(
                &[],
                &["oversized".into(), "file".into(), "network".into()],
                "机器人检测数据库权限变更生成超大文件"
            ),
            "network"
        );
        // query 没有家族证据时才回退正文。
        assert_eq!(query(&[], &["hello".into()], "数据库连接失败"), "db");
        assert_eq!(
            query(
                &[],
                &[
                    "website".into(),
                    "access".into(),
                    "email".into(),
                    "delivery".into(),
                    "cutover".into()
                ],
                "Enom 计划迁移到新云基础设施，cutover 复杂导致数据复制、网络路由和 DNS 解析问题"
            ),
            "network"
        );
        // 跨域事故：单主桶是 db（query 先命中），但正文的“传播/全网”提供 network
        // 证据；多标签必须同时保留两者，否则 network 问法会把该 case 硬筛掉。
        let multi = buckets(
            &[],
            &[
                "database".into(),
                "permission".into(),
                "file".into(),
                "larger".into(),
            ],
            "机器人检测数据库权限变更生成超过软件限制的文件，文件传播全网导致系统级宕机",
        );
        assert!(multi.contains(&"db".to_string()), "{multi:?}");
        assert!(multi.contains(&"network".to_string()), "{multi:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn seeds_are_wide() {
        let c = seeds("数据库连接超时 conn_id");
        assert!(c.contains(&"db".to_string()), "候选桶应含 db: {:?}", c);
        let c2 = seeds("cargo build 磁盘满");
        assert!(c2.contains(&"build".to_string()) && c2.contains(&"disk".to_string()));
        let c3 = seeds("普通问题");
        assert!(c3.is_empty(), "无家族命中时空候选桶 = 全量扫（防漏召）");
        // 裸 "db" 必须命中 db 家族，保持桶判定对称并防漏召。
        let c4 = seeds("db timeout");
        assert!(
            c4.contains(&"db".to_string()),
            "裸 db 应命中 db 桶: {:?}",
            c4
        );
        // 子串不得误判："kubectl" 含 "db" 子串，但不含独立 token "db"。
        let c5 = seeds("kubectl get pods");
        assert!(
            !c5.contains(&"db".to_string()),
            "子串不得乱扩 db 桶: {:?}",
            c5
        );
        assert!(
            seeds("timeout").is_empty(),
            "通用 timeout 必须全量扫，不能硬筛 network"
        );
        assert!(seeds("connection").is_empty(), "通用 connection 必须全量扫");
        assert!(seeds("socket timeout").contains(&"network".to_string()));
        assert!(seeds("storage timeout").contains(&"disk".to_string()));
        // 主库 failover 的 query 即使带 "network partition" 也必须保留 db 候选桶，
        // 否则 db 桶 case 被网络桶过滤、主库故障切换直接漏召。
        let c6 = seeds("primary failover during network partition");
        assert!(
            c6.contains(&"db".to_string()),
            "主库 failover query 应候选 db 桶: {:?}",
            c6
        );
    }
}

//! 实体边一跳扩展：case↔实体倒排（error_code/file_loc/symbol/num_fp 四类字段值
//! 各为一条实体键），召回沿边扩一跳取兄弟 case。
//!
//! 机制与边界（诚实口径）：实体键是 case 词面的子集（token 层无法"零词面共享"），
//! 实体边的真实收益有两条：
//!
//! 1) 跨桶兜底：query 判候选桶后，被桶过滤滤掉、但实体键相同的兄弟 case 被兜底并入候选；
//! 2) 实体加权：共享实体数 × edge_weight 直接进打分（fb），把实体强相关但词面弱的
//!    兄弟 case 提过截止线。
//!
//! 零依赖、确定性；实体表全库现算（小库口径）。
//! 倒排路径直接使用 `index::entity_neighbors`（postings 自带字段快照），本模块
//! 只服务 <10k 的线性召回路径。
//!
//! 实体表使用进程内缓存（root + meta.toml mtime 键，与索引同模式）；
//! store/rate/gc/rebuild 推进库代际后会触发自动 miss 与重建。
//! 库外进程无缓存，多进程共享 `--mem-dir` 仍是受支持场景（每次冷构建 ≤1 次）。

use crate::memory::store;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock};

/// 实体 → case id 倒排（实体键精确匹配）。
pub(crate) struct Edges {
    map: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>,
}

impl Edges {
    /// 实体命中的 case id 集合（去重、保序）。
    pub(crate) fn neighbors(&self, ents: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut seen = HashSet::new();
        for e in ents {
            if let Some(ids) = self.map.get(e) {
                for id in ids {
                    if seen.insert(id.as_str()) {
                        out.push(id.clone());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        out
    }
}

/// 缓存键：root + meta.toml mtime（任何库变更都重写 meta.toml → 键失效）。
type Entry = (String, Option<std::time::SystemTime>, Arc<Edges>);
static EDGE_CACHE: OnceLock<Mutex<Option<Entry>>> = OnceLock::new();
fn cache() -> &'static Mutex<Option<Entry>> {
    EDGE_CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(None))
}

/// 全库构建实体表：每个 case 的四类字段值各作为一条实体键（去重）。
pub(crate) fn build(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Edges> {
    let mut map: HashMap<String, Vec<String>> = HashMap::new();
    for id in store::list(root)? {
        let c = store::load(root, &id)?;
        for e in crate::memory::classify::keys(&c.fields) {
            map.entry(e).or_default().push(id.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(Edges { map })
}

/// 进程内缓存的实体表（见模块注释）。mtime 读取失败 → 每次重建（保守正确）。
fn cached(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Arc<Edges>> {
    let p = std::path::Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let mt = p.metadata().and_then(|m| m.modified()).ok();
    let mut g = cache().lock().unwrap();
    if let Some((r, t, idx)) = g.as_ref() {
        if r == root && *t == mt {
            return Ok(idx.clone());
        }
    }
    let idx = Arc::new(build(root)?);
    *g = Some((root.to_string(), mt, idx.clone()));
    Ok(idx)
}

/// 桥 case 的召回上下文（与 recall::Doc 同构，由调用方转写）。
pub(crate) struct Bridge {
    pub id: String,
    pub terms: std::sync::Arc<[String]>,
    pub query_terms: std::sync::Arc<[String]>,
    pub fields: std::sync::Arc<store::Fields>,
    pub status: std::sync::Arc<str>,
    pub quality: f64,
    pub updated_at: std::sync::Arc<str>,
    pub edge_shared: usize,
}

/// 桥并入：query 实体 → 兄弟 case（未在 `exist` 中）读出完整上下文与共享实体计数。
/// 桥只增加候选；调用方保持全库 df/avgdl 口径。仅当 edge_enable>0 且 query
/// 确有实体时触发。
pub(crate) fn bridge(
    root: &str,
    meta: &store::Meta,
    qf_ents: &[String],
    exist: &[String],
) -> std::io::Result<Vec<Bridge>> {
    if meta.param("edge_enable") <= 0.0 {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    }
    let mut ents: Vec<String> = qf_ents.to_vec();
    ents.sort();
    ents.dedup();
    if ents.is_empty() {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    }
    let idx = cached(root)?;
    let bridge = idx.neighbors(&ents);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for id in bridge {
        if exist.contains(&id) {
            continue;
        }
        let c = store::load(root, &id)?;
        let (query_terms, terms) = crate::terms::document(&c.query, &c.text);
        let shared = shared(&ents, &c.fields);
        out.push(Bridge {
            id,
            terms: terms.into(),
            query_terms: query_terms.into(),
            fields: std::sync::Arc::new(c.fields),
            status: c.status.into(),
            quality: c.quality,
            updated_at: c.updated_at.into(),
            edge_shared: shared,
        });
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn shared(ents: &[String], fields: &store::Fields) -> usize {
    ents.iter().filter(|e| entity(e, fields)).count()
}

fn entity(e: &str, fields: &store::Fields) -> bool {
    fields.error_code.iter().any(|x| x == e)
        || fields.file_loc.iter().any(|x| x == e)
        || fields.symbol.iter().any(|x| x == e)
        || fields.num_fp.iter().any(|x| x == e)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::ingest::ingest;
    use crate::memory::recall::recall;
    use crate::memory::store::Stats;
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::fs;

    fn stats() -> Stats {
        Stats {
            kept: 2,
            total: 20,
            cut: 90.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// 实体边一跳（召回集成）：共享 file_loc 实体但主桶不同（build）的兄弟 case，
    /// 被 db/network 候选桶过滤掉后，由实体边兜底并入候选并加权召回；关桥则被滤。
    #[test]
    fn edge_bridge_recovers_cross_bucket_sibling() {
        let root = root("eb");
        let s1 = stats();
        // A：db/network 桶（含 timeout），共享实体 pool.java:214。
        ingest(
            &root,
            "db timeout",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout\nat Pool.java:214",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // B：build 桶（compile），词面弱（无 timeout），但共享实体 pool.java:214。
        ingest(
            &root,
            "compile fail",
            vec!["compile".into()],
            "ERROR compile fail\nat Pool.java:214",
            vec!["/b.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // C：db/network 桶干扰 case，无共享实体。
        ingest(
            &root,
            "db timeout",
            vec!["errno".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout\nat Db.java:4",
            vec!["/c.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // 桥开（默认 edge_enable=1）：q 实体 pool.java:214 → B 兜底召回。
        let q_open = "数据库连接池 timeout at Pool.java:214";
        let hits = recall(&root, q_open, 3, &crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let b_id = {
            let ids = store::list(&root).unwrap();
            ids.iter()
                .find(|id| store::load(&root, id).unwrap().query == "compile fail")
                .cloned()
                .unwrap()
        };
        assert!(
            hits.iter().any(|h| h.id == b_id),
            "实体边应兜底召回跨桶兄弟 case：{}（B 桶=build 被 db/network 候选滤掉）",
            hits.iter()
                .map(|h| h.id.as_str())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(",")
        );
        // 关桥（edge_enable=0）：B 被桶过滤，不再出现在结果里。
        crate::memory::meta::set(&root, "edge_enable", 0.0).unwrap();
        // 隔离本测试：关闭低置信桶回退，确保 B 只能被实体边召回。
        crate::memory::meta::set(&root, "bucket_bypass_sim", 0.0).unwrap();
        let q_off = "数据库连接池 timeout at Pool.java:214 pool";
        let hits2 = recall(&root, q_off, 3, &crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !hits2.iter().any(|h| h.id == b_id),
            "关桥后 B 应被桶过滤排除：{:?}",
            hits2.iter().map(|h| h.id.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>()
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn build_and_neighbors_are_deterministic() {
        let root = root("bn");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "db timeout",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a\nat Pool.java:214",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "compile fail",
            vec!["compile".into()],
            "ERROR compile fail\nat Pool.java:214",
            vec!["/b.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        ingest(
            &root,
            "db errno",
            vec!["errno".into()],
            "ERROR db errno=28\nat Db.java:4",
            vec!["/c.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let idx = build(&root).unwrap();
        // 共享 file_loc 实体：Pool.java:214 → 两个 case；独立实体不串。
        let n = idx.neighbors(&["pool.java:214".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(n.len(), 2, "Pool.java:214 应命中 2 个 case: {n:?}");
        let e = idx.neighbors(&["conn_id=9f2a".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(e.len(), 1, "conn_id=9f2a 只在一个 case 里");
        // 无命中实体 → 空（不报错）。
        assert!(idx.neighbors(&["no_such_entity".to_string()]).is_empty());
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 评估系统：冻结 baseline 重放、A/B 指标与诊断输出。
//!
//! `--eval <baseline.json>`：冻结评估输入重放——标注集（query → expected case + 分层 +
//! 相关度 0..2）上分三层（literal/paraphrase/semantic）输出 Recall@5 / MRR / NDCG@10。
//! 对拍：A = 完整统计管线（recall::recall，字段加权+PRF+衰减+MMR+反馈+桶过滤），
//! B = 朴素词面基线（`plain`：全库候选、纯词面匹配 + 长度归一化、无任何增强）。
//!
//! 口径说明：打分词表两边都是去重词表（tf 恒 1），实际是
//! "二值词面匹配 + 长度归一化 + 字段加权"，不是严格 BM25（tf 项恒为 1）。
//! A/B 同词表对比仍公平，但任何结论须按此口径引用，不宣称"BM25 增益"。
//! 确定性：无随机源，同 baseline + 同库 → 同输出，可重放存档。
//! 时间衰减时钟冻结到库的 `created_at`，避免同一快照因运行时刻不同而在近似并列处换序。
//!
use crate::memory::gate::Gate;
use crate::memory::json::Val;
use crate::memory::recall::{self, Hit};
use crate::memory::store;
use crate::memory::Eval;
use crate::terms::{document, memory};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// 单条评估输入（baseline.json 的一行标注）。
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Case {
    pub query: String,
    pub layer: String,
    pub expected: Vec<String>,
    pub rel: HashMap<String, f64>,
    /// `--judge` 写入的裁决人；自动标注集为空（`--gate` 据此拒绝非 literal 条目）。
    pub judged_by: Option<String>,
    /// `--judge` 写入的裁决时间（UTC）；与 judged_by 同时存在才算人工裁决。
    pub judged_date: Option<String>,
    /// `judge.method`：区分逐条盲审与"人工规则物化"，供 gate 输出证据边界。
    pub judged_method: Option<String>,
    /// 逐候选裁决溯源：候选 id → 裁决人。`rel` 里每个键都必须能在此找到
    /// 对应条目，`--gate-human` 才认可为"逐条人工"而非整包签收。
    pub judge_items: HashMap<String, String>,
}

impl Case {
    /// expected 首个目标的相关度；literal 层 query 就是目标 case 原文，
    /// 该值必须为 2，否则标签与行不对应（或整包机械填写）。
    pub(crate) fn expected(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        self.expected.first().map(|e| relation(self, e))
    }
}

/// 解析 baseline.json：`{"name":..,"cases":[{"query":..,"layer":..,"expected":[..],"rel":{..}}]}`
/// rel 缺省时 expected 内 case 视为 rel=1；容错（缺字段报错，不静默）。
pub(crate) fn baseline(v: &Val) -> Result<Vec<Case>, String> {
    let cases = match v {
        Val::Obj(kvs) => match kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "cases") {
            Some((_, Val::Arr(items))) => items,
            _ => return Err("baseline: missing array \"cases\"".to_string()),
        },
        _ => return Err("baseline: expected top-level object".to_string()),
    };
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(cases.len());
    for (i, item) in cases.iter().enumerate() {
        let kvs = match item {
            Val::Obj(kvs) => kvs,
            _ => return Err(format!("baseline: cases[{i}] not an object")),
        };
        out.push(case(kvs, i)?);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// 解析单条 case：query/layer/expected/rel/judge 元数据/judge_items。
/// 与原内联逻辑逐字段一一对应，仅拆分以降低圈复杂度。
fn case(kvs: &[(String, Val)], i: usize) -> Result<Case, String> {
    let get_str = |key: &str| -> Result<String, String> {
        match kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == key) {
            Some((_, Val::Str(s))) => Ok(s.clone()),
            _ => Err(format!("baseline: cases[{i}] missing string \"{key}\"")),
        }
    };
    let query = get_str("query")?;
    let layer = get_str("layer")?;
    // 盲测裁决门——judge:null（未裁决）一律拒绝，防止
    // "人工直接接受预填 rel = 自动标注自证"。先跑 --judge 再评估。
    if kvs
        .iter()
        .any(|(k, v)| k == "judge" && matches!(v, Val::Null))
    {
        return Err(format!(
            "baseline: cases[{i}] unjudged (judge:null) - run --judge first"
        ));
    }
    let expected = wanted(kvs, i)?;
    let rel = parse(kvs, &expected, i)?;
    let (judged_by, judged_date, judged_method) = judge(kvs);
    let judge_items = items(kvs);
    Ok(Case {
        query,
        layer,
        expected,
        rel,
        judged_by,
        judged_date,
        judged_method,
        judge_items,
    })
}

/// 解析 expected 字符串数组。
fn wanted(kvs: &[(String, Val)], i: usize) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    match kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "expected") {
        Some((_, Val::Arr(items))) => {
            let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(items.len());
            for e in items {
                match e {
                    Val::Str(s) => v.push(s.clone()),
                    _ => return Err(format!("baseline: cases[{i}].expected not strings")),
                }
            }
            Ok(v)
        }
        _ => Err(format!("baseline: cases[{i}] missing array \"expected\"")),
    }
}

/// 解析 rel 字典并为未标注的 expected 补 rel=1。
fn parse(
    kvs: &[(String, Val)],
    expected: &[String],
    i: usize,
) -> Result<HashMap<String, f64>, String> {
    let mut rel = HashMap::new();
    if let Some((_, Val::Obj(rel_kvs))) = kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "rel") {
        for (rk, rv) in rel_kvs {
            let r = value(rv, i, rk)?;
            rel.insert(rk.clone(), r);
        }
    }
    // expected 可能是完整 id，而 rel 字典常用 hash 后缀（跨日重建后日期前缀
    // 不同）。先按同一匹配口径找已有标签，避免为同一 case 再插入 rel=1
    // 的重复键；否则 rel_of 会因 HashMap 遍历顺序随机取到 1 或 2。
    for e in expected {
        if !matched(&rel, e) {
            rel.insert(e.clone(), 1.0);
        }
    }
    Ok(rel)
}

fn value(rv: &Val, i: usize, rk: &str) -> Result<f64, String> {
    match rv {
        Val::Num(n) if n.is_finite() && (0.0..=2.0).contains(n) => Ok(*n),
        _ => Err(format!("baseline: cases[{i}].rel.{rk} not 0..=2 number")),
    }
}

fn matched(rel: &HashMap<String, f64>, e: &str) -> bool {
    rel.keys().any(|k| same(e, k) || same(k, e))
}

/// 读取 judge 元数据供 --gate 校验。自动标注集没有 judge
/// 对象（或只有 rel），因此不能冒充人工裁决证据。
fn judge(kvs: &[(String, Val)]) -> (Option<String>, Option<String>, Option<String>) {
    let mut judged_by = None;
    let mut judged_date = None;
    let mut judged_method = None;
    if let Some((_, Val::Obj(jkvs))) = kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "judge") {
        let get_optional = |key: &str| -> Option<String> {
            jkvs.iter()
                .find(|(k, _)| k == key)
                .and_then(|(_, v)| match v {
                    Val::Str(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.clone()),
                    _ => None,
                })
        };
        judged_by = get_optional("by");
        judged_date = get_optional("date");
        judged_method = get_optional("method");
    }
    (judged_by, judged_date, judged_method)
}

/// 读取 judge_items：候选 id → 裁决人。
fn items(kvs: &[(String, Val)]) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    let mut judge_items = HashMap::new();
    if let Some((_, Val::Obj(ikvs))) = kvs.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == "judge_items") {
        for (ik, iv) in ikvs {
            let by = match iv {
                Val::Obj(m) => m
                    .iter()
                    .find(|(k, _)| k == "by")
                    .and_then(|(_, v)| match v {
                        Val::Str(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.clone()),
                        _ => None,
                    }),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(by) = by {
                judge_items.insert(ik.clone(), by);
            }
        }
    }
    judge_items
}

/// expected/rel 的 id 匹配：支持完整 id、hash 后缀（tail）或 hash 后缀的后 8 位
/// （case id 为 64 位后 tail=16 hex，标注集里的旧 8 位
/// hash 仍须匹配，golden 免日期漂移）。完整 id 的日期前缀允许不同：重建库跨日
/// 运行时 hash 不变，冻结 baseline 不应因此整体 miss。
fn same(exp: &str, id: &str) -> bool {
    let tail = id.rsplit('_').next().unwrap_or(id);
    let tail8 = if tail.len() >= 8 {
        &tail[tail.len() - 8..]
    } else {
        tail
    };
    exp == id
        || exp == tail
        || exp == tail8
        || exp.rsplit('_').next().is_some_and(|suffix| suffix == tail)
}

fn contains(exp: &[String], id: &str) -> bool {
    exp.iter().any(|e| same(e, id))
}

fn relation(c: &Case, id: &str) -> f64 {
    if let Some(v) = c.rel.get(id) {
        return *v;
    }
    let tail = id.rsplit('_').next().unwrap_or(id);
    if let Some(v) = c.rel.get(tail) {
        return *v;
    }
    let tail8 = if tail.len() >= 8 {
        &tail[tail.len() - 8..]
    } else {
        tail
    };
    if let Some(v) = c.rel.get(tail8) {
        return *v;
    }
    // 慢路径：rel 用完整 id、命中用另一日期前缀时按后缀匹配。
    // 先按 key 排序再取，避免 HashMap 遍历顺序影响重复/近重复键的选择。
    let mut keys: Vec<&String> = c.rel.keys().collect();
    keys.sort();
    keys.into_iter()
        .find(|k| same(k, id))
        .map(|k| c.rel[k])
        .unwrap_or(0.0)
}

/// 单例指标：Recall@5 / Recall@10（expected 命中占比）、MRR（首个 expected 的 1/rank）、
/// NDCG@10（rel 分级，DCG/IDCG）。r10 供弱相关 semantic 层使用。
fn metric(c: &Case, hits: &[Hit]) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let (r5, r10) = if c.expected.is_empty() {
        (0.0, 0.0)
    } else {
        let hit5 = hits
            .iter()
            .take(5)
            .filter(|h| contains(&c.expected, &h.id))
            .count();
        let hit10 = hits
            .iter()
            .take(10)
            .filter(|h| contains(&c.expected, &h.id))
            .count();
        (
            hit5 as f64 / c.expected.len() as f64,
            hit10 as f64 / c.expected.len() as f64,
        )
    };
    let mut mrr = 0.0;
    for (i, h) in hits.iter().take(10).enumerate() {
        if contains(&c.expected, &h.id) {
            mrr = 1.0 / (i as f64 + 1.0);
            break;
        }
    }
    let dcg_r: Vec<f64> = hits.iter().take(10).map(|h| relation(c, &h.id)).collect();
    let dc = dcg(&dcg_r);
    // IDCG 必须来自 rel 字典里所有标注为相关的候选（含非 expected 的弱相关/强相关），
    // 不能只用 expected：否则实际 top-10 里的 rel=1 候选会让 DCG > IDCG，NDCG 突破 1.0。
    let mut ideal: Vec<f64> = c.rel.values().copied().filter(|v| *v > 0.0).collect();
    ideal.sort_by(|a, b| b.partial_cmp(a).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    ideal.truncate(10);
    let idcg = dcg(&ideal);
    let ndcg = if idcg > 0.0 { dc / idcg } else { 0.0 };
    (r5, r10, mrr, ndcg)
}

/// DCG：Σ rel_i / log2(i+1)，i 从 0 计（log2(2)=1）。
fn dcg(rels: &[f64]) -> f64 {
    rels.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, r)| r / (i as f64 + 2.0).log2())
        .sum()
}

/// 单一评估入口：报告/三种门禁 × 是否逐例诊断由参数决定，不再维护函数矩阵。
pub(crate) fn run(
    root: &str,
    path: &str,
    mode: Eval,
    verbose: bool,
) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<String>, bool)> {
    let gate_mode = match mode {
        Eval::Report => None,
        Eval::Mechanical => Some(Gate::Mechanical),
        Eval::Human => Some(Gate::Human),
        Eval::Items => Some(Gate::Items),
    };
    inner(root, path, verbose, gate_mode)
}

fn inner(
    root: &str,
    path: &str,
    verbose: bool,
    gate_mode: Option<Gate>,
) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<String>, bool)> {
    let txt = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
    let v = crate::memory::json::parse(&txt)
        .map_err(|e| std::io::Error::other(format!("eval: {e}")))?;
    let cases = baseline(&v).map_err(std::io::Error::other)?;
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let eval_now_s = crate::memory::util::parse(&meta.created_at);
    let (l1_base, l1_margin) = crate::memory::feedback::params(&meta);
    let plain = Plain::load(root, &meta)?;
    let mut acc = Acc::default();
    for c in &cases {
        let a = recall::clock(root, &c.query, 10, eval_now_s, &meta)?;
        let b = plain.search(&c.query, 10);
        acc.fold(c, a, b, l1_base, l1_margin, verbose);
    }
    report(&cases, &acc, verbose, gate_mode)
}

/// 一次重放的累加状态：分层顺序按首次出现保持（golden 稳定）。
#[derive(Default)]
struct Acc {
    l1_hit: usize,
    l1_total: usize,
    layers: Vec<String>,
    /// [n, A:r5,r10,mrr,ndcg, B:r5,r10,mrr,ndcg]；semantic 层报告 r@10（弱相关口径）。
    agg: HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>,
    /// 每层每 case 的 A/B mrr/ndcg 值（bootstrap 95% CI 重采样用）。
    per: HashMap<String, [Vec<f64>; 4]>,
    /// verbose 时缓存每例的 A/B 命中，聚合后统一输出诊断（避免二次召回）。
    diag: Vec<(String, Vec<Hit>, Vec<Hit>)>,
}

impl Acc {
    fn fold(
        &mut self,
        c: &Case,
        a: Vec<Hit>,
        b: Vec<Hit>,
        l1_base: f64,
        l1_margin: f64,
        verbose: bool,
    ) {
        // L1 自答率：分母是全部有期望结果的 case。旧口径只在 top1 命中时计入
        // 分母，等于把"答错"整体剔除，命中率虚高；间距也必须与生产
        // `feedback::qualified` 同口径（sim 差，而不是 BM25 绝对分差）。
        if !c.expected.is_empty() {
            self.l1_total += 1;
            if let Some(top) = a.first() {
                let second = a.get(1).map_or(0.0, |h| h.sim);
                if crate::memory::feedback::qualified(top.sim, second, l1_base, l1_margin)
                    && contains(&c.expected, &top.id)
                {
                    self.l1_hit += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        let (ar5, ar10, amrr, andcg) = metric(c, &a);
        let (br5, br10, bmrr, bndcg) = metric(c, &b);
        let e = self.agg.entry(c.layer.clone()).or_insert([0.0; 9]);
        e[0] += 1.0;
        e[1] += ar5;
        e[2] += ar10;
        e[3] += amrr;
        e[4] += andcg;
        e[5] += br5;
        e[6] += br10;
        e[7] += bmrr;
        e[8] += bndcg;
        let p = self
            .per
            .entry(c.layer.clone())
            .or_insert_with(|| [Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Vec::new(), Vec::new()]);
        p[0].push(amrr);
        p[1].push(andcg);
        p[2].push(bmrr);
        p[3].push(bndcg);
        if !self.layers.iter().any(|l| l == &c.layer) {
            self.layers.push(c.layer.clone());
        }
        if verbose {
            self.diag.push((c.query.clone(), a, b));
        }
    }
}

/// 汇总报告行 + 门禁判定；返回（输出行，是否未通过门禁）。
fn report(
    cases: &[Case],
    acc: &Acc,
    verbose: bool,
    gate_mode: Option<Gate>,
) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<String>, bool)> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(acc.layers.len() + 2);
    // 报告 NDCG 判别强度——multi-rel 条目（expected>1 或 rel 多值）
    // 使 NDCG 非二值；single-rel 条目 NDCG 接近二值（单相关时评估严格性有限）。
    let multi_rel = cases
        .iter()
        .filter(|c| c.expected.len() > 1 || c.rel.values().any(|r| *r > 0.0 && *r < 2.0))
        .count();
    out.push(format!(
        "eval: cases={} layers={} multi-rel={} single-rel={} (NDCG strength)",
        cases.len(),
        acc.layers.join(","),
        multi_rel,
        cases.len().saturating_sub(multi_rel)
    ));
    for l in &acc.layers {
        let e = acc.agg.get(l).unwrap_or(&[0.0; 9]);
        out.push(layer(l, e, acc.per.get(l).unwrap()));
    }
    // L1 直答命中率出表。
    let l1_rate = if acc.l1_total > 0 {
        acc.l1_hit as f64 / acc.l1_total as f64
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    out.push(format!(
        "l1: hits={} total={} rate={l1_rate:.3}",
        acc.l1_hit, acc.l1_total
    ));
    // 机械门——样本量/分层/裁决元数据/主指标 A≥B。
    let mut gate_failed = false;
    if let Some(mode) = gate_mode {
        let g = gate(mode, cases, acc);
        out.extend(g.lines);
        gate_failed = g.failed;
    }
    // 逐 case 诊断段（A/B 各 top-10，case 尾 8 位与 --eval 口径一致）。
    if verbose {
        for (i, (q, a, b)) in acc.diag.iter().enumerate() {
            out.push(format!("case {}/{} q=\"{}\"", i + 1, acc.diag.len(), q));
            out.push(format!("  A: {}", hits(a, &cases[i])));
            out.push(format!("  B: {}", hits(b, &cases[i])));
        }
    }
    Ok((out, gate_failed))
}

/// 按门禁模式选择检查器。
fn gate(mode: Gate, cases: &[Case], acc: &Acc) -> crate::memory::gate::Verdict {
    match mode {
        Gate::Mechanical => crate::memory::gate::check(cases, &acc.layers, &acc.agg),
        Gate::Human => crate::memory::gate::human(cases, &acc.layers, &acc.agg),
        Gate::Items => crate::memory::gate::items(cases, &acc.layers, &acc.agg),
    }
}

/// 分层报告行：强相关层用 r@5，semantic 弱相关层用 r@10；CI 固定 seed。
fn layer(name: &str, e: &[f64; 9], p: &[Vec<f64>; 4]) -> String {
    let n = e[0].max(1.0);
    let (k, a_r, b_r) = if name == "semantic" {
        (10, e[2], e[6])
    } else {
        (5, e[1], e[5])
    };
    let am = bootstrap(&p[0], CI_SEED);
    let an = bootstrap(&p[1], CI_SEED);
    let bm = bootstrap(&p[2], CI_SEED);
    let bn = bootstrap(&p[3], CI_SEED);
    format!(
        "layer {name}: n={:.0} A r@{k}={:.3} mrr={:.3} ci95=[{:.3},{:.3}] ndcg@10={:.3} ci95=[{:.3},{:.3}] | B r@{k}={:.3} mrr={:.3} ci95=[{:.3},{:.3}] ndcg@10={:.3} ci95=[{:.3},{:.3}]",
        e[0],
        a_r / n,
        e[3] / n,
        am.0,
        am.1,
        e[4] / n,
        an.0,
        an.1,
        b_r / n,
        e[7] / n,
        bm.0,
        bm.1,
        e[8] / n,
        bn.0,
        bn.1,
    )
}

/// 单行候选诊断：`1) <tail8> sim=0.86 score=0.55 [hit] | 2) ... [miss]`。
fn hits(hits: &[Hit], c: &Case) -> String {
    if hits.is_empty() {
        return "(no hits)".to_string();
    }
    let mut parts = Vec::with_capacity(hits.len());
    for (i, h) in hits.iter().enumerate() {
        let tail = h.id.rsplit('_').next().unwrap_or(&h.id);
        let tag = if contains(&c.expected, &h.id) {
            "hit"
        } else {
            "miss"
        };
        parts.push(format!(
            "{}) {} sim={:.2} score={:.2} [{}]",
            i + 1,
            tail,
            h.sim,
            h.score,
            tag
        ));
    }
    parts.join(" | ")
}

/// bootstrap 95% CI（百分位法，固定 seed 确定性可重放）。
/// 对每层每 case 的指标值有放回重采样，取 2.5/97.5 百分位——n 很小（9/3）时
/// 置信区间如实展示不确定性，不允许"点值更高 = 更好"的结论。
const CI_SEED: u64 = 0x5DEE_CE66_D202_6102;

/// xorshift64*：零依赖确定性 PRNG（无随机源，同 seed 逐位可重放）。
struct Rng(u64);
impl Rng {
    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.0;
        x ^= x >> 12;
        x ^= x << 25;
        x ^= x >> 27;
        self.0 = x;
        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D)
    }
}

/// 有放回重采样 B 次 → 样本均值 → 95% 分位区间。空输入返回 (0,0)。
fn bootstrap(vals: &[f64], seed: u64) -> (f64, f64) {
    const B: usize = 1000;
    let n = vals.len();
    if n == 0 {
        return (0.0, 0.0);
    }
    let mut rng = Rng(seed ^ 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
    let mut means = Vec::with_capacity(B);
    for _ in 0..B {
        let mut s = 0.0;
        for _ in 0..n {
            let idx = (rng.next() % n as u64) as usize;
            s += vals[idx];
        }
        means.push(s / n as f64);
    }
    means.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    let lo = means[(B * 25 / 1000).min(B - 1)];
    let hi = means[(B * 975 / 1000).min(B - 1)];
    (lo, hi)
}

/// 评估 B 基线：朴素 BM25。全库候选（无桶过滤）、纯词面 BM25（无字段加权/
/// 衰减/quality/词权/PRF/MMR）、sim=score/sm 归一、按 score 降序取 top-k。
/// 语料只加载一次，150 条查询复用，避免每个 case 重复读取全库 JSON。
struct Plain {
    docs: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)>,
    df: HashMap<String, usize>,
    n: f64,
    avgdl: f64,
    k1: f64,
    b: f64,
}

impl Plain {
    fn load(root: &str, meta: &store::Meta) -> std::io::Result<Self> {
        let mut docs = Vec::new();
        let mut df: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        let mut total_len = 0usize;
        for id in store::list(root)? {
            let c = store::load(root, &id)?;
            let (_, terms) = document(&c.query, &c.text);
            total_len += terms.len();
            for t in &terms {
                *df.entry(t.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
            }
            docs.push((id, terms));
        }
        let n = docs.len() as f64;
        Ok(Self {
            avgdl: if n > 0.0 { total_len as f64 / n } else { 0.0 },
            n,
            docs,
            df,
            k1: meta.param("bm25_k1"),
            b: meta.param("bm25_b"),
        })
    }

    fn search(&self, query: &str, k: usize) -> Vec<Hit> {
        if self.docs.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let qterms = memory(query);
        // query 相关 IDF 只依赖 df，与文档无关：每条 query 预计算一次，
        // 避免在 10k 候选 × 150 query 的热路径上重复做 df 查表与 ln。
        let qidf: Vec<f64> = qterms
            .iter()
            .map(|qt| {
                let d = *self.df.get(qt).unwrap_or(&0) as f64;
                crate::memory::ranking::idf(self.n, d)
            })
            .collect();
        let sm: f64 = qidf.iter().sum();
        let mut scored: Vec<(usize, f64)> = Vec::with_capacity(self.docs.len());
        for (idx, (_, terms)) in self.docs.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut score = 0.0;
            let denom =
                crate::memory::ranking::denom(self.k1, self.b, terms.len() as f64, self.avgdl);
            for (qt, idf) in qterms.iter().zip(&qidf) {
                if terms.binary_search(qt).is_err() {
                    continue;
                }
                score += crate::memory::ranking::score(*idf, self.k1, denom);
            }
            // 与 A 管线的零支持度过滤同口径：没有 query 词命中的 case 不得以
            // 0 分进入 top-k，否则 B 会靠库顺序"碰巧命中"被高估。
            if score > 0.0 {
                scored.push((idx, score));
            }
        }
        scored.sort_by(|a, b| {
            b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1)
                .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
                .then_with(|| self.docs[a.0].0.cmp(&self.docs[b.0].0))
        });
        scored.truncate(k);
        scored
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(idx, score)| Hit {
                id: self.docs[idx].0.clone(),
                score,
                sim: if sm > 0.0 {
                    (score / sm).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

/// 运行期 [l1] 历史出表（--l1-hist）——top1.sim 采样分布统计。
/// hist 由 recall 侧每次 meta::record 落盘（meta.toml [l1] hist，CAP 上限），
/// 出表兑现"L1 命中率可统计"；over_base = 达到当前 l1_base 的采样占比。
pub(crate) fn history(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let h = &meta.l1_hist;
    if h.is_empty() {
        return Ok(vec!["l1hist: n=0 (no recall history yet)".to_string()]);
    }
    let mut sorted = h.clone();
    sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    let p = |q: f64| {
        let idx = ((sorted.len() as f64 - 1.0) * q).round() as usize;
        sorted[idx]
    };
    let mean = h.iter().sum::<f64>() / h.len() as f64;
    let base = crate::memory::feedback::params(&meta).0;
    let over = h.iter().filter(|s| **s >= base).count();
    Ok(vec![format!(
        "l1hist: n={} mean={mean:.3} p50={:.3} p90={:.3} over_base={over} (base={base:.2})",
        h.len(),
        p(0.50),
        p(0.90),
    )])
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn hit(id: &str, score: f64) -> Hit {
        Hit {
            id: id.to_string(),
            score,
            sim: score,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn dcg_matches_standard() {
        // rel [2,1]：2/1 + 1/log2(3) = 2 + 0.6309
        let d = dcg(&[2.0, 1.0]);
        assert!((d - (2.0 + 1.0 / (3.0f64).log2())).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert_eq!(dcg(&[]), 0.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn expected_does_not_override_tail_label_with_one() {
        // rel 用 hash 后缀、expected 用完整 id（跨日重建后的常见形态）：
        // 解析不得再插入一个 rel=1 的完整 id 键，否则 rel_of 随机取到 1/2。
        let v = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q","layer":"literal","expected":["2026-10-22_abcdef0123456789"],"rel":{"abcdef0123456789":2},"judge":{"by":"fei","date":"2026-10-24T00:00:00Z"}}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let cases = baseline(&v).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cases[0].rel.len(), 1, "{:?}", cases[0].rel);
        assert_eq!(relation(&cases[0], "2026-10-24_abcdef0123456789"), 2.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn l1_accuracy_denominator_covers_all_expected_cases() {
        let mut rel = HashMap::new();
        rel.insert("c1".to_string(), 2.0);
        let mk = |expected: &[&str]| Case {
            query: "q".to_string(),
            layer: "literal".to_string(),
            expected: expected.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(),
            rel: rel.clone(),
            judged_by: None,
            judged_date: None,
            judged_method: None,
            judge_items: HashMap::new(),
        };
        let mut acc = Acc::default();
        // 例 1：top1 正确且自信（sim 0.9，间距 0.4）→ 自答命中。
        acc.fold(
            &mk(&["c1"]),
            vec![hit("c1", 0.9), hit("c2", 0.5)],
            vec![],
            0.55,
            0.15,
            false,
        );
        // 例 2：top1 答错（分数很高）→ 必须计入分母且算未命中。
        acc.fold(
            &mk(&["c1"]),
            vec![hit("c9", 0.95)],
            vec![],
            0.55,
            0.15,
            false,
        );
        // 例 3：top1 正确但间距 0.1 < 0.15 → 不自答。
        acc.fold(
            &mk(&["c1"]),
            vec![hit("c1", 0.9), hit("c2", 0.85)],
            vec![],
            0.55,
            0.15,
            false,
        );
        assert_eq!(acc.l1_total, 3, "所有有期望结果的 case 都要计入分母");
        assert_eq!(acc.l1_hit, 1, "只有正确且自信的 case 计入命中");
    }

    #[test]
    fn metric_recall_mrr_ndcg() {
        let mut rel = HashMap::new();
        rel.insert("c1".to_string(), 2.0);
        rel.insert("c2".to_string(), 1.0);
        let c = Case {
            query: "q".to_string(),
            layer: "literal".to_string(),
            expected: vec!["c1".to_string(), "c2".to_string()],
            rel,
            judged_by: None,
            judged_date: None,
            judged_method: None,
            judge_items: HashMap::new(),
        };
        // 命中顺序 c2 在前：recall@5=1.0，recall@10=1.0，MRR=1/1（c2 首个 expected 即第一），NDCG<1（c1 排后）。
        let hits = vec![hit("c2", 0.9), hit("c1", 0.8), hit("c3", 0.1)];
        let (r5, r10, mrr, ndcg) = metric(&c, &hits);
        assert!((r5 - 1.0).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((r10 - 1.0).abs() < 1e-9);
        assert!((mrr - 1.0).abs() < 1e-9);
        // DCG=1/1+2/log2(3)=2.2619，IDCG=2/1+1/log2(3)=2.6309 → NDCG≈0.8597（c1 rel=2 排在 c2 后）。
        assert!((ndcg - 0.8597).abs() < 1e-3, "ndcg={ndcg}");
        // 完全未命中：全 0。
        let (r5, r10, mrr, ndcg) = metric(&c, &[hit("c9", 0.5)]);
        assert_eq!((r5, r10, mrr, ndcg), (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn frozen_full_ids_match_across_date_prefix() {
        let expected = vec!["2026-10-22_337ecde86ee61f26".to_string()];
        let current = "2026-10-24_337ecde86ee61f26";
        assert!(contains(&expected, current));
        let mut rel = HashMap::new();
        rel.insert(expected[0].clone(), 2.0);
        let c = Case {
            query: "q".to_string(),
            layer: "literal".to_string(),
            expected,
            rel,
            judged_by: None,
            judged_date: None,
            judged_method: None,
            judge_items: HashMap::new(),
        };
        assert_eq!(relation(&c, current), 2.0);
        assert!(!same("2026-10-22_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", current));
    }

    #[test]
    fn ndcg_never_exceeds_one_with_non_expected_relevant() {
        // rel 里有非 expected 的弱相关候选：理想排序必须把它纳入 IDCG，
        // 否则 top-10 命中它时 NDCG 会超过 1.0（回归：gate 实测 literal 1.108）。
        let mut rel = HashMap::new();
        rel.insert("t".to_string(), 2.0);
        rel.insert("w".to_string(), 1.0);
        let c = Case {
            query: "q".to_string(),
            layer: "literal".to_string(),
            expected: vec!["t".to_string()],
            rel,
            judged_by: None,
            judged_date: None,
            judged_method: None,
            judge_items: HashMap::new(),
        };
        let hits = vec![hit("t", 1.0), hit("w", 0.9)];
        let (_, _, _, ndcg) = metric(&c, &hits);
        // DCG = 2/1 + 1/log2(3)；IDCG 同为 [2,1] → NDCG=1.0（不越界）。
        assert!((ndcg - 1.0).abs() < 1e-9, "ndcg={ndcg}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_baseline_is_strict_and_tolerant() {
        let v = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q1","layer":"literal","expected":["a","b"],"rel":{"a":2}}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let cases = baseline(&v).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(cases[0].expected, vec!["a".to_string(), "b".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(cases[0].rel.get("a"), Some(&2.0));
        assert_eq!(cases[0].rel.get("b"), Some(&1.0), "expected 内缺省 rel=1");
        // 缺 cases → 报错。
        assert!(baseline(&Val::Obj(Vec::new())).is_err());
        // rel 越界 → 报错。
        let bad = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q","layer":"l","expected":["a"],"rel":{"a":3}}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(baseline(&bad).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_baseline_reads_per_item_provenance() {
        let v = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q","layer":"semantic","expected":["a"],
                "rel":{"a":2,"b":0},
                "judge":{"by":"fei","date":"2026-10-24T00:00:00Z","method":"per-item-blind-v1"},
                "judge_items":{"a":{"by":"fei","date":"2026-10-24T00:00:00Z"},
                               "b":{"by":"fei","date":"2026-10-24T00:00:00Z"}}}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let cases = baseline(&v).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cases[0].judge_items.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            cases[0].judge_items.get("b").map(String::as_str),
            Some("fei")
        );
        assert_eq!(cases[0].judged_method.as_deref(), Some("per-item-blind-v1"));
    }

    /// judge:null（未裁决）必须被 --eval 拒绝，防止接受预填 rel 自证。
    #[test]
    fn parse_baseline_rejects_unjudged() {
        let v = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q","layer":"paraphrase","expected":["a"],"judge":null}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let e = baseline(&v).unwrap_err();
        assert!(e.contains("unjudged"), "{e}");
        // 裁决后（judge 对象 + rel）→ 正常解析。
        let v2 = crate::memory::json::parse(
            r#"{"cases":[{"query":"q","layer":"paraphrase","expected":["a"],"rel":{"a":1},"judge":{"by":"tester","date":"2026-10-22T00:00:00Z"}}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let cases = baseline(&v2).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(cases[0].rel.get("a"), Some(&1.0));
        assert_eq!(cases[0].judged_by.as_deref(), Some("tester"));
        assert_eq!(
            cases[0].judged_date.as_deref(),
            Some("2026-10-22T00:00:00Z")
        );
    }

    /// bootstrap CI 必须确定性（同 seed 同输出）且区间在 [min,max] 内。
    #[test]
    fn bootstrap_ci_deterministic_and_bounded() {
        let vals = vec![1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0.0];
        let (a_lo, a_hi) = bootstrap(&vals, CI_SEED);
        let (b_lo, b_hi) = bootstrap(&vals, CI_SEED);
        assert_eq!(a_lo, b_lo, "同 seed 必须逐位可重放");
        assert_eq!(a_hi, b_hi);
        assert!(a_lo >= 0.0 && a_hi <= 1.000_000_1, "区间在指标范围内");
        assert!(a_lo <= a_hi);
        // 空输入 → (0,0) 不 panic。
        assert_eq!(bootstrap(&[], CI_SEED), (0.0, 0.0));
    }
}

//! 反馈双环：`--rate good|bad <case-id>` 落地 case 状态机、质量分、
//! 词级调权与 L1 自适应置信基线。
//!
//! - case 环：quality = good/(good+bad)，状态机 open→solved→regressed，
//!   quality 进入排序先验（recall::score_pass 乘 (1+quality*quality_prior)）。
//! - 词环：good 词 +Δ / bad 词 −Δ（meta.toml [word_w]，默认上下限 ±0.5）。
//! - L1 自适应：recall 侧把每次 top1.sim 记入 [l1] 历史（meta::record），
//!   rate 时重算 l1_base = P50(历史) 写回 [params]，CLI 过滤用动态基线 + margin。

use crate::memory::meta::{self, Meta};
use crate::memory::store;
use crate::memory::store::{Case, Feedback};
use crate::memory::util::stamp;

/// 反馈后重算 L1 自适应基线并写回 meta [params]（失败静默，旁路）。
fn adapt(root: &str) {
    let Ok(meta) = meta::load(root) else {
        return;
    };
    let min_history = meta.param("l1_adapt_min_history").max(1.0) as usize;
    if meta.l1_hist.len() < min_history {
        return; // 历史太少不滑动，保持默认 0.55。
    }
    let mut sorted = meta.l1_hist.clone();
    sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    let mid = sorted.len() / 2;
    let p50 = if sorted.len() % 2 == 0 {
        (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2.0
    } else {
        sorted[mid]
    };
    let base = p50.clamp(meta.param("l1_adapt_min"), meta.param("l1_adapt_max"));
    let _ = meta::set(root, "l1_base", base);
}

/// 反馈标注：good=true 记 good，false 记 bad。
/// 返回更新后的 case（含 quality/status），供 CLI 输出核对。
pub(crate) fn rate(root: &str, id: &str, good: bool) -> std::io::Result<Case> {
    let _case_lock = store::lock(root, id)?;
    let mut c = store::load(root, id)?;
    let fb = feedback(&c, good);
    c.feedback = fb.clone();
    c.quality = if fb.good + fb.bad == 0 {
        0.0
    } else {
        fb.good as f64 / (fb.good + fb.bad) as f64
    };
    c.status = status(&c.status, good, c.quality);
    c.updated_at = stamp();
    // 词环：该 case 词表 ±Δ（仅质量≥0.5 的 good / bad 参与，防误标污染）。
    let terms = terms(&c);
    if (good && c.quality >= 0.5) || c.status == "regressed" {
        meta::learn(root, &terms, good);
    }
    // 写回 case（原子写；save 内部 bump gen，qmap/缓存随之失效）。
    store::save(root, &c)?;
    // L1 自适应：基于 [l1] 历史重算 l1_base。
    adapt(root);
    Ok(c)
}

fn feedback(c: &Case, good: bool) -> Feedback {
    if good {
        Feedback {
            good: c.feedback.good + 1,
            bad: c.feedback.bad,
        }
    } else {
        Feedback {
            good: c.feedback.good,
            bad: c.feedback.bad + 1,
        }
    }
}

/// 状态机（§4.1）：open → solved（good 且 quality≥0.5）→ regressed（bad 且曾 solved）。
fn status(prev: &str, good: bool, quality: f64) -> String {
    match (prev, good, quality) {
        (_, true, q) if q >= 0.5 => "solved".to_string(),
        ("solved", false, _) => "regressed".to_string(),
        (s, false, _) if s != "solved" => s.to_string(), // 直接 bad 标 open：无效经验，不改态
        (s, _, _) => s.to_string(),
    }
}

/// case 词表并入 query 切词结果（保序去重）。
fn terms(c: &Case) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut terms = c.terms.clone();
    for t in crate::terms::memory(&c.query) {
        if !terms.contains(&t) {
            terms.push(t);
        }
    }
    terms
}

/// L1 自适应置信判据（§5.1）：sim_top1 ≥ l1_base 且 (top1−top2) ≥ margin。
/// 两重判据已足够保守：`--fix` 始终是候选答案（SKILL.md 要求验证后再直答）。
pub(crate) fn qualified(top1_sim: f64, top2_sim: f64, l1_base: f64, margin: f64) -> bool {
    top1_sim >= l1_base && (top1_sim - top2_sim) >= margin
}

/// 从 meta 读 l1_base / l1_margin_min；缺省值统一由 `meta::DEFAULT_PARAMS` 提供。
pub(crate) fn params(meta: &Meta) -> (f64, f64) {
    (meta.param("l1_base"), meta.param("l1_margin_min"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::ingest::ingest;
    use crate::memory::store::{self, Stats};
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::fs;

    fn stats() -> Stats {
        crate::memory::store::sample()
    }

    #[test]
    fn rate_good_moves_open_to_solved() {
        let root = root("good");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "连接超时",
            vec!["timeout".into()],
            "ERROR conn timeout alpha",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        let c = rate(&root, &id, true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.status, "solved");
        assert_eq!(c.feedback.good, 1);
        assert_eq!(c.quality, 1.0);
        // 词环已写：timeout / conn / error 应有词权重。
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert!(
            m.word_w.iter().any(|(k, v)| k == "timeout" && *v > 0.0),
            "good 词应有正权重: {:?}",
            m.word_w
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rate_bad_regresses_solved_case() {
        let root = root("bad");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "连接超时",
            vec!["timeout".into()],
            "ERROR conn timeout beta",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        rate(&root, &id, true).unwrap();
        let c = rate(&root, &id, false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.status, "regressed");
        assert_eq!(c.quality, 0.5);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn l1_qualified_requires_base_and_margin() {
        assert!(qualified(0.8, 0.4, 0.6, 0.15), "达标");
        assert!(!qualified(0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.15), "margin 不足");
        assert!(!qualified(0.5, 0.1, 0.6, 0.15), "低于基线");
    }

    #[test]
    fn l1_base_adapts_after_enough_history() {
        let root = root("adapt");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "连接超时",
            vec!["timeout".into()],
            "ERROR conn timeout gamma",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // 写入 4 条历史：0.7/0.8/0.9/1.0 → P50=0.85。
        for s in [0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0] {
            meta::record(&root, s);
        }
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        rate(&root, &id, true).unwrap();
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        let (base, _) = params(&m);
        assert!(
            (base - 0.85).abs() < 0.01,
            "l1_base 应滑动到 P50≈0.85, got {base}"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn l1_adapt_clamp_comes_from_config() {
        let root = root("adaptcfg");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "连接超时",
            vec!["timeout".into()],
            "ERROR conn timeout delta",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        meta::set(&root, "l1_adapt_max", 0.80).unwrap();
        for s in [0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0] {
            meta::record(&root, s);
        }
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        rate(&root, &id, true).unwrap();
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        let (base, _) = params(&m);
        assert!((base - 0.80).abs() < 1e-9, "上限应来自配置: {base}");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn concurrent_rate_same_case_does_not_lose_feedback() {
        let root = root("conc");
        ingest(
            &root,
            "连接超时",
            vec!["timeout".into()],
            "ERROR conn timeout concurrent",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &stats(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        let root = std::sync::Arc::new(root);
        let id = std::sync::Arc::new(id);
        let barrier = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(8));
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let root = root.clone();
            let id = id.clone();
            let barrier = barrier.clone();
            handles.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {
                barrier.wait();
                for _ in 0..5 {
                    rate(&root, &id, true).unwrap();
                }
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        let c = store::load(&root, &id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.feedback.good, 40, "并发 rate 的读改写不得丢更新");
        assert_eq!(c.quality, 1.0);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root.as_str());
    }
}

//! 证据门：机械、逐项与人工三种强度的可执行校验。
//!
//! `--gate` 只校验机械资格（样本量/分层/裁决元数据/A 不劣于 B）；
//! `--gate-human` 额外要求全量人工裁决、弱相关与负例控制，并校验 NDCG。
//! 后者才是"人工弱相关/负例闭环"的证据门，机械 target 标签不能替代它。
//!
//! 目标：把"30–50 组、每层 ≥10、非 literal 必须人工裁决、A 不劣于 B"
//! 从口头约定变成可执行门禁，防止用 5 条 demo 或自动标注集冒充人工证据。
//!
//! 纯函数：只读解析后的 Case 与已聚合指标，不触碰库、不写文件。

use crate::memory::eval::Case;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// 证据门最少总组数（30–50 组；超过 50 组不惩罚）。
pub(crate) const MIN_TOTAL: usize = 30;
/// 每层最少组数（literal / paraphrase / semantic）。
pub(crate) const MIN_LAYER: usize = 10;
/// 浮点比较容差：指标是整数计数除以 n，1e-9 足以吸收除法误差。
const EPS: f64 = 1e-9;
/// 绝对地板：拒绝"全部 miss / 基线退化"仍因相对非劣而 PASS。
/// 取值低于 Gauge 各层实测最差值（paraphrase r@5 0.567、MRR 0.242），
/// 只拦截退化到不可用区间的结果，不替代相对非劣判定。
pub(crate) const MIN_RECALL: f64 = 0.20;
pub(crate) const MIN_MRR: f64 = 0.10;
/// 人工闭环最少弱相关标签数：10 与单层样本下限一致，避免单个边界例冒充控制集。
pub(crate) const MIN_WEAK: usize = 10;
/// 人工闭环最少负例标签数：同样取 10（理由同上）。
pub(crate) const MIN_NEGATIVE: usize = 10;
/// 至少两层同时含弱相关与负例：防止全部控制集中在一层。
pub(crate) const MIN_CONTROL_LAYERS: usize = 2;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Gate {
    Mechanical,
    Human,
    Items,
}

impl Gate {
    fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Gate::Mechanical => "mechanical",
            Gate::Human => "human",
            Gate::Items => "items",
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Verdict {
    pub lines: Vec<String>,
    pub failed: bool,
}

/// 机械校验证据门。`layers` 为报告层顺序，`agg` 为 eval 的 [n, A(4), B(4)] 聚合。
pub(crate) fn check(cases: &[Case], layers: &[String], agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>) -> Verdict {
    mode(cases, layers, agg, Gate::Mechanical)
}

/// 人工弱相关/负例闭环门：在机械门之上增加全量人工元数据、控制标签与 NDCG 校验。
pub(crate) fn human(cases: &[Case], layers: &[String], agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>) -> Verdict {
    mode(cases, layers, agg, Gate::Human)
}

/// 逐候选裁决门（允许非人类裁决人）：证据等级低于 `--gate-human`，
/// 只证明"每一条候选都有独立裁决记录"，不证明人工闭环。
pub(crate) fn items(cases: &[Case], layers: &[String], agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>) -> Verdict {
    mode(cases, layers, agg, Gate::Items)
}

fn mode(cases: &[Case], layers: &[String], agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>, mode: Gate) -> Verdict {
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    let mut failed = false;

    lines.push(format!("gate: mode={}", mode.name()));
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: total={} need>={MIN_TOTAL} (target 30-50) {}",
        cases.len(),
        verdict(cases.len() >= MIN_TOTAL)
    ));
    failed |= cases.len() < MIN_TOTAL;

    tiers(cases, &mut lines, &mut failed);
    unknown(layers, &mut lines, &mut failed);
    literal(cases, &mut lines, &mut failed);

    if mode != Gate::Mechanical {
        adjudication(
            cases,
            layers,
            agg,
            &mut lines,
            &mut failed,
            mode == Gate::Human,
        );
    }

    // 主指标预声明：literal/paraphrase 用 r@5，semantic 用 r@10；另加 MRR。
    // NDCG 只报告不过门（单相关时接近二值，判别力弱）。
    // 同时校验 A/B 的绝对地板：B 全 miss 时 A 的"相对优势"不是有效证据。
    let diff_layers = metrics(layers, agg, &mut lines, &mut failed);

    // 标签分布与判别力只告警、不单独判失败：全 2 的语料可以证明"能召回"，
    // 但证明不了 A 相对 B 的优势；报告必须带着这两行引用。
    spread(cases, &mut lines);

    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: discrimination A!=B layers={diff_layers}/{}",
        layers.len()
    ));
    if diff_layers == 0 {
        lines.push("gate: warning A=B on all layers (no measurable advantage)".to_string());
    }

    if mode == Gate::Mechanical {
        lines.push(
            "gate: note mechanical target labels are not human weak/negative closure; use --gate-human"
                .to_string(),
        );
    }
    lines.push(format!("gate: {}", if failed { "FAIL" } else { "PASS" }));
    Verdict { lines, failed }
}

/// 固定三层（literal/paraphrase/semantic）的样本量门槛。
fn tiers(cases: &[Case], lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    for layer in ["literal", "paraphrase", "semantic"] {
        let n = cases.iter().filter(|c| c.layer == layer).count();
        let ok = n >= MIN_LAYER;
        lines.push(format!(
            "gate: layer {layer} n={n} need>={MIN_LAYER} {}",
            verdict(ok)
        ));
        *failed |= !ok;
    }
}

/// 未知层不允许用来凑总数：证据门只认三层。
fn unknown(layers: &[String], lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    for layer in layers {
        if !matches!(layer.as_str(), "literal" | "paraphrase" | "semantic") {
            lines.push(format!("gate: unknown layer {layer} FAIL"));
            *failed = true;
        }
    }
}

/// non-literal 层的 judge 元数据（by+date）与占位裁决人拒绝。
/// literal 是 query 原样/指纹机械判定，不要求 judge 元数据；
/// paraphrase/semantic 必须由 --judge 写入 by+date，自动标注集不得过门。
fn literal(cases: &[Case], lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    let non_literal = cases.iter().filter(|c| c.layer != "literal").count();
    let meta_ok = cases
        .iter()
        .filter(|c| c.layer != "literal")
        .all(|c| acceptable(c.judged_by.as_deref()) && present(c.judged_date.as_deref()));
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: judge metadata nonliteral={non_literal} (need real by+date) {}",
        verdict(meta_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !meta_ok;
    let mut placeholders: Vec<String> = cases
        .iter()
        .filter(|c| c.layer != "literal" && !acceptable(c.judged_by.as_deref()))
        .filter_map(|c| c.judged_by.clone())
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        .collect();
    placeholders.sort();
    placeholders.dedup();
    if !placeholders.is_empty() {
        lines.push(format!(
            "gate: placeholder judge rejected: {}",
            placeholders.join(", ")
        ));
    }
}

/// 逐层主指标（r@5/r@10 + MRR）相对非劣与绝对地板；返回 A≠B 的层数。
fn metrics(
    layers: &[String],
    agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>,
    lines: &mut Vec<String>,
    failed: &mut bool,
) -> usize {
    let mut diff_layers = 0usize;
    for layer in layers {
        let Some(e) = agg.get(layer) else {
            continue;
        };
        let n = e[0];
        if n <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        if metric(layer, n, e, lines, failed) {
            diff_layers += 1;
        }
    }
    diff_layers
}

/// 单层主指标判定；返回 A 与 B 是否有可测差异。
fn metric(layer: &str, n: f64, e: &[f64; 9], lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) -> bool {
    let (a_r, b_r, metric) = if layer == "semantic" {
        (e[2] / n, e[6] / n, "r@10")
    } else {
        (e[1] / n, e[5] / n, "r@5")
    };
    let a_mrr = e[3] / n;
    let b_mrr = e[7] / n;
    let r_ok = a_r + EPS >= b_r;
    let m_ok = a_mrr + EPS >= b_mrr;
    let r_floor_ok = a_r >= MIN_RECALL && b_r >= MIN_RECALL;
    let m_floor_ok = a_mrr >= MIN_MRR && b_mrr >= MIN_MRR;
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: layer {layer} A {metric}={a_r:.3} vs B={b_r:.3} {}; A mrr={a_mrr:.3} vs B={b_mrr:.3} {}",
        verdict(r_ok),
        verdict(m_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !r_ok || !m_ok;
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: layer {layer} absolute A/B {metric}={a_r:.3}/{b_r:.3}>={MIN_RECALL:.2} {}; mrr={a_mrr:.3}/{b_mrr:.3}>={MIN_MRR:.2} {}",
        verdict(r_floor_ok),
        verdict(m_floor_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !r_floor_ok || !m_floor_ok;
    (a_r - b_r).abs() > EPS || (a_mrr - b_mrr).abs() > EPS
}

/// rel 标签分布统计与"全 2"告警。
fn spread(cases: &[Case], lines: &mut Vec<String>) {
    let mut rel2 = 0usize;
    let mut rel1 = 0usize;
    let mut rel0 = 0usize;
    for c in cases {
        for v in c.rel.values() {
            if *v >= 2.0 {
                rel2 += 1;
            } else if *v >= 1.0 {
                rel1 += 1;
            } else {
                rel0 += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    lines.push(format!("gate: rel distribution 2={rel2} 1={rel1} 0={rel0}"));
    if rel2 > 0 && rel1 == 0 && rel0 == 0 {
        lines.push("gate: warning all labels are 2 (no weak/negative controls)".to_string());
    }
}

fn adjudication(
    cases: &[Case],
    layers: &[String],
    agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>,
    lines: &mut Vec<String>,
    failed: &mut bool,
    human: bool,
) {
    judge(cases, human, lines, failed);
    policy(cases, lines, failed);
    item(cases, human, lines, failed);
    if !human {
        let mut names: Vec<String> = cases.iter().filter_map(|c| c.judged_by.clone()).collect();
        names.sort();
        names.dedup();
        lines.push(format!(
            "gate: adjudicator={} non-human (evidence: per-item AI, not human closure)",
            names.join(",")
        ));
    }
    matches(cases, human, lines, failed);
    let (rel1, rel0, control_layers) = controls(cases, layers);
    let control_ok =
        rel1 >= MIN_WEAK && rel0 >= MIN_NEGATIVE && control_layers >= MIN_CONTROL_LAYERS;
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: human controls weak={rel1}>={MIN_WEAK} negative={rel0}>={MIN_NEGATIVE} layers={control_layers}>={MIN_CONTROL_LAYERS} {}",
        verdict(control_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !control_ok;
    ndcg(layers, agg, lines, failed);
}

/// 全量 judge 元数据（by+date）与裁决人去重清单。
fn judge(cases: &[Case], human: bool, lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    let judge_ok = cases.iter().all(|c| {
        let by_ok = if human {
            person(c)
        } else {
            acceptable(c.judged_by.as_deref()) && !materialized(c)
        };
        by_ok && present(c.judged_date.as_deref())
    });
    let mut judges: Vec<String> = cases
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|c| c.judged_by.as_deref())
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_lowercase())
        .collect();
    judges.sort();
    judges.dedup();
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: {} judge metadata all={} judges={} {}",
        if human { "human" } else { "items" },
        cases.len(),
        judges.join(","),
        verdict(judge_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !judge_ok;
}

/// 规则物化标签即使真人签署也不是逐条裁决；human 门必须失败。
fn policy(cases: &[Case], lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    let policy = cases.iter().filter(|c| materialized(c)).count();
    if policy > 0 {
        lines.push(format!(
            "gate: human provenance policy-materialized labels={policy} (not per-item review) FAIL"
        ));
        *failed = true;
    }
}

/// 逐候选溯源计数：required/covered/bad_by/complete_cases。
fn counts(cases: &[Case], human: bool) -> (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
    let mut required = 0usize;
    let mut covered = 0usize;
    let mut bad_by = 0usize;
    let mut complete_cases = 0usize;
    for c in cases {
        let mut complete = !c.rel.is_empty();
        for k in c.rel.keys() {
            required += 1;
            match classify(&c.judge_items, k, human) {
                Item::Covered => covered += 1,
                Item::Bad => {
                    bad_by += 1;
                    complete = false;
                }
                Item::Missing => complete = false,
            }
        }
        if complete {
            complete_cases += 1;
        }
    }
    (required, covered, bad_by, complete_cases)
}

/// 单候选裁决分类：covered / bad_by / missing。
enum Item {
    Covered,
    Bad,
    Missing,
}

fn classify(items: &HashMap<String, String>, k: &str, human: bool) -> Item {
    match items.get(k) {
        Some(by) if name(by) || (!human && acceptable(Some(by))) => Item::Covered,
        Some(_) => Item::Bad,
        None => Item::Missing,
    }
}

/// 逐候选溯源行：每个 rel 键都有真人 per-item 条目。
fn item(cases: &[Case], human: bool, lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    let (required, covered, bad_by, complete_cases) = counts(cases, human);
    let method_ok = cases.iter().all(|c| {
        c.judged_method
            .as_deref()
            .is_some_and(|m| m.to_lowercase().starts_with("per-item-"))
    });
    let items_ok = required > 0 && covered == required && bad_by == 0 && method_ok;
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: {} per-item provenance items={covered}/{required} cases={complete_cases}/{} bad={bad_by} method={} {}",
        if human { "human" } else { "items" },
        cases.len(),
        if method_ok { "per-item" } else { "missing/other" },
        verdict(items_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !items_ok;
}

/// literal 层 self-match：query 即目标原文，expected_rel 必须为 2。
fn matches(cases: &[Case], human: bool, lines: &mut Vec<String>, failed: &mut bool) {
    let literal: Vec<&Case> = cases
        .iter()
        .filter(|c| c.layer == "literal" && !c.rel.is_empty())
        .collect();
    let literal_bad = literal.iter().filter(|c| c.expected() != Some(2.0)).count();
    let literal_ok = literal_bad == 0;
    lines.push(format!(
        "gate: {} literal self-match rel=2 bad={literal_bad}/{} {}",
        if human { "human" } else { "items" },
        literal.len(),
        verdict(literal_ok)
    ));
    *failed |= !literal_ok;
}

/// 逐层统计弱相关(rel=1)/负例(rel=0)总数与同时含两者的层数。
fn controls(cases: &[Case], layers: &[String]) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
    let mut rel1 = 0usize;
    let mut rel0 = 0usize;
    let mut control_layers = 0usize;
    for layer in layers {
        let (weak, negative) = control(cases, layer);
        rel1 += weak;
        rel0 += negative;
        if weak > 0 && negative > 0 {
            control_layers += 1;
        }
    }
    (rel1, rel0, control_layers)
}

/// 单层的弱相关/负例标签计数。
fn control(cases: &[Case], layer: &str) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut weak = 0usize;
    let mut negative = 0usize;
    for c in cases.iter().filter(|c| c.layer == layer) {
        for v in c.rel.values() {
            if *v >= 2.0 {
                continue;
            }
            if *v >= 1.0 {
                weak += 1;
            } else {
                negative += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    (weak, negative)
}

/// 逐层 NDCG@10 相对非劣（人工闭环证据）。
fn ndcg(
    layers: &[String],
    agg: &HashMap<String, [f64; 9]>,
    lines: &mut Vec<String>,
    failed: &mut bool,
) {
    for layer in layers {
        let Some(e) = agg.get(layer) else {
            continue;
        };
        let n = e[0];
        if n <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let a_ndcg = e[4] / n;
        let b_ndcg = e[8] / n;
        let ok = a_ndcg + EPS >= b_ndcg;
        lines.push(format!(
            "gate: layer {layer} ndcg@10 A={a_ndcg:.3} vs B={b_ndcg:.3} {}",
            verdict(ok)
        ));
        *failed |= !ok;
    }
}

fn verdict(ok: bool) -> &'static str {
    if ok {
        "PASS"
    } else {
        "FAIL"
    }
}

fn present(s: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    s.is_some_and(|v| !v.trim().is_empty())
}

/// 真实裁决人标识：拒绝空值、尖括号占位符和常见匿名/模板名。
fn acceptable(s: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    let Some(s) = s else {
        return false;
    };
    let t = s.trim().to_lowercase();
    if t.is_empty() || t.contains('<') || t.contains('>') {
        return false;
    }
    !matches!(
        t.as_str(),
        "anonymous" | "todo" | "placeholder" | "your name" | "你的名字" | "name"
    )
}

/// 人工裁决人标识：机械 target 规则、AI 草案和自动标注不得冒充人工闭环。
fn person(c: &Case) -> bool {
    let Some(s) = c.judged_by.as_deref() else {
        return false;
    };
    name(s) && !materialized(c)
}

/// 逐候选裁决人标识：同一套真人判定，不含整包 policy 方法判断。
fn name(s: &str) -> bool {
    if !acceptable(Some(s)) {
        return false;
    }
    let t = s.trim().to_lowercase();
    ![
        "mechanical",
        "machine",
        "auto",
        "draft",
        "rule",
        "policy",
        "materialized",
        "rubric",
        "target-only",
        "codex",
        "ai:",
    ]
    .iter()
    .any(|w| t.contains(w))
}

/// 规则/评分卡物化标签：即使由真人签署，也不是逐条候选裁决。
fn materialized(c: &Case) -> bool {
    c.judged_method.as_deref().is_some_and(|m| {
        let m = m.to_lowercase();
        ["policy", "materialized", "rubric", "mechanical", "auto"]
            .iter()
            .any(|w| m.contains(w))
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn case(layer: &str, judged: bool) -> Case {
        Case {
            query: format!("q-{layer}"),
            layer: layer.to_string(),
            expected: vec!["a".to_string()],
            rel: HashMap::new(),
            judged_by: judged.then(|| "fei".to_string()),
            judged_date: judged.then(|| "2026-10-22T00:00:00Z".to_string()),
            judged_method: None,
            judge_items: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    /// 把当前 rel 的每个键都标成逐条人工裁决（测试用）。
    fn stamp_items(c: &mut Case, by: &str) {
        for k in c.rel.keys() {
            c.judge_items.insert(k.clone(), by.to_string());
        }
        c.judged_method = Some("per-item-blind-v1".to_string());
    }

    fn corpus() -> Vec<Case> {
        let mut cases = Vec::new();
        for layer in ["literal", "paraphrase", "semantic"] {
            for _ in 0..MIN_LAYER {
                cases.push(case(layer, layer != "literal"));
            }
        }
        cases
    }

    fn perfect_agg() -> HashMap<String, [f64; 9]> {
        let mut agg = HashMap::new();
        for layer in ["literal", "paraphrase", "semantic"] {
            // n=10，A/B 全部命中且排第 1：r=1、mrr=1、ndcg=1。
            agg.insert(layer.to_string(), [10.0; 9]);
        }
        agg
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_passes_complete_judged_corpus_with_a_not_worse_than_b() {
        let cases = corpus();
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &perfect_agg());
        assert!(!r.failed, "{}", r.lines.join("\n"));
        assert!(r.lines.last().unwrap().contains("gate: PASS"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_rejects_small_or_unbalanced_corpus() {
        let mut cases = corpus();
        cases.truncate(23);
        let layers = vec!["literal".to_string(), "paraphrase".to_string()];
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &perfect_agg());
        assert!(r.failed);
        let joined = r.lines.join("\n");
        assert!(joined.contains("total=23 need>=30"), "{joined}");
        assert!(
            joined.contains("layer semantic n=3 need>=10 FAIL"),
            "{joined}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_rejects_nonliteral_without_judge_metadata() {
        let mut cases = corpus();
        cases[10].judged_by = None; // 第一条 paraphrase 失去裁决人
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &perfect_agg());
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(
            r.lines.join("\n").contains("judge metadata nonliteral=20"),
            "{}",
            r.lines.join("\n")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_rejects_a_below_b_on_primary_metric() {
        let cases = corpus();
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let mut agg = perfect_agg();
        // paraphrase：A r@5=0.9，B=1.0；MRR 仍持平 → 必须失败。
        agg.get_mut("paraphrase").unwrap()[1] = 9.0;
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &agg);
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(
            r.lines.join("\n").contains("A r@5=0.900 vs B=1.000 FAIL"),
            "{}",
            r.lines.join("\n")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_rejects_degenerate_absolute_recall() {
        let cases = corpus();
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let mut all_miss = HashMap::new();
        for layer in &layers {
            let mut e = [0.0; 9];
            e[0] = MIN_LAYER as f64;
            all_miss.insert(layer.clone(), e);
        }
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &all_miss);
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(
            r.lines
                .join("\n")
                .contains("absolute A/B r@5=0.000/0.000>=0.20 FAIL"),
            "{}",
            r.lines.join("\n")
        );

        // A 满分但 B 全 miss：相对非劣成立，也不能作为有效比较证据。
        let mut broken_b = perfect_agg();
        broken_b.get_mut("paraphrase").unwrap()[5] = 0.0;
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &broken_b);
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(
            r.lines
                .join("\n")
                .contains("absolute A/B r@5=1.000/0.000>=0.20 FAIL"),
            "{}",
            r.lines.join("\n")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn gate_rejects_unknown_layer() {
        let mut cases = corpus();
        cases.push(case("other", false));
        let mut layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        layers.push("other".to_string());
        let mut agg = perfect_agg();
        agg.insert("other".to_string(), [1.0; 9]);
        let r = check(&cases, &layers, &agg);
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(r.lines.join("\n").contains("unknown layer other FAIL"));
    }

        );
