    #[test]
    fn items_gate_accepts_ai_but_human_gate_rejects_it() {
        let mut cases = corpus();
        for c in &mut cases {
            c.judged_by = Some("codex".to_string());
            c.judged_date = Some("2026-10-24T00:00:00Z".to_string());
            c.judged_method = Some("per-item-ai-v1".to_string());
            c.rel.insert("a".to_string(), 2.0);
            c.rel.insert("weak".to_string(), 1.0);
            c.rel.insert("negative".to_string(), 0.0);
            for k in c.rel.keys() {
                c.judge_items.insert(k.clone(), "codex".to_string());
            }
        }
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let items = items(&cases, &layers, &perfect_agg());
        assert!(!items.failed, "{}", items.lines.join("\n"));
        let joined = items.lines.join("\n");
        assert!(joined.contains("gate: mode=items"), "{joined}");
        assert!(
            joined.contains("non-human (evidence: per-item AI"),
            "{joined}"
        );
        let human = human(&cases, &layers, &perfect_agg());
        assert!(human.failed);
        assert!(
            human
                .lines
                .join("\n")
                .contains("human judge metadata all=30 judges=codex FAIL"),
            "{}",
            human.lines.join("\n")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn human_gate_rejects_ndcg_below_baseline() {
        let mut cases = corpus();
        for c in &mut cases {
            c.judged_by = Some("fei+hao".to_string());
            c.judged_date = Some("2026-10-22T00:00:00Z".to_string());
            c.rel.insert("a".to_string(), 2.0);
            c.rel.insert("weak".to_string(), 1.0);
            c.rel.insert("negative".to_string(), 0.0);
            stamp_items(c, "fei+hao");
        }
        let layers = vec![
            "literal".to_string(),
            "paraphrase".to_string(),
            "semantic".to_string(),
        ];
        let mut agg = perfect_agg();
        agg.get_mut("paraphrase").unwrap()[4] = 9.0; // A NDCG 0.9 < B 1.0
        let r = human(&cases, &layers, &agg);
        assert!(r.failed);
        assert!(
            r.lines
                .join("\n")
                .contains("layer paraphrase ndcg@10 A=0.900 vs B=1.000 FAIL"),
            "{}",
            r.lines.join("\n")
        );
    }
}

//! 倒排索引：postings.bin 全量构建、加载校验与候选提取。
//!
//! 布局（自产自销，零依赖，v2 起 doc 表自包含打分快照）：
//! ```text
//! [magic u32 "POST"][ver u16][body_len u64][body][crc32 u32]
//! body:
//!   [n_docs u32][total_len u64][n_terms u32]
//!   doc 表（case id 字典序）：
//!     [idlen u8][id]
//!     [nterms u32][(tlen u8)(term)]*nterms
//!     [nqterms u32][(tlen u8)(term)]*nqterms
//!     [nbuckets u32][(blen u8)(bucket)]*nbuckets
//!     [n_fp u32][(vlen u8)(value)]*n_fp   × 4 字段（error_code/file_loc/symbol/num_fp）
//!     [slen u8][status][quality f32][ulen u8][updated_at]
//!   term 表（term 字典序）：[tlen u16][term][df u32][delta-varint doc_idx 序列]
//! ```
//!
//! 设计要点：
//! - 索引是可丢弃缓存（index/ 目录），`build` 全量重建、确定性：case id 排序 +
//!   term 字典序 → 同库同字节。新增/删除 case 使索引过期 → 调用方惰性作废（删文件，
//!   回退线性扫描）；`--rebuild`/首次自动构建恢复。
//! - v2 起 doc 表自包含打分快照（词表/字段/状态/质量/时间），候选打分零 case.json
//!   读取（1 万条库召回 p50 < 5 ms）；df 快照随 build 返回，供 meta [df] 落盘。
//! - 崩溃一致性：body_len 边界校验 + CRC-32（IEEE 查表）段尾校验；坏段 →
//!   `load` 返回 Err（corrupt），调用方自动重建或回退线性扫描，不崩溃。
//! - 口径说明：线性与索引两条路径的 df/avgdl 均为全库口径，桶过滤只裁候选；
//!   同一 query 在两条路径下使用同一 BM25 统计量，A/B 对拍要求输出一致。

use crate::memory::store::{self, Meta};
use crate::terms::document;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock};
use std::time::SystemTime;

/// 自动启用倒排的规模阈值（库 case 数）；`meta [params] index_force=1` 可强制小库启用。
pub(crate) const INDEX_MIN_DOCS: usize = 10_000;

const POST_MAGIC: u32 = 0x5453_4f50; // "POST"
const POST_VER: u16 = 3;

pub(crate) fn postings(root: &str) -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(root).join("index").join("postings.bin")
}

/// 写 postings.bin：header + body + crc32 段尾校验。
fn write(root: &str, body: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let p = postings(root);
    if let Some(d) = p.parent() {
        crate::memory::lock::mkdir(d)?;
    }
    let digest = checksum(body);
    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(14 + body.len() + 4);
    buf.extend_from_slice(&POST_MAGIC.to_le_bytes());
    buf.extend_from_slice(&POST_VER.to_le_bytes());
    buf.extend_from_slice(&(body.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
    buf.extend_from_slice(body);
    buf.extend_from_slice(&digest.to_le_bytes());
    crate::memory::lock::atomic(&p, &buf)
}

fn put(buf: &mut Vec<u8>, mut v: u64) {
    while v >= 0x80 {
        buf.push((v as u8) | 0x80);
        v >>= 7;
    }
    buf.push(v as u8);
}

fn get(buf: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> Option<u64> {
    let mut v = 0u64;
    let mut shift = 0u32;
    loop {
        let b = *buf.get(*i)?;
        *i += 1;
        v |= u64::from(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if b & 0x80 == 0 {
            return Some(v);
        }
        shift += 7;
        if shift >= 64 {
            return None;
        }
    }
}

fn checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut table = [0u32; 256];
    for i in 0..256u32 {
        let mut c = i;
        for _ in 0..8 {
            c = if c & 1 != 0 {
                0xEDB8_8320 ^ (c >> 1)
            } else {
                c >> 1
            };
        }
        table[i as usize] = c;
    }
    let mut sum = 0xFFFF_FFFFu32;
    for &b in data {
        sum = table[((sum ^ u32::from(b)) & 0xFF) as usize] ^ (sum >> 8);
    }
    !sum
}

/// doc 打分快照（与 case.json 同源，build 时落盘进 postings，避免召回期二次 IO）。
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) struct Record {
    pub terms: Arc<[String]>,
    /// 原始 case query 词表（query-field 重排特征；与 terms 的 query∪text 不同）。
    pub query_terms: Arc<[String]>,
    /// 多标签场景桶（query/正文任一命中）；过滤用交集，stats 仍用主 bucket。
    pub buckets: Vec<String>,
    pub bucket: String,
    pub fields: Arc<crate::memory::store::Fields>,
    pub status: Arc<str>,
    pub quality: f64,
    pub updated_at: Arc<str>,
    /// `updated_at` 的 Unix 秒快照；召回热循环不再逐候选解析日期。
    pub updated_s: u64,
}

pub(crate) struct Index {
    pub n_docs: usize,
    pub total_len: usize,
    /// doc_idx → case id（字典序）；候选只克隆 `Arc`，不复制字符串。
    pub ids: Vec<Arc<str>>,
    /// doc_idx → 打分快照（与 ids 对齐）。
    pub docs: Vec<Record>,
    /// term → (df, doc_idx 升序列表)。
    pub dict: HashMap<String, (usize, Vec<usize>)>,
    /// 实体键 → doc_idx 升序列表；由 doc 快照惰性派生（无实体查询时不付构建成本）。
    entities: OnceLock<HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>>,
}

/// 从 doc 字段快照派生实体倒排（实体键去重、doc_idx 升序）。
fn entities(docs: &[Record]) -> HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> {
    let mut entities: HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
    for (di, rec) in docs.iter().enumerate() {
        for key in crate::memory::classify::keys(&rec.fields) {
            entities.entry(key).or_default().push(di);
        }
    }
    entities
}

/// 获取索引写锁。调用方在"case 资产变更 + 索引失效 + gen 前进"期间持锁，
/// 防止 index::build 在失效之后又把旧快照写回。
pub(crate) fn lock(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<crate::memory::lock::Lock> {
    crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, "index.lock")
}

/// 持锁清除索引（调用方必须已持有 [`lock`] 返回的守卫）。
pub(crate) fn clear(root: &str) {
    let p = postings(root);
    if p.exists() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&p);
    }
    // 进程内缓存随之失效：mtime 键已失（文件删除 → 下次 load 短路 None）。
    let mut g = cache().lock().unwrap();
    if let Some((r, _, _)) = g.as_ref() {
        if r == root {
            *g = None;
        }
    }
}

/// 惰性作废索引（新增/删除 case 后调用）：删 postings.bin，召回回退线性/按需重建。
/// 锁失败必须上抛：静默失败会让新 case 永远被旧索引漏掉。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn invalidate(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let _g = lock(root)?;
    clear(root);
    Ok(())
}

/// 进程内索引缓存（会话/守护进程多次召回免重复 parse；CLI 单次无副作用）。
/// 键 = (root, postings mtime)：invalidate 删文件/重建后 mtime 变化 → 自动 miss。
/// 缓存键：mtime + 文件长度（仅 mtime 在粗粒度文件系统上会误命中）。
type Key = (SystemTime, u64);
type Entry = (String, Key, Arc<Index>);
static INDEX_CACHE: OnceLock<Mutex<Option<Entry>>> = OnceLock::new();

fn cache() -> &'static Mutex<Option<Entry>> {
    INDEX_CACHE.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(None))
}

/// df 快照行：term 字典序 → 库内出现次数。
pub(crate) type Df = Vec<(String, usize)>;

/// 读取全部 case 构建 doc 打分快照；返回 (docs, 全库词数 total_len)。
fn records(root: &str, ids: &[String]) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<(String, Record)>, usize)> {
    let mut docs: Vec<(String, Record)> = Vec::with_capacity(ids.len());
    let mut total_len = 0usize;
    for id in ids {
        let c = store::load(root, id)?;
        let (query_terms, terms) = document(&c.query, &c.text);
        let updated_s = crate::memory::util::parse(&c.updated_at);
        total_len += terms.len();
        let buckets = crate::memory::classify::buckets(&[], &query_terms, &c.text);
        docs.push((
            id.clone(),
            Record {
                terms: terms.into(),
                query_terms: query_terms.into(),
                buckets,
                bucket: c.bucket,
                fields: Arc::new(c.fields),
                status: c.status.into(),
                quality: c.quality,
                updated_at: c.updated_at.into(),
                updated_s,
            },
        ));
    }
    Ok((docs, total_len))
}

/// 由 doc 快照派生 term → doc_idx 列表（doc_idx 升序 = docs 迭代序）。
fn terms(docs: &[(String, Record)]) -> HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> {
    let mut dict: HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
    for (di, (_, rec)) in docs.iter().enumerate() {
        for t in rec.terms.iter() {
            // 命中已存在的键时不再克隆字符串（10k 库可达百万次无谓分配）。
            match dict.get_mut(t.as_str()) {
                Some(v) => v.push(di),
                None => {
                    dict.insert(t.clone(), vec![di]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    dict
}

/// 序列化一条字符串列表段：[len u32][(u8 len + bytes)*]。
fn strings(body: &mut Vec<u8>, list: &[String]) {
    body.extend_from_slice(&(list.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    for s in list {
        body.push(s.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(s.as_bytes());
    }
}

/// 写 doc 表（id + 词表 + 4 字段 + 状态/质量/时间快照）。
fn table(body: &mut Vec<u8>, docs: &[(String, Record)]) {
    for (id, rec) in docs {
        body.push(id.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(id.as_bytes());
        strings(body, &rec.terms);
        strings(body, &rec.query_terms);
        strings(body, &rec.buckets);
        for f in [
            &rec.fields.error_code,
            &rec.fields.file_loc,
            &rec.fields.symbol,
            &rec.fields.num_fp,
        ] {
            body.extend_from_slice(&(f.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
            for v in f {
                body.push(v.len() as u8);
                body.extend_from_slice(v.as_bytes());
            }
        }
        body.push(rec.bucket.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(rec.bucket.as_bytes());
        body.push(rec.status.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(rec.status.as_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(&(rec.quality as f32).to_le_bytes());
        body.push(rec.updated_at.len() as u8);
        body.extend_from_slice(rec.updated_at.as_bytes());
    }
}

/// 写 term 表（term 字典序 + df + delta-varint doc_idx 序列）。
fn lexicon(body: &mut Vec<u8>, dict: &HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>) {
    let mut term_keys: Vec<&String> = dict.keys().collect();
    term_keys.sort(); // term 字典序，确定性
    for t in &term_keys {
        let post = &dict[*t];
        body.extend_from_slice(&(t.len() as u16).to_le_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(t.as_bytes());
        body.extend_from_slice(&(post.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        let mut prev = 0usize;
        for &di in post {
            put(body, (di - prev) as u64);
            prev = di;
        }
    }
}

/// 全量构建 postings.bin（读取全部 case 的 query∪text 词表）。
/// 返回 (n_docs, n_terms, df 快照按 term 字典序) —— df 供 meta [df] 节落盘。
pub(crate) fn build(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize, Df)> {
    // 跨进程串行构建：避免两个 rebuild/自动构建同时写 postings.bin。
    let _g = lock(root)?;
    let ids = store::list(root)?;
    let (docs, total_len) = records(root, &ids)?;
    let dict = terms(&docs);
    let mut body: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(32 + docs.len() * 96);
    body.extend_from_slice(&(docs.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    body.extend_from_slice(&(total_len as u64).to_le_bytes());
    body.extend_from_slice(&(dict.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    table(&mut body, &docs);
    lexicon(&mut body, &dict);
    write(root, &body)?;
    // df 快照按 term 字典序输出（与原 term_keys.sort() 同序）。
    let mut df: Vec<(String, usize)> = dict.iter().map(|(t, v)| (t.clone(), v.len())).collect();
    df.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));
    Ok((docs.len(), dict.len(), df))
}

/// 加载索引。不存在 → Ok(None)；校验失败 → Err(corrupt)（调用方重建或回退线性）。
/// 命中进程内缓存（root+mtime 键）直接复用 Arc，零重复 parse；否则整文件 fs::read
/// 一次读入解析。不使用 mmap：无文件锁时，另一进程 rebuild/truncate 会使映射失效；
/// 1 万条库的 postings 仅数 MB，`fs::read` 在页缓存下开销可忽略，且保持零 unsafe。
pub(crate) fn load(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<Option<Arc<Index>>> {
    let p = postings(root);
    // 缓存键 = mtime + 文件长度：粗粒度 mtime 文件系统（ext3/NFS/SMB）上同秒重建
    // 会得到相同 mtime，仅比 mtime 会长期复用旧索引并漏掉新 case。
    let mtime = match p.metadata() {
        Ok(m) => m.modified().ok().map(|t| (t, m.len())),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
        Err(_) => None,
    };
    if let Some(idx) = cached(root, mtime.as_ref()) {
        return Ok(Some(idx));
    }
    let buf = match fs::read(&p) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        // 读取与 stat 之间被并发 rebuild 删除：按"无索引"处理，不当作错误。
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
        Err(e) => return Err(e),
    };
    let parsed: Option<Index> = parse(&buf).map(Some)?;
    let arc = parsed.map(Arc::new);
    store(root, mtime, arc.as_ref());
    Ok(arc)
}

fn cached(root: &str, mtime: Option<&Key>) -> Option<Arc<Index>> {
    let mt = mtime?;
    let g = cache().lock().unwrap();
    let (r, t, idx) = g.as_ref()?;
    (r == root && t == mt).then(|| idx.clone())
}

fn store(root: &str, mtime: Option<Key>, idx: Option<&Arc<Index>>) {
    if let (Some(mt), Some(idx)) = (mtime, idx) {
        let mut g = cache().lock().unwrap();
        *g = Some((root.to_string(), mt, idx.clone()));
    }
}

/// 解析失败统一错误（postings.bin corrupt: ...）。
fn corrupt(m: &str) -> std::io::Error {
    std::io::Error::other(format!("postings.bin corrupt: {m}"))
}

/// 从游标语境取 u32（边界不足返回 None）。
fn word(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> Option<u32> {
    if *i + 4 > body.len() {
        return None;
    }
    let v = u32::from_le_bytes(body[*i..*i + 4].try_into().unwrap());
    *i += 4;
    Some(v)
}

/// 从游标语境取一条 u8 长度前缀字符串。
fn text(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<String> {
    if *i >= body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("str len truncated"));
    }
    let len = body[*i] as usize;
    *i += 1;
    if *i + len > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("str overflow"));
    }
    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body[*i..*i + len]).into_owned();
    *i += len;
    Ok(s)
}

/// 从游标语境取一个 u32 长度前缀的字符串列表（用于 4 个字段向量）。
fn list(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let n = count(body, i, "no field n")?;
    batch(body, i, n)
}

fn count(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize, what: &str) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
    let n = word(body, i).ok_or_else(|| corrupt(what))? as usize;
    if n > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt(&format!("{what} exceeds body")));
    }
    Ok(n)
}

fn batch(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize, n: usize) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for _ in 0..n {
        v.push(text(body, i)?);
    }
    Ok(v)
}

fn float(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize, what: &str) -> std::io::Result<f32> {
    if *i + 4 > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt(what));
    }
    let v = f32::from_le_bytes(body[*i..*i + 4].try_into().unwrap());
    *i += 4;
    Ok(v)
}

/// 校验 header（magic/version/body_len/crc32），返回 body 切片。
fn open(buf: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<&[u8]> {
    let (body_end, total_len) = valid(buf)?;
    let body = &buf[14..body_end];
    let stored = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[body_end..total_len].try_into().unwrap());
    if checksum(body) != stored {
        return Err(corrupt("crc mismatch"));
    }
    Ok(body)
}

fn valid(buf: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    if buf.len() < 14 {
        return Err(corrupt("too short"));
    }
    let magic = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
    if magic != POST_MAGIC {
        return Err(corrupt("bad magic"));
    }
    let ver = u16::from_le_bytes(buf[4..6].try_into().unwrap());
    if ver != POST_VER {
        return Err(corrupt("bad version"));
    }
    let (body_end, total_len) = lengths(buf)?;
    if total_len != buf.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("bad body_len"));
    }
    Ok((body_end, total_len))
}

fn lengths(buf: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    let body_len = usize::try_from(u64::from_le_bytes(buf[6..14].try_into().unwrap()))
        .map_err(|_| corrupt("body_len too large"))?;
    let body_end = 14usize
        .checked_add(body_len)
        .ok_or_else(|| corrupt("body_len overflow"))?;
    let total_len = body_end
        .checked_add(4)
        .ok_or_else(|| corrupt("file length overflow"))?;
    Ok((body_end, total_len))
}

/// 解析 doc 表（n_docs 条打分快照），返回 (ids, docs)。
fn scan(
    body: &[u8],
    n_docs: usize,
    i: &mut usize,
) -> std::io::Result<(Vec<Arc<str>>, Vec<Record>)> {
    let mut ids: Vec<Arc<str>> = Vec::with_capacity(n_docs);
    let mut docs: Vec<Record> = Vec::with_capacity(n_docs);
    for _ in 0..n_docs {
        let (id, doc) = doc(body, i)?;
        ids.push(id);
        docs.push(doc);
    }
    Ok((ids, docs))
}

fn doc(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<(Arc<str>, Record)> {
    let (id, terms, query_terms, buckets) = split(body, i)?;
    let fields = values(body, i)?;
    let (bucket, status, quality, updated_at) = tail(body, i)?;
    let updated_s = crate::memory::util::parse(&updated_at);
    Ok((
        id.into(),
        Record {
            terms: terms.into(),
            query_terms: query_terms.into(),
            buckets,
            bucket,
            fields: Arc::new(fields),
            status: status.into(),
            quality,
            updated_at: updated_at.into(),
            updated_s,
        },
    ))
}

type Terms = (String, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>);

fn split(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<Terms> {
    let id = text(body, i)?;
    let nterms = count(body, i, "no doc nterms")?;
    let terms = batch(body, i, nterms)?;
    let nqterms = count(body, i, "no doc nqterms")?;
    let query_terms = batch(body, i, nqterms)?;
    let nbuckets = count(body, i, "no doc nbuckets")?;
    let buckets = batch(body, i, nbuckets)?;
    Ok((id, terms, query_terms, buckets))
}

fn values(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<crate::memory::store::Fields> {
    Ok(crate::memory::store::Fields {
        error_code: list(body, i)?,
        file_loc: list(body, i)?,
        symbol: list(body, i)?,
        num_fp: list(body, i)?,
    })
}

fn tail(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<(String, String, f64, String)> {
    let bucket = text(body, i)?;
    let status = text(body, i)?;
    let quality = float(body, i, "no quality")? as f64;
    let updated_at = text(body, i)?;
    Ok((bucket, status, quality, updated_at))
}

/// 解析 term 表（n_terms 条倒排），返回 term → (df, doc_idx 升序列表)。
fn dictionary(
    body: &[u8],
    n_terms: usize,
    n_docs: usize,
    i: &mut usize,
) -> std::io::Result<HashMap<String, (usize, Vec<usize>)>> {
    let mut dict: HashMap<String, (usize, Vec<usize>)> = HashMap::with_capacity(n_terms);
    for _ in 0..n_terms {
        let (term, entry) = term(body, n_docs, i)?;
        dict.insert(term, entry);
    }
    Ok(dict)
}

fn term(
    body: &[u8],
    n_docs: usize,
    i: &mut usize,
) -> std::io::Result<(String, (usize, Vec<usize>))> {
    if *i + 2 > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("term len truncated"));
    }
    let tlen = u16::from_le_bytes(body[*i..*i + 2].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
    *i += 2;
    if *i + tlen + 4 > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("term overflow"));
    }
    let term = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body[*i..*i + tlen]).into_owned();
    *i += tlen;
    let df = u32::from_le_bytes(body[*i..*i + 4].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
    *i += 4;
    if df > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("df exceeds body"));
    }
    let mut post = Vec::with_capacity(df);
    let mut prev = 0usize;
    for _ in 0..df {
        let d = get(body, i).ok_or_else(|| corrupt("posting varint"))?;
        let doc = prev + d as usize;
        if doc >= n_docs {
            return Err(corrupt("doc idx overflow"));
        }
        post.push(doc);
        prev = doc;
    }
    Ok((term, (df, post)))
}

/// 解析字节切片为内存索引（纯函数，输入来自 fs::read）。
pub(crate) fn parse(buf: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<Index> {
    let body = open(buf)?;
    let mut i = 0usize;
    let (n_docs, total_len, n_terms) = header(body, &mut i)?;
    let (ids, docs) = scan(body, n_docs, &mut i)?;
    let dict = dictionary(body, n_terms, n_docs, &mut i)?;
    Ok(Index {
        n_docs,
        total_len,
        ids,
        docs,
        dict,
        entities: OnceLock::new(),
    })
}

fn header(body: &[u8], i: &mut usize) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize, usize)> {
    let n_docs = word(body, i).ok_or_else(|| corrupt("no n_docs"))? as usize;
    if n_docs > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("n_docs exceeds body"));
    }
    if *i + 8 > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("no total_len"));
    }
    let total_len = u64::from_le_bytes(body[*i..*i + 8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
    *i += 8;
    let n_terms = word(body, i).ok_or_else(|| corrupt("no n_terms"))? as usize;
    if n_terms > body.len() {
        return Err(corrupt("n_terms exceeds body"));
    }
    Ok((n_docs, total_len, n_terms))
}

/// 候选：query 词命中 doc 的并集（去重、按 doc_idx 升序 → 确定性）。
/// 返回 doc_idx（配合 `idx.docs[di]` 零 case 文件 IO 打分）。
pub(crate) fn candidates(idx: &Index, qterms: &[String]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut seen: Vec<bool> = vec![false; idx.n_docs];
    for t in qterms {
        if let Some((_, post)) = idx.dict.get(t) {
            for &di in post {
                seen[di] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    seen.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter_map(|(di, &hit)| hit.then_some(di))
        .collect()
}

/// term 的全库 df（未收录 = 0）。
pub(crate) fn df(idx: &Index, t: &str) -> usize {
    idx.dict.get(t).map(|(df, _)| *df).unwrap_or(0)
}

/// case id → doc 下标（`ids` 已按字典序，二分查找）。
pub(crate) fn find(idx: &Index, id: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    idx.ids.binary_search_by(|x| x.as_ref().cmp(id)).ok()
}

/// query 实体命中的兄弟 doc（去重后按 doc_idx 升序），并给出共享实体数。
pub(crate) fn neighbors(idx: &Index, ents: &[String]) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
    let mut keys: Vec<&str> = ents.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
    keys.sort_unstable();
    keys.dedup();
    let mut shared = vec![0usize; idx.n_docs];
    for key in keys {
        if let Some(docs) = idx.entities().get(key) {
            for &di in docs {
                shared[di] += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    shared
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter_map(|(di, n)| (n > 0).then_some((di, n)))
        .collect()
}

impl Index {
    fn entities(&self) -> &HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> {
        self.entities.get_or_init(|| entities(&self.docs))
    }
}

/// 是否启用倒排路径：规模达标（meta 可覆盖）或 --rebuild 后强制（index_force=1）。
pub(crate) fn enabled(meta: &Meta) -> bool {
    let force = meta.param("index_force") > 0.0;
    force || meta.case_count >= INDEX_MIN_DOCS
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::ingest::ingest;
    use crate::memory::store::{self, Stats};
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::fs;

    fn stats() -> Stats {
        crate::memory::store::sample()
    }

    #[test]
    fn crc_and_varint_are_deterministic() {
        let a = checksum(b"hello world");
        assert_eq!(a, checksum(b"hello world"));
        assert_ne!(a, checksum(b"hello worle"));
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        put(&mut buf, 0);
        put(&mut buf, 127);
        put(&mut buf, 128);
        put(&mut buf, 300);
        put(&mut buf, 1 << 35);
        let mut i = 0;
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), Some(127));
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), Some(128));
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), Some(300));
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), Some(1 << 35));
        assert_eq!(get(&buf, &mut i), None, "越界返回 None");
    }

    fn seed(root: &str) {
        let s = stats();
        ingest(
            root,
            "数据库连接超时",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a alpha",
            vec!["/a.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        ingest(
            root,
            "磁盘空间不足",
            vec!["disk".into()],
            "ERROR disk full errno=28 beta",
            vec!["/b.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        ingest(
            root,
            "编译失败",
            vec!["cargo".into()],
            "error: could not compile gamma",
            vec!["/c.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn build_parse_roundtrip() {
        let root = root("rt");
        seed(&root);
        let (n_docs, n_terms, df) = build(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(n_docs, 3);
        assert!(n_terms > 0);
        assert_eq!(df.len(), n_terms, "df 快照覆盖全部 term");
        let idx = load(&root).unwrap().expect("index 应存在");
        assert_eq!(idx.n_docs, 3);
        assert_eq!(idx.ids.len(), 3);
        assert!(idx.ids.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] < w[1]), "id 字典序");
        assert!(
            idx.docs.iter().all(|d| !d.query_terms.is_empty()),
            "索引必须携带 case-query 词表，倒排路径才能执行 query-field 重排"
        );
        assert!(
            idx.docs.iter().all(|d| !d.buckets.is_empty()),
            "索引必须携带多标签桶"
        );
        assert!(
            idx.docs.iter().all(|d| d.updated_s > 0),
            "索引加载时必须一次解析 updated_at，热循环不再逐候选解析日期"
        );
        // df 语义：df=posting 长度，且 posting 严格递增（确定性）。
        for (df, post) in idx.dict.values() {
            assert_eq!(*df, post.len());
            assert!(post.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] < w[1]), "doc_idx 升序");
        }
        // 跨 case 词 df>1："error"（空格分隔）出现在 A/B 两个 seed 文本；
        // C 的 "error: could not" 冒号并入 token → "error:" 独立（df=1）。
        assert_eq!(idx.dict.get("error").map(|(df, _)| *df), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(idx.dict.get("error:").map(|(df, _)| *df), Some(1));
        let entities = neighbors(&idx, &["conn_id=9f2a".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(entities.len(), 1, "实体倒排应直接来自 doc 快照");
        assert_eq!(entities[0].1, 1, "共享实体数必须参与实体加权");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn candidates_union_dedup_sorted() {
        let root = root("cand");
        seed(&root);
        build(&root).unwrap();
        let idx = load(&root).unwrap().unwrap();
        // 词命中两篇：conn_id 只中 A；error 中 A+B（db timeout 与 disk full 都含 error）。
        let one = candidates(&idx, &["conn_id".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(one.len(), 1);
        let both = candidates(&idx, &["error".to_string(), "disk".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(both.len(), 2, "A+B 并集应为 2（确定性排序）");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn corrupt_tail_rejected_and_rebuild_recovers() {
        let root = root("cor");
        seed(&root);
        build(&root).unwrap();
        let p = postings(&root);
        let mut buf = fs::read(&p).unwrap();
        buf.truncate(buf.len() - 4); // 截断 crc 尾部 → body_len 不匹配
        fs::write(&p, &buf).unwrap();
        assert!(
            load(&root).is_err(),
            "坏段必须报 corrupt（Err），不静默吞掉"
        );
        // --rebuild 语义：build 覆盖坏文件后恢复。
        let (nd, _, _) = build(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(nd, 3);
        assert!(load(&root).unwrap().is_some(), "重建后索引应可加载");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalidate_removes_index_file() {
        let root = root("inv");
        seed(&root);
        build(&root).unwrap();
        assert!(postings(&root).exists());
        invalidate(&root).unwrap();
        assert!(!postings(&root).exists());
        assert!(load(&root).unwrap().is_none());
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn write_case_invalidates_cached_index() {
        let root = root("wcinv");
        seed(&root);
        build(&root).unwrap();
        assert!(postings(&root).exists());
        let c = store::Case::new(
            "newcase".to_string(),
            "new query".to_string(),
            vec![],
            "ERROR new evidence".to_string(),
        );
        store::save(&root, &c).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !postings(&root).exists(),
            "新 case 必须让旧索引失效，否则大库会漏召"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_rejects_overflowing_body_len() {
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        buf.extend_from_slice(&POST_MAGIC.to_le_bytes());
        buf.extend_from_slice(&POST_VER.to_le_bytes());
        buf.extend_from_slice(&u64::MAX.to_le_bytes());
        buf.extend_from_slice(&[0u8; 4]);
        let err = match parse(&buf) {
            Ok(_) => panic!("溢出 body_len 必须被拒绝"),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        assert!(
            err.to_string().contains("body_len"),
            "溢出长度必须明确报 corrupt: {err}"
        );
    }
}

//! 摄取：压缩产物（Outcome）→ 记忆 case。
//!
//! 摄取即过滤：入库的不是原始日志，而是 compress 筛出的高密度证据块。
//! 去重：归一化指纹 `fp = fnv1a(norm(query) ‖ norm(text))`，已存在则只更新
//! updated_at 与反馈相关字段，不新增（设计 v0.2 §6）。
//!
//! 红线：本模块是 I/O 侧（memory），compress 零改动；摄取结果不影响压缩输出，
//! 只沉淀旁路资产。
//!
use crate::memory::store::{self, Case, Stats};
use std::fs;
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// 单 case 文本上限：64 MiB 输入不得直接变 64 MiB case；
/// 超过上限拒绝摄取并明确报错（旁路，不影响压缩主流程）。
pub(crate) const MAX_CASE_TEXT: usize = 1024 * 1024; // 1 MiB

/// 修复结论上限；`--fix` 只保存用户摘要文本。
pub(crate) const MAX_FIX_LEN: usize = 4096; // 4 KiB

const FP_INDEX: &str = "index/fingerprints.tsv";
const FP_READY: &str = "index/fingerprints.ready";
const FP_LOCK: &str = "index/fingerprints.lock";

/// 计算去重指纹（确定性、无随机源）。
///
/// 身份口径：query 保留数字（8080/9090、errno=28/29 是不同事故），text 仍按
/// `normalize` 折叠数字（日志里的 PID/时间戳/行号不应制造重复 case）。
/// 这修复了旧实现"query 数字也被折叠 → 不同端口事故互相去重"的问题。
pub(crate) fn fingerprint(query: &str, text: &str) -> String {
    let mut q = String::new();
    crate::analysis::canonical(query, &mut q);
    let mut t = String::new();
    crate::analysis::normalize(text, &mut t);
    let h = store::parts(&[q.as_bytes(), b"\0", t.as_bytes()]);
    format!("{:016x}", h)
}

fn index(root: &str) -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(root).join(FP_INDEX)
}

fn ready(root: &str) -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(root).join(FP_READY)
}

fn total(root: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    fs::read_to_string(ready(root)).ok()?.trim().parse().ok()
}

/// 惰性构建去重索引：一次性读取旧库 case，之后只看一个小文件。
fn ensure(root: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let count = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?.case_count;
    if total(root) == Some(count) && index(root).exists() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let _lock = crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, FP_LOCK)?;
    let count = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?.case_count;
    if total(root) == Some(count) && index(root).exists() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    rebuild(root)
}

fn rebuild(root: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let ids = store::list(root)?;
    let mut body = String::with_capacity(ids.len().saturating_mul(40));
    for id in &ids {
        let c = store::load(root, id)?;
        body.push_str(&fingerprint(&c.query, &c.text));
        body.push('\t');
        body.push_str(id);
        body.push('\n');
    }
    crate::memory::lock::atomic(&index(root), body.as_bytes())?;
    crate::memory::lock::atomic(&ready(root), ids.len().to_string().as_bytes())
}

/// 追加一条索引并把 ready 对齐到**索引实际行数**（不是库 case_count：并发写库时
/// case_count 可能已包含别的进程刚写入、本索引尚无行的 case，拿它会误判完整）。
///
/// 幂等：同一 (fp, id) 若已被并发 rebuild 收录，则不再追加重复行——否则行数会
/// 超过 case 数，ready 与 case_count 永远对不上，触发无谓的全表重建。
fn remember(root: &str, fp: &str, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    let _lock = crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, FP_LOCK)?;
    // ready 缺失（删除后失效/尚未构建）或索引不存在：整表重建。
    if total(root).is_none() {
        return rebuild(root);
    }
    let Some(body) = read(root)? else {
        return rebuild(root);
    };
    let mut lines = body.lines().count();
    let already = body.lines().any(|l| l.split_once('\t') == Some((fp, id)));
    if !already {
        let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new().append(true).open(index(root))?;
        writeln!(file, "{fp}\t{id}")?;
        lines += 1;
    }
    crate::memory::lock::atomic(&ready(root), lines.to_string().as_bytes())
}

/// case 删除后让去重索引在下一次写入时惰性重建。
pub(crate) fn invalidate(root: &str) {
    let _ = fs::remove_file(ready(root));
}

/// 按身份指纹查库内是否已存在 case，返回其 id。
/// 索引按动态重算指纹构建，因此旧库无需迁移也能按当前身份口径去重。
pub(crate) fn find(root: &str, fp: &str) -> io::Result<Option<String>> {
    ensure(root)?;
    let Some(body) = read(root)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    for line in body.lines() {
        if let Some(id) = matched(root, line, fp) {
            return Ok(Some(id));
        }
    }
    Ok(None)
}

fn read(root: &str) -> io::Result<Option<String>> {
    match fs::read_to_string(index(root)) {
        Ok(body) => Ok(Some(body)),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

fn matched(root: &str, line: &str, fp: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let (stored, id) = line.split_once('\t')?;
    if stored != fp {
        return None;
    }
    if store::valid(id) && store::path(root, id).exists() {
        return Some(id.to_string());
    }
    invalidate(root);
    None
}

/// 已脱敏、已切词的存储字段。公开门面 `memory::save` 是唯一构造入口；
/// 本结构只负责持久化，避免每种可选字段各复制一套函数。
pub(crate) struct Payload<'a> {
    pub root: &'a str,
    pub query: &'a str,
    pub terms: Vec<String>,
    pub text: &'a str,
    pub source: &'a [String],
    pub stats: &'a Stats,
    pub forces: &'a [String],
    pub fix: &'a str,
    pub evidence_lno: &'a [usize],
    pub evidence: &'a [String],
    pub max_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

pub(crate) fn persist(input: Payload<'_>) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    store::ensure(input.root)?;
    check(
        input.root,
        input.max_bytes,
        input.text,
        input.fix,
        input.evidence_lno,
        input.evidence,
    )?;
    let fp = fingerprint(input.query, input.text);
    // 同一指纹的"查重 + 写入"必须串行：两个并发 store 若都在 find 前进入，
    // 会跨秒生成两个 id，或在去重更新时用旧快照覆盖刚写入的反馈。
    let _ingest_lock =
        crate::memory::lock::acquire(input.root, &format!("cases/.ingest-{fp}.lock"))?;
    if let Some(existing) = find(input.root, &fp)? {
        return update(
            input.root,
            &existing,
            input.fix,
            input.evidence_lno,
            input.evidence,
        );
    }
    let id = insert(input, &fp)?;
    Ok((true, id))
}

fn update(
    root: &str,
    existing: &str,
    fix: &str,
    evidence_lno: &[usize],
    evidence: &[String],
) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    let _case_lock = store::lock(root, existing)?;
    let mut c = store::load(root, existing)?;
    let now = store::stamp();
    c.updated_at = now;
    backfill(&mut c, fix, evidence_lno, evidence);
    store::save(root, &c)?;
    Ok((false, existing.to_string()))
}

fn insert(fields: Payload<'_>, fp: &str) -> std::io::Result<String> {
    let Payload {
        root,
        query,
        terms,
        text,
        source,
        stats,
        forces,
        fix,
        evidence_lno,
        evidence,
        max_bytes: _,
    } = fields;
    let now = store::stamp();
    let id = store::id(&now, query, text);
    let _case_lock = store::lock(root, &id)?;
    let mut c = Case::new(id.clone(), query.to_string(), terms, text.to_string());
    c.fp = fp.to_string();
    c.fix = fix.to_string();
    c.evidence_lno = evidence_lno.to_vec();
    c.evidence = evidence.to_vec();
    c.source = source.to_vec();
    c.stats = stats.clone();
    c.forces = forces.to_vec();
    // 摄取即抽取：判别字段随 case 写入，召回时无需重扫正文。
    c.fields = crate::memory::classify::extract(text);
    // 摄取即分桶：先用 case query 判家族，query 无证据再回退正文，
    // 避免根因里的宽域词把 query 已明确的场景带偏。
    let fvec = c.fields.error_code.clone();
    let qterms = crate::terms::memory(&c.query);
    c.bucket = crate::memory::classify::query(&fvec, &qterms, text);
    store::save(root, &c)?;
    store::bump(root)?;
    remember(root, fp, &id)?;
    Ok(id)
}

/// 入库前校验：配额 / 文本上限 / fix 上限 / 证据数组长度一致。
fn check(
    root: &str,
    max_bytes: Option<u64>,
    text: &str,
    fix: &str,
    evidence_lno: &[usize],
    evidence: &[String],
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    if let Some(max) = max_bytes {
        let total = store::bytes(root)?;
        if total > max {
            return Err(std::io::Error::other(format!(
                "memory quota exceeded: {total} bytes > --max-bytes {max}"
            )));
        }
    }
    if text.len() > MAX_CASE_TEXT {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!(
                "case text too large: {} bytes > {} (scx-memory MAX_CASE_TEXT)",
                text.len(),
                MAX_CASE_TEXT
            ),
        ));
    }
    if fix.len() > MAX_FIX_LEN {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
            format!(
                "case fix too long: {} bytes > {} (scx-memory MAX_FIX_LEN)",
                fix.len(),
                MAX_FIX_LEN
            ),
        ));
    }
    if evidence_lno.len() != evidence.len() {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "evidence_lno/evidence length mismatch",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 同指纹重复摄取：只补录空的 fix / evidence，已有结论绝不覆盖。
fn backfill(c: &mut Case, fix: &str, evidence_lno: &[usize], evidence: &[String]) {
    if c.fix.is_empty() && !fix.is_empty() {
        c.fix = fix.to_string();
    }
    if c.evidence.is_empty() && !evidence.is_empty() {
        c.evidence_lno = evidence_lno.to_vec();
        c.evidence = evidence.to_vec();
    }
}

/// 测试便捷入口：直接构造已切词字段，覆盖不带 fix/evidence 的旧调用形态。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn ingest(
    root: &str,
    query: &str,
    terms: Vec<String>,
    text: &str,
    source: Vec<String>,
    stats: &Stats,
    forces: Vec<String>,
) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    fix(root, query, terms, text, source, stats, forces, "")
}

/// 测试便捷入口：只扩展 fix，不改变既有测试的七参数调用形态。
#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] // 测试夹具兼容：生产路径只用 Payload。
pub(crate) fn fix(
    root: &str,
    query: &str,
    terms: Vec<String>,
    text: &str,
    source: Vec<String>,
    stats: &Stats,
    forces: Vec<String>,
    fix: &str,
) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    evidence(
        root,
        query,
        terms,
        text,
        source,
        stats,
        forces,
        fix,
        &[],
        &[],
    )
}

/// 测试便捷入口：完整可选字段。
#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] // 测试夹具兼容：字段已由 Payload 统一。
pub(crate) fn evidence(
    root: &str,
    query: &str,
    terms: Vec<String>,
    text: &str,
    source: Vec<String>,
    stats: &Stats,
    forces: Vec<String>,
    fix: &str,
    evidence_lno: &[usize],
    evidence: &[String],
) -> std::io::Result<(bool, String)> {
    persist(Payload {
        root,
        query,
        terms,
        text,
        source: &source,
        stats,
        forces: &forces,
        fix,
        evidence_lno,
        evidence,
        max_bytes: None,
    })
}

/// 按 id 删除一个 case，并让派生索引按库代际自动失效。
#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) fn delete(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    crate::memory::maintenance::delete(root, id)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const TEXT: &str = "ERROR db timeout conn_id=9f2a\nat Pool.java:214\nRoot cause: pool size";

    #[test]
    fn ingest_dedup_by_fingerprint() {
        let root = root("dedup");
        let s1 = Stats {
            kept: 3,
            total: 200,
            cut: 94.2,
            risk: "HIGH".to_string(),
        };
        let a = ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库连接超时 conn_id",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(a.0, "首次摄取应为新增");
        let b = ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库连接超时 conn_id",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!b.0, "同指纹重复摄取应去重，不新增");
        assert!(
            store::list(&root).unwrap().contains(&b.1),
            "去重也应返回既有 case id"
        );
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 1, "case 数必须保持 1");
        // 内容变体（证据块不同）应新增
        let s2 = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 100,
            cut: 90.0,
            risk: "HIGH".to_string(),
        };
        let c = ingest(
            &root,
            "数据库连接超时 conn_id",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            "ERROR 磁盘已满 errno=28",
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s2,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(c.0, "证据块变体应新增");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 2);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ingest_with_fix_persists_and_rejects_oversize() {
        // --store 配 --fix 时修复结论随 case 入库（L1 本地直答）。
        let root = root("fix");
        let s1 = Stats {
            kept: 3,
            total: 200,
            cut: 94.2,
            risk: "HIGH".to_string(),
        };
        let added = fix(
            &root,
            "数据库连接超时 conn_id",
            vec!["conn_id".into()],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s1,
            vec![],
            "enlarge pool to 64 conns, restart daemon",
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(added.0, "带 fix 首次摄取应为新增");
        let ids = store::list(&root).unwrap();
        let c = store::load(&root, &ids[0]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            c.fix, "enlarge pool to 64 conns, restart daemon",
            "fix 必须落盘"
        );
        // 超长 fix 拒绝。
        let huge_fix = "x".repeat(MAX_FIX_LEN + 1);
        let err = fix(&root, "q", vec![], "t", vec![], &s1, vec![], &huge_fix).unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            err.to_string().contains("case fix too long"),
            "超长 fix 应明确拒绝: {err}"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn dedup_backfills_missing_fix_and_evidence_without_overwriting() {
        let root = root("backfill");
        let s = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 90.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        let first = ingest(&root, "q", vec![], TEXT, vec![], &s, vec![]).unwrap();
        assert!(first.0);
        let second = evidence(
            &root,
            "q",

            vec![],

        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!second.0, "同指纹必须去重");
        let c = store::load(&root, &first.1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.fix, "restart pool", "空 fix 可由后续 store 补录");
        assert_eq!(c.evidence_lno, vec![1], "空 evidence 可由后续 store 补录");
        assert_eq!(c.evidence, vec!["ERROR db timeout"]);
        // 已有结论不被后续重复摄取覆盖。
        fix(
            &root,

            TEXT,

            &s,
            vec![],
            "different fix",
        )
        .unwrap();
        let c = store::load(&root, &first.1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.fix, "restart pool", "已有修复结论不得被覆盖");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ingest_with_evidence_roundtrip_and_legacy_compat() {

        let root = root("ev");

        let c = store::load(&root, &ids[0]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.evidence_lno, ev_lno, "证据行区间必须落盘");
        assert_eq!(c.evidence, ev, "原始证据行必须落盘");
        assert_eq!(c.fix, "enlarge pool", "fix 与 evidence 可同时落盘");
        // 旧 case 兼容：直接用 store::decode 模拟无键读取（无 evidence 字段）。

    #[test]
    fn fingerprint_is_deterministic_and_sensitive() {
        let a = fingerprint("db timeout", TEXT);
        let b = fingerprint("db timeout", TEXT);
        assert_eq!(a, b);
        assert_ne!(
            a,
            fingerprint("db timeoutx", TEXT),
            "query 变体指纹必须不同"
        );
        assert_ne!(
            a,
            fingerprint("db timeout", "other text"),
            "文本变体指纹必须不同"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn fingerprint_keeps_query_numbers_but_folds_text_noise() {
        assert_ne!(
            fingerprint("port 8080 already in use", "ERROR port 8080 in use"),
            fingerprint("port 9090 already in use", "ERROR port 9090 in use"),
            "不同端口是不同事故，不能共享身份指纹"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            fingerprint("port 8080 in use", "ERROR pid=12345 port 8080"),
            fingerprint("port 8080 in use", "ERROR pid=67890 port 8080"),
            "同一 query 下 text 的 PID/时间戳噪声仍应折叠"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn fingerprint_index_is_lazily_rebuilt() {
        let root = root("fpidx");
        let s = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        let (_, id) = ingest(&root, "q index", vec![], TEXT, vec![], &s, vec![]).unwrap();
        let fp = fingerprint("q index", TEXT);
        assert_eq!(find(&root, &fp).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(id.as_str()));

        fs::remove_file(index(&root)).unwrap();
        fs::remove_file(ready(&root)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(find(&root, &fp).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(id.as_str()));
        assert!(index(&root).exists(), "重查应重建指纹索引");
    }

    #[test]
    fn fingerprint_index_rebuilds_after_delete() {
        let root = root("fpdel");

    #[test]
    fn ingest_keeps_numeric_query_variants_and_dedups_legacy_fp() {
        let root = root("numid");
        let s = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        let text = "ERROR port 8080 already in use\nat Sock.java:1";
        let a = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 8080 already in use",
            vec![],
            text,
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let b = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 9090 already in use",
            vec![],
            "ERROR port 9090 already in use\nat Sock.java:1",
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(a.0 && b.0, "不同端口必须各自落库");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 2);

        // 模拟旧库：fp 是旧"数字折叠"口径；动态重算仍应识别同一条记忆。
        let mut c = store::load(&root, &a.1).unwrap();
        c.fp = "0000000000000000".to_string();
        store::save(&root, &c).unwrap();
        let dup = ingest(
            &root,
            "port 8080 already in use",
            vec![],
            text,
            vec![],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!dup.0, "旧 fp 也应通过动态身份键去重");
        assert_eq!(store::list(&root).unwrap().len(), 2);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    /// 回归：remember 按索引行数推进 ready。并发进程若已写入新 case（case_count
    /// 变大、索引尚未含该行），ready 不得直接等于 case_count，否则 ensure 会信任
    /// 残缺索引而漏判重，重复 case 入库。
    /// remember 必须幂等：并发 rebuild 已收录同一 (fp, id) 时不得再追加重复行，
    /// 否则索引行数超过 case 数、ready 与 case_count 永远对不上。
    #[test]
    fn remember_is_idempotent_for_same_case() {
        let root = root("ready-idem");
        let (_, id) = ingest(
            &root,
            "qa conn",
            vec![],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &store::sample(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let fp = fingerprint("qa conn", TEXT);
        // 模拟并发 rebuild 已收录该行后，迟到的 remember 再次执行。
        remember(&root, &fp, &id).unwrap();
        remember(&root, &fp, &id).unwrap();
        let body = fs::read_to_string(index(&root)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body.lines().count(), 1, "同一 (fp,id) 只能有一行");
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(ready(&root)).unwrap().trim(),
            "1",
            "ready 必须等于索引真实行数"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn remember_does_not_claim_unindexed_cases() {
        let root = root("ready-race");
        let s = store::sample();
        let (_, id_a) = ingest(
            &root,
            "qa conn",
            vec![],
            TEXT,
            vec!["/x/build.log".into()],
            &s,
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let base = store::load(&root, &id_a).unwrap();
        // 模拟并发：另外两个 case 已落库并推进 case_count，但索引尚无它们的行。
        let mut b = base.clone();
        b.id = "2026-01-01_bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb".to_string();
        b.query = "qb conn".to_string();
        let mut c = base.clone();
        c.id = "2026-01-01_cccccccccccccccc".to_string();
        c.query = "qc conn".to_string();
        for case in [&b, &c] {
            store::save(&root, case).unwrap();
            store::bump(&root).unwrap();
        }
        // 迟到的 remember：只追加自己的一行，索引此时仍不覆盖 C。
        let fp_b = fingerprint(&b.query, &b.text);
        remember(&root, &fp_b, &b.id).unwrap();
        // 索引不完整 → ensure 必须重建；find(C) 应命中而不是漏判。
        let fp_c = fingerprint(&c.query, &c.text);
        assert_eq!(find(&root, &fp_c).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(c.id.as_str()));
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn delete_removes_case_and_meta() {
        let root = root("del");
        let s1 = Stats {
            kept: 1,
            total: 10,
            cut: 0.0,
            risk: "LOW".to_string(),
        };
        ingest(&root, "q1", vec![], "t1", vec![], &s1, vec![]).unwrap();
        let id = store::list(&root).unwrap()[0].clone();
        assert!(delete(&root, &id).unwrap());
        assert!(store::list(&root).unwrap().is_empty());
        let m = crate::memory::meta::load(&root).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m.case_count, 0);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 极简 JSON 子集解析/序列化（零依赖，仅覆盖本库自产自销的 case.json schema）。
//!
//! 只支持：object / array / string / number / bool / null；
//! 不支持：转义 \\uXXXX 之外的复杂规则、注释、尾逗号、科学计数法。
//! 解析失败返回 Err，序列化失败仅发生在字符串含未转义控制符时（用 escape 不会发生）。

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Val {
    Null,
    Bool(bool),
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Arr(Vec<Val>),
    Obj(Vec<(String, Val)>),
}

/// 字符串转义（JSON 字符串字面量所需的最小集）。
pub fn escape(s: &str, out: &mut String) {
    for c in s.chars() {
        glyph(c, out);
    }
}

fn glyph(c: char, out: &mut String) {
    match c {
        '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
        '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
        '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
        '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
        '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
        c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
        c => out.push(c),
    }
}

/// 序列化 Val 到字符串。
pub fn write(v: &Val) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    encode(v, &mut out);
    out
}

fn encode(v: &Val, out: &mut String) {
    match v {
        Val::Null => out.push_str("null"),
        Val::Bool(true) => out.push_str("true"),
        Val::Bool(false) => out.push_str("false"),
        Val::Num(n) => number(*n, out),
        Val::Str(s) => {
            out.push('"');
            escape(s, out);
            out.push('"');
        }
        Val::Arr(items) => array(items, out),
        Val::Obj(kvs) => object(kvs, out),
    }
}

/// 数值序列化：整数域内的 f64 写成整数形态（与解析容错口径一致）。
fn number(n: f64, out: &mut String) {
    if n.fract() == 0.0 && n.is_finite() && n.abs() < 1e15 {
        out.push_str(&format!("{}", n as i64));
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!("{}", n));
    }
}

fn array(items: &[Val], out: &mut String) {
    out.push('[');
    for (i, item) in items.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        encode(item, out);
    }
    out.push(']');
}

fn object(kvs: &[(String, Val)], out: &mut String) {
    out.push('{');
    for (i, (k, item)) in kvs.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push('"');
        escape(k, out);
        out.push_str("\":");
        encode(item, out);
    }
    out.push('}');
}

/// 最大嵌套深度：递归下降解析器在更深处直接报错，防恶意深嵌套触发栈溢出。
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 128;

/// 从字符串解析 JSON，返回 Val。递归下降，O(n)。
pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Val, String> {
    let mut p = Parser {
        bytes: s.as_bytes(),
        pos: 0,
        depth: 0,
    };
    p.space();
    let v = p.value()?;
    p.space();
    if p.pos != p.bytes.len() {
        return Err(format!("trailing bytes at {}", p.pos));
    }
    Ok(v)
}

struct Parser<'a> {
    bytes: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
    depth: usize,
}

impl<'a> Parser<'a> {
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> {
        self.bytes.get(self.pos).copied()
    }
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
        let b = self.peek();
        if b.is_some() {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        b
    }
    fn space(&mut self) {
        while self
            .peek()
            .is_some_and(|b| matches!(b, b' ' | b'\t' | b'\n' | b'\r'))
        {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
    }
    fn expect(&mut self, b: u8) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.next() == Some(b) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(format!("expected {:?} at {}", b as char, self.pos))
        }
    }
    fn value(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        if matches!(self.peek(), Some(b'{') | Some(b'[')) {
            self.depth += 1;
            if self.depth > MAX_DEPTH {
                self.depth -= 1;
                return Err(format!("nesting exceeds {MAX_DEPTH} at {}", self.pos));
            }
            let v = match self.peek() {
                Some(b'{') => self.obj(),
                Some(b'[') => self.arr(),
                _ => unreachable!("guarded by matches!"),
            };
            self.depth -= 1;
            return v;
        }
        match self.peek() {
            Some(b'"') => self.str().map(Val::Str),
            Some(b't') => self.lit("true", Val::Bool(true)),
            Some(b'f') => self.lit("false", Val::Bool(false)),
            Some(b'n') => self.lit("null", Val::Null),
            Some(b'-') | Some(b'0'..=b'9') => self.num(),
            Some(other) => Err(format!(
                "unexpected byte {:?} at {}",
                other as char, self.pos
            )),
            None => Err("unexpected end of input".to_string()),
        }
    }
    fn lit(&mut self, word: &str, v: Val) -> Result<Val, String> {
        for (i, b) in word.bytes().enumerate() {
            if self.bytes.get(self.pos + i) != Some(&b) {
                return Err(format!("expected literal {} at {}", word, self.pos));
            }
        }
        self.pos += word.len();
        Ok(v)
    }
    fn str(&mut self) -> Result<String, String> {
        self.expect(b'"')?;
        let mut out = String::new();
        let mut raw: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        let flush = |out: &mut String, raw: &mut Vec<u8>| -> Result<(), String> {
            if !raw.is_empty() {
                let s =
                    std::str::from_utf8(raw).map_err(|_| "invalid utf8 in string".to_string())?;
                out.push_str(s);
                raw.clear();
            }
            Ok(())
        };
        loop {
            match self.next() {
                Some(b'"') => {
                    flush(&mut out, &mut raw)?;
                    return Ok(out);
                }
                Some(b'\\') => {
                    flush(&mut out, &mut raw)?;
                    match self.next() {
                        Some(b'"') => out.push('"'),
                        Some(b'\\') => out.push('\\'),
                        Some(b'n') => out.push('\n'),
                        Some(b'r') => out.push('\r'),
                        Some(b't') => out.push('\t'),
                        Some(b'b') => out.push('\u{8}'),
                        Some(b'f') => out.push('\u{c}'),
                        Some(b'u') => {
                            let mut code = 0u32;
                            for _ in 0..4 {
                                let c = self.next().ok_or("truncated \\u escape")?;
                                let d = (c as char).to_digit(16).ok_or("bad \\u escape")?;
                                code = code * 16 + d;
                            }
                            out.push(char::from_u32(code).ok_or("bad \\u codepoint")?);
                        }
                        Some(other) => return Err(format!("bad escape {:?}", other as char)),
                        None => return Err("truncated escape".to_string()),
                    }
                }
                Some(b) if (b as char).is_ascii_control() => {
                    return Err(format!("unescaped control byte 0x{:02x}", b));
                }
                Some(b) => raw.push(b),
                None => return Err("unterminated string".to_string()),
            }
        }
    }
    fn num(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        let start = self.pos;
        while self
            .peek()
            .is_some_and(|b| matches!(b, b'-' | b'+' | b'.' | b'e' | b'E' | b'0'..=b'9'))
        {
            self.pos += 1;
        }
        let txt = std::str::from_utf8(&self.bytes[start..self.pos]).map_err(|_| "bad number")?;
        txt.parse::<f64>()
            .map(Val::Num)
            .map_err(|_| format!("bad number {:?}", txt))
    }
    fn arr(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        self.expect(b'[')?;
        let mut items = Vec::new();
        self.space();
        if self.peek() == Some(b']') {
            self.next();
            return Ok(Val::Arr(items));
        }
        loop {
            self.space();
            items.push(self.value()?);
            self.space();
            if !self.separator(b']', "array")? {
                return Ok(Val::Arr(items));
            }
        }
    }
    fn obj(&mut self) -> Result<Val, String> {
        self.expect(b'{')?;
        let mut kvs = Vec::new();
        self.space();
        if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {
            self.next();
            return Ok(Val::Obj(kvs));
        }
        loop {
            self.space();
            let key = self.str()?;
            self.space();
            self.expect(b':')?;
            self.space();
            let v = self.value()?;
            kvs.push((key, v));
            self.space();
            if !self.separator(b'}', "object")? {
                return Ok(Val::Obj(kvs));
            }
        }
    }

    /// 容器分隔符：`,` 继续、闭合符结束；其余或 EOF 报错。
    fn separator(&mut self, close: u8, name: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
        match self.next() {
            Some(b',') => Ok(true),
            Some(c) if c == close => Ok(false),
            Some(other) => Err(format!(
                "expected , or {} got {:?}",
                close as char, other as char
            )),
            None => Err(format!("unterminated {name}")),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn roundtrip(v: &Val) -> Val {
        parse(&write(v)).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn scalar_roundtrip() {
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Null), Val::Null);
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Bool(true)), Val::Bool(true));
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Num(42.0)), Val::Num(42.0));
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&Val::Num(-1.5)), Val::Num(-1.5));
        assert_eq!(
            roundtrip(&Val::Str("中文 \"q\" \\ \n".to_string())),
            Val::Str("中文 \"q\" \\ \n".to_string())
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn nested_roundtrip() {
        let v = Val::Obj(vec![
            (
                "id".to_string(),
                Val::Str("2026-10-22_a1b2c3d4".to_string()),
            ),
            ("n".to_string(), Val::Num(3.0)),
            (
                "arr".to_string(),
                Val::Arr(vec![Val::Bool(true), Val::Null, Val::Str("x".to_string())]),
            ),
            (
                "fields".to_string(),
                Val::Obj(vec![(
                    "error_code".to_string(),
                    Val::Arr(vec![Val::Str("conn_id=9f2a".to_string())]),
                )]),
            ),
        ]);
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&v), v);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_errors() {
        assert!(parse("{").is_err());
        assert!(parse("{\"a\":}").is_err());
        assert!(parse("[1,2,]").is_err());
        assert!(parse("").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cjk_and_utf8_roundtrip() {
        let v = Val::Str("数据库连接超时 conn_id=9f2a 🚀".to_string());
        assert_eq!(roundtrip(&v), v);
    }

    #[test]
    fn write_format_sanity() {
        assert_eq!(
            write(&Val::Obj(vec![("a".to_string(), Val::Num(1.0))])),
            "{\"a\":1}"
        );
        assert_eq!(write(&Val::Str("a\"b".to_string())), "\"a\\\"b\"");
        assert_eq!(write(&Val::Arr(vec![])), "[]");
    }

    #[test]
    fn deep_nesting_is_rejected_not_stack_overflow() {
        let ok = format!("{}1{}", "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH), "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH));
        assert!(parse(&ok).is_ok(), "深度内应正常解析");
        let over = format!(
            "{}1{}",
            "[".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1),
            "]".repeat(MAX_DEPTH + 1)
        );
        let err = parse(&over).unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.contains("nesting"), "超深应报错而非栈溢出: {err}");
    }

    /// 确定性生成器：覆盖标量、嵌套数组/对象与需要转义的字符串。
    fn gen(next: &mut dyn FnMut() -> u32, depth: usize) -> Val {
        match next() % if depth >= 3 { 4 } else { 6 } {
            0 => Val::Null,
            1 => Val::Bool(next() % 2 == 0),
            2 => Val::Num((next() % 10_000) as f64 / 8.0),
            _ => {
                if next() % 2 == 0 && depth < 3 {
                    let n = next() % 4;
                    Val::Arr((0..n).map(|_| gen(next, depth + 1)).collect())
                } else if next() % 3 == 0 && depth < 3 {
                    let n = next() % 4;
                    Val::Obj(
                        (0..n)
                            .map(|i| (format!("k{i}"), gen(next, depth + 1)))
                            .collect(),
                    )
                } else {
                    // 覆盖需要转义的字符与多字节文本。
                    let pool: Vec<char> = "a\"\\\n\r\t\u{1}中文🚀 ".chars().collect();
                    let n = next() as usize % 8;
                    let mut s = String::new();
                    for _ in 0..n {
                        s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
                    }
                    Val::Str(s)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn roundtrip_write_parse_on_generated_values() {
        let mut state = 0x1234_abcdu32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..500 {
            let v = gen(&mut next, 0);
            let txt = write(&v);
            assert_eq!(parse(&txt), Ok(v), "往返不一致: {txt}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_never_panics_on_garbage() {
        let pool: Vec<char> = "{}[]\",:.-+0123456789eE_ \n\t\\/:中文🚀\u{0}naNs"
            .chars()
            .collect();
        let mut state = 0x0bad_f00du32;
        let mut next = || {
            state = state.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            state
        };
        for _ in 0..1500 {
            let n = next() as usize % 40;
            let mut s = String::new();
            for _ in 0..n {
                s.push(pool[next() as usize % pool.len()]);
            }
            // 不得 panic；Ok/Err 都合法。
            let _ = parse(&s);
        }
    }
}

//! 跨进程写锁与原子写（零依赖）。
//!
//! 记忆库允许多个 `scx` 进程共享同一 `--mem-dir`（例如并行 agent / 终端）。
//! 原先的 `fs::write(tmp) + rename` 使用固定临时名，且 `meta.toml` 的
//! read-modify-write 没有跨进程互斥：并发写会互相 rename、丢 gen 更新。
//!
//! 本模块提供两件互补的机制：
//! - `atomic`：每次写入使用唯一临时名 + rename，保证读者只看到旧文件
//!   或完整新文件（防半写）；Windows 上对短暂 sharing violation 做有限重试。
//! - `acquire`：`create_new` 锁文件 + 超时/陈旧锁回收，保护 meta/qmap/index
//!   这类 read-modify-write 或追加写。锁内容带唯一 token，Drop 只删除自己的锁，
//!   避免“陈旧锁被抢走后误删新持有者”的竞态。

use std::fs::{self, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::thread;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// 等锁上限：meta/qmap 写都是毫秒级，10s 足够覆盖磁盘抖动。
const LOCK_WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// 陈旧锁阈值：持锁超过 15s 视为进程崩溃遗留（正常写远小于此）。
const LOCK_STALE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
const RETRY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(10);

static TOKEN_SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

/// 建目录（Windows 杀毒/索引器短暂占用时重试 PermissionDenied）。
pub(crate) fn mkdir(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    for attempt in 0..3 {
        match fs::create_dir_all(path) {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                let transient = e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied;
                last = Some(e);
                if !transient || attempt == 2 {
                    break;
                }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("create_dir_all always records an error"))
}

/// 锁守卫：作用域结束自动释放（只删自己 token 的锁文件）。
pub(crate) struct Lock {
    path: PathBuf,
    token: String,
}

impl Drop for Lock {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // 被判定陈旧后可能已被新持有者替换：只删自己的 token。
        if let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&self.path) {
            if txt.trim() == self.token {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// 获取 `<root>/<name>` 锁；超时返回 `WouldBlock`。
pub(crate) fn acquire(root: &str, name: &str) -> io::Result<Lock> {
    let path = Path::new(root).join(name);
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        mkdir(dir)?;
    }
    let seq = TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let token = format!("{}-{seq}", std::process::id());
    let deadline = Instant::now() + LOCK_WAIT;
    let mut permission_retries = 0u32;
    loop {
        match OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(&path) {
            Ok(f) => return finish(&path, f, &token),
            Err(e) if contended(e.kind()) => {
                wait(&path, deadline, &e, &mut permission_retries)?;
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
}

fn contended(kind: io::ErrorKind) -> bool {
    kind == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists || kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied
}

fn finish(path: &Path, mut f: fs::File, token: &str) -> io::Result<Lock> {
    // token 落盘后其它进程才可能看到锁；写失败则移除，避免假锁。
    if let Err(e) = writeln!(f, "{token}") {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
        return Err(e);
    }
    Ok(Lock {
        path: path.to_path_buf(),
        token: token.to_string(),
    })
}

fn wait(
    path: &Path,
    deadline: Instant,
    original: &io::Error,
    permission_retries: &mut u32,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let kind = original.kind();
    // Windows：锁文件 pending-delete 时 CreateFile(CREATE_NEW) 返回
    // ACCESS_DENIED；给 1s 让删除完成，超过按真实权限错误返回。
    if kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied {
        *permission_retries += 1;
        if *permission_retries > 100 {
            return Err(io::Error::new(kind, format!("memory lock: {original}")));
        }
    }
    if stale(path) {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
        return Ok(());
    }
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
        return Err(io::Error::new(
            io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
            format!("memory lock busy: {}", path.display()),
        ));
    }
    thread::sleep(RETRY);
    Ok(())
}

/// 按固定序一次性获取多把锁（锁序契约见 `docs/locking.md`）。
///
/// 任一锁获取失败时，已持有的锁随守卫 `Drop` 逆序自动释放——绝不半持锁返回。
/// 调用方必须按契约顺序传 `names`（细粒度在前、粗粒度在后），禁止自行穿插。
pub(crate) fn locks(root: &str, names: &[&str]) -> io::Result<Vec<Lock>> {
    let mut guards = Vec::with_capacity(names.len());
    for name in names {
        guards.push(acquire(root, name)?);
    }
    Ok(guards)
}

fn stale(path: &Path) -> bool {
    fs::metadata(path)
        .and_then(|m| m.modified())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|t| t.elapsed().ok())
        .is_some_and(|age| age > LOCK_STALE)
}

/// 唯一临时名 + rename 的原子写。
///
/// 说明：保证“不会读到半写文件”，不做 fsync 级别的掉电持久化；case/meta 都是
/// 可再生/可重建数据，崩溃后最坏回到上一个完整版本。每次写使用
/// `<name>.tmp.<pid>.<seq>`，并发写不会互相覆盖临时文件。
pub(crate) fn atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        mkdir(dir)?;
    }
    let base = path.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("data");
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    // Windows 杀毒/索引器会短暂锁住目标或临时文件；PermissionDenied 时换新
    // 临时名重试整次写，避免把可恢复的文件占用报成记忆写入失败。
    for attempt in 0..3 {
        let seq = TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let tmp = path.with_file_name(format!("{base}.tmp.{}.{seq}", std::process::id()));
        let result = once(&tmp, path, bytes);
        match result {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp);
                let transient = retry(e.kind());
                last = Some(io::Error::new(
                    e.kind(),
                    format!("atomic write {}: {e}", path.display()),
                ));
                if !transient || attempt == 2 {
                    break;
                }
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("atomic always records an error"))
}

fn once(tmp: &Path, path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut f = OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(tmp)?;
    f.write_all(bytes)?;
    drop(f);
    rename(tmp, path)
}

fn retry(kind: io::ErrorKind) -> bool {
    kind == io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied || kind == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
}

/// Windows 上目标文件可能被短暂打开（杀毒/索引/读者），rename 做有限重试。
fn rename(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut last: Option<io::Error> = None;
    for attempt in 0..10 {
        match fs::rename(from, to) {
            Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
            Err(e) => {
                last = Some(e);
                if attempt < 9 {
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last.expect("rename retry always records an error"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::memory::util::root;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::thread;

    #[test]
    fn atomic_keeps_last_complete_value() {
        let root = root("atomic");
        let p = Path::new(&root).join("value.txt");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for i in 0..8 {
            let p = p.clone();
            handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {
                atomic(&p, format!("value-{i}").as_bytes()).unwrap();
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        let got = fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap();
        assert!(got.starts_with("value-"), "必须是某次完整写入: {got}");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn lock_serializes_and_releases() {
        let root = root("lock");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        let root = Arc::new(root);
        let mut handles = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..4 {
            let root = root.clone();
            handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {
                for _ in 0..10 {
                    let _g = acquire(&root, "test.lock").unwrap();
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
                }
            }));
        }
        for h in handles {
            h.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert!(!Path::new(root.as_str()).join("test.lock").exists());
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root.as_str());
    }

    #[test]
    fn locks_fixed_order_and_failure_releases() {
        let root = root("lock_all");
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
        // 固定序获取成功，Drop 逆序释放后锁文件全部消失。
        {
            let _g = locks(&root, &["a.lock", "b.lock", "c.lock"]).unwrap();
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists());
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("b.lock").exists());
            assert!(Path::new(&root).join("c.lock").exists());
        }
        assert!(!Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists());
        // 中途失败：已持锁逆序释放，不留半持状态。
        let _held = acquire(&root, "b.lock").unwrap();
        let err = match locks(&root, &["a.lock", "b.lock"]) {
            Ok(_) => panic!("locks 必须失败"),
            Err(e) => e,
        };
        assert_eq!(err.kind(), io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock);
        assert!(!Path::new(&root).join("a.lock").exists(), "a 必须已释放");
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
    }
}

//! 库维护：索引重建、过期清理、case 删除与 `--stats` 盘点。
//!
//! - rebuild：全量重建 postings.bin（index::build）+ qmap 合并（同指纹取 recency
//!   最新）+ df 快照写回 meta.toml [df]（评估与召回共用的 IDF 数据源）+ 写
//!   不改变索引启用策略（索引只是可丢弃缓存）。
//! - gc：expire 双条件（meta [params] gc_ttl_regressed=180 / gc_ttl_stale=365）：
//!   regressed 且超期，或从未反馈（quality=0）且陈旧 → 物理删除 + 索引作废。
//! - delete：物理删除 + 惰性作废索引（删 postings.bin，回退线性；重建由
//!   rebuild/自动构建恢复）。
//!
//! 索引是可丢弃缓存（index/）：任何维护操作不触碰 cases/ 资产；坏段由
//! index::load 校验报告，重建覆盖。

use crate::memory::cache;
use crate::memory::index;
use crate::memory::store;
use crate::memory::util::{parse, stamp};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::io;
use std::path::Path;

/// 全量重建索引 + qmap 合并 + df 快照。返回 (n_docs, n_terms)。
pub(crate) fn rebuild(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<(usize, usize)> {
    store::ensure(root)?;
    // 1) 倒排索引全量重建（确定性：case id 排序 + term 字典序）；df 快照随建随取。
    let (n_docs, n_terms, df) = index::build(root)?;
    // 2) qmap 合并：同归一化 query 只留 recency 最新一条。
    cache::merge(root)?;
    // 3) df 快照写 meta.toml [df]；不改 index_force（重建不得改变召回语义）。
    write(root, n_docs, &df);
    Ok((n_docs, n_terms))
}

/// 过期清理：删除满足 expire 双条件的 case。返回删除数。
pub(crate) fn gc(root: &str) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let ttl_regressed = meta.param("gc_ttl_regressed");
    let ttl_stale = meta.param("gc_ttl_stale");
    let now_s = parse(&stamp());
    let mut removed = 0usize;
    for id in store::list(root)? {
        let Ok(c) = store::load(root, &id) else {
            continue;
        };
        if expired(&c, now_s, ttl_regressed, ttl_stale) && delete(root, &id).unwrap_or(false) {
            removed += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok(removed)
}

/// 过期双条件：regressed 超短 TTL，或从未反馈且无 fix 且陈旧。
fn expired(c: &store::Case, now_s: u64, ttl_regressed: f64, ttl_stale: f64) -> bool {
    let age_days = now_s.saturating_sub(parse(&c.updated_at)) as f64 / 86_400.0;
    (c.status == "regressed" && age_days > ttl_regressed)
        || (c.quality == 0.0 && c.fix.is_empty() && age_days > ttl_stale)
}

/// 删除一个 case（物理删除 + 惰性作废索引 + 库代际前进）。
/// id 先过白名单校验，禁止 `..` 与路径分隔符逃逸。
/// 返回是否存在。
pub(crate) fn delete(root: &str, id: &str) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    // id 白名单必须先于取锁：锁名 `cases/{id}.lock` 与目录 `cases/{id}` 都以
    // 用户输入拼接，`Path::join` 遇绝对路径会整段替换、遇 `../` 会逃逸目录。
    if !store::valid(id) {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            format!("invalid case id: {id}"),
        ));
    }
    // 锁序契约（docs/locking.md）：case → index → meta → qmap，细粒度在前。
    // locks 按固定序一次性取齐，任一把失败即整体放弃（已持锁逆序释放），
    // 绝不半持锁返回；meta 的写入用 *_locked 变体避免自死锁。
    let _guards = crate::memory::lock::locks(
        root,
        &[
            &format!("cases/{id}.lock"),
            "index.lock",
            "meta.lock",
            "qmap.lock",
        ],
    )?;
    let dir = Path::new(root).join("cases").join(id);
    if !dir.exists() {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    fs::remove_dir_all(dir)?;
    index::clear(root);
    store::recount(root)?;
    crate::memory::ingest::invalidate(root);
    crate::memory::meta::advance(root)?;
    let _ = fs::remove_file(cache::path(root));
    Ok(true)
}

/// 写 meta.toml [df] 快照（来自 index::build）。
/// 不写 `index_force`：索引只是缓存，重建不得改变召回语义
/// （线性/索引两条路径的 df/avgdl 均为全库口径，桶过滤只裁候选；强制索引只用于
/// A/B 对拍，不写回 meta）。索引启用只由规模阈值决定。失败静默旁路。
fn write(root: &str, n_docs: usize, df: &[(String, usize)]) {
    let Ok(_g) = crate::memory::lock::acquire(root, "meta.lock") else {
        return;
    };
    let p = Path::new(root).join("meta.toml");
    let Ok(txt) = fs::read_to_string(&p) else {
        return;
    };
    // 持 meta.lock 重数一遍：build 起点到此处之间可能有并发 ingest 新增 case 并
    // 已 recount 回写，用 build 时的 n_docs 会把计数覆盖回旧值。
    let n_docs = store::list(root).map(|v| v.len()).unwrap_or(n_docs);
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut wrote_df = false;
    for line in txt.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if section(t) {
            if t == "[df]" {
                // 跳过旧 df 节，统一在末尾重写。
                wrote_df = true;
                continue;
            }
            if insert(wrote_df, df) {
                out.extend(block(df));
                wrote_df = true;
            }
        }
        if t.starts_with("case_count") {
            out.push(format!("case_count = {n_docs}"));
            continue;
        }
        out.push(line.to_string());
    }
    if insert(wrote_df, df) {
        out.extend(block(df));
    }
    let mut body = out.join("\n");
    body.push('\n');
    let _ = crate::memory::lock::atomic(&p, body.as_bytes());
}

fn section(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.starts_with('[') && t.ends_with(']')
}

fn insert(wrote_df: bool, df: &[(String, usize)]) -> bool {
    !wrote_df && !df.is_empty()
}

fn block(df: &[(String, usize)]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = vec!["[df]".to_string()];
    for (k, v) in df {
        out.push(format!("{k} = {v}"));
    }
    out.push(String::new());
    out
}

/// `--stats` 盘点：case/桶/状态/fix 覆盖率/质量/磁盘占用。
pub(crate) fn stats(root: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let meta = crate::memory::meta::load(root)?;
    let ids = store::list(root)?;
    let mut buckets: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut statuses: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut fixes = 0usize;
    let mut quality_sum = 0.0f64;
    let mut disk = 0u64;
    for id in &ids {
        sample(
            root,
            id,
            &mut buckets,
            &mut statuses,
            &mut fixes,
            &mut quality_sum,
            &mut disk,
        )?;
    }
    let n = ids.len();
    let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(6);
    lines.push(format!("stats: cases={} gen={}", n, meta.gen));
    lines.push(format!("  bucket: {}", join(&buckets)));
    lines.push(format!("  status: {}", join(&statuses)));
    lines.push(format!(
        "  fix: {}/{} ({:.0}%)",
        fixes,
        n,
        if n == 0 {
            0.0
        } else {
            100.0 * fixes as f64 / n as f64
        }
    ));
    lines.push(format!(
        "  quality: mean={:.2}",
        if n == 0 { 0.0 } else { quality_sum / n as f64 }
    ));
    lines.push(format!("  disk: {:.1} KiB", disk as f64 / 1024.0));
    Ok(lines)
}

fn sample(
    root: &str,
    id: &str,
    buckets: &mut HashMap<String, usize>,
    statuses: &mut HashMap<String, usize>,
    fixes: &mut usize,
    quality_sum: &mut f64,
    disk: &mut u64,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let c = store::load(root, id)?;
    *buckets.entry(c.bucket.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    *statuses.entry(c.status.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
    if !c.fix.is_empty() {
        *fixes += 1;
    }
